src: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
mt: "Manje sinezimbuzi ezinezinyanga ezine ubudala ezingenawo ushukela ezazikade zinoshukela", enezela.
ref: "Manje sinamagundane anezinyanga ezingu-4 angenawo ushukela ayenoshukela," wanezela.

src: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
mt: UDkt. Ehud Ur, uprofesa wezokwelapha eDalhousie University eHalifax, eNova Scotia futhi ongusihlalo wesigaba sezokwelapha nesosayensi se-Canadian Diabetes Association waxwayisa ngokuthi ucwaningo lusesezinsukwini zalo zokuqala.
ref: UDkt. Ehud Ur, usolwazi wezokwelapha eNyuvesi yaseDalhousie eHalifax, eNova Scotia kanye nosihlalo womnyango wezokwelapha nowesayensi weCanadian Diabetes Association uxwayise ngokuthi ucwaningo lusanda kuqala.

src: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
mt: Njengabanye ochwepheshe, ungabaza ukuthi isifo sikashukela singaphulukiswa yini, ephawula ukuthi lezi zimpumelelo azisebenzi kubantu asebenesifo sikashukela sohlobo 1.
ref: Njengezinye izazi, unokungabaza ukuthi isifo sikashukela singalashwa, ephawula ukuthi lokhu okutholakele akubathinti asebevele benesifo sikashukela soHlobo loku-1.

src: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
mt: NgoMsombuluko, uSara Danius, unobhala ohlala njalo weKomidi leNobel leNcwadi eSweden Academy, wamemezela esidlangalaleni ngesikhathi sohlelo lomsakazo ku-Sveriges Radio eSweden ukuthi ikomidi, elingakwazi ukufinyelela kuBob Dylan ngokuqondile ngokuwina uMklomelo kaNobel weNcwadi ka-2016, liyekile imizamo yalo yokufinyelela kuye.
ref: NgoMsombuluko, uSara Danius, unobhala wesikhathi sonkeweKomidi leNobel for Literature eSwedish Academy, umemezele obala phakathi nohlelo lomsakazo eSveriges Radio eSweden ikomiti, njengoba lingakwazi ukufinyelela kuBob Dylan ngokuqondile mayelana nokunqoba Umklomelo weNobel weZincwadi ka-2016, liyeke imizamo yokumfinyelela.

src: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
mt: UDanius wathi, "Njengamanje asenzi lutho. Ngishayele futhi ngathumela ama-imeyili kumuntu osebenzisana naye eduze kakhulu futhi ngithole izimpendulo ezinobungane kakhulu. Okwamanje, lokho kwanele".
ref: UDanius wathi, “Okwamanje asenzi lutho. Sengishayele ucingo ngaphinde ngathumela ama-imeyile kwabasondelene naye kakhulu asebenzisana nabo futhi ngathola izimpendulo ezinobungane. Okwamanje, lokho ngokuqinisekile kwanele.”

src: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
mt: Ngaphambilini, isikhulu esiphezulu seRing, uJamie Siminoff, waphawula ukuthi inkampani yaqala lapho insimbi yomnyango wakhe ingekho esitolo sakhe egaraji lakhe.
ref: Phambilini, isikhulu esiphezulu sakwa-Ring, u-Jamie Siminoff, sathi le nkampani yaqala ngenkathi kungezwakali ukuthi kukhona ongqongqozayo emnyango uma esesitolo sakhe esisegalaji lakhe.

src: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
mt: Wakha isilinda somnyango we-WiFi, esho.
ref: Wakhe insimbi yasemnyango yeWiFi, washo.

src: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
mt: USiminoff uthe ukuthengisa kwanda ngemuva kokuvela kwakhe ngo-2013 esiqeshini se-Shark Tank lapho iphaneli yombukiso yenqabile ukusiza ukuqala.
ref: USminoff uthe izintengo zanyuka ngemva kokuvela kwakhe embukwisweni we-Shark Tank ngo-2013 lapho iphaneli yohlelo yenqaba ukusekela ibhizinisi ngezimali.

src: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
mt: Ngasekupheleni kuka-2017, uSiminoff wavela esiteshini sethelevishini sokuthenga iQVC.
ref: Ekupheleni kuka-2017, iSiminoff savela ohlelweni lokuthengisa lukamabonakude iQVC.

src: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
mt: URing uphinde waxazulula icala nenkampani yezokuphepha enengxabano, i-ADT Corporation.
ref: U-Ring wabuye waxazulula icala nenkampani ancintisana nayo yezokuphepha, i-ADT Corporation.

src: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
mt: Nakuba umuthi wokugoma oyisibonelo ubonakala ukunciphisa ukufa kwabantu nge-Ebola, kuze kube manje, awukho umuthi oye waboniswa ngokucacile ukuthi ufanelekile ekwelapheni ukutheleleka okukhona.
ref: Nakuba umjovo wokulinga ubonakala ukwazi ukunciphisa ukufa okubangelwa yi-Ebola, kuze kube manje, ayikho imithi eboniswe ngokucacile ukuthi ifanelekela ukulapha isifo esikhona.

src: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
mt: I-antibody cocktail eyodwa, i-ZMapp, ekuqaleni yayithembisa ensimini, kodwa ucwaningo olwenziwa ngokusemthethweni lwabonisa ukuthi yayinzuzo encane kunalokho okufunwa ekuvimbeleni ukufa.
ref: I-cocktail eyodwa nje emzimbeni, ZMapp, ekuqaleni ibonakale ithembisa ensimini, kodwa ngokocwaningo kubonisa ukuthi inomthelela omncane kunalowo obucatshwangwa ekuvimbeleni ukufa.

src: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
mt: Esivivinyweni se-PALM, i-ZMapp yasebenza njengendlela yokulawula, okusho ukuthi ososayensi bayisebenzisa njengendlela yokusungula futhi baqhathanisa ezinye izindlela ezintathu zokwelapha nalo.
ref: Ekuhloleni kwe-PALM, i-ZMapp yasebenza njengesifaniso, okusho ukuthi ososayensi bayisebenzisa njengesiqalo sokuqhathanisa futhi baqhathanisa amanye amakhambi amathathu okwelapha nayo.

src: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
mt: I-USA Gymnastics isekela incwadi yeKomidi Lama-Olimpiki lase-United States futhi yamukela isidingo esiphelele somndeni wama-Olimpiki sokukhuthaza indawo ephephile yabo bonke abasubathi bethu.
ref: I-USA Gymnastics isekela incwadi yeKomiti lama-Olimpiki laseMelika futhi kwamukela isidingo esiphelele sokuba umndeni wama-Olimpiki ukhathaze indawo ephephile yabadlali bethu bonke.

src: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
mt: Siyavumelana nesitatimende se-USOC sokuthi izintshisekelo zabadlali bethu namaqembu, nemidlalo yabo, zingase zilungiselelwe kangcono ngokuqhubekela phambili noshintsho olunengqondo ngaphakathi kwenhlangano yethu, kunokuba kuhoxiswe isitifiketi.
ref: Sivumelana nesitatimende se-USOC ukuthi izintshisekelo zabadlali kanye namaqembu, kanye nemidlalo yabo, zingakhonzwa kangcono ngokuyaphambili ngoshintsho olunenjongo phakathi kwenhlangano yethu, kunokuthathelwa izitifiketi.

src: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
mt: I-USA Gymnastics isekela uphenyo oluzimele olungafaka ukukhanya ngokuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwesilinganiso esichazwe ngesibindi ngabasindile bakaLarry Nassar kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi akuzange kutholakale isikhathi eside futhi kwamukele noma yiziphi izinguquko ezidingekayo nezilungelekile.
ref: I-USA Gymnastics isekela uphenyo oluzimele olungaveza ukukhanya  ngokuhlukunyezwa kwenxenye echazwe ngesibindi yilabo abasinde kuLarry Nassar obekungenzeka kungabonwa ngayo isikhathi eside kangaka futhi yamukela noma iziphi izinguquko ezidingekayo nezifanele.

src: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
mt: I-USA Gymnastics ne-USOC banomgomo ofanayo - ukwenza umdlalo we-gymnastics, nabanye, uphephe ngangokunokwenzeka kubagijimi ukulandela amaphupho abo endaweni ephephile, enhle futhi enamandla.
ref: I-USA Gymnastic kanye ne-USOC zinomgomo ofanayao — ukwenza umdlalo wezokuzivivinya komzimba, kanye neminye, iphephe ngangokunokwenzeka ukuba abadlali balandele amaphupho wabo endaweni ephephile, enhle kanye nenika amandla.

src: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
mt: Kuwo wonke ama-1960, uBrezinski wasebenzela uJohn F. Kennedy njengomeluleki wakhe wabe esebamba iqhaza kuhulumeni kaLyndon B. Johnson.
ref: Kuyo yonke iminyaka yawo-1960, uBrzezinski wasebenzela uJohn F. Kennedy njengomeluleki wakhe bese uhulumeni kaLyndon B. Johnson.

src: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
mt: Phakathi nokukhethwa kuka-1976 weluleka uCarter ngezepolitiki zangaphandle, wabe eseba uMeluleki Wezokuphepha Kazwelonke (NSA) kusukela ngo-1977 kuya ku-1981, eshintsha uHenry Kissinger.
ref: Phakathi nokhetho luka-1976 waluleka uCarter ngemithetho yakwamanye amazwe, bese wasesebenza njenge-National Security Advisor (NSA) kusuka ngo-1977 kuya ku-1981, ethatha isikhundla sikaHenry Kissinger.

src: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
mt: Njenge-NSA, wasiza uCarter ekuphatheni izindaba zomhlaba ngodiploma, njengezivumelwano zaseCamp David, ngo-1978; ukuvuselelwa kobudlelwano baseMelika neChina kwakubonakala ngasekupheleni kwawo-1970, i-Iranian Revolution, eyaholela enkingeni yezitho zangasese zase-Iran, ngo-1979; nokuhlasela kweSoviet e-Afghanistan, ngo-1979.
ref: Njenge-NSA, usize uCarter ngokuphatha izindaba zezwe ngokusemthethweni, njenge-Camp David Accords, 1978; ukwenza kube nobudlelwane obuvamile phakathi kweMelika neShayina ekupheleni kwawo-1970; Ushintsho lwase-Iran, olwaholela enhlekeleleni yezithunjwa zase-Iran, ngo-1979; kanye nokuhlasela kweSoviet e-Afghanistan, ngo-1979.

src: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
mt: Le filimu, eyayibandakanya uRyan Gosling no-Emma Stone, yathola ukuqokwa kuzo zonke izigaba ezinkulu.
ref: Ifilimu, eno-Ryan Gosling noEmma Stone, ikhethelwe ukuwina kuzo zonke izigaba ezinkulu.

src: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
mt: UGosling noStone bathola ukuqokwa komlingisi nomlingisi ongcono kakhulu ngokulandelana.
ref: U-Gosling no-Stone bathole ukuqokwa kwe-Best Actor no-Actress ngokulandelana kwabo.

src: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
mt: Ezinye izinqunyiwe zihlanganisa i-Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing kanye ne- Original Screenplay.
ref: Abanye abakhethiwe bahlanganisa neSithombe Esihle Kakhulu, Umqondisi Webhayisikobho, Umklami Wezimpahla, Umhleli-wefilimu, Umculo, Umklamo Womkhiqizo, Ukuhlelwa Komsindo, Ukuhlanganiswa Komsindo kanye Nombhalo weFilimu Wangempela.

src: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
mt: Izingoma ezimbili ezivela kule filimu, i-Audition (The Fools Who Dream) neCity of Stars, zithole ukuqokwa kwengoma engcono kakhulu yokuqala. Isitudiyo iLionsgate yathola ukuqokwa okungama-26 - ngaphezu kwanoma iyiphi enye isitudiyo.
ref: Izingoma ezimbili ezivela kwifilimu, i-Audition (The Fools Who Dream) kanye ne-City of Stars, zithole ukuqokelwa kwengoma yangempela ehamba phambili. Isitudiyo se-Lionsgate sikhethwe izikhathi ezingu-26 — ukudlula noma esiphi Isitudiyo.

src: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
mt: Ngasekupheleni kweSonto, uMongameli wase-United States uDonald Trump, esitatimendeni asethula ngoNobhala Wezindaba, wamemezela ukuthi amasosha ase-US azophuma eSyria.
ref: Ntambama ngeSonto, uMongameli waseMelika u-Donald Trump, esitatimendeni esikhishwe unobhala wephephandaba, umemezele ukuthi amasosha aseMelika azoshiya elaseSiriya.

src: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
mt: Lesi simemezelo senziwa ngemva kokuba uTrump eningxoxo yocingo noMongameli waseTurkey uRecep Tayyip Erdoğan.
ref: Isimemezelo senziwa ngemva kokuba u-Trump eshayele uMongameli waseTheki uRecep Tayyip Erdoğan ucingo.

src: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
mt: I-Turkey izophinde ithathe ukuqapha izishoshovu ze-ISIS ezithathwe, okusho isitatimende, ukuthi amazwe aseYurophu enqabile ukubuyisela emuva.
ref: ITheki izophatha ukugada amasosha we-ISIS athunjiwe lawo, ngokwesitatimende, amazwe waseYurophu anqabe ukuwalanda.

src: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
mt: Lokhu akuqinisekisi nje kuphela ukuthi okungenani amanye ama-dinosaur ayenamaqabunga, okuyisimo esivele sesisakazeke, kodwa kunikeza imininingwane ama-fossil ngokuvamile angakwazi, njengombala nokuhlelwa kwezinkomba ezintathu.
ref: Lokhu akugcini nje ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani amanye ama-dinosaur ayenezimpaphe, inkolelo-mbono ebanzi kakade, kepha inikezela imininingwane imivubukulo engayinikezi ngokujwayelekile, njengombala nokuhleleka kwezinhlangothi ezintathu.

src: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
mt: Ososayensi bathi izimpaphe zalesi silwane zazinombala onjengekastani phezulu futhi zinombala ophansi ophuzi noma onombala we-carotenoid.
ref: . Ososayensi bathi iplamu lalesi silwane lalinesifuba esinsundu ngaphezulu siphaphathekile nokumibalabala emaceleni.

src: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
mt: Okutholakale kunikeza nokuqonda ngokuziphendukela kwemiphiko ezinyoni.
ref: Ucwaningo lunikeza nokuqonda ngokuvela kwezimpaphe ezinyonini.

src: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
mt: Ngenxa yokuthi izimpaphe zama-dinosaur azinawo umsele othuthukile, obizwa ngokuthi i-rachis, kodwa zinokunye izici zezinsiza - izimbadada nama-barbules - abacwaningi baphetha ngokuthi i-rachis kungenzeka ukuthi yaba ukuthuthuka kokuziphendukela kwemvelo kamuva kunezinye lezi zimpawu.
ref: Ngenxa yokuthi izimpaphe zama-dinosaur aziso isiqu esikhule kahle, osibizwa ngokuthi i-rachis, kodwa zinezinye izici zezimpaphe — izindlendla kanye nama-barbule — abacwaningi baphethe ngokuthi i-rachis cishe bekungukwakheka kokuziphendukela kunalezinye izici.

src: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
mt: Isakhiwo sezinsiza zikhombisa ukuthi zazingasetshenziselwa ukudubula kodwa zazisetshenziselwa ukulawula izinga lokushisa noma ukubonisa. Abacwaningi basikisela ukuthi, nakuba lokhu kungumsila wedinozaur entsha, isampula libonisa izimpaphe zabantu abadala hhayi phansi kwenkukhu.
ref: Ukwakheka kwezimpaphe kusikisela ukuthi bezingasetshenziselwa ukundiza kodwa kunalokho ukulawula ukushisa kanye nokuzibonakalisa. Abacwaningi basikisela ukuthi, nakuba lona kungumsila we-dinosaur encane, isampula liveza izimpaphe zendala futhi hhayi isihluphe somntwanyana.

src: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
mt: Abacwaningi basikisele ukuthi, nakuba lokhu kuwumsila wedinoza eyisencane, isampula libonisa izimpaphe zabantu abadala hhayi inkunzi.
ref: Abacwaningi basikisela ukuthi, ngisho noma lona kungumsila we-dinosaur, isampula liveza izimpaphe zendala futhi hhayi isihluphe somntwanyana.

src: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
mt: Imoto eqhumise ibhomu eqhumise ekomkhulu lamaphoyisa eGaziantep, eTurkey izolo ekuseni kwabulala amaphoyisa amabili futhi kwalimala abanye abantu abangaphezu kwamashumi amabili.
ref: Ibhomu esemotweni eqhume esikhungweni samaphoyisa eGaziantep, eTheki izolo ekuseni ibulale amaphoyisa amabili futhi yalimaza abantu abanye abangaphezu kweshumi nambili.

src: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
mt: Ihhovisi likahulumeni lathi abayishumi nesishiyagalolunye kulabo abalimele bangamaphoyisa.
ref: Ihhovisi lombusi lithe abayishumi nesishiyagalolunye babengamaphoyisa.

src: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
mt: Amaphoyisa athi asola ukuthi umsolwa we-Daesh (ISIL) unesibopho sokuhlasela.
ref: Amaphoyisa athi asola osolwa ngokuba isosha leDaesh (ISIL) elinesikhundla ngenxa yalokhu kuhlasela.

src: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
mt: Bathola ukuthi ilanga lisebenza ngemigomo eyisisekelo efanayo nezinye izinkanyezi: Umsebenzi wazo zonke izinkanyezi ohlelweni lutholakala ukuthi uxhaswa ukukhanya kwazo, ukujikeleza kwazo, futhi akukho okunye.
ref: Bathole ukuthi ilanga lisebenza ngezimiso eziyisisekelo njengezinye izinkanyezi: umsebenzi wezinkanyezi zonke ohlelweni kutholakale ukuthi uqondiswa ukukhanya kwazo, ukuphenduka kwazo, futhi hhayi okunye.

src: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
mt: Ukukhanya nokujikeleza kusetshenziswa ndawonye ukuze kutholakale inombolo ye-Rossby yenkanyezi, ehlobene nokugeleza kwe-plasma.
ref: Ukukhanya nokuphenduka kusetshenziswa ndawonye ukuthola inombolo yeRossby yenkanyezi, ehlobene nokugeleza kwe-plasma.

src: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
mt: Inani likaRossby lincane, inkanyezi ayisebenzi kangako maqondana nokubuyekezwa komoya.
ref: Uma i-Rossby inenombolo encane, inkanyezi ayibi namandla ngokuphathelene nokuhlehla kazibuthe.

src: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
mt: Phakathi nohambo lwakhe, u-Iwasaki wahlangana nezinkinga izikhathi eziningi.
ref: Phakathi naloluhambo, u-Iwasaki wahlangabezana nezinkinga kaningi.

src: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
mt: Waphangwa izintandane, wahlaselwa eTibet yinja enenhlansi, wabaleka emshadweni eNepal futhi waboshwa eNdiya.
ref: Ubanjwe inkunzi yizigcwelegcwele zasolwandle, wahlaselwa yinja enesifo sobuhlanya e-Tibet, wabalekela umshado e-Nepal bese waboshwa eNdiya.

src: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
mt: Izinga le-802.11n lisebenza kokubili kumaza we-2.4Ghz kanye ne-5.0Ghz.
ref: Isimiso se-802.11n sisebenza kuwo womabili amafrikhwensi angu-2.4Ghz no-5.0Ghz.

src: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
mt: Lokhu kuzovumela ukuthi ivumelane emuva ne-802.11a, 802.11b ne-802.11g, inqobo nje uma isiteshi sesisekelo sineziteshi zomsakazo ezimbili.
ref: Lokhu kuzoyivumela ukuthi ihambisane nezinhlelo zakudala ze-802.11a, i-802.11b kanye ne-802.11g, uma nje isikhungo sesiteshi sinemisakazo emibili.

src: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
mt: Izinga le-802.11n liyakhula kakhulu kunelalawo awandulelayo nge-theoretical throughput ephezulu engu-600Mbit/s.
ref: Ijubane lika-802.11n liphezulu kakhulu kunelangaphambili elaligcina ejubaneni elingu-600Mbit/s.

src: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
mt: UDuvall, oshadile onezingane ezimbili ezindala, akazange amthonye kakhulu uMiller, okuyiye indaba eyayihlobene naye.
ref: UDuvall, oshadile nonezingane ezimbili ezindalaa, akazange ahlabe u-Miller umxhwele, lowo otshelwe indaba.

src: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."
mt: Lapho ebuzwa ngempendulo, uMiller wathi, "UMike ukhuluma kakhulu ngesikhathi sokuzwa...Bengilungiselela ngakho-ke ngangingakuzwa ngempela lokho ayekusho".
ref: Lapho ecelwa ukuthi aphawule, u-Miller uthe, “U-Mike ukhuluma kakhulu phakathi nokuthethwa kwecala...bengizilungiselela ngakho angikuzwanga ayekusho.”

src: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
mt: "Sizama ukunciphisa ukukhishwa kwekhabhoni dioxide iyunithi ngalinye le-GDP ngomkhawulo ophawulekayo ngo-2020 kusuka ezingeni lika-2005", kusho uHu.
ref: Sizophumelela ukunciphisa inani lomoya ongcolile ngesikali se-GDP ngezinga eliphawulekayo ngo-2020 ukusuka esilinganisweni sango-2005, kusho u-Hu.

src: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.
mt: Akazange abeke isibalo sokuncishiswa, ethi kuzokwenziwa ngokusekelwe ekukhiqizeni komnotho waseChina.
ref: Akazange abeke izibalo zokuncishiswa, ethi zizokwenziwa ngokomphumela womnotho waseShayina.

src: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."
mt: UHu wakhuthaza amazwe asathuthuka "ukugwema indlela endala yokungcola kuqala nokuhlanza kamuva".
ref: UHu ukhuthaze amazwe athuthukayo "ukugwema indlela yakudala yokugcolisa kuqala bese uhlanza kamuva."

src: He added that "they should not, however, be asked to take on obligations that go beyond their development stage, responsibility and capabilities."
mt: Uthe "kodwa akumele bacelwe ukuthi bathathe izibopho ezingaphezu kwesigaba sabo sokuthuthuka, umthwalo wemfanelo namandla".
ref: Wanezela ukuthi “akumelwe, nokho, bacelwe bathathe ukuzibophezela okungaphezu kwesigaba sabo sentuthuko, imithwalo yemfanelo kanye namakhono.”

src: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today.
mt: Iqembu Lokufunda E-Iraq lilethe umbiko walo ngo-12:00 GMT namuhla.
ref: IQembu Locwaningo lase-Iraq lethule umbiko walo ngo-12,00 GMT namuhla.

src: It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos.
mt: Iyaxwayisa Akukho muntu ongaqinisekisa ukuthi noma iyiphi indlela yokwenza e-Iraq kuleli phuzu izoyeka impi yamahlelo, ubudlova obandayo, noma ukuguqukela ekudidekeni.
ref: Iyaxwayisa Akekho ongaqinisekisa ukuthi nanoma iyiphi inkambo e-Iraq okwamanje izoqeda impi yamahlelo, ubudlova obukhulayo, noma ukuthambekela ebuxakalaleni.

src: The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East.
mt: Umbiko uvula ngesicelo sokuphendula ngokuvulekile nokwakhiwa kokuvumelana e-United States mayelana nenqubomgomo maqondana ne-Middle East.
ref: UMbiko uvula ngesicelo senkulumo-mpikiswano evulekile kanye nokwenziwa kokuvumelana eMelika ngesimiso saseNingizimu ePhakathi.

src: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
mt: Umbiko ugxeka kakhulu cishe zonke izici zenqubomgomo yamanje ye-Executive maqondana ne-Iraq futhi unxuse ushintsho olusheshayo lokuqondisa.
ref: Umbiko ugxeka kakhulu cishe zonke izici zesimiso samanje sesiGungu sase-Iraq futhi ucela ukuba kube noshintsho olusheshayo lwenkambo.

src: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
mt: Esokuqala phakathi kwezincomo zayo ezingu-78 ukuthi kufanele kuthathwe isinyathelo esisha sezempilakahle ngaphambi kokuphela kwalo nyaka ukuvikela imingcele ye-Iraq ekungeneleleni okuphambene nokubuyisela ubudlelwano bezombusazwe nomakhelwane bayo.
ref: Okokuqala phakathi kokutusa kwayo okungu-78 ukuthi isinyathelo sokuxhumana kumelwe sithathe ngaphambi kokuphela kwalonyaka ukuvikela imingcele yase-Iraq ekungeneleni konya kanye nasekumiseni kabusha ubuhlobo bokuxhumana nomakhelwane bayo.

src: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
mt: Isishayamthetho esikhona kanye noNkosikazi Omkhulu wase-Argentina uCristina Fernandez de Kirchner wamemezela ukuthi uzokhankasa njengomongameli izolo kusihlwa eLa Plata, idolobha eliqhele ngamakhilomitha angama-50 (31 miles) ukusuka eBuenos Aires.
ref: Ilungu lesigele lamanje kanye noNkosikazi kaMongameli wase-Argentina uCristina Fernandez de Kirchner umemezele ukungenela kwakhe ukhetho lokuba umongameli izolo ntambama eLa Plata, idolobha elingamakhilomitha angu-50 (amamayela angu-31) kusuka eBuenos Aires.

src: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
mt: UNkk. Kirchner wamemezela inhloso yakhe yokuphikisana nomongameli e-Argentine Theatre, indawo efanayo ayekuyo ukuqala umkhankaso wakhe we-2005 weSenate njengelungu lethimba lesifundazwe saseBuenos Aires.
ref: UNkk. Kirchner umemezelo inhloso yakhe yokukhankasela ukuba umongameli eThiyetheni yase-Argentina, indawo efanayo ayisebenzisele ukuqala umkhankaso wakhe wokuba ilunga leSigele njengelunga lamanxusa esifunda sase-Buenos Aires.

src: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
mt: Le ngxoxo yaqala ngempikiswano mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwezimali ekusiza nasekwakheni kabusha kulandela iSiphepho u-Katrina; abanye abagcini bezimali babiza ngokuhlekisa ngokuthi "i-Bush's New Orleans Deal".
ref: Inkulumo-mpikiswano idalwe ukuphikisana ngokuchitha imali eningi yokusiza kanye nokwakha kabusha ngemva kokudlula kweSiphepho iKatrina; leyo abesikhwama sezwe abadla ngoludala abayibize sakudlala ngokuthi "Bush's New Orleans Deal."

src: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
mt: Ukugxekwa okuvulekile komzamo wokwakha kabusha kugxile ekunikezelweni kwamasevisi okwakha kabusha kubantu ababonakala bengaphakathi eWashington.
ref: Ukugxekwa okukhulu komzamo wokwakha kabusha kugxile ekuklomeliseni ukuvuselelwa kwezinkontileka ukuze baqonde ezangaphakathi zase-Washington.

src: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
mt: Abantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezine baya eRoma ukuze bayohlanganyela emngcwabeni.
ref: Abantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezine baya eRoma enkonzweni yomngcwabo eRoma.

src: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
mt: Inani labantu ababekhona lalikhulu kangangokuthi kwakungenzeki ukuba wonke umuntu afike emngcwabeni eSt. Peter's Square.
ref: Inani labantu ababekhona lalilikhulu kangangokuba kwakungenzeki ukuba wonke umuntu angene enkonzweni yomngcwabo eSt. Peter's Square.

src: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
mt: Kwakhiwe izibuko eziningi ezinkulu zethelevishini ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene eRoma ukuze abantu babukele lo mcimbi.
ref: Izikrini ezinkulu eziningana zethelevishini zifakiwe ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene eRoma ukwenzela ukuthi abantu babukele umcimbi.

src: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
mt: Kwamanye amadolobha amaningi e-Italy nakwezinye izindawo emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi ePoland, kwenziwa izilungiselelo ezifanayo, ezabonwa yinani elikhulu labantu.
ref: Kwamanye amazwe amaningi waseNtaliyane nasemhlabeni wonke, ngokukhethekile ePoland, ukumiswa okufanayo kwenziwe, okubukwe abantu abaningi kakhulu.

src: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
mt: Izazi-mlando ziye zagxeka izinqubomgomo ze-FBI zangaphambilini ngokugxila izinsiza emacaleni alula ukuxazulula, ikakhulukazi amacala ezimoto ezebiwe, ngenhloso yokukhulisa izinga lempumelelo yenhlangano.
ref: Abezomlando bagxeke imithetho edlule yeFBI ngokugxila emacaleni alula ukuwaxazulula, ikakhulukazi amacala okuntshontshwa kwezimoto, ngenjongo yokukhuphula izinga lokuphumelela le nkampani.

src: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
mt: I-Congress yaqala ukuxhasa isinyathelo sokungcola ngonyaka wezimali we-2005 futhi yachaza ukuthi i-FBI kufanele inikeze izisebenzi eziyi-10 ezithombeni zobulili ezingcolile zabantu abadala.
ref: Ukhongolose waqala ukuxhasa ngezimali uhlelo olungamanyala ngesikhwama sezwe ngo-2005 futhi wachaza ukuthi i-FBI kumelwe inikele ngezisebenzi ezingu-10 ezithombeni ezingcolile zabantu abadala.

src: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
mt: URobin Uthappa wenza innings ephezulu, amagoli angama-70 emiboleni engama-41 kuphela ngokushaya ama-fourers ayi-11 kanye nama-six.
ref: U-Robin Uthappa wenze amaphuzu aphezulu kwi-innings, ama-runs angu-70 emabholeni angu-41 kuphela eshaya o-four abangu-11 kanye no-six abangu-2.

src: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
mt: Amabhetsi asezingeni eliphakathi, uSachin Tendulkar noRahul Dravid, basebenza kahle futhi benza ubudlelwano obuyizinhlamvu eziyikhulu.
ref: Amadoda ashayayo adlalela phakathi, u-Sachin Tendulkar no-Rahul Dravid, bedlale kahle futhi benza umsebenzisano wokugijima ka-100.

src: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
mt: Kodwa, ngemuva kokulahlekelwa yikhiphu likaputeni, i-India yenza ama-run angama-36 kuphela, yalahlekelwa ama-wicket ayi-7 ukuqeda i-innings.
ref: Kodwa, ngemva kokuba kukhiswhe ukaputeni wayo, iNdiya yenze amaphuzu angu-36 kuphela ilahlekelwa amawikhethi angu-7 kuze kube sekugcineni kwengxenye yomdlalo.

src: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
mt: UMengameli wase-U.S. uGeorge W. Bush wafika eSingapore ekuseni ngoNovemba 16, waqala uhambo oluthatha isonto lonke lokuvakashela i-Asia.
ref: UMongameli waseMelika uGeorge W. Bush wafika eSingapore ekuseni ngoLwezi 16, eqalisa uhambo lwakhe lweviki lokuvakashela i-Asia.

src: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
mt: Wamukelwa yiSekela likaNdunankulu waseSingapore uWong Kan Seng futhi waxoxa ngezindaba zokuhweba nezobuphekula noNdunankulu waseSingapore uLee Hsien Loong.
ref: Wabingelelwa yiPhini likaNdunankulu wase-Singapore u-Wong Kan Seng futhi baxoxa ngezohwebo kanye nezokuvakasha noNdunankulu waseSingapore uLee Hsien Loong.

src: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
mt: Ngemva kwesonto lokulahlekelwa okhethweni lwesikhathi esiphakathi, uBush watshela izilaleli ngokwanda kwezohwebo e-Asia.
ref: Ngemva kweviki lokulahlekelwa okhethweni lwaphakathi nesikhathi, uBush watshela izilaleli ngokukhulisa kokuhwebelana e-Asia.

src: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
mt: UNdunankulu uStephen Harper uvumile ukuthumela 'Umthetho Womoya Ohlanzekile' kahulumeni ekomidini lezinhlangano zonke ukuze liwubuyekeze, ngaphambi kokufundwa kwesibili, ngemuva komhlangano wemizuzu engama-25 ngoLwesibili nomholi weNDP uJack Layton e-PMO.
ref: UNdunankulu uStephen Harper uvumile ukuthumela uhulumeni 'Umthetho woMoya Ohlanzekile' ukuba uhlolwe ikomiti lamaqembu onke, ngaphambi kokuba ufundwe okwesibili, ngemva komhlangano wangoLwesibili wemizuzu engu-25 nomhloli weNDP uJack Layton kuyi-PMO.

src: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
mt: ULayton wayecele izinguquko kumthethosivivinywa wezemvelo wabashisekeli ngesikhathi ehlangana noNdunankulu, ecela "ukubhalwa kabusha ngokuphelele" komthethosivivinywa wezemvelo weqembu lamaConservative.
ref: U-Layton ucele kube nezinguquko kumthethosivivinywa wezemvelo we-conservatives ngesikhathi somhlangano nama-PM, ecela kube “nokubhalwa kabusha okuphelele” komthethosivivinywa wezemvelo weqembu le-Conservative.

src: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
mt: Kusukela uhulumeni we-Federal wangenela ukuze athathe imali yesibhedlela i-Mersey eDevonport, eTasmania, uhulumeni wesifundazwe namanye amalungu ephalamende lombuso bagxeke lesi senzo njengokuqamba ngaphambi kokhetho lombuso oluzobanjwa ngoNovemba.
ref: Kusukela ngesikhathi Uhulumeni Wenhlangano Yamazwe ungenela ekuphatheni uxhaso lwesibhedlela i-Mersey eDevonport, eTasmania, uhulumeni wezwe kanye namanye amalungu kahulumeni wenhlangano yamazwe asola lesi senzo njengesandulela sokhetho lukahulumeni oluzokwenziwa ngoLwezi.

src: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
mt: Kodwa uNdunankulu uJohn Howard uthe lo msebenzi wawukwenzelwe ukuvikela izikhungo zesibhedlela ukuthi zingahlaliswa phansi nguhulumeni waseTasmania, ngokunikeza imali eyengeziwe eyizigidi ezingama-AUD$45.
ref: Kodwa uNdunankulu uJohn Howard uthe umthetho kwakungowokulondoloza izakhiwo zesibhedlela ukuba zingabekwa ezingeni eliphansi uhulumani waseTasmania, ngokunikeza izigidi ezingu-AUD$45.

src: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.
mt: Ngokombiko wakamuva, ukufundwa kwamazinga olwandle kwabonisa ukuthi kwakhiwe i-tsunami.Kwakukhona umsebenzi we-tsunami oqondile obhalwe eduze kwasePago Pago naseNiue.
ref: Ngokwencwajana yezindaba yakamuva, amazinga omthamo olwandle aveze ukuthi i-tsunami yenzekile. Bekune-tsunami ebekhona erekhodwe eduze nePago Pago kanye neNiue.

src: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
mt: Akukho monakalo omkhulu noma ukulimala okubikiwe eTonga, kodwa amandla aphela okwesikhashana, okusho ukuthi kwavimbela iziphathimandla zaseTonga ukuthi zithole isixwayiso se-tsunami esikhishwe yi-PTWC.
ref: Awukho umonakalo omkhulu noma ukulimala okubikiwe eTonga, kodwa ugesi ubungekho okwesikhashana, lokho okubikwa ukuthi kuvimebele iziphathimandla zaseTonga ekutholeni isexwayiso setsunami esikhishwe iPTWC.

src: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
mt: Izikole eziyi-14 eHawaii eziseceleni noma eduze kobhishi zavalwa ngoLwesithathu lonke naphezu kwezixwayiso ezazisusiwe.
ref: Izikole eziyishumi nanye eHawaii ezisendaweni noma eziseduze nogu bezivaliwe ngoLwesithathu wonke nangaphezu kokususwa kwesixwayiso.

src: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
mt: UMengameli wase-U.S. uGeorge W. Bush wasamukela lesi simemezelo.
ref: Umongameli waseMelika uGeorge W Bush wasamukela isimemezelo.

src: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
mt: Okhulumela u-Bush uGordon Johndroe wabiza isithembiso seNyakatho Korea ngokuthi "isinyathelo esikhulu esiya emgomweni wokufinyelela ekuqinisekiseni ukudedelwa kwezikhali zenuzi enhlonhlweni yaseKorea".
ref: Umkhulumeli kaBush uGordon Johndroe ubize isithembiso seNyakatho Korea "ngesinyathelo esiyinhloko emgomweni wokususwa kwezikhali zenuzi okungafakazelwa enhlonhlweni yaseKorea."

src: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
mt: Isiphepho seshumi esibizwa ngegama sesizini yeSiphepho se-Atlantic, iSiphepho esisezingeni eliphansi uJerry, sakhiwa oLwandlekazini lwe-Atlantic namuhla.
ref: Isiphepho seshumi esinikwe igama senkathi yeziPhepho zase-Atlantic, iSiphepho Sendawo Efudumele uJerry, saqala oLwandlekazini i-Atlantic namuhla.

src: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
mt: Isikhungo Sikazwelonke Sezivunguvungu (NHC) sithi okwamanje uJerry akamele abeke usongo emhlabathini.
ref: INational Hurricane Center (NHC) ithi kulenkathi uJerry ingaba nosongo ezweni.

src: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
mt: I-U.S. Corps of Engineers ilinganisela ukuthi imvula engamasentimitha angu-6 ingase iphule amachibi abhidliziwe ngaphambilini.
ref: I-U.S. Corps of Engineers lilinganise ukuthi ukuna kwemvula engama-intshi angu-6 angafohla uhide lwezindundumela ezimoshekile esikhathini esidlule.

src: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
mt: IWadi Lesishiyagalolunye, eyabona izikhukhula eziphakeme ngamamitha angu-20 ngesikhathi seSiphepho u-Katrina, njengamanje isemanzini aphakeme njengoba idamu eliseduze laligcwele.
ref: I-Ninth Ward, elabonakala likhukhuleka ngamagxathu angu-20 phakathi Nesiphepho uKatrina, okwamanje linamanzi asokhalweni njengoba amanzi elweqe ngaphezulu udonga lokuvimba amanzi oluseduze.

src: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
mt: Amanzi ayachitheka phezu kwe-dame esigabeni esibanzi ngamamitha ayi-100 ububanzi.
ref: Amanzi ayachitheka ngaphezu kohide lwezindundumela engxenyeni engamafidi angu-100 ububanzi.

src: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
mt: Umphathi weCommons u-Adam Cuerden uveze ukukhungatheka kwakhe ngenxa yokususwa lapho ekhuluma ne-Wikinews ngenyanga edlule.
ref: Umqondisi weCommons u-Adam Cuerden uzwakalise ukukhungatheka kwakhe ngokusulwa ngemva kokukhuluma ne-Wikinews ngenyanga edlule.

src: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
mt: "Wayesiqamba amanga kwasekuqaleni. Okokuqala, ngokuziphatha sengathi lokhu kwakungenxa yezizathu zomthetho. Okwesibili, ngokuzenza sengathi uyasilalela, kuze kube yilapho esulame ubuciko bakhe".
ref: "Yena [uWales] ngokuyisisekelo ukhulume amanga kusuka ekuqaleni. Okokuqala, ngokushaya sengathi lokhu bekungenxa yezizathu ezingokomthetho. Okwesibili, ngokuzishaya sengathi wayesilalele, kuze kube sekususweni kobuciko bakhe."

src: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
mt: Ukucasulwa komphakathi kwaholela emizamweni yamanje yokubhala inqubomgomo ephathelene nokuqukethwe kocansi kusayithi elinamamukeli ezigidi zemithombo yezindaba enelayisense evulekile.
ref: Ukudineka komphakathi kwaholela emzamweni wamanje wokubhala umthetho ophathelene nezindaba zobulli ezingosini ezihlinzeka izinkulungwane ngezindaba ezigunyaziwe ezisemthethweni.

src: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
mt: Umsebenzi owenziwe wawungokombono, kodwa lolu hlelo lwabhalwa ukuze kulinganiswe ukubonwa okwenziwa ngesafu se-Sagittarius.
ref: Umsebenzi owenziwe bekungowomcabango kakhulu, kodwa uhlelo lubhalelwe ukulingisa okubonwe emthaleni weSagittarius.

src: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
mt: Umphumela ithimba elaliwufuna kwakuzoba ngenxa yamandla okufika phakathi komkhathi omnyama we-galaxy nomkhathi omnyama we-Milky Way.
ref: Umphumela iqembu ebeliwulindele ubuzobangelwa amandla adonsayo phakathi kwesigaxa esimnyama somthala nesigaxa esimnyama somthala i-Milky way.

src: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
mt: Njengoba nje inyanga inamandla okudonsa umhlaba, ibangele amagagasi, kanjalo ne-Milky Way inamandla ku-Sagittarius galaxy.
ref: Njengoba inyanga idonsa umhlaba, ibangele amagagasi olwandle, kanjalo neMilky Way idonsa umthala weSagittarius.

src: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
mt: Ososayensi bakwazile ukuphetha ngokuthi izinto ezimnyama zithinta ezinye izinto ezimnyama ngendlela efanayo nezinto ezivamile.
ref: Ososayensi bakwazile ukuphetha ngokuthi izigaxa ezimnyama zithinta ezinye izigaxa ezimnyama ngendlela izigaxa ezijwayelekile ezenza ngayo.

src: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
mt: Le mbono ithi iningi lezinto ezimnyama ezizungeze umdali wendawo yonke zikhona eduze komdali wendawo yonke, zenziwe izinhlayiya ezincane.
ref: Isichasiselo sithi okumnyama okuzungeze umthala kuzungeze umthala njengendingilizi yokukhanya yohlobo oluthile, futhi kwenziwe ngezinto ezincane eziningi.

src: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
mt: Imibiko yethelevishini ibonisa intuthu emhlophe evela esitshalweni.
ref: Imibiko kamabonakude ibonisa intuthu emhlophe iphuma esitshalweni.

src: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
mt: Iziphathimandla zendawo zixwayisa izakhamuzi eziseduze nesitshalo ukuba zihlale endlini, zivale imishini yokuthambisa umoya futhi zingaphuzi amanzi ompompi.
ref: Iziphathimandla zasendaweni zixwayisa abahlali abaseduze nendawo yemboni ukuba bahlale ezindlini, bacime izipholisa-moya futhi bangaphuzi amanzi ompompi.

src: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
mt: Ngokusho kwe-ejensi yenuzi yaseJapane, i-caesium enomsakazo ne-iodine kutholakale kule sitshalo.
ref: Ngokwenkampani yenuzi yaseJapan, imisebe yenuzi ye-caesium ne-iodine itholakale endaweni yokusebenzela.

src: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
mt: Iziphathimandla zithi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izitsha eziphethe uphethiloli we-uranium endaweni kungenzeka ukuthi zaqhuma futhi ziyavuza.
ref: Iziphathimandla zicabangela ukuthi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi iziqukathi ebeziqukethe amafutha e-uranium endaweni yokusebenzela kungenzeka ukuthi ziqhumile futhi ziyavuza.

src: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
mt: UDkt. Tony Moll wathola i-Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) esifundeni saseNingizimu Afrika iKwaZulu-Natal.
ref: UDkt. Tony Moll wathola i-Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) esifundeni saseNingizimu Afrika KwaZulu-Natal.

src: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
mt: Engxoxweni, wathi uhlobo olusha "luyakhathaza kakhulu futhi luyethusa ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu kakhulu lokufa".
ref: Engxoxweni, uthe okuhlukile okusha "kukhathaza kakhulu futhi kuyethusa ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lokufa kwabantu."

src: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
mt: Abanye iziguli kungenzeka ukuthi bathola lesi sifo esibhedlela, kucabanga uDkt. Moll, futhi okungenani ababili kwakungabasebenzi bezempilo esibhedlela.
ref: Ezinye iziguli zithole igciwane esibhedlela, kucabanga uDkt. Moll, futhi okungenani ababili bekuyizisebenzi zempilo zasesibhedlela.

src: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
mt: Esikhathini esingunyaka owodwa, umuntu onegciwane angase athelele abantu abahlobene naye abayishumi kuya kwabayishumi nanhlanu.
ref: Ngesikhathi sonyaka owodwa, umuntu othelelekile angathelela abantu asondelene nabo abangu-10 kuya ku-15.

src: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
mt: Kodwa-ke, iphesenti le-XDR-TB eqenjini lonke labantu abanesifo sofuba libonakala liphansi; abantu abangu-6 000 kubantu abangu-330 000 abathelelekile nganoma yisiphi isikhathi esithile eNingizimu Afrika.
ref: Nokho, iphesenti le-XDR-TB eningini labantu abaphila nesifo sofuba kubukeka siphansi; u-6,000 wabantu abangu-330,000 abathintekayo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
mt: Lezi zinsana, zombili ezazinesisindo esingaphezu kwamaphawundi ayi-1000, futhi ezazinqamula cishe ngamamayela angu-17,500 ngehora, zashayisana ngamamayela angu-491 ngaphezu koMhlaba.
ref: Amasathelayithi, womabili anesisindo esingaphezu  kwamaphawundi angu-1,000, futhi zihamba cishe ngamamayela angu-17,500 ngehora, zishayisene amamayela angu-491 ngaphezu koMhlaba.

src: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
mt: Ososayensi bathi ukuqhuma okubangelwa ukushayisana kwaba okukhulu.
ref: Ososayensi bathi ukuqhuma okudalwe ukushayisana kwakukukhulu.

src: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
mt: Basalokhu bezama ukuthola ukuthi umonakalo wawukhulu kangakanani nokuthi umhlaba uzothinta kanjani.
ref: Basazama ukuthola ukuthi kube kukhulu kangakanani ukugqubuzana nokuthi uMhlaba uzothinteka kanjani.

src: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
mt: I-United States Strategic Command yehhovisi loMnyango Wezokuvikela wase-U.S. ilandelela imfucumfucu.
ref: I-United States Strategic Command yehhovisi loMnyango Wezokuvikela e-U.S. ilandelela le mfucumfucu.

src: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
mt: Umphumela wokuhlaziywa kwamapulani uzothunyelwa kuwebhusayithi yomphakathi.
ref: Imiphumela yokuhlaziya udaba izobhalwa kuyiwebhusayithi.

src: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
mt: Udokotela owayesebenza esibhedlela sezingane sasePittsburgh, ePennsylvania uzobekwa icala lokubulala okunzima ngemuva kokuthi umama wakhe etholwe efile ethunjini lemoto yakhe ngoLwesithathu, kusho iziphathimandla e-Ohio.
ref: Udokotela owayesebenza eSibhedlela seziNgane sasePittsburgh, ePennsylvania uzobekwa icala lokubulala ngesisihluku ngemva kokuba unina etholakale eshonile endaweni yokubeka izimpahla ngemuva kwemoto yakhe ngoLwesithathu, kusho iziphathimandla e-Ohio.

src: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
mt: UDkt. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, watholakala eBlue Ash, e-Ohio, indawo eseduze namadolobha cishe engamakhilomitha angu-15 enyakatho yeCincinnati elele phansi eceleni komgwaqo egqoke i-T-shirt nezingubo zangaphansi esimweni esibonakala sinomuthi kakhulu.
ref: UDkt. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, utholwe eBlue Ash,  e-Ohio, idolobha elicishe libe amamayela angu-15 enyakatho yeCincinnati elele phansi eceleni komgwaqo ngesikibha kanye nezingubo zangaphansi ebonakala sengathi unikwe imithi eminingi yezinhlungu.

src: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
mt: Wayala amaphoyisa ukuba aye ku-Oldsmobile Intrigue yakhe emnyama eyayikude ngamamitha angu-500.
ref: Uqondise izikhulu kuyi-Oldsmobile Intrigue yakhe eyayikude ngamafidi angu- 500.

src: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.
mt: Lapho, bathola isidumbu sikaSaroja Balasubramanian, oneminyaka engu-53, sihlanganiswe namantende agqamile egazi.
ref: Lapho, bathola umzimba kaSaroja Balasubramanian, oneminyaka engu-53, wembozwe ngezingubo zokulala ezinindwe yigazi.

src: Police said that the body appeared to have been there for about a day.
mt: Amaphoyisa athi umzimba wawubonakala usekude cishe usuku.
ref: Amaphoyisa athe umzimba ububonakala sengathi ubulapho izinsuku eziningi.

src: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
mt: Amacala okuqala esifo kule sizini abikwa ngasekupheleni kukaJulayi.
ref: Ukuba khona kwesifo kulenkathi kwaqala ukubikwa ekupheleni uNtulikazi.

src: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
mt: Lesi sifo sithwalwa yizingulube, bese sithuthela kubantu ngamasosha omzimba.
ref: Lesi sifo sitholakala ezingulubeni, bese sidlulela ebantwini ngominyane.

src: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
mt: Ukuqubuka kwabangela ukuba uhulumeni waseNdiya athathe izinyathelo ezifana nokuthumela abadobi bezingulube ezindaweni ezithinteke kakhulu, ukusatshalaliswa kwezinkulungwane zamakhardini omiyane nokuthambisa izibulali-zinambuzane.
ref: Lolu bhubhane lushukumise uhulumeni waseNdiya ukuba athathe izinyathelo ezinjengokuthumela ababamba izingulube ezindaweni ezithinteke kakhulu, ukusakaza izigidi zamakhethini womiyane kanye nokufutha imithi ebulala izinambuzane.

src: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.
mt: Uhulumeni uye wathembisa ama-vial ayizigidi eziningana omuthi wokugoma i-encephalitis, okuzosiza izinhlangano zezempilo ukulungiselela unyaka ozayo.
ref: Izigidi ezimbalwa zamabhodlela womjovo wesifo sobuchopho zithenjiswe uhulumeni, azosiza ukulungiselela izinhlangano zezempilo unyaka ozayo.

src: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
mt: Izinhlelo zokuthi imigomo izofakwa ezindaweni ezithinteke kakhulu ngokomlando kulo nyaka zahlehliswa ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemali kanye nokubekwa phambili okuphansi maqondana nezinye izifo.
ref: Izinhlelo zemijovo okumelwe ithunyelwe ezindaweni ezithinteke kakhulu ngokomlando kulonyaka zilibazisiwe ngenxa yokungabi nemali nokungathathwa njengokubalulekile uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izifo.

src: In 1956 Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he began work for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief engraver.
mt: Ngo-1956 uSłania wathuthela eSweden, lapho eminyakeni emithathu kamuva waqala ukusebenza e-Swedish Post Office futhi waba umqambi omkhulu.
ref: Ngo-1956 u-Słania wathuthela e-Sweden, lapho iminyaka emithathu kamuva waqala ukusebenzela iHhovisi lePosi lase-Sweden futhi waba umqophi wabo omkhulu.

src: He produced over 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries.
mt: Wakhiqiza izitembu ezingaphezu kuka-1 000 eSweden nakwamanye amazwe angu-28.
ref: Wenzele iSweden izitembu ezingaphezu kuka-1,000 kanye nezingu-28 zamanye amazwe.

src: His work is of such recognized quality and detail that he is one of the very few "household names" among philatelists. Some specialize in collecting his work alone.
mt: Umsebenzi wakhe ungowemfanelo owaziwayo kanye nemininingwane kangangokuthi ungomunye "wamagama omndeni" ambalwa kakhulu phakathi kwama-filatelists.
ref: Umsebenzi wakhe ungowekhwalithi eyaziwayo nemininingwane kangangokuthi ungelinye “lamagama aziwayo” phakathi kwabafundi bezitembu. Abanye bangochwepheshe bokuqoqa umsebenzi wakhe wodwa.

src: His 1,000th stamp was the magnificent "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" by David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl in 2000, which is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.
mt: Isitembu sakhe se-1 000 kwakuyi-"Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" kaDavid Klöcker Ehrenstrahl ngo-2000, esishiwo kuGuinness Book of World Records.
ref: Isitembu sakhe se-1,000 “bekuyiZenzo eZinkulu zamaKhosi waseSweden” ezibabazekayo ezenzwe nguDavid Klöcker Ehrenstrahl ngo-2000, esibhalwe ku-Guinness Book of World Record.

src: He was also engaged in engraving banknotes for many countries, recent examples of his work including the Prime Ministerial portraits on the front of the new Canadian $5 and $100 bills.
mt: Uphinde wahlanganyela ekuqoshiwe kwamaranothi emazweni amaningi, izibonelo zakamuva zomsebenzi wakhe kuhlanganise nezithombe zikaNdunankulu eziphambili zezimali ezintsha zaseCanada ezingu-5 no-100 $.
ref: Wayetholakele nasekudwebeni imali eyiphepha yamazwe amaningi, izibonelo zakamuva zomsebenzi wakhe zihlanganisa imifanekiso yoNdunankulu phambi kwemali yephepha yaseCanada engu-$5 kanye no-$100.

src: After the accident occurred, Gibson was transported to a hospital but died shortly afterwards.
mt: Ngemva kokuba kwenzeke ingozi, uGibson wathunyelwa esibhedlela kodwa washona ngemva kwesikhashana.
ref: Ngemva kokuba kwenzeke ingozi, uGibson wayiswa esibhedlela kodwa washona ngokushesha ngemva kwalokho.

src: The truck driver, who is aged 64, was not injured in the crash.
mt: Umshayeli weloli, oneminyaka engu-64, akazange alimale engozini.
ref: Umshayeli weloli, oneminyaka engu-64, akalimalanga ekunqubuzaneni.

src: The vehicle itself was taken away from the scene of the accident at approximately 1200 GMT on the same day.
mt: Imoto ngokwayo yathathwa endaweni yesehlakalo sesehlakalo cishe ngo-1200 GMT ngosuku olufanayo.
ref: Imoto ngokwayo yasuswa endaweni ingozi eyenzeke kuyo cishe ngo-1200 GMT ngosuku olufanayo.

src: A person working in a garage near where the accident occurred said: "There were children waiting to cross the road and they were all screaming and crying."
mt: Umuntu osebenza egaraji eliseduze nendawo yenhlekelele wathi: "Kwakunabantwana abalinde ukuwela umgwaqo futhi bonke babememeza futhi bekhala".
ref: Umuntu osebenza egalaji eduze nalapho okwenzeke khona inhlekelele uthe: "Bekunezingane ezilinde ukuwela umgwaqo futhi zonke bezimemeza futhi zikhala."

src: They all ran back from where the accident had happened.
mt: Bonke babaleka babuya lapho kwenzeke khona ingozi.
ref: Bonke bagijima babuyela lapho ingozi yenzeke khona.

src: Other subjects on the agenda in Bali include saving the world's remaining forests, and sharing technologies to help developing nations grow in less-polluting ways.
mt: Ezinye izinto ezibekwe ku-ajenda eBali zihlanganisa ukusindisa amahlathi asele emhlabeni, nokwabelana ngobuchwepheshe ukusiza amazwe asathuthuka ukuthi akhule ngezindlela ezingcolisa kancane.
ref: Ezinye izindaba okuzoxoxwa ngazo emhlanganweni eBali zihlanganisa ukuvikela amahlathi womhlaba asele, nokwabelana ngezobuchwepheshe ukusiza amazwe athuthukayo ukuba akhule ngezindlela ezingangcolisi kakhulu.

src: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
mt: I-UN futhi inethemba lokuqedela isikhwama sokusiza amazwe athintwe ukufudumala kwembulunga yonke ukuba abhekane nemithelela.
ref: I-U.N ifuna ukuqedela isikhwama sokusiza amazwe athintwe ukufudumala kwembulunga yonke ukuba abhekane namathonya.

src: The money could go toward flood-proof houses, better water management, and crop diversification.
mt: Imali ingaya ezindlini ezingangenwa yizikhukhula, ekuphathweni ngcono kwamanzi, nasekuhlanganiseni izitshalo.
ref: Imali ingasetshenziselwa izindlu ezingakhukhuleki, indlela yokuphatha amanzi engcono, kanye nezinhlobonhlobo zezitshalo.

src: Fluke wrote that the efforts by some to drown out women from speaking out about women’s health were unsuccessful.
mt: UFluké wabhala ukuthi imizamo yabanye yokunqanda abesifazane ukuba bakhulume ngokuphepha ngezempilo yabesifazane ayiphumelelanga.
ref: UFluke ubhale ukuthi imizamo yabanye yokuvimba abesifazane ukuthi bakhulume ngempilo yabesifazane ayiphumelelanga.

src: She came to this conclusion due to the multitude of positive comments and encouragement sent to her by both female and male individuals urging that contraception medication be considered a medical necessity.
mt: Ufike kulesi siphetho ngenxa yezinkulumo eziningi ezinhle nesikhuthazo esithunyelwe kuye ngabesilisa nabesifazane abakhuthaza ukuthi imithi yokunqanda inzalo ithathwe njengesidingo sezokwelapha.
ref: Ufike kulesi siphetho ngenxa yokuphawula okuhle okuningi kanye nesikhuthazo athunyelwe sona kokubili abantu ngabanye besifazane kanye nabesilisa becela ukuthi imithi yokuvimbela inzalo ibhekwe njengesidingo sezokwelapha.

src: When the fighting ceased after the wounded were transported to the hospital, about 40 of the other remaining inmates stayed in the yard and refused to return to their cells.
mt: Lapho impi iseka ngemva kokuba abamenxeba behashelwe esibhedlela, ezinye iziboshwa ezingu-40 ezazisele zahlala egcekeni futhi zenqaba ukubuyela emaseleni azo.
ref: Lapho ukulwa kuphela ngemva kokuba abalimele bephuthunyiswe esibhedlela, iziboshwa ezicishe zibe ngu-40 ezisele zihlale egcekeni futhi zenqaba ukubuyela ezitokisini zazo.

src: Negotiators tried to rectify the situation, but the prisoners' demands are not clear.
mt: Abaxoxisanayo bazama ukulungisa isimo, kodwa izimfuno zeziboshwa azicacile.
ref: Abaxoxisanayo bazama ukulungisa isimo, kodwa izikhalazo zeziboshwa azicacile.

src: Between 10:00-11:00 pm MDT, a fire was started by the inmates in the yard.
mt: Phakathi kuka-10:00 no-11:00 ntambama nge-MDT, kwaqala umlilo yiziboshwa egcekeni.
ref: Phakathi kuka-10:00-11:00 pm MDT, umlilo waqalwa iziboshwa egcekeni.

src: Soon, officers equipped with riot gear entered the yard and cornered the inmates with tear gas.
mt: Ngokushesha, amaphoyisa anezinto zokulwa nezidubedube angena egcekeni futhi agxilisa iziboshwa ngogesi obulala izinyembezi.
ref: Ngokushesha, izikhulu ezihlome ngempahla yokuzivikela kwababhikishayo zangena egcekeni zavimbezela iziboshwa ngesisi esikhipha unyembezi.

src: Fire rescue crews eventually doused the fire by 11:35 pm.
mt: Abasebenzi abasindisa umlilo bagcina bewucime umlilo ngo-11:35 ntambama.
ref: Izisebenzi ezingabacishi bomlilo zacima umlilo ngo-11:35 ebusuku.

src: After the dam was built in 1963, the seasonal floods that would spread sediment throughout the river were halted.
mt: Ngemva kokuba idamu lakhiwe ngo-1963, kwaqedwa izikhukhula zesikhathi esivamile ezazizosabalalisa imfucumfucu kulo lonke umfula.
ref: Ngemva kokuba kwakhiwe idamu ngo-1963, izikhukhula zenkathi ethile yonyaka ezazisabalalisa inzika emfuleni wonke zamiswa.

src: This sediment was necessary for creating sandbars and beaches, which served as wildlife habitats.
mt: Le ndawo yayidingeka ukuze kwakhiwe izindawo ezinesihlabathi namabhishi, okwakusebenza njengendawo yokuhlala yezilwane zasendle.
ref: Lenzika beyidingeka ekwenzeni izindunduma zesihlabathi nezingu, ezisebenza njengendawo yokuhlala yezilwane zasendle.

src: As a result, two fish species have become extinct, and two others have become endangered, including the humpback chub.
mt: Ngenxa yalokho, izinhlobo ezimbili zezinhlanzi seziphele, kanti ezinye ezimbili zisengozini yokushabalala, kuhlanganise ne-humpback chub.
ref: Ngenxa yalokho, izinhlobo ezimbili zezinhlanzi zaqothulwa, futhi ezinye ezimbili zibe sengozini, kuhlanganise ne-humpback chub.

src: Although the water level will only rise a few feet after the flood, officials are hoping it will be enough to restore eroded sandbars downstream.
mt: Nakuba izinga lamanzi lizokwenyuka ngamamitha ambalwa kuphela ngemva kwesikhukhula, izikhulu zinethemba lokuthi lizokwanele ukubuyisela izindawo ezinesihlabathi ezonakele ngaphansi kogwaja.
ref: Nakuba izinga lamanzi lizokhuphuka kuphela amafidi ambalwa ngemva kwesikhukhula, iziphathimandla zithemba ukuthi lizokwanela ukuvuselela izindunduma zesihlabathi ezigugulekile ezansi nomfula.

src: No tsunami warning has been issued, and according to the Jakarta geophysics agency, no tsunami warning will be issued because the quake did not meet the magnitude 6.5 requirement.
mt: Asikho isixwayiso se-tsunami esikhishwe, futhi ngokusho kwe-ejensi ye-geophysics yaseJakarta, asikho isixwayiso se-tsunami esizokhishwa ngoba ukuzamazama komhlaba akuhlangabezani nesidingo sobukhulu obungu-6.5.
ref: Akukho isixwayiso sesiphepho esikhishiwe, futhi ngokusho kwesikhungo sezemvelo i-Jakarta, asikho isixwayiso sesiphepho esizokhishwa ngoba lokhu kuzamazama komhlaba akufinyelelanga ubukhulu buka-6.5.

src: Despite there being no tsunami threat, residents started to panic and began to leave their businesses and homes.
mt: Naphezu kokungekho usongo lwe-tsunami, izakhamuzi zaqala ukwethuka futhi zaqala ukushiya amabhizinisi nezindlu zazo.
ref: Yize kwakungekho ukusabisa kwe-tsunami, kodwa abahlali baqala baba nokwethuka base beqala beshiya amakhaya abo nama bhizinisi abo.

src: Although Winfrey was tearful in her farewell, she made it clear to her fans she will be back.
mt: Nakuba uWinfrey ayekhala ngesikhathi eshiya, wachazela abalandeli bakhe ukuthi uzobuya.
ref: Yize uWinfrey wayekhala ngokuvaleliswa kwakhe, wakubeka kwacaca kubalandeli bakhe ukuthi uzobuya.

src: "This is not going to be goodbye. This is the closing of one chapter and the opening of a new one."
mt: "Lokhu ngeke kube ukuvalelisa. Lokhu kuwukuvala kwesahluko esisodwa nokuvula kwesisha".
ref: “Lokhu angeke kube okokugcina. Lokhu kuwukuvala isihloko esisodwa bese uvula esinye esisha.”

src: Final results from Namibian presidential and parliamentary elections have indicated that the incumbent president, Hifikepunye Pohamba, has been reelected by a large margin.
mt: Imiphumela yokugcina yokhetho lukamongameli nolwephalamende eNamibia ibonise ukuthi umengameli osebenzayo, uHiffikepunye Pohamba, ukhethwe kabusha ngomehluko omkhulu.
ref: Imiphumela yokugcina yokhetho lukamongameli kanye nephalamende lase-Namibia ibonisa ukuthi umongameli obesesihlalweni, uHifikepunye Pohamba, ukhishwe ngendlela ephawulekayo.

src: The ruling party, South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), also retained a majority in the parliamentary elections.
mt: Iqembu elisesimweni sokubusa, iSouth West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), nalo laligcina iningi okhethweni lwephalamende.
ref: Iqembu elibusayo i-South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO) liphinde lavotelwa ngabaningi okhethweni lwasephalamende.

src: Coalition and Afghan troops moved into the area to secure the site and other coalition aircraft have been sent to assist.
mt: Amaphoyisa ase-Coalition kanye ne-Afghan ahambe endaweni ukuze aqinisekise indawo futhi ezinye izindiza ze-Coalition zithunyelwe ukusiza.
ref: Amabutho ahlangene nawase-Afghanistan aya endaweni ukuyithatha futhi ezinye izindiza zamabutho ahlangene zithunyelwe kuba ziyosiza.

src: The crash occurred high up in mountainous terrain, and is believed to have been the result of hostile fire.
mt: Le ngozi yenzeke phezulu endaweni enentabeni, futhi kukholakala ukuthi yayiphethwe umlilo ononya.
ref: Ukuphahlazeka kwenzeke phezulu endaweni enezintaba, futhi kukholelwa ukuthi kubekhona ngenxa yomlilo onamandla.

src: Efforts to search for the crash site are being met by bad weather and harsh terrain.
mt: Imizamo yokusesha indawo yenhlekelele ihambisana nesimo sezulu esibi kanye nendawo enzima.
ref: Imizamo yokufuna indawo yokuphahlazeka iphazanyiswa isimo sezulu esibi kanye nendawo embi.

src: The medical charity Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres and the World Health Organisation say it is the worst outbreak recorded in the country.
mt: Inhlangano yokusiza kwezokwelapha i-Mangola, i-Medicines Sans Frontieres kanye ne-World Health Organization bathi lokhu kuqubuka okubi kakhulu okuqoshiwe ezweni.
ref: Izinhlangano ezisiza abaswele zezokwelapha iMangola, iMedecines Sans Frontieres kanye neWorld Health Organisation zithi ukuqubuka okubi kunakho konke okurekhodiwe ezweni.

src: Spokesman for Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman said: "Angola is heading for its worst ever outbreak and the situation remains very bad in Angola," he said.
mt: Okhulumela i-Medicines Sans Frontiere uRichard Veerman uthe: "I-Angola iya ekuqhamukeni kwayo okubi kakhulu futhi isimo sihlala sibi kakhulu e-Angola", esho.
ref: Umkhulumeli we-Medecines Sans Frontiere u-Richard Veerman uthe: “I-Angola izobhekana nobhubhane olukhulu futhi isimo siqhubeka sisibi e-Angola,” washo.

src: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby.
mt: Imidlalo yaqala ngo-10:00 ekuseni ngesimo sezulu esihle futhi ngaphandle kwemvula yasekuseni esheshayo, kwakuwusuku oluhle kakhulu lombhoxo we-7s.
ref: Imidlalo iqale ngo-10:00 ekuseni ngesimo sezulu esihle futhi ngaphandle komkhemezelo waphakathi nasekuseni onyamalale ngokushesha, kwakuwusuku oluhle lomdlalo weragbhi edlalwa abantu abangu-7 uhlangothi ngalunye.

src: Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia.
mt: Izithelo eziphezulu zomqhudelwano iNingizimu Afrika yaqala ngamanothi alungile lapho inqoba ngo-26 - 00 ngokuthokozela neZambia enesihlanu.
ref: INingizimu Afrika esesikhundleni esiphezulu emqhudelwaneni iqale kahle lapho iwina ngo-26 -00 kalula lapho idlala neZambia esesikhundleni sesihlanu.

src: Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed.
mt: Njengoba ibukeka ingenawo amandla emdlalweni ngokumelene nodadewabo baseningizimu, iNingizimu Afrika nokho yathuthuka kancane kancane njengoba umqhudelwano uqhubekela phambili.
ref: Ibukeka sengathi iyawukhohlwa umdlalo ngokumelene nodadewabo abangaseningizimu, iNingizimu Afrika nokho yaya ngokuya ithuthuka njengoba umncintiswano uqhubeka.

src: Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.
mt: Ukuzivikela kwabo okuqeqeshiwe, amakhono abo okuphathwa kwebhola nokusebenza kahle kweqembu kwabenza bavela phambili futhi kwacaca ukuthi leli yiqembu okufanele linqobe.
ref: Isivikelo sabo esihlelekile, amakhono wokuphatha ibhola nokusebenzisana njengeqembu okuhle kwabenza bavelela futhi kwakucacile ukuthi bayiqembu elihamba phambili.

src: Officials for the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank Museum state that the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health hazard as they argue that it was in imminent danger of falling over.
mt: Izikhulu zedolobha lase-Amsterdam kanye ne-Anne Frank Museum zithi lesi sihlahla sinesifo sesikhunta futhi sibeka ingozi empilweni yomphakathi njengoba zithi sasisengcupheni enkulu yokuwa.
ref: Iziphathimandla zedolobha lase-Amsterdam kanye neMnyuziyamu ka-Anne Frank zithi lesi sihlahla singene ukukhunta futhi siyingozi emphakathini njengoba zithi bowusengozini yokuwa ngokushesha.

src: It had been scheduled to be cut down on Tuesday, but was saved after an emergency court ruling.
mt: Kwakuhlelelwe ukuthi inqunywe ngoLwesibili, kodwa yasindiswa ngemva kwesinqumo senkantolo yesimo esiphuthumayo.
ref: Beyihlelelwa ukunqunywa ngoLwesibili, kodwa yasindiswa ngemva kwesinqumo senkantolo sezimo eziphuthumayo.

src: All of the cave entrances, which were named "The Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in diameter.
mt: Zonke izindlu zokungena emhumeni, ezaziwa ngokuthi "Odade Abayisikhombisa", zinobubanzi obungenani obuphakathi kwamamitha ayi-100 kuya kwangu-250 (328 kuya ku-820 amamitha).
ref: Yonke iminyango yomhume, eyaqanjwa ngokuthi “The Seven Sisters”, okungenani ingamamitha ayi-100 kuye kwangama-250 (amafidi angama-328 kuye kwangama-820) ububanzi.

src: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.
mt: Izithombe ze-infrared zibonisa ukuthi ukuhlukahluka kwamazinga okushisa ebusuku nasemini kubonisa ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi kungamagobongo.
ref: Izithombe eziveza ukushisa zibonisa ukuthi ukuhlukahlukana kokushisa kwasebusuku nasemini kubonisa ukuthi zifana nomgede.

src: "They are cooler than the surrounding surface in the day and warmer at night.
mt: "Zipholile kunendawo ezungezile emini futhi zifudumele ebusuku.
ref: Ipholile kunezindawo ezizizungezile emini futhi ifudumale ebusuku.

src: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.
mt: Ukuziphatha kwabo okushisayo akuzinzile njengamagoba amakhulu eMhlabeni avame ukugcina izinga lokushisa eliqinile, kodwa kuyahambisana nokuthi lawa ngamagodi ajulile phansi", kusho uGlen Cushing we-United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team kanye neNyakatho ye-Arizona University etholakala eFlagstaff, e-Arizona.
ref: Ukuziphatha kwayo kokushisa akuzinzanga njengemigede emikhulu eMhlabeni leyo egcina izinga lokushisa cishe elifanayo kaningi, kodwa iyafana nalena ngokuba imigodi ejulile enhlabathini, kwasho uGlen Cushing we-United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team kanye neNorthern Arizona University eseFlagstaff, e-Arizona.

src: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
mt: EFrance, ukuvota kuye kwaba yinto enobuchwepheshe obuncane: abavoti bazihlukanisa esitokisini, bafake ishidi lephepha eliphrintiwe ngaphambili elibonisa umuntu abazokhetha ukumqoka ebhuloheni.
ref: E-France, ukuvota kwakuyisiko lobuchwepheshe obuphansi: abavoti bazihlukanisa bodwa ebhokisini, babeka iphepha eliphrintiwe ekuqaleni elibonisa ukhetho lwabo ngaphakathi kwemvilophi.

src: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
mt: Ngemva kokuba izikhulu ziqinisekise ukuthi umvoti ungubani, umvoti uphonsa imvilophu ebhokisini lokuvota bese esayina uhlu lokuvota.
ref: Ngemva kokuba iziphathimandla ziqinisekise ubuqu bomuntu ovotayo, abavotayo balahlela izimvilophu ebhokisini lamaphepha okuvota futhi basayine uhlu lwabavotayo.

src: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.
mt: Umthetho wokhetho waseFrance uhlanganisa ngokuqinile inqubo.
ref: Umthetho wokhetho waseFrance kunalokho uhlanganisa ngokuqinile ukuqulwa kwamacala.

src: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
mt: Kusukela ngo-1988, izikhwama zokuvota kumele zibe sobala ukuze abavoti nababheki bakwazi ukufakazela ukuthi azikho izembozo ezikhona ekuqaleni kokuvota nokuthi azikho izembozo ezingezwe ngaphandle kwalabo abavoti ababalwe kahle futhi abagunyaziwe.
ref: Kusukela ngo-1988, amabhokisi amaphepha okuvota kumelwe kube abonisayo ukuze abavoti kanye nezibukeli bafakazele ukuthi azikho izimvilophu ezikhona lapho kuqala ukuvota nokuthi azikho izimvilophu ezifakwayo ngaphandle kwalezo zabavoti ababalwe ngokufanelekile nabagunyaziwe.

src: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
mt: Abavoti bangathumela abamele ukuba babheke zonke izingxenye zenqubo.Ebusuku, amavoti ayabalwa ngamavolontiya ngaphansi kokuqondisa okunzima, kulandela izinqubo ezithile.
ref: Amakhandidethi angathumela abameli ukuze babone zonke izingxenye zenqubo. Kusihlwa, amavoti abalwa amavolontiya abekwe iso elibukhali, alandela izinqubo ezithile.

src: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.
mt: I-ASUS Eee PC, eyethulwe ngaphambilini emhlabeni wonke ukuze isindise izindleko nezinto zokusebenza, yaba isihloko esishisayo ku-2007 Taipei IT Month.
ref: I-ASUS Eee PC, ngaphambili iqalise ukusebenza emhlabeni jikelele ngenxa yezizathu zokonga izindleko nezokusebenza, okwaba wundabamlonyeni ngonyaka ka-2007 ngenyanga yeTaipei IT.

src: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.
mt: Kodwa imakethe yabathengi kumakhompyutha e-laptop izohluka kakhulu futhi ishintshe ngemuva kokuba i-ASUS yanikezwa i-Taiwan Sustainable Award ka-2007 yi-Executive Yuan yaseRiphabhuliki yaseChina.
ref: Kepha abathengi bekhompuyutha ephathekayo bazohluka kakhulu futhi baguquke ngemva kokuba i-ASUS iklomeliswe Eklomelweni Wokulondoloza wase-Taiwan ngo-2007 ilungu lesiGungu uYuan waseRiphabhulikini yaseShayina.

src: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"
mt: Iwebhusayithi yesiteshi ichaza lo mbukiso ngokuthi "umdlalo womsakazo wesikole esidala onesici esisha nesimanga!"
ref: Iwebhusayithi yesiteshi ichaza uhlelo "njengomdlalo womsakazo odla ngoludala onokwaziswa okusha kwezobuchwepheshe!"

src: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.
mt: Ezinsukwini zayo zokuqala, lo mbukiso wawubonakala kuphela kusayithi lesiteshi somsakazo se-inthanethi i-TogiNet Radio, indawo egxile emsakazweni wezinkulumo.
ref: Ngesikhathi lusaqala, lolu hlelo lwalufaka lodwa isikhathi eside emsakazweni we-inthanethi i-TogiNet, lengosi yayigxile emisakazweni ekhulumayo.

src: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.
mt: Ngasekupheleni kuka-2015, iTogiNet yasungula i-AstroNet Radio njengesiteshi esincekayo.
ref: Ekupheleni kuka-2015, iTogiNet yamisa i-AstroNet Radio njengesiteshi njengesiteshi esingaphansi kwayo

src: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
mt: Lo mbukiso ekuqaleni wawunabalingisi bezwi abafana, bendawo yase-East Texas.
ref: Umdlalo ekuqaleni wawunabalingisi bezwi abangafundile, endaweni yase-East Texas.

src: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
mt: Ukuphangwa okubanzi kubikwe ukuthi kwaqhubeka ubusuku bonke, njengoba izikhulu zokuphoqelela umthetho zazingekho emigwaqweni yaseBishkek.
ref: Ukugqekeza okugcwele konke kubikwa ukuthi kwaqhubeka ubusuku bonke, njengoba amaphoyisa ayengekho emigwaqweni yaseBishkek.

src: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
mt: Omunye umbukeli wachaza iBishkek ngokuthi yayigcwele "umshoshaphansi", njengoba amaqembu abantu ayezulazula emigwaqweni futhi ephuca izitolo zezimpahla zabathengi.
ref: IBishkek beyichazwa njengecwila esimweni seziyaluyalu” ngomunye wababukeli, njengoba amaqembu wabantu ayezulazula emigwaqweni futhi bephanga izitolo zezimpahla zabathengi. "

src: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
mt: Izakhamuzi eziningi zaseBishkek zisola ababhikishi abavela eningizimu ngokungaziphathi kahle.
ref: Abahlali abaningana baseBishkek bathwese ababhikishi abasuka eningizimu icala lokwephulwa komthetho.

src: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
mt: INingizimu Afrika ihlulile i-All Blacks (iNew Zealand) emdlalweni we-rugby union Tri Nations eMnyangweni weRoyal Bafokeng eRustenburg, eNingizimu Afrika.
ref: INingizimu Afrika ihlule ama-All Blacks (iNyuzilandi) emdlalweni we-ragbhi wenyunyoni we-Tri Nations eRoyal Bafokeng Stadium, eRustenburg, eNingizimu Afrika.

src: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
mt: Umphumela wokugcina kwaba ukunqoba ngamaphuzu owodwa, ngamaphuzu angu-21 kuya kwangu-20, okuqeda ukulandelana kwemidlalo engu-15 yama-All Blacks.
ref: Imiphumela yokugcina bekuwukuphumelela kwephuzu elilodwa, u-21 ku-20, okwaqeda ukuwina njalo kwama-All Blacks kwemidlalo engu-15.

src: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
mt: KumaSpringboks, kwaphela umdlalo owawudlalwa imidlalo emihlanu.
ref: KumaBhokobhoko, lokhu kunqamule ukungaphumeleli emidlalweni emihlanu elandelanayo.

src: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
mt: Kwakuwumdlalo wokugcina we-All Blacks, eyayisivele iwine indebe emasontweni amabili edlule.
ref: Bekuwumdlalo wokugcina wama-All Blacks, asephumelele kakade indebe emavikini ambalwa adlule.

src: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
mt: Umdlalo wokugcina wochungechunge uzobanjelwa e-Ellis Park eGoli ngesonto elizayo, lapho ama-Springboks edlala ne-Australia.
