ref: Umdlalo wokugcina womqhudelwano uzokwenzeka e-Ellis Park eGoli ngeviki elizayo, lapho ama-Springbok edlala ne-Australia.

src: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.
mt: Ukuzamazama komhlaba okulinganiselwe kuzamazamisa entshonalanga yeMontana ngo-10:08 ntambama ngoMsombuluko.
ref: Ukuzamazama komhlaba okuncane kwanyakazisa intshonalanga ye-Montana ngo-10: 08 p.m. ngoMsombuluko.

src: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
mt: Akukho imibiko esheshayo yokulimala etholiwe yi-United States Geological Survey (USGS) kanye ne-National Earthquake Information Center yayo.
ref: Ayikho imibiko esheshayo yomonakalo etholwe yi-United States Geological Survey (USGS) kanye ne-National Earthquake Information Center yayo.

src: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
mt: Ukuzamazama komhlaba kwakusendaweni engamakhilomitha angu-20 (amamayela ayi-15) enyakatho-mpumalanga yeDillon, futhi cishe amakhilomitha angu-65 (amamayela ayi-40) eningizimu yeButte.
ref: Ukuzamazama komhlaba kwakugxile endaweni cishe engama-20 km (amamayela angu-15) enyakatho esempumalanga esenyakatho yeDillon, futhi cishe nama-65 km (amamayela angu-40) eningizimu neButte.

src: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
mt: Uhlobo lomkhuhlane wezinyoni obulalayo kubantu, i-H5N1, luye lwaqinisekiswa ukuthi luthelelekile emdondeni wasendle ofile, otholakala ngoMsombuluko, ezindaweni ezishisayo eduze naseLyon empumalanga yeFrance.
ref: Uhlobo lomkhuhlane wezinyoni olubulalayo ebantwini, i-H5N1, kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi luhlasele idada lasendle, elatholakala ngoMsombuluko, endaweni yamaxhaphozi eduze naseLyon empumalanga neFulansi.

src: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
mt: I-France iyizwe lesikhombisa e-European Union elihlaselwe yileli gciwane; kulandela i-Austria, iJalimane, iSlovenia, iBulgaria, iGrisi ne-Italy.
ref: IFulansi yizwe lesikhombisa esiGungwini saseYurophu lokuthola leligciwane; ngemva kwe-Austria, iJalimane, iSlovenia, iBulgria, iGrisi kanye neNtaliyane.

src: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
mt: Izimo okusolwa ukuthi zikhona ze-H5N1 eCroatia naseDenmark zisaqhubeka zingaqinisekisiwe.
ref: Ubantu okusolakala ukuthi baphethwe i-H5N1 eCroatia naseDenmark abakaqinisekiswa.

src: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
mt: AmaChambers ayemangalele uNkulunkulu "ngokufa okubanzi, ukubhujiswa nokwesabisa izigidi nezigidi zabantu emhlabeni".
ref: I-Chambers yayimangalele uNkulunkulu“ngokwanda kakhulu kokufa, izinhlekelele kanye nokuphekulwa kwezigidi zezigidi zabahlali boMhlaba.”

src: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
mt: UChambers, ongakholelwa kuNkulunkulu, uthi icala lakhe "lingeyona into enengqondo" nokuthi "noma ubani angamsola noma ubani".
ref: UChambers, ongakholelwa kunkulunkulu, uphikisa ngokuthi ukumangalelwa kwakhe "akunanjongo" futhi "noma ubani angahlawulisa noma ubani."

src: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
mt: Indaba ethulwa ku-opera yaseFrance, kaCamille Saint-Saens, ingeyomculi "ophila impilo yakhe ethenjwa uthando lwezidakamizwa neJapan".
ref: Indaba evezwe ku-opera yaseFrance, ngu-Camille Saint-Saens, iciko “elikuphila kwalo kwathathwa uthando lwezidakamizwa kanye ne-Japani.”

src: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
mt: Ngenxa yalokho, abaculi bashaya izidakamizwa zensangu esiteji, futhi umnyuziyamu uqobo ukhuthaza izilaleli ukuba zijoyine.
ref: Njengomphumela, abaculi babhema amajoyinynti insangu ye-cannabis esiteji, futhi nethiyetha ngokwayo igqugquzela izilaleli ukuba zihlanganyele.

src: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
mt: OwayengusiSithunywa seNdlu kaZwelonke uNewt Gingrich, umbusi waseTexas uRick Perry, nowesifazane waseKhomanisi uMichele Bachmann baqeda endaweni yesine, yesihlanu, nesithupha, ngokulandelana.
ref: Umkhulumeli Wendlu uNewt Gingrich, umbusi waseTexas uRick Perry, kanye nelungu lesishaya-mthetho lowesifazane uMichele Bachmann baqede endaweni yesine, yesihlanu, kanye neyesithupha, ngokulandelana.

src: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
mt: Ngemva kokuba imiphumela seyifikile, uGingrich wadumisa uSantorum, kodwa wakhuluma kanzima noRomney, egameni lakhe okwakusakazwa izikhangiso zenkampanini ezingezinhle e-Iowa ngokumelene noGingrich.
ref: Ngemva kokuba kufike imiphumela, uGingrich ubabaze uSantorum, kodwa wayenamazwi anzima kuRomney, lowo owenzelwa umkhankaso wezikhangiso ezimbi e-Iowa ngokumelene noGingrich.

src: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
mt: UPerry wathi "uzobuyela eTexas ukuhlola imiphumela ye-caucus yanamuhla, anqume ukuthi ikhona yini indlela engizoya ngayo kulo mncintiswano", kodwa kamuva wathi uzohlala kulo mncintiswano futhi ancintane kuma-primary aseNingizimu Carolina ngoJanuwari 21.
ref: U-Perry wathi waye "zobuyela e-Texas ukuyohlola imiphumela yekhokhasi yanamuhla ebusuku, nginqume ukuthi ingabe ikhona yini indlela ephambili yami kulo mjaho", kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi wathi uzohlala emncintiswaneni futhi ancintisane ngoMasingana 21 e-South Carolina primary.

src: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
mt: UBachmann, owawina i-Ames Straw Poll ngo-August, wanquma ukuqeda umkhankaso wakhe.
ref: UBachmann, owanqoba i-Ames Straw Poll  ngoNcwaba, wanquma ukuqeda umkhankaso.

src: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
mt: Umthwebuli wezithombe wathunyelwa eRonald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, lapho ashona khona kamuva.
ref: Umthwebuli wezithombe wayiswa esiKhungweni sezoKwelapha sikaRonald Reagan UCLA, lapho eshone khona ngokushesha.

src: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
mt: Kubikwa ukuthi wayeneminyaka engaphezu kwengu-20 ubudala. Esitatimendeni, uBieber wathi "[yize] bengingekho noma ngithinteke ngqo kule ngozi edabukisayo, imicabango nemithandazo yami inomndeni wesisulu".
ref: Kuthiwa wayeseminyakeni yawo-20. Esitatimendeni, uBieber uthe "nakuba ngangingekho futhi ngingahilelekile ngokuqondile kulengozi ebuhlungu, imicabango kanye nemikhuleko yami inomndeni wesisulu."

src: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
mt: Iwebhusayithi yezindaba zokuzijabulisa i-TMZ iyaqonda ukuthi umthwebuli wezithombe wamisa imoto yakhe ngaphesheya kweSepulveda Boulevard futhi wazama ukuthatha izithombe zokuma kwamaphoyisa ngaphambi kokuwela umgwaqo nokuqhubeka, okwenza iphoyisa laseCalifornia Highway Patrol eliqhuba ukumisa izimoto ukuba limyale ukuba aphinde aphinde, kabili.
ref: Iwebhusayithi yezindaba zokuzijabulisa i-TMZ iqonda ukuthi umthathi wezithombe wamisa imoto yakhe kolunye uhlangothi lweSepulveda Boulevard futhi wazama ukuthatha izithombe zamaphoyisa ayevimbezele ngaphambi kokuwela umgwaqo futhi aqhubeke, okwashukumisa iphoyisa leCalifornia Highway Patrol elalivimebezele izimoto ukuba limyalele ukuthi a welele emuva, kabili.

src: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
mt: Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa, umshayeli wemoto eshayise umthwebuli wezithombe akunakwenzeka ukuthi abhekane namacala obugebengu.
ref: Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa, cishe akunakwenzeka ukuthi umshayeli wemoto eshayise umthathi wezithombe amangalelwe.

src: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
mt: Njengoba kunem medal eyishumi nesishiyagalombili kuphela etholakala ngosuku, amazwe amaningana ahlulekile ukufinyelela endaweni yokudlulisa indondo.
ref: Ngamamedali ayishumi nesishiyagalimbili kuphela atholakalayo ngosuku, amazwe amaningi ahlulekile ukuthola izindondo zamamedali.

src: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
mt: Kuzohlanganisa neNetherlands, lapho u-Anna Jochemsen aqeda khona okwesishiyagalolunye esigabeni sabasetyhini esimile ku-Super-G izolo, neFinland noKathaja Saarinen eqeda eyishumi emcimbini ofanayo.
ref: Bahlanganisa iNetherlands, ngo-Anna Jochemsen oqede endaweni yesishiyagalolunye esigabeni sabesifazane abamile kuyiSuper-G izolo, neFinland ngoKatja Saarinen oqede endaweni yeshumi emdlalweni ofanayo.

src: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
mt: Umdlali wase-Australia uMitchell Gourley waqeda endaweni yeshumi nanye kuma-Super-G amadoda. Umncintiswano waseCzech u-Oldrich Jelinek waqeda endaweni yeshumi nesithupha kuma-Super-G amadoda ahleliyo.
ref: U-Mitchell Gourley wase-Australia uqede esikhundleni seshumi nanye esigabeni sabesilise sabamile se-Super-G. Imbangi yaseCzech u-Oldrich Jelinek uqede esikhundleni seshumi nesithupha esigabeni sabesilisa sabahlezi se-Super-G.

src: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
mt: U-Arly Velasquez waseMexico waqeda endaweni yeshumi nanhlanu e-Super-G yabesilisa. U-Adam Hall waseNew Zealand waqeda endaweni yesishiyagalolunye e-Super-G yamadoda.
ref: U-Arly Velasquez waseMexico uqede endaweni yesishumi nanhlanu kuyiSuper-G yabesilisa abahlezi. UAdam Hall waseNyuzilandi uqede endaweni yesishiyagalolunye kuyiSuper G yabesilisa abamile.

src: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
mt: Umgijimi we-ski wesilisa ongaboni kahle wasePoland uMaciej Krezel nomqondisi u-Anna Ogarzynska baqede endaweni yesithathu ku-Super-G. I-Jong Seork Park yaseNingizimu Korea yaqeda indawo yamashumi amabili nane ku-Super-G yabesilisa.
ref: Umshushuluzi waseqhweni wase-Poland wesigaba sabesilisa abangaboni kahle u-Maciej Krezel nomqondisi u-Anna Ogarzynska uqede endaweni yeshumi nantathu kuyi-Super-G. UJong Seork Park waseNingizimu Korea uqede endaweni yamashumi amabili nesine esigabeni sabesilisa abahlezi se-Super-G.

src: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
mt: Abasebenzi bezokuvikela ukuthula be-UN, abafika eHaiti ngemva kokuzamazama komhlaba kuka-2010, basolwa ngokusabalala kwalesi sifo esaqala eduze kwekamu lamasosha.
ref: Abagcini bokuthula be-UN, abafike eHaiti ngemva kokuzamazama komhlaba kwango-2010, babekwa icala ngokusabalala kwesifo esiqale eduze nakumu lamasosha.

src: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
mt: Ngokwesicelo, udoti ovela ekamu le-UN awuhlanzekanga kahle, okwenza ukuba amabhaktheriya angene emfuleni i-Artibonite River, omunye omkhulu kunawo wonke eHaiti.
ref: Ngokwecala, ukungcola okuvela ekamu le-UN akukhucululwanga kahle, okwabangela ukuthi amabhakithiliya angene emingeneleni yoMfula i-Artibonite, omunye wemifula emikhulu yaseHaiti.

src: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
mt: Ngaphambi kokufika kwamaphoyisa, iHaiti yayingahlangabezani nezinkinga ezihlobene nalesi sifo kusukela ngawo-1800.
ref: Ngaphambi kokufika kwamabutho, iHaiti beyingakahlangabezani nezinkinga ezihlobene nesifo kusukela ngawo-1800.

src: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
mt: I-Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy ibhekisele ezifundweni ezizimele ezibonisa ukuthi ibutho le-UN lokugcina ukuthula laseNepal laletha lesi sifo eHaiti ngaphandle kokwazi.
ref: Inhlangano yaseHaiti yoKulunga Nombuso Wentando Yeningi icaphune ucwaningo oluzimele olusikisela ukuthi iqembu lamabutho ayinkulungwane le-UN laseNephali lokugcina ukuthula lilethe isifo eHaiti lingazi.

src: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
mt: UDanielle Lantagne, isazi se-UN esibhekene nalesi sifo, wathi kungenzeka ukuthi ukuqubuka kwabangelwa ngabasebenzi bezokuvikela ukuthula.
ref: UDanielle Lantagne, isazi se-UN ngisifo, uthe kunamathuba okuthi ukuqubuka kwesifo kubangelwe abagcini bokuthula.

src: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
mt: UHamilton waqinisekisa ukuthi isibhedlela saseHoward University samukela isiguli esimweni esizinzile.
ref: UHamilton uqinisekise ukuthi Isibhedlela saseNyuvesi yaseHoward samukele isiguli sisesimweni esizinzile.

src: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
mt: Lesi siguli besiseNigeria, lapho kube khona amanye amacala egciwane le-Ebola.
ref: Isiguli ebesiye eNigeria, lapho kwenzeke khona ezinye izigameko zegciwane le-Ebola.

src: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
mt: Isibhedlela silandele inqubo yokulawula ukutheleleka, kuhlanganise nokuhlukanisa isiguli kwabanye ukuze kuvinjelwe ukutheleleka okungenzeka kwabanye.
ref: Izibhedlela zilandele imithetho yokulawula ukutheleleka, okuhlanganisa ukuhlukanisa iziguli kwezinye ukuze kugwenywe ukutheleleka.

src: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
mt: Ngaphambi kwe-The Simpsons uSimon wayesebenze emidlalweni eminingi ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene.
ref: Ngaphambi kweThe Simpsons uSimon wayesebenze ezinhlelweni eziningana ezikhundleni ezihlukahlukene.

src: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
mt: Ngawo-1980 wasebenza emidlalweni efana neTaxis, Cheers, neThe Tracy Ullman Show.
ref: Ngeminyaka yama-1980 wasebenza emibukisweni efana neTaxi, i-Cheers, noMboniso we-Tracy Ullman.

src: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
mt: Ngo-1989 wasiza ukudala iThe Simpsons noBrooks noGroening, futhi waba nesibopho sokuqasha ithimba lokuqala lokubhala lombukiso.
ref: Ngo-1989 wasiza ukwakha i-The Simpsons no-Brooks kanye no-Groening, futhi wayenomthwalo wemfanelo wokuqasha iqembu lohlelo lokubhala lokuqala.

src: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
mt: Naphezu kokushiya lo mbukiso ngo-1993 wagcina isihloko somkhiqizi ophezulu, futhi waqhubeka nokuthola amashumi ezigidi zamaRandi ngesizini ngayinye njengamalungelo obukhosi.
ref: Ngaphezu kokuyeka uhlelo ngo-1993 ugcine isiqu somdidiyeli wohlelo, futhi waqhubeka nokuthola amashumi wezigidi zamadola isizini ngayinye wemivuzo.

src: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.
mt: Ngaphambilini i-ejensi yezindaba yaseChina i-Xinhua yabika indiza ukuthi izothathwa.
ref: Ngaphambili, inhlangano yezindaba yaseShayina i-Xinhua yabika ukuthi kunendiza ethunjiwe.

src: Later reports then stated the plane received a bomb threat and was diverted back to Afghanistan, landing in Kandahar.
mt: Imibiko yakamuva yathi indiza yathola usongo lwebhomu futhi yaqondiswa emuva e-Afghanistan, yafika e-Kandahar.
ref: Imibiko yakamuva yabe isithi indiza ithola ukusongelwa ngebhomu futhi yaphambukiselwa emuva e-Afghanistan, ima e-Kandahar.

src: The early reports say the plane was diverted back to Afghanistan after being denied an emergency landing in Ürümqi.
mt: Imibiko yokuqala ithi indiza yaqondiswa emuva e-Afghanistan ngemva kokwenqatshelwa ukufika okuphuthumayo e-Ürümqi.
ref: Imibiko yasekuqaleni ithi indiza iphambukiselwe emuva e-Afghanistan ngemva kokwenqatshelwa indawo yokuma yezimo eziphuthumayo e-Ürümqi.

src: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
mt: Izingozi zezindiza zivamile e-Iran, enenqwaba endala yomkhumbi engalondolozwa kahle kokubili imisebenzi yomphakathi neyempi.
ref: Izingozi zasemoyeni zivamile e-Iran, enezindiza eziningi ezigugile ezingalondolozwa kahle ezisetshenziselwa kokubili izakhamizi ezivamile kanye nempi.

src: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.
mt: Izinhlawulo zamazwe ngamazwe ziye zasho ukuthi izindiza ezintsha azikwazi ukuthengwa.
ref: Ukujeziswa kwamanye amazwe kusho ukuthi indiza entsha ayinakuthengwa.

src: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
mt: Ekuqaleni kwaleli sonto, ingozi yendiza enophephela emhlane yamaphoyisa yabulala abantu abathathu futhi yalimaza abanye abathathu.
ref: Ekuqaleni kwaleli viki, ukuphahlazeka kwendiza yamaphoyisa enophephela emhlane kubulale abantu abathathu futhi kwalimaza abanye abathathu.

src: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
mt: Ngenyanga edlule i-Iran yabhekana nenhlekelele yayo embi kunazo zonke emoyeni eminyakeni eminingi lapho indiza eya e-Armenia ingqubuzana, yabulala abangu-168 ababekhombeni.
ref: Ngenyanga edlule i-Iran yavelelwa inhlekelele enkulu yezindiza ngemva kweminyaka lapho indiza eyayiphokophele e-Armenia yaphahlazeka khona, yabulala abangu-168 ababekuyo.

src: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
mt: Ngenyanga efanayo, enye indiza yezindiza yagqekeza umzila wokugibela eMashhad futhi yashaya udonga, kwafa abayishumi nesikhombisa.
ref: Ngenyanga efanayo indiza idlule lapho umgwaqo wezindiza uphelela khona eMashhad futhi yashayisa udonga, ibulala abayishumi nesikhombisa.

src: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
mt: I-Aerosmith ikhanselile amakhonsathi ayo asele ohambweni lwayo.
ref: I-Aerosmith ikhansele amakhonsathi ayo asele ohambweni lwayo.

src: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
mt: Leli qembu le-rock kwakufanele lihambele e-United States nase-Canada kuze kube ngu-September 16.
ref: Iqembu lomculo we-rock bekufanele livakashele eMelika naseKhanada kuze kube nguMandulo 16.

src: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
mt: Bakhansele lolu hambo ngemuva kokuba umculi oholayo uSteven Tyler elimele ngemva kokuwa esiteji ngesikhathi edlala ngo-Agasti 5.
ref: Bakhansele uhambo ngemva kokuba umculi oyinhloko u-Steven Tyler elimele ngemva kokuwa esiteji ngenkathi ecula ngoNcwaba

src: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
mt: UMurray walahlekelwa isethi yokuqala ngesikhathi sokubambana ngemuva kokuba bobabili abantu beqede isethi ngayinye.
ref: UMurray ulahlekelwe ingxenye yakhe yomdlalo emdlalweni wokubona ukuthi kuwina bani kwabalinganayo ngamaphuzu ngemva kokuthi womabili amadoda ayelingana ezinyeni zawo zomdlalo.

src: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.
mt: UDel Potro waba nesandla sokuqala emdlalweni wesibili, kodwa lokhu futhi kwakudinga ukuphumula ngokulingana ngemuva kokufinyelela ku-6-6.
ref: UDel Potro wayesesimweni esiyinzuzo ekuqaleni engxenyeni yesibili yomdlalo, kodwa lona nawo ubudinga umdlalo wokubona ukuthi kuphumelela bani kwabalinganayo ngemva kokufika ku-6-6.

src: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
mt: UPotro wathola ukwelashwa ehlombe lakhe ngalesi sikhathi kodwa wakwazi ukubuyela emdlalweni.
ref: UPotro uthole ukwelashwa ehlombe ngaleso sikhathi kodwa wakwazi ukubuyela emdlalweni .

src: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
mt: Lolu hlelo lwaqala ngo-8:30 ntambama ngesikhathi sendawo (15.00 UTC).
ref: Uhlelo lwaqala ngo-8:30 p.m. ngesikhathi sendawo (15.00 UTC).

src: Famous singers across the country presented bhajans, or devotional songs, to Shri Shyam's feet.
mt: Abaculi abadumile ezweni lonke baletha amabhajans, noma izingoma zokuzinikela, ezinyaweni zikaShri Shyam.
ref: Abaculi abadumile ezweni lonke banikela ngama-bhajan, noma izingoma zokuzinikela, ezinyaweni zikaShri Shyam.

src: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, followed by Jai Shankar Choudhary. esented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
mt: Umculi uSanju Sharma waqala kusihlwa, kulandela uJai Shankar Choudhary. wahlabelela i-chhappan bhog bhajan futhi. Umculi, uRaju Khandelwal wayehamba naye.
ref: Umculi uSanju Sharma bekunguye oqalile kusihlwa, elandelwa uJai Shankar Choudhary. Unikele nge-chhappan bhog bhajan ngokufanayo. Umculi, uRaju Khandelwala wayehamba naye.

src: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
mt: Bese kuthi uLakhha Singh uhola ekuculeni amabhajans.
ref: Ngakho, uLakkha Singh uholile ekuculeni i-bhajans.

src: 108 plates of Chhappan Bhog (in Hinduism, 56 different edible items, like, sweets, fruits, nuts, dishes etc. which are offered to deity) were served to Baba Shyam.
mt: Izitsha eziyi-108 ze-Chappan Bhog (kumaHindu, izinto ezidliwayo ezahlukahlukene ezingama-56, njengezithako, izithelo, amantongomane, izitsha njll. ezinikelwe kunkulunkulu) zazinikezwa uBaba Shyam.
ref: Izitsha ezingu-108 zeChhappan Bhog (ngenkolelo yobuHindu, izinto ezidliwayo ezihlukile ezingu-56, njengamaswidi, izithelo, amantongomane, ukudla njll. Okunikelwa esithixweni) zanikezelwa kuBaba Shyam.

src: Lakkha Singh presented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
mt: ULakha Singh wethula i-chhappan bhog bhajan futhi.Umculi, uRaju Khandelwal wayehamba naye.
ref: U-Lakkha Singh wanikezela ngange-Chhappan bhog bhajan. Umculi, uRaju Khandelwal bekahamba naye.

src: At Thursday's keynote presentation of the Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's new Nintendo Revolution console.
mt: Esethulweni esikhulu sangoLwesine seTokyo Game Show, umongameli weNintendo uSatoru Iwata wethule umklamo wokulawula wekhonsoli entsha yeNintendo Revolution yenkampani.
ref: EsethulwenisangoLwesine esasingumongo se-Tokyo Game Show, umongameli we-Nintendo u-Satoru Iwata wadalula isakhiwo sesilawuli se-Nintendo Revolution sesilawuli esisha senkampani.

src: Resembling a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed near the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.
mt: Isebenzisa izinzwa ezimbili ezibekwe eduze kwethelevishini yomsebenzisi ukuze ihlukanise indawo yayo endaweni engokwemvelo.
ref: Isilawuli esifana ne-remote yethelevishini, sisebenzisa izinzwa ezimbili ezibekwe duzane nethelevishini ukwenza indawo yayo ibe nezingxenye ezintathu endaweni enezinhlangothi ezintathu.

src: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.
mt: Lokhu kuzovumela abadlali ukuba balawule izenzo nokunyakaza emidlalweni yevidiyo ngokuhambisa idivayisi emoyeni.
ref: Lokhu kuzovumela abadlali ukuba balawule izenzo nokunyakaza emdlalweni wevidiyo ngokunyakazisa isisetshenziswa emoyeni.

src: Giancarlo Fisichella lost control of his car and ended the race very soon after the start.
mt: UGiancarlo Fisichella walahlekelwa ukulawula imoto yakhe futhi waqeda umjaho ngokushesha ngemva kokuqala.
ref: UGiancarlo Fisichella wangakwazi ukuqondisa imoto yakhe futhi waqeda umjaho ngokushesha ngomva kokuba uqale.

src: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.
mt: Umlingani wakhe uFernando Alonso wayehola umjaho isikhathi esiningi, kodwa waqeda ngokushesha ngemva kokuma kwakhe emgodini, mhlawumbe ngenxa yesondo langaphambili langakwesokudla elalihlelwe kabi.
ref: Abeqembu lakhe u-Fernando Alonso bebephuma phambili cishe kuwoo wonke umjaho, kodwa kuphele ngokushesha nje ngemva kokupaka endaweni yokulungisa imoto, kungenzeka kungenxa yesondo langaphambili elifakwe kabi.

src: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.
mt: UMichael Schumacher waqeda umjaho wakhe ngemva nje kuka-Alonso, ngenxa yokulimala kokumiswa kwemoto emizamweni eminingi ngesikhathi somjaho.
ref: UMichael Schumacher waqeda umjaho wakhe kungekudala ngemva kuka-Alonso, ngenxa yokulimala kwesimo esigcina imoto iphakeme emishikashikeni eminingi phakathi nomjaho.

src: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.
mt: "Uyamjabulisa futhi uhlabelela kahle kakhulu," esho ngokusho kombhalo wenkomfa yezindaba.
ref: "Muhle kakhulu futhi ucula kahle kakhulu, futhi," washo kuya ngamakhophi okukhulunyiwe wenkomfa yabezindaba.

src: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."
mt: "Ngangishaywa umxhwele njalo lapho senza umzamo kulokhu, ngokusuka enhliziyweni yami".
ref: Ngangithinteka ekujuleni kwenhliziyo yami, njalo lapho silungiselela lokhu.

src: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.
mt: Cishe ngemva kwemizuzu emithathu kwethulwe, ikhamera ebhodini yabonisa izingcezu eziningi ze-insulation foam eziphuka ethangini likaphethiloli.
ref: Cishe emizuzwini emithathu ngaphambi kokuqalisa, ikhamera esemkhumbini yaveza izingcezu eziningi zogwebu olufudumazayo luphuma ethangini lamafutha.

src: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.
mt: Kodwa-ke, akucatshangwa ukuthi zibangele noma yiziphi izingozi ku-shuttle.
ref: Nokho, akucatshangwa ukuthi zenze noma imuphi umonakalo enqoleni.

src: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."
mt: Inhloko yohlelo lwe-NASA shuttle u-N. Wayne Hale Jr. uthe i-foam yawa "ngemuva kwesikhathi esikhathazeke ngaso".
ref: Isikhulu sohlelo lwemikhumbi-mkhathi luka-NASA u-N. Wayne Hale Jr. uthe igwebu lase liwile "ngemuva kwesikhathi esikhathazekile ngazo."

src: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.
mt: Emizuzwini emihlanu embonisweni umoya uqala ukudilika, cishe ngemva komzuzu, umoya ufinyelela ku-70km / h... bese kuza imvula, kodwa enamandla futhi inkulu kangangokuthi ishaya isikhumba sakho njengenaliti, bese kuba nesikhungu esivela esibhakabhakeni, abantu beshaqeka futhi bememeza futhi begijima omunye komunye.
ref: Imizuzu emihlanu umbukiso uqalile umoya uqala ukungena, cishe ngemva komzuzu, umoya ufinyelela u-70km/h… bese imvula iyeza, kodwa enzima nenkulu kangangokuba ihlaba isikhumba sakho njengenaliti, bese isichotho sawa emkhathini, abantu bayaxhamazela futhi bayamemeza futhi bayagxobana.

src: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.
mt: Ngashonelwa ngudadewethu nomngane wakhe, futhi endleleni yami kwakukhona abantu ababili abakhubazekile ababehamba ngamasondo, abantu ababegxuma nje futhi babacindezele," kusho u-Armand Versace.
ref: Ngilahlekelwe ngudadewethu kanye nomngane wakhe, futhi endleleni ngilibangise lapho bekunabantu ababili abakhubazekile ababehlezi ezihlalweni ezinamasondo, abantu bebeqa ngaphezulu futhi bebasunduza,” kusho u-Armand Versace.

src: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
mt: I-NHK yabika futhi ukuthi isitshalo samandla enuzi iKashiwazaki Kariwa esifundazweni saseNiigata sasisebenza ngendlela evamile.
ref: I-NHK ibike nokuthi isifunda sesikhungo samandla wenuzi iKashiwazaki Karawa eNiigata besisebenza ngokuvamile.

src: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
mt: I-Hokuriku Electric Power Co. ibike ukuthi ayikho imiphumela yokuzamazama komhlaba nokuthi ama-reactors e-Nomb 1 no-2 esikhungweni sayo samandla enuzi i-Shika avalwa.
ref: IHokuriku Electric Power Co. ayibikanga ukuthinteka okuvela ekuzamazameni komhlaba nokuthi isiphehli Nombolo 1 no-2 esikhungweni sayo samandla enuzi zivaliwe.

src: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
mt: Kubikwa ukuthi cishe amakhaya angu-9400 kule ndawo awanamanzi futhi cishe angu-100 awanamandla kagesi.
ref: Kubikwe ukuthi amakhaya angaba ngu-9400 endaweni awanawo amanzi futhi cishe angu-100 awanawo ugesi.

src: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
mt: Eminye imigwaqo yonakele, umsebenzi wesitimela uphazamisekile ezindaweni ezithintekile, futhi Isikhumulo sezindiza i-Noto esifundazweni sase-Ishikawa sivaliwe.
ref: Eminye imigwaqo ibe nomonakalo, imisebenzi yesitimela iphazamisekile ezindaweni ezithintekile, futhi neSikhumulo Sezindiza saseNoto sasesifundazweni sase-Ishikawa sisavaliwe.

src: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
mt: Ibhomu elilodwa laqhuma ngaphandle kwehhovisi lika-governor-general.
ref: Ibhomu eyodwa iqhume ngaphandle kwehhovisi likandunankulu.

src: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
mt: Amabhomu amathathu aphinde aqhuma eduze kwezakhiwo zikahulumeni esikhathini esingamahora amabili.
ref: Amabhomu amanye amathathu aqhumile eduze nezakhiwo zikahulumeni esikhathini samahora amabili.

src: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.
mt: Eminye imibiko ibeka isibalo sabantu abashonile ngokusemthethweni esiyisishiyagalombili, futhi imibiko esemthethweni iqinisekisa ukuthi kwalimala abantu abangaba ngu-30, kodwa izinombolo zokugcina asaziwa.
ref: Eminye imibiko ithi inani labafile elisemthethweni isishiyagalombili, futhi umbiko osemthethweni uqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abangaba ngu-30 balimele; kepha izinombolo zokugcina azikaziwa.

src: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
mt: Kokubili i-cyanuric acid ne-melamine zatholakala kumasampula omchamo ezifuywayo ezafa ngemva kokudla ukudla okudidiyelwe kwezilwane ezifuywayo.
ref: Kokubili i-cynuric acid kanye ne-melamine zitholakele kumasampula omchamo ovela ezilwaneni ezifuywayo ezishne ngemva kokudla ukudla kwezilwane okungcolile.

src: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
mt: Abacwaningi baseyunivesithi bathi lezi zinhlanganisela ezimbili zihlangana ukuze zakhe amakristalu angase avimbele ukusebenza kwezinso.
ref: Izakhi ezimbili ziyaxubana ukuze zenze amakristalu angavimba ukusebenza kwezinso, kwasho abacwabingi basenyuvesi.

src: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
mt: Abacwaningi babona amakristalu akhiwa kumchamo wekati ngokungezwa kwe-melamine ne-cyanuric acid.
ref: Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi amakristalu enzeka emchamweni wekati ngokunezeleka kwe-milamine kanye ne-cyanuric acid.

src: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
mt: Ukwakheka kwalawa makristalu kuyafana nalokho okutholakala emchameni wezilwane ezifuywayo ezithintekile uma kuqhathaniswa ne-infrared spectroscopy (i-FTIR).
ref: Ukwakheka kwalamakristalu kufana nalokho okutholakale emchamweni wezilwane ezifuywayo ezithintekile uma uqhathaniswa nge-infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).

src: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
mt: Angazi ukuthi uyakuqaphela noma cha, kodwa izimpahla eziningi ezivela eMelika Ephakathi zafika kuleli zwe zingenazo intela.
ref: Angazi ukuthi uyakuphawula noma cha, kodwa iningi lezimpahla ezivela eMelika ePhakathi zeza kulelizwe ngaphandle kokukhokhiswa intela.

src: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.
mt: Kodwa amaphesenti angamashumi ayisishiyagalombili ezimpahla zethu zafakwa intela ngentela emazweni aseMelika Ephakathi.
ref: Nokho amaphesenti ayisishiyagalombili wempahla yethu akhokhiswe intela ngezihlelo zokutheliswa kwempahla engenayo noma ephumayo ezweni emazweni waseMelika ePhakathi. Siyakuphatha.

src: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
mt: Lokho akuzange kubonakale kunengqondo kimi; ngokuqinisekile kwakungalungile.
ref: Lokho bekungenzi ingqondo kimi; bekungalungile nakanjani.

src: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
mt: Engikushoyo kubantu ukuthi usiphathe ngendlela thina esikuphatha ngayo.
ref: Engikushoyo nje kubantu ngukuthi siphathe ngendlela esikuphatha ngayo.

src: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
mt: Umbusi waseCalifornia u-Arnold Schwarzenegger wasayina umthetho omisa umthetho ovimbela ukuthengiswa noma ukuqashwa kwemidlalo ye-video enobudlova ezinganeni.
ref: UMbusi waseCalifornia u-Arnorld Schwarzenegger ugunyaze umthetho ovivinywayo ovimbela ukudayisela noma ukuqashisela izingane imidlalo yevidiyo enodleme ukuba ube umthetho.

src: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
mt: Umthetho-sisekelo udinga ukuthi imidlalo yama-video enobudlova ethengiswa esifundazweni saseCalifornia ibhalwe ngo-decal efundeka ngokuthi "18" futhi yenza ukuthengiswa kwayo kumuntu omncane kuhlawuliswe ngenhlawulo engu-$1000 ngecala ngalinye.
ref: Irisidi ebonisa ukudayiswa kwemidlalo yevidiyo embusweni wase-California ephawulwe ngokuthi “18”okwenza umthengisi wayo ahlawuliswe imali engu-$1000 icala ngalinye.

src: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
mt: Umqondisi Wezokushushiswa Komphakathi, u-Kir Starmer QC, wenze isitatimende namuhla ekuseni ememezela ukushushiswa kokubili kukaHuhne noPrice.
ref: UMqondisi wezoKubekwa Kwamacala koMphakathi, uKier Starmer QC, unikeze isitatimende namuhla ekuseni ememezela ukubekwa kwecala kukaHuhne kanye noPryce bobabili.

src: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
mt: U-Huhne usishiyile isikhundla futhi uzothathelwa indawo kuKhabhinethi yi-Ed Davey MP. Kulindeleke ukuthi u-Norman Lamb MP athathe umsebenzi kaNgqongqoshe Wezamabhizinisi uDavey awushiyayo.
ref: UHuhne ushiye phansi futhi isikhundla sakhe kuKhabhinethi sizothathwa ngu-Ed Davey MP. UNorman Lamb MP kulindeleke ukuthi athathe umsebenzi wobuNgqongqoshe Wezamabhizinisi lo oyekwe uDavey.

src: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
mt: UHuhne noPrice bahlelelwe ukuvela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseWestminster ngoFebhuwari 16.
ref: UHhne kanye noPryce bahlelelwe ukuvela eNkantolo kaMatshi yaseWestminster ngoNhlolanja 16,

src: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.
mt: Abafayo kwakunguNicholas Alden, oneminyaka engu-25, noZachary Cuddeback, oneminyaka engu-21. UCuddeback wayenguMshayeli.
ref: Ukufa kukaNicholas Alden, ona-25, kanye noZachary Cuddeback, ona-21. UCuddeback wayengumshayeli.

src: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.
mt: U-Edgar Veguilla wathola amanxeba engalweni nasesithendeni kuyilapho u-Kristoffer Schneider eshiywe edinga ukuhlinzwa kabusha ebusweni bakhe.
ref: U-Edga Veguilla wathola amanxeba wasengalweni nasemhlathini kuyilapho u-Kristoffer Schneider wasala edinga ukuhlizwa kokwakha kabusha ebusweni.

src: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.
mt: Isikhali sika-Uka sehlulekile ngenkathi sikhomba ikhanda lendoda yesihlanu.U-Snaider unesifo esiqhubekayo, ukungaboni kahle kwelinye iso, ingxenye engekho yesikhunta nobuso obakhiwe kabusha nge-titanium.
ref: Isikhali sika-Uka sahluleka lapho wayekhombe indoda yesihlanu ekhanda. U-Schneider wayenobuhlungu obungapheli, ukungaboni esweni elilodwa, ingxenye yogebhezi engekho kanye nobuso obakhiwe kabusha nge-titanium.

src: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.
mt: US Schneider ufakazile nge-video link esuka esikhungweni se-USAF ezweni lakubo.
ref: U-Schneider wanikeza ubufakazi ngevidiyo kusuka esikhungweni se-USAF ezweni lakubo.

src: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.
mt: Ngaphandle komcimbi wangoLwesithathu, uCarpanedo wancintisana emincintiswaneni emibili ngawodwana kuma-Championships.
ref: Ngale kwesehlakalo sangolwesithathu, uCarpanedo uncintisane emijahweni emibili ngayinye yobuShampeni.

src: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.
mt: Owokuqala wayo kwakuyi-Slalom, lapho yathola khona i-Did Not Finish emjahweni wayo wokuqala. Abangu-36 kwabayincintisana abangu-116 baba nomphumela ofanayo kulowo mncintiswano.
ref: Umncintiswano wakhe wokuqala bekuyi-Slalom, lapho Engaqedanga khona umncintiswano wakhe wokuqala. Abancintisanayo abangu-36 kwabangu-116 bathole imiphumela efanayo kulowo mncintiswano.

src: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.
mt: Omunye umjaho wakhe, iGiant Slalom, wabona eqeda endaweni yeshumi eqenjini labesifazane abahleli phansi ngesikhathi sokugijima esihlanganisiwe esingu-4:41.30, 2:11.60 imizuzu ephansi kunomdlali wase-Austria uClaudia Loesch ogcine indawo yokuqala kanye no-1:09.02 imizuzu ephansi kunomdlali wase-Hungary uGyöngyi Dani ogcine indawo yesishiyagalolunye.
ref: Omunye umjaho wakhe, i-Giant Slalom, waqeda engoweshumi eqenjini labesifazane elalihlezi nesikhathi esihlanganisiwe esingu-4:41.30, wayesemuva ngo-2:11.60 ku-Austrian Claudia Loesch owathatha indawo yokuqala futhi wayesemuva ngo- 1:09.02 k-uGyöngyi Dani wase-Hungary owaqeda ekwindawo yesishiyagalolunye.

src: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
mt: Abashushumbisi abane eqenjini labesifazane abahleli phansi bahlulekile ukuqeda imijikelezo yabo, futhi abangu-45 kubashushumbisi abangu-117 abagijimile eGiant Slalom bahlulekile ukufaka umjaho.
ref: Abashushuluza eqhweni abane eqenjini labesifazane abahlezi bahluleke ukuqeda imijaho yabo, futhi abangu-45 kwabangu-117 abashushuluza eqhweni eSlalom eNkulu bahluleke ukuthola izikhundla emjahweni.

src: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
mt: Amaphoyisa aseMadhya Pradesh athola i-laptop ne-smartphone eyebiwe.
ref: Amaphoyisa aseMadhya Pradesh amukele ikhompyutha ephathwayo kanye nomakhalekhukhwini.

src: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".
mt: Iphini loMhloli Jikelele uDK Arya uthe, "Sibophe abantu abahlanu abadlwengula owesifazane waseSwitzerland futhi bathola umakhalekhukhwini wakhe kanye ne-laptop".
ref: Iphini loMphenyi oMkhulu uD K Arya uthe, "Sibophe abantu abahlanu abanukubeze ngokocansi owesifazane waseSwitzerland futhi simbuyisele ucingo lwakhe kanye ne-laptop".

src: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
mt: Abasolwa babizwa ngokuthi uBaba Kanjar, uBhutha Kanjar, uRampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar noVishnu Kanjar.
ref: Abasolwa babizwa ngoBaba Kanjar, uBhutha Kanjar, uRampro Kanjar, uGaza Kanjar kanye noVishnu Kanjar.

src: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
mt: Umphathi wamaphoyisa uCandra Shekhar Solanki uthe umsolwa wavela enkantolo ebusweni bakhe.
ref: Umphathi wamaphoyisa uChandra Solanki uthe abasolwa bavele enkantolo bazifihle ubuso.

src: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.
mt: Nakuba abantu abathathu babephakathi endlini ngesikhathi imoto ingena kuyo, akekho kubo owalimala.
ref: Nakuba bekunabantu abathathu phakathi kwendlu ngenkathi imoto iyishayisa, akekho kubo olimele.

src: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.
mt: Nokho, umshayeli walimala kakhulu ekhanda.
ref: Noma kunjalo, umshayeli uthole izingozi ezimbi ekhanda.

src: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.
mt: Umgwaqo lapho kwenzeke khona ingozi wavalwa okwesikhashana ngenkathi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zikhulula umshayeli emgqeni obomvu we-Audi TT.
ref: Umgwaqo lapho inhlekelele yenzeka khona wavalwa okwesikhashana ngesikhathi izisebenzi zezimo eziphuthumayo zikhulula umshayeli kuyi-Audi TT ebomvu.

src: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
mt: Ekuqaleni wahlala esibhedlela esibhedlela iJames Paget Hospital eGreat Yarmouth.
ref: Uqale wangeniswa esibhedlela sase-James Paget e–Yarmouth eNkulu.

src: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
mt: Kamuva wathuthela esibhedlela i-Addenbrooke's Hospital eCambridge.
ref: Ngokulandelayo uye watholakala eSibhedlela i-Addenbrooke e-Cambridge.

src: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
mt: Kusukela ngaleso sikhathi u-Adekoya useNkantolo ye-Edinburgh Sheriff esolwa ngokubulala indodana yakhe.
ref: uAdekoya selokhu eseNkantolo ka-Sheriff yas-Edinburgh etheswe icala lokubulala indodana yakhe.

src: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
mt: Uboshiwe kuze kube yilapho esolwa futhi ethethwa icala, kodwa noma yibuphi ubufakazi obubonwe ngeso kungase bungcoliswe ngoba isithombe sakhe sesishicilelwe kabanzi.
ref: Uboshiwe njengoba esalinde ukubekwa nokuthethwa kwecala, kodwa noma ibuphi ubufakazi bofakazi bokuzibonela bungonakaliswa njengoba isithombe sakhe sishicilelwe kabanzi.

src: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.
mt: Lokhu kuwumkhuba ovamile kwenye indawo e-UK kodwa ubulungiswa baseScotland busebenza ngendlela ehlukile futhi izinkantolo zibone ukushicilelwa kwezithombe njengokulimaza.
ref: Lena inqubo evamile kwezinye izindawo e-UK kodwa umthetho waseScotland usebenza ngokuhlukile futhi izinkantolo zibone ukushicilelwa kwezithombe njengokungonakalisa.

src: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."
mt: UProfesa Pamela Ferguson wase-University of Dundee uphawula ukuthi "intatheli ibonakala ihamba emgqeni oyingozi uma ishicilela izithombe njll. abasolwa".
ref: Usolwazi Pamela Ferguson wase Nyuvesi yase-Dundee uyabhala “izintantheli zizibizela amathonsi abanzi ngokushicilela izithombe nokunye kwabasolwa.”

src: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.
mt: IHhovisi loMqhele, elibhekele ukushushiswa kwabantu, litshele izintatheli ukuthi ngeke kwenziwe amanye amazwi okungenani kuze kube yilapho sekubekwe icala.
ref: I-Crown Office, okuyiyo ephethe uphenyo, itshele izintatheli ukuthi ngeke iphawule okungenani kuze kube ukuthethwa kwecala.

src: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.
mt: Idokhumende, ngokusho kokuvuza, lizobhekisela empikiswaneni yemingcele, iPalestina efuna ngokusekelwe emingceleni ngaphambi kweMpi YaseMpumalanga Ephakathi ka-1967.
ref: Lo mbhalo, ngokwalokho okuputshukile, uzobhekisa embangweni wemingcele, iPalestine ewufunayo ngokusekelwe emingceleni ngaphambi kweMpi YaseMpumalanga yango-1967.

src: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.
mt: Ezinye izihloko okuxoxwa ngazo kubikwa ukuthi zihlanganisa isimo esizayo seJerusalema esingcwele kuzo zombili izizwe kanye nenkinga yeGodi laseJordani.
ref: Ezinye izihloko ezikhona zihlanganisa ikusasa leJerusalema eligcwele kuzo zombili izizwe kanye nenkinga Yesigodi saseJordani.

src: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.
mt: U-Israel ufuna ukuba kube khona impi eqhubekayo esigodini iminyaka eyishumi uma sekusayinwe isivumelwano kanti i-PA iyavuma ukushiya lokho kuba khona iminyaka emihlanu kuphela.
ref: I-Israyeli ifuna ukuba amasosha aqhubeke ekhona esigodini iminyaka eyishumi uma nje isivumelwano sisayinilwe nakuba i-PA ivuma ukuba amasosha abe khona iminyaka eyisihlanu kuphela.

src: Shooters in the supplementary pest control trial were to be closely supervised by rangers, as the trial was monitored and its effectiveness evaluated.
mt: Ababulali ocwaningweni lokwelashwa kwezinambuzane olwengeziwe kwakufanele babhekwe eduze ngabalindi, njengoba ucwaningo lwalubhekwa futhi ukusebenza kwalo kuhlolwa.
ref: Abadubuli esivivinyweni esingeziwe sokulawula izinambuzane kwakufanele bagadwe eduze abaqaphi, njengoba uhlolo lwaluqashwe futhi ukusebenza kwalo kwahlolwa.

src: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.
mt: Ngokubambisana kwe-NPWS ne-Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, kwaqashwa amavolontiya afanelekile, ngaphansi kohlelo lokuzingela lwe-Sporting Shooters Association.
ref: Ngokubambisana neNPWS kanye neSporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, amavolontiya afanelekayo abuthwa, ngaphansi kohlelo lokuzingela lweSporting Shooters Association.

src: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.
mt: Ngokusho kukaMick O'Flynn, uMqondisi Osebenzayo wePark Conservation and Heritage ne-NPWS, abadubuli abane abakhethelwe umsebenzi wokuqala wokudubula bathola imfundo ephelele yokuphepha nokuqeqeshwa.
ref: NgokukaMick O’Flynn, Umqondisi Obambele wePaki Lokonga Nefa kanye neNPWS, abadubuli abane abakhethwe ohlelweni lokudubula bathola ukuqeqeshwa okujulile kokuphepha nokuqeqesha.

src: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
mt: UMartelly ufunge eMkhandlwini Omusha Wezokhetho Wesikhashana (CEP) wamalungu ayisishiyagalolunye izolo.
ref: UMartelly ufungiise i-Provisional Electora Council (CEP) entsha enamalunga ayisishiyagalolunye izolo.

src: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
mt: Lona i-CEP yesihlanu kaMartelly eminyakeni emine.
ref: I-CEP yesihlanu eminyakeni emine ka-Martelly.

src: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
mt: Ngenyanga edlule ikhomishana kamongameli yancoma ukuthi i-CEP yangaphambilini isuse esikhundleni njengengxenye yephakheji yezinyathelo zokushayela izwe okhethweni olusha.
ref: Ngenyanga edlule ikhomishani yobumongameli ituse ukuyeka isikhundla kwe-CEP kwangaphambili njengengxenye yezinyathelo zokwenza izwe ukuba livote.

src: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.
mt: Leli khomishini kwakuyimpendulo kaMartelly emibhikishweni emikhulu yokulwa nohulumeni eyaqala ngo-Okthoba.
ref: Ukwenza bekuwukusabela kukaMartelly ekubhikisheni ngokumelene nohulumeni okusakazekile okuqale ngoMfumfu.

src: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.
mt: Imibhikisho ngezinye izikhathi enobudlova yaqala ngokwehluleka ukuqhuba ukhetho, oluthile olwalumele lwenziwe kusukela ngo-2011.
ref: Ukubhikisha okuba nodlame ngezinye izikhathi kususwe ukuhluleka kokuba nokhetho, olunye okwakufanele lube khona kusukela ngo-2011.

src: Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns.
mt: Cishe amacala angu-60 okushisa ngokweqile kwama-iPod asebenza kabi abikwe, abangele umlilo omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha omusha.
ref: Izigameko ezicishe zibe ngu-60 zama-iPod angasebenzi kahle zibikiwe, ezidale ingqikithi yemililo eyisithupha nokushiye abantu abane beshe kancane.

src: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.
mt: UMnyango Wezomnotho, Wezohwebo Nezimboni waseJapane (METI) uthe ubezi izingozi ezingu-27 ezihlobene nalezi zinsiza.
ref: I-Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) ithe ibe yazi ngezenzakalo ezingu-27 ezihlobene nale mishini.

src: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
mt: Ngesonto eledlule, i-METI yamemezela ukuthi i-Apple yayimtshele ngezigameko ezengeziwe ezingama-34 zokushisa ngokweqile, inkampani eyazibiza ngokuthi "ezingenzima".
ref: Ngeviki elidlule, iMETI imemezele ukuthi i-Apple iyazise ngezigamego zokushisa ngokweqile ezengeziwe ezingu-34, lezo inkampani ezibize ngokuthi "into engeyona enkulu."

src: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."
mt: UMnyango wasabela ngokuthi ukubambezeleka kuka-Apple kombiko "kuzisola ngempela".
ref: Umnyango uphendule ngokubiza ukuhlehlisa kwe-Apple lo mbiko "kuyadabukisa ngempela."

src: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
mt: Ukuzamazama komhlaba kwenzeke eMariana ngo-07: 19 ekuseni ngesikhathi sendawo (09:19 ntambama GMT ngoLwesihlanu).
ref: Ukuzamazama komhlaba kuhlasele i-Mariana ngo-07:19 ekuseni wesikhathi sakhona (09:19 ntambama ngoLwesihlanu GMT).

src: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.
mt: Ihhovisi lokuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo laseNyakatho Marianas lathi abukho ubungozi obambalwa ezweni.
ref: Ihhovisi lokulawula izimo eziphuthumayo laseNyakatho Marianas lithe awukho umonakalo obikiwe ezweni.

src: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
mt: Futhi i-Pacific Tsunami Warning Center yathi ayikho inkomba ye-tsunami.
ref: Futhi i-Pacific Tsunami Warning Agency Center ithe akukho okukhombisa i-Tsunami.

src: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
mt: Owayengumphoyisa wasePhilippines ubambe izivakashi zaseHong Kong njengeziboshwa ngokuthumba ibhasi lazo eManila, inhloko-dolobha yasePhilippines.
ref: Lowo owayeyiphoyisa lasePhilippines uthumbe izivakashi zaseHong Kong ngokuthumba ibhasi lazo eManila, inhlokodolobha yasePhilippines.

src: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
mt: URolando Mendoza wadutshulwa isibhamu sakhe se-M16 kubavakashi.
ref: URolando Mandoza wadubula isibhamu sakhe se-M16 ezivakashini.

src: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
mt: Izithunjwa eziningana zisindisiwe futhi okungenani eziyisithupha seziqinisekisiwe ukuthi zifile kuze kube manje.
ref: Izithunjwa ezimbalwa zikhululiwe futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okungenani eziyisithupha zishonile kuze kube manje.

src: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
mt: Izithunjwa eziyisithupha, kuhlanganise nezingane kanye nabantu asebekhulile, zakhululwa kusenesikhathi, njengoba kwakunjalo ngezithombe zasePhilippines.
ref: Izithunjwa eziyisithupha, kuhlanganise izingane kanye nabakhulile, zikhululwe masinya, kanjalo nangabathathi bezithombe basePhilippines.

src: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
mt: Kamuva abathwebuli bezithombe bathatha isikhundla sowesifazane osekhulile njengoba ayedinga indlu yangasese. UMendoza wadutshulwa.
ref: Abathathi bezithombe kamuva bathatha indawo yesalukazi njengoba besidinga indlu yangasese. Umendoza wadutshulwa.

src: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
mt: ULiggins walandela ezinyathelweni zikayise futhi waqala umsebenzi wezokwelapha.
ref: ULiggins walandela izinyathelo zikayise futhi wasebenza emkhakheni wezokwelapha.

src: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
mt: Waqeqeshwa njengomhlengikazi wezingane futhi waqala ukusebenza esibhedlela sabantu besifazane sase-Auckland ngo-1959.
ref: Ufundele ukuba udokotela wokubelethisa futhi waqala ukusebenza e-Auckland's National Womens's Hospital ngo-1959,

src: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.
mt: Ngesikhathi esebenza esibhedlela uLiggins waqala ukuphenya ngokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngesikhathi sakhe sokuphumula.
ref: Ngenkathi esebenza esibhedlela uLiggins waqala ukuphenya imihelo efika singakafiki isikhathi sokubeletha lapho engasebenzi.

src: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
mt: Ucwaningo lwakhe lwabonisa ukuthi uma i-hormone inikezwa ingasheshisa ukuvuthwa kwamaphaphu omntwana.
ref: Ucwaningo lwakhe lubonise ukuthi uma ihomoni isetshenziswa izokwenza ukuba ukukhula kwamaphaphu wombungu wengane kusheshe.

src: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
mt: I-Xinhua ibike ukuthi abaphenyi bakahulumeni bathola amarekhodi amabili endiza 'ebhokisi elimnyama' ngoLwesithathu.
ref: I-Xinhua yabika ukuthi abaphenyi bakahulumeni bathola ama-“black box” amabilii okurekhoda izindiza ngoLwesithathu.

src: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
mt: Abalwi abakanye nabo bamhlonipha uLuna.
ref: Umdlali we-wrestling naye washo amazwi okuhlonipha uLuna.

src: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
mt: UTommy Dreamer wathi "ULuna wayenguNdlovukazi yokuqala ye-Extreme. Umphathi wami wokuqala. ULuna washona ngobusuku bezinyanga ezimbili. Uyingqayizivele njengaye. Owesifazane onamandla".
ref: UTommy Dreamer wathi “uLuna bekuyiNdlovukazi Yokwedlulele yokuqala. Umphathi wami wokuqala. ULuna washona ngobusuku bezinyanga ezimbili. Kuyingqayizivele njengaye. Owesifazane Onamandla.”

src: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
mt: UDustin "Goldust" Runnels waphawula ukuthi "ULuna wayengowesabekayo njengami...mhlawumbe nakakhulu...yamthanda futhi uzomkhumbula...ngethemba ukuthi usendaweni engcono".
ref: U-Dustin “Thulilwegolide” Runnels waphawula ngokuthi “uLuna wayehlanya njengami...mhlawumbe ukungidlula...ngiyamthanda futhi ngizomkhumbula...ngiyethemba usendaweni engcono.”

src: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
mt: Kubantu abangu-1 400 abahlolwa ngaphambi kokhetho lukahulumeni lwango-2010, labo abaphikisana nokuthi i-Australia iba yi-republic bakhule ngamaphesenti angu-8 kusukela ngo-2008.
ref: Phakathi kwabantu abangu-1,400 abavote ngaphambi kokhetho lukahulumeni 2010, labo ababengavumelani nokuthi i-Australia ibe iriphabhuliki banda ngamaphesenti angu-8 kusukela ngo-2008.

src: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
mt: UNdunankulu ongumbusi uJulie Gillard wathi ngesikhathi sokukhankasa okhethweni lukahulumeni lwango-2010 ukuthi ukholelwa ukuthi i-Australia kufanele ibe yi-republic ekupheleni kokubusa kweNdlovukazi u-Elizabeth II.
ref: UNdunankulu Wokunakekela uJulia Gillard wathi phakathi nomkhankaso wokhetho lwango-2010 wayekholelwa ukuthi i-Astralia kumelwe ibe izwe elibuswa ngentando yeningi ngemva kokubusa kweNdlovukazi uElizabeth II.

src: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
mt: Amaphesenti angu-34 alabo abavotayo avuma kanje, efuna iNdlovukazi u-Elizabeth II ibe yinkosi yokugcina yase-Australia.
ref: Amaphesenti angu-34 walabo abavotayo unalombono, ufuna Indlovukazi u-Elizabeth II ukuba abe umbusi wokugcina wase-Australia.

src: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
mt: Ekupheleni kwalolu cwaningo, amaphesenti angu-29 alabo abahlolwayo akholelwa ukuthi i-Australia kufanele ibe yi-republic ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka, kuyilapho amaphesenti angu-31 akholelwa ukuthi i-Australia akufanele neze ibe yi-republic.
ref: Emananini adlulele wokuvota, amaphesentu angu-29 walabo ababuzwe imibuzo bakholelwa ukuthi i-Australia kumelwe ibe yiriphabhuliki ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka, kuyilapho amaphesenti angu-31 akholelwa ukuthi i-Australia akumelwe ibe yiriphabhuliki.

src: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
mt: Umpetha wegolide wama-Olympic kwakumele ageze kuma-100m naku-200m freestyle kanye kuma-relay amathathu kuma-Commonwealth Games, kodwa ngenxa yezinkathazo zakhe ukufaneleka kwakhe sekungaqinisekisiwe.
ref: Lowo owathola indondo yegolide kuma-Olimpiki kwakumelwe ahlanganyele emcintiswaneni wokubhukude we-100m kanye ne-200m wokubhukuda nganoma iyiphi indlela futhi kunemidlalo yokunikezelana eMidlalweni yama-Commonwealth, kodwa ngenxa yokukhalaza kwakhe kuyasolwa ukuthi unamandla ngokomzimba.

src: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
mt: Ube engakwazi ukuthatha imithi edingekayo ukuze anqobe ubuhlungu bakhe njengoba ivinjelwe emidlalweni.
ref: Akakwazanga ukuthatha imithi edingekayo yokulwisana nobuhlungu bakhe njengoba ingavunyelwe eMidlalweni.

src: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
mt: UCurtis Cooper, isazi sezibalo noprofesa wezesayensi yamakhompyutha e-University of Central Missouri, uthole inombolo eyinhloko enkulu kunazo zonke eyaziwayo kuze kube manje ngoJanuwari 25.
ref: U-Curtis Cooper, usozibalo nophinde abe ngusolwazi wesayensi yamakhompuyutha eNyuvesi yaseCentral Missouri, uthole inombolo enkulu kunazo zonke kuze kube manje ongakwazi ukuyidivayida ngayo ngokwayo ngoMasingina 25.

src: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
mt: Abantu abaningana baqinisekisa lokhu okutholakele besebenzisa izinto ezibonakalayo nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezahlukahlukene ekuqaleni kukaFebhuwari futhi kwamenyezelwa ngoLwesibili.
ref: Abantu abaningana baqinisekise okutholakele ngokusebenzisa imishini kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zamakhompyutha ngasekuqaleni kukaNhlolanja futhi kumenyezelwe ngoLwesibili.

src: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
mt: Kumelwe ukuba ama-comet ayewumthombo wokulethwa kwamanzi emhlabeni kanye nezinto eziphilayo ezingakha amaprotheni futhi zisekele ukuphila.
ref: Amatshe awayo esuka emkhathini kungenzeka ukuthi ayengumthombo wamanzi athunyelwe emhlabeni kanye nezinsalela zezinto eziphilayo ezingakha amaphrotheni futhi zisekele ukuphila.

src: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
mt: Ososayensi banethemba lokuqonda ukuthi amaplanethi akhiwa kanjani, ikakhulukazi ukuthi uMhlaba wakhiwa kanjani, njengoba amaplanethi angqubuzana noMhlaba esikhathini eside esidlule.
ref: Ososayensi banethemba lokuqonda indlela amapulanethi akheka ngayo, ikakhulukazi indlela uMhlaba owakheke ngayo, njengoba amatshe asuka emkhathini eshayisene noMhlaba kudala.

src: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
mt: UCuomo, 53, waqala ukuba ngumbusi ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka futhi wasayina umthetho osanda kwedlula owenza umshado wobulili obufanayo ube semthethweni.
ref: UCuomo, oneminyaka engu-53, waqala ukubusa ekuqaleni kulo nyaka futhi wasayina umthetho ovivinywayo ngenyanga edlule ogunyaza ukushada kwabantu bobulili obufanayo.

src: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
mt: Wabiza lezi zinsolo ngokuthi "izingxoxo zezombusazwe nobuwula".
ref: Ubhekisele emahlebezini ngokuthi "ingevu yepolotiki kanye nobuthutha".

src: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
mt: Kucatshangwa ukuthi uzokhankasa ukuba ngumengameli ngo-2016.
ref: Kufuniselwa ukuthi uzokhankasela ukuba umongameli ngo-2016.

src: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
mt: I-NextGen uhlelo i-FAA ethi luzovumela izindiza ukuba zindize emikhondweni emfushane futhi zonge izigidi zamalitha kawoyela unyaka ngamunye futhi zinciphise ukukhishwa kwekhabhoni.
ref: I-NextGen indlela i-FAA ethi izovumela indiza ukuba indize imizila emifishane futhi yonge izigidi zamagalani wamafutha unyaka ngamunye futhi inciphise i-carbon ekhishwa emkhathini.

src: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
mt: Isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusekelwe ku-satellite ngokungafani nobuchwepheshe obudala obusekelwe ku-radar yasemhlabeni ukuze ivumele abalawuli bemoto ukuba bakhombe izindiza ngokunemba okukhulu futhi banikeze abashayeli bezindiza ulwazi olunembile.
ref: Isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusekelwe esiphuphuthekini kunobuchwepheshe bakudala obusekelwe kuyi-radar yaphansi ukuvumela abalawuli bezinto ezihamba emoyeni ukuthola indawo indiza ekuyo ngokunemba okukhulu nokunika abashayeli bezindiza ukwaziswa okunembe kakhudlwana.

src: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
mt: Akukho ukuthutha okwengeziwe okubekwa futhi izitimela ezingaphansi komhlaba aziyeki eWembley, futhi izindawo zokupaka izimoto nezindawo zokupaka nezokugibela azitholakali phansi.
ref: Azikho izinto zokuthutha ezibekwayo futhi izitimela ezihamba phezulu ngeke zime eWembli, futhi ukupaka izimoto kanye nezindawo zokupaka nokugibela azitholakali enkundleni.

src: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
mt: Ukwesaba ukuntuleka kwezithuthi kwaveza ukuthi umdlalo uzophoqeleka ukuba udlale ngemuva kweminyango evaliwe ngaphandle kwabalandeli beqembu.
ref: Ukwesaba kokungabi khona kwezinto zokuthutha kwenze ukuthi kube nokwenzeka ukuthi umdlalo uphoqelelwe ukudlalwa ngasese ngaphandle kwabathandi beqembu.

src: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
mt: Ucwaningo olwanyatheliswa ngoLwesine kumagazini i-Science lubike ngokwakheka kwezinhlobo ezintsha zezinyoni eziQhingini zase-Ecuador i-Galapagos.
ref: Ucwaningo olushicilelwe ngoLwesine kumagazini weSayensi lubike ngokwakhiwa kwezinhlobo ezintsha zezinyoni eZiqhingini zase-Ecuadore eGalápagos.

src: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
mt: Abacwaningi base-University of Princeton e-United States nase-Uppsala University eSweden babike ukuthi lezi zinhlobo ezintsha zavela eminyakeni emibili nje kuphela, nakuba kwakukholakala ukuthi le nqubo yayithatha isikhathi eside kakhulu, ngenxa yokuzalanisa phakathi kwe-Darwin finch endemic, i-Geospiza fortes, ne-cactus finch engumfuduki, i-Geospiza conirostris.
ref: Abacwaningi abavela eNyuvesi yasePrinceton eMelika kanye naseNyuvesi yase-Uppsala eSweden babike ukuthi izidalwa ezintsha ziziphendukele ngezizukulwane ezimbili kuphela, nakuba lenqubo bekukholelwa ukuthi ithatha isikhathi eside, ngenxa yokuzalela phakathi kwezintaka zika-Darwin ezitholakala kuleyo ndawo kuphela, ama-Geospiza fortes, kanye nezintaka ze-cactus ezithuthele lapho, ama-Geospiza conirostris.

src: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
mt: Igolide lingasetshenziswa kuzo zonke izinhlobo zezimilo. Lingase ligoqwe zibe yizimilo ezincane.
ref: Igolide lingenziwa libe noma isiphi isibumbeko. Lingagingqwa libe yizibumbeko ezincane..

src: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
mt: Ingadonswa ngentambo encane, engaguqulwa futhi ilungiswe. Ingashayiwa noma isongwe ibe amashidi.
ref: Ingadonswa ibe ucingo oluncinyanyane, olungasontwa noma lulukwe. Lungabethelwa noma lugoqwe lube amashidi.

src: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
mt: Ingenziwa ibe mncane kakhulu, bese inamathela kwenye insimbi. Ingenziwa ibe mncane kakhulu kangangokuthi ngezinye izikhathi yayisetshenziselwa ukuhlobisa izithombe ezidwetshwe ngesandla ezincwadini ezibizwa ngokuthi "imibhalo yesandla ekhanyisiwe".
ref: Ingenziwa ibe ncane kalula, bese inamathiselwa kwenye insimbi. Ingenziwa ibe ncane kangangokuthi kwesinye isikhathi yayisetshenziselwa ukuhlobisa izithombe ezidwetshwe ngesandla ezincwadini ezibizwa ngokuthi "illuminated manuscripts".

src: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
mt: Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-pH yamakhemikhali. Ungenza inkomba usebenzisa ijusi lekholifulazi elibomvu.
ref: Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-pH yekhemikhali. Ungenza inkomba ngokusebenzisa ujusi weklabishi ebomvu.

src: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
mt: Ijusi lekhowe lishintsha umbala kuye ngokuthi amakhemikhali anama-asidi noma ayisisekelo (e-alkaline).
ref: Ijusi yeklabishi ishintsha umbala kuye ngokuthi ikhemikhali ino-asidi noma i-alikhali engakanani.

src: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
mt: Izinga le-pH liboniswa inani lama-ion e-Hrogen (i-H ku-pH) kumakhemikhali ahlolwe.
ref: Izinga le-pH likhonjwa inani lama-ion weHydrogen (i-H ku-pH) kuyikhemikhali elihlolwayo.

src: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
mt: Ama-ion e-hydrogen angama-proton anama-electron awo asusiwe kuwo (njengoba ama-athomu e-hydrogen aqukethe i-proton eyodwa ne-electron eyodwa).
ref: Ama-ion e-hydrogen amaphrothoni lawo ekususwe ama-elektroni wawo kuwo (njengoba ama-athomu weHydrogen enziwa iphrothoni elilodwa kanye ne-elektroni elilodwa).

src: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
mt: Zisongele ndawonye lezi zinsiza ezimbili ezomile bese, ngezandla ezimsulwa ezimanzi, uzicindezele zibe ibhola.
ref: Yaluzisa izimpuphu ezimbili ezomile bese, ngezandla ezihlanzekile ezimanzi, uzicindezele zibe yindingiliza.

src: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
mt: Umswakama ezandleni zakho uzosabela nezendwangu zangaphandle, eziyozizwa zihlekisa futhi zibe uhlobo lwegobolondo.
ref: Umswakamo osezandleni zakho uzohlangana nongqimba olungaphandle, okuzoba nomuzwa oxakayo futhi kwenze uhlobo lwegobongo.

src: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
mt: Amadolobha aseHarappa naseMohenjo-daro ayenezindlu zangasese ezihlanzekile cishe kuyo yonke indlu, ezixhumene nohlelo oluthuthukile lwamanzi angcolile.
ref: Amadolobha waseHarappa kanye naseMohenjo-daro ayenedlu yangasese eshaywayo cishe kuzo zonke izindlu, ehlanganiswe nendlela eyinkimbinkimbi yokuthutha indle.

src: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
mt: Izinsalela zemithombo yokulahla imfucuza zitholakale ezindlini zamadolobha aseMinoia aseKrethe naseSantorini eGrisi.
ref: Insalela yamapayipi athutha indle itholakele ezindlini zamadolobha wase-Minoan waseKhrithi nase-Santorini eGreece.

src: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
mt: Kwakukhona nezindlu zangasese e-Egypt yasendulo, e-Persia naseChina. Emphakathini wamaRoma, izindawo zangasese ngezinye izikhathi zaziyingxenye yezindlu zangasese zomphakathi lapho abesilisa nabesifazane babehlangana khona besemphakathini oxubile.
ref: Zazikhona izindlu zangasese eGibhithe, e, kanye naseShayina yamandulo. Empucukweni yaseRoma, izindlu zangasese kwesinye isikhathi kwakuyingxenye yezindlu zokugezela zomphakathi lapho abasilisa nabesifazana babehlangana ndawonye.

src: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
mt: Uma ubiza umuntu okude ngamakhilomitha ayinkulungwane, usebenzisa isathelayithi.
ref: Uma ushayela ucingo umuntu othile okude ngamamayela ayinkulungwane, usebenzisa isiphuphutheki.

src: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
mt: Isathelayithi esikhaleni sithola ucingo bese siyalubonisa emuva, cishe ngokushesha.
ref: Isiphuphutheki esisemkhathini sithola ucingo bese siluthumela emuva ezansi, cishe ngaleso sikhathi.

src: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
mt: Isathelayithi sathunyelwa esikhaleni ngomsakazo. Ososayensi basebenzisa izibonakude esikhaleni ngoba umoya womhlaba uphazamisa ukukhanya kwethu kanye nombono wethu.
ref: Isethilayithi ithunyelwe emkhathini kusentshenziswa irokhethi. Ososayensi basebenzise izibona kude ezisemkhathini ngoba umkhathi uphazamisa okunye kokukhanya kwethu kanye nokubona.

src: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
mt: Kuthatha irokhethi elikhulu elingaphezu kwamamitha ayi-100 ukuphakama ukubeka isathelayithi noma itheleskopu endaweni.
ref: Kudingeka irokhethi enkulu engaphezu kwamafidiangu-100 ukuphakama ukubeka isiphuphutheki noma ithelisikobho emkhathini.

src: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
mt: Isondo selishintshe umhlaba ngezindlela ezimangalisayo. Into enkulu kunazo zonke isondo elisenzele yona ukusinika ukuthuthwa okulula nokusheshayo.
ref: Isondo seliguqule umhlaba ngezindlela ezimangalisayo. Into enkulu ukuthi isondo elisenzele yona ukusinika indlela yokuthutha elula neshesha kakhulu.

src: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
mt: Isilethele isitimela, imoto, nezinye izinto eziningi zokuhamba.
ref: Isilethele isitimela, imoto, kanye nezinye izisetshenziswa zokuthutha.

src: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
mt: Ngaphansi kwazo kunamakati amancane anesisindo esiphakathi adla izilwane ezizidla izilwane ezizidla izilwane eziphakathi nesizinda kusukela kumphoko kuya ku-antelope kanye ne-deer.
ref: Ngaphansi kwazo kukhona amakati amancanyana ngobukhulu adla inyama ebanjelwa ukudliwakusuka kunogwaja kuya ezinyamazaneni.

src: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
mt: Ekugcineni, kunamakati amancane amaningi (kuhlanganisa namakati asendlini) adla izilwane ezincane eziningi kakhulu njengezinambuzane, amagundane, izimbungulu, nezinyoni.
ref: Ekugcineni, kunamakati amaningi amancane (kuhlanganise namakati afuywayo azizulelayo) adla izilwanyane ezizingelwayo eziningi kakhulu njengezinambuzane, izilwane eziququdayo, izibankwa, kanye nezinyoni.

src: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
mt: Imfihlo yempumelelo yabo ingumqondo we-niche, umsebenzi okhethekile ikati ngalinye eliwenzayo owenza lingakwazi ukuncintisana nabanye.
ref: Imfihlo yempumelelo yabo umcabango wesikhundla, umsebenzi okhethekile ikati ngalinye elinawo olenza lingancintisani namanye.

src: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
mt: Izingonyama ziyizikati ezihlala nabantu abaningi, ezihlala ngamaqembu amakhulu abizwa ngokuthi ama-pride.
ref: Amabhubesi angamakati anobudlelwane kakhulu, aphila ngamaqembu amakhulu abizwa ngokuthi umhlambi.

src: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
mt: Ama-pride akhiwa owesilisa omdala oyedwa kuya kwamathathu ahlobene, kanye nezinsikazi namantshontsho angamashumi amathathu.
ref: Imihlambi yakhiwa iduna elilodwa noma amathathu ahlobene, ngokufanayo nezinsikazi ezintathu kanye namawundlu.

src: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
mt: Ngokuvamile abesifazane bahlobene kakhulu, ngokuba umndeni omkhulu odade namadodakazi.
ref: Abesifazane ngokuvamile bahlobene, okuwumndeni omkhulu wodadewabo noma amadodakazi.

src: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
mt: Amabhere ezingonyama enza njengezinhlanzi zezimvu noma izinja, izilwane ezifana kakhulu nezingonyama (kodwa hhayi amanye amakati amakhulu) ekuziphatheni, futhi zibulala kakhulu izilwane eziziphangayo.
ref: Ivuyo lamabhubesi liziphatha njengomhlambi wamanketshane, izilwane ezifana namabhubesi ngokumangalisayo (kodwa hhayi amanye amakati amakhulu) ngokuziphatha, kanye futhi nokuba yingozi ezilwaneni ezizizingelayo.

src: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
mt: Njengoba ingumdlali wezemidlalo ohlanganiswe kahle, ingwe ingakwazi ukukhwela (yize ingakhuli kahle), ukubhukuda, ukugxuma ibanga elide futhi idonse ngamandla aphindwe kahlanu kunomuntu onamandla.
ref: Umgadli ophelele, ihlosi lingakhuphuka (yize lingakwazi kahle), libhukude, ligxume amabanga amade futhi lidonse ngamandla womuntu onamandla aphindwe kasihlanu.

src: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
mt: Ingwe iseqenjini elifanayo (i-Genus Panthera) namabhubesi, amahlosi, nama-jaguar. Lawa makati amane yiwo kuphela akwaziyo ukuhwaza.
ref: Ithayiga lisesigabeni esifanayo (Genus Panthera) njengamabhubesi, izingwe, kanye nama-jaguar. Lawa makati amane yiwo kuphela akwazi ukubhonga.

src: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
mt: Ukugquma kwengwe akufani nokugquma kwengonyama okuphuma ngezwi eliphelele, kodwa kunjengomusho wamagama anomsindo, amemeza.
ref: Ukubhonga kwehlosi akufani ncamashi nokubhonga kwengonyama, kodwa kucishe kufane nomusho wamagama entukuthelo, amenyezwayo.

src: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
mt: Ama-ocelot athanda ukudla izilwane ezincane. Azobamba izinkawu, izinyoka, izilwane ezincelisayo nezinyoni uma zikwazi. Cishe zonke izilwane i-ocelot eyizingela zincane kakhulu kunalokho okuyiyo.
ref: Ama-ocelots athanda ukudla izilwane ezincane. Azobamba izimfene, izinyoka, izilwane eziququdayo kanye nezinyoni uma angakwazi. Cishe zonke izilwane ezizingelwa yilawa makati zincane kakhulu kunawo.

src: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
