mt: Ososayensi bacabanga ukuthi ama-ocelots alandela futhi athole izilwane azidla (izilwane) ngephunga, aziphunga lapho ebezikhona khona phansi.
ref: Ososayensi bakholelwa ukuthi ama-ocelots alandelela futhi athola izilwane zokuzidla (izilwane ezizingelwayo) ngokunuka, efufuza lapho bezikhona phansi.

src: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
mt: Zibona kahle kakhulu ebumnyameni ngombono wasebusuku, futhi zihamba ngokucashile kakhulu. Ama-ocelots adla inyamazane yawo ngokuhlangana nendawo ezungezile bese ehlasela inyamazane yawo.
ref: Ayakwazi ukubona kahle kakhulu ebumnyameni ngekhono lokubona ebusuku, abuye ahambe ngesinyenyela esikhulu, futhi. Ama-ocelot azingela izisulu zawo ngokuzifanisa nendawo akuyo bese agxumela izisulu zawo.

src: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
mt: Lapho iqembu elincane lezinto eziphilayo (isixuku esincane) lihlukaniswa nesibalo esikhulu esivela kuso (njengokuthi uma lihamba phezu kwentaba noma umfula, noma uma lihamba liya esiqhingini esisha ukuze lingakwazi ukubuyela kalula) ngokuvamile lizithola lisendaweni ehlukile kunalokho elalikulo ngaphambili.
ref: Lapho iqembu elincane lezinto eziphilayo (inani elincane) lihlukana eqenjini elikhulu elisuka kulo (cishe lapho liya ngaphesheya kokhahlamba lwentaba noma umfula, noma uma liya esiqhingini esisha kangangokuba lingakwazi ukubuyela emuva kalula) ngokuvamile lizozithola endaweni ehlukile kunaleyo ebezikuyo ngaphambili.

src: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
mt: Le ndawo entsha inezinsiza ezahlukene kanye nezimbangi ezahlukene, ngakho-ke abantu abasha bazodinga izici noma ukuguqulwa okuhlukile ukuze babe nguncintisana enamandla kunalokho ababekudinga ngaphambili.
ref: Le ndawo entsha inezinsizakusebenza ezihlukile nabancintisani abahlukene, ngakho-ke umphakathi omusha uzodinga izici ezihlukile noma ukuzivumelanisa nezimo ukuze ube ngabancintisani abaqinile kunalokho ababekudinga ngaphambilini.

src: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
mt: Abantu bakuqala abashintshi nhlobo, basadinga ukuguqulwa okufanayo njengakuqala.
ref: Izidalwa ezazikhona zasekuqaleni azikashintshi, zisadinga indlela yokuphila efana neyangaphambili.

src: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
mt: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, njengoba abantu abasha beqala ukuzivumelanisa nendawo yabo entsha, baqala ukubukeka kancane kancane njengabanye abantu.
ref: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, njengoba iqembu elisha liqala ukujwayela indawo yalo entsha, liqala ukuya libukeka lingafani neqembu elinye.

src: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
mt: Ekugcineni, ngemva kwezinkulungwane noma ngisho nezigidi zeminyaka, lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zizobukeka zihlukile kangangokuthi ngeke zibizwe ngokuthi zinhlobo eyodwa.
ref: Ekugcineni, ngemva kweminyaka eyizinkulungwane noma ngisho eyizigidi, amaqembu amabili azobukeka ehlukile kangangokuba angeke abizwe ngokuthi uhlobo olulodwa.

src: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
mt: Sibiza le nqubo ngokuthi i-specialization, okusho nje ukwakheka kwezinhlobo ezintsha. Ukuhlukahluka kuwumphumela ongenakugwenywa futhi kuyingxenye ebaluleke kakhulu yokuziphendukela kwemvelo.
ref: Le nqubo siyibiza nge-speciation, okushe nje ukwakhekha kwezinhlobo ezintsha. Lokhu kwakheka umphumela ongakwemeki kanye nengxenye ebaluleke kakhulu yokuziphendukela kwemvelo.

src: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
mt: Izitshalo zikhiqiza umoya-mpilo abantu abawuphefumulayo, futhi zithatha i-carbon-dioxide abantu abawuphefumulayo (okungukuthi, baphefumula).
ref: Izitshalo zenza i-oxygen leyo ephefumulwa abantu, futhi zithatha i-carbon-dioxide leyo ekhishwa abantu (okungukuthi, ukuphefumula ukhiphe umoya).

src: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
mt: Izitshalo zenza ukudla kwazo elangeni ngokwenziwa komzimba. Ziphinde zinikeze umthunzi.
ref: Izitshalo zenza ukudla kwazo nge-photosynthesis. Zibuye zenze nomthunzi.

src: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
mt: Senza izindlu zethu ngezitshalo futhi senze izingubo ngezitshalo. Ukudla okuningi esikudlayo yizitshalo. Ngaphandle kwezitshalo, izilwane ngeke zingasinda.
ref: Senza izindlu zethu ngezitshalo futhi senza nezingubo ngezitshalo. Ukudla okuningi esikudlayo izitshalo. Ngaphandle kwezitshalo, izilwane angeke ziqhubeke ziphila.

src: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
mt: UMosaurus wayengumshaya omkhulu wesikhathi sakhe, ngakho-ke wayengesabi lutho, ngaphandle kwamanye ama-mosasaur.
ref: I-mosasaurus bekuyisilwane esizingelayo esiyinhloko ngesikhathi sayo, ngakho-ke yayingesabi lutho, ngaphandle kwama-mosasaurus amanye.

src: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
mt: Izinsini zayo ezinde zazinamazinyo anesihlangu angaphezu kuka-70, kanye nesethi eyengeziwe ophahleni lomlomo wayo, okusho ukuthi kwakungekho ndawo yokuphuma kunoma yini eyayingqamuka indlela yayo.
ref: Imihlathi yayo emide eyayihlome ngamazinyo acijise okwensingo angaphezu kuka-70, kanye namanye engeziwe phezu komlomo wayo, okusho ukuthi kwakungekho lutho esondela eduze kwayo eyayingaphunyuka.

src: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
mt: Asazi ngokuqinisekile, kodwa kungenzeka ukuthi yayinenlimi enesichotho. Ukudla kwayo kwakuhlanganisa izibungu, izinhlanzi ezinkulu, ezinye izilwane eziphilayo, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi yayingumdlali.
ref: Asazi ngokuqinisekile, kodwa kungenzeka ukuthi yayinolimi olusamfoloko. Ukudla eyayikudla kuhlanganisa izimfudu, izinhlanzi ezinkulu, ama-mosasaurus amanye, futhi kungenzeka nokuthi yayiyizimu.

src: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
mt: Yayihlaselwa futhi noma yini eyayingena emanzini; ngisho ne-dinosaur enkulu enjenge-T. rex yayingeke ilingane nayo.
ref: Yayibuye ihlasele noma yini engena emanzini; ngisho ne-dinosaur enkulu njenge-T.rex yayingeke ikwazi ukumelana nayo.

src: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
mt: Nakuba ukudla kwabo okuningi kwakujwayele kithi, amaRoma ayevame ukudla ukudla ukudla okungavamile noma okungavamile, kuhlanganise nesingulube sasendle, i-pawn, i-snickles, nohlobo lwezinambuzane olubizwa ngokuthi igundane
ref: Ngenkathi iningi lokukudla kwabo kungaba okujwayelekile kuthina, amaRoma eyenesabelo sabo sezinto zemikhosi ezingajwayelekile, kubandakanya izingulube zasendle, ipigogo, iminenke, nohlobo lwegundane olubizwa nge-dormouse

src: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
mt: Omunye umehluko kwaba ukuthi kuyilapho abantu abampofu nowesifazane bedla ukudla kwabo behleli ezihlalweni, amadoda acebile ayethanda ukuba nemidango ndawonye lapho ayelala khona eceleni kwawo ngesikhathi edla ukudla kwawo.
ref: Omunye umehluko kwakuwukuthi nakuba abantu abampofu kanye nabesifazane babedla ukudla kwabo babe behlezi ezihlalweni, amadoda acebile ayethanda ukuba namadili ndawonye lapho ayehlala khona ngezinhlangothi kuyilapho edla ukudla kwawo.

src: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
mt: Ukudla kwaseRoma lasendulo bekungeke kufake ukudla okwafika eYurophu kuvela eMelika noma e-Asia emakhulwini eminyaka kamuva.
ref: Ukudla kwaseRoma yamandulo kwakungeke kuhlanganise ukudla okufike eYurophu kuvela eMelika noma kuvela e-Asia emakhulwini eminyaka alandelayo.

src: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
mt: Ngokwesibonelo, babengenawo ummbila, namatamatisi, amazambane, noma i-cocoa, futhi akekho umRoma wasendulo owake wanambitha ungo-turkey.
ref: Ngokwesibonelo, babengenawo ummbila, noma otamatisi, noma amazambane, noma i-cocoa, futhi akekho umuntu waseRoma yamandulo oke wanambitha ikalikuni.

src: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
mt: AmaBhabhiloni akhela ngamunye wonkulunkulu bawo ithempeli eliyinhloko elalibhekwa njengekhaya lonkulunkulu.
ref: AbaseBhabhiloni bakhela izithixo zabo ngazinye ithempeli eliyinhloko elalibhekwa njengekhaya lesithixo.

src: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
mt: Abantu babeletha iminikelo konkulunkulu futhi abapristi bazama ukunakekela izidingo zonkulunkulu ngemikhosi nemikhosi.
ref: Abantu abaletha imihlatshelo konkulunkulu nakubaphristi bazozama ukunika onkulunkulu izidingo zabo ngemigidi nemikhosi.

src: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
mt: Ithempeli ngalinye lalinegceke lethempeli elivulekile bese kuba nendawo engcwele yangaphakathi okwakungena kuyo abapristi kuphela.
ref: Ithempeli ngalinye lalinegceke elivulekile lethempeli kanye nendawo engcwele ephakathi lapho kwakungena khona umphristi kuphela.

src: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
mt: Ngezinye izikhathi kwakhiwa imibhoshongo ekhethekile enesimo sepiramidi, ebizwa ngokuthi ama-ziggurats, ukuze ibe yingxenye yethempeli.
ref: Ngezinye izikhathi imibhoshongo ekhethekile engunxa-ntathu, ebizwa ngokuthi ama-ziggurat, yayakhiwe ukuze ibe ingxenye yamathempeli.

src: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
mt: Isiqongo sombhoshongo sasiyindawo engcwele ekhethekile kathixo.
ref: Isiqongo sombhoshongo kwakuyindawo engcwele ekhethekile yesithixo.

src: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
mt: Esimweni sezulu esifudumele saseMpumalanga Ephakathi, indlu yayingenandaba kangako.
ref: Esimweni sezulu esifudumele saseMpumalanga ePhakathi, indlu beyingabalulekanga kakhulu.

src: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
mt: Iningi lempilo yomkhaya wamaHeberu lalikwenzeka ngaphandle.
ref: Isikhathi esiningi impilo yemindeni yamaHebheru yenzeka endaweni evulekile.

src: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
mt: Abesifazane babepheka egcekeni; izitolo kwakuyizitolo ezivulekile ezibheke emgwaqeni.
ref: Owesifazane wayepheka egcekeni, izitolo kwakungamatafula avulwayo abheke emgwaqweni. Amatshe ayesetshenziselwa ukwakha izindlu.

src: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
mt: Kwakungekho amahlathi amakhulu ezweni laseKhanani, ngakho izinkuni zazibiza kakhulu.
ref: Ayengekho amahlathi amakhulu ezweni laseKhanani, ngakho izingodo zazibiza kakhulu.

src: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
mt: IGreenland yayihlala kancane. Kuma-saga aseNorse kuthiwa u-Erik Omomvu wadingiselwa e-Iceland ngenxa yokubulala, futhi lapho ehamba ngempumalanga, wathola iGreenland wayinika igama elithi Greenland.
ref: I-Greenland yayihlelwe kancane. E-Norse Segas bathi u-Erik the Red waboshwa e-Iceland ngenxa yokubulala, futhi lapho ehambela eNtshonalanga, wathola i-Greenland wase eyibiza ngokuthi i-Greenland.

src: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
mt: Kodwa kungakhathaliseki ukuthi wathola ini, izizwe zama-Eskimo zase zihlala lapho ngaleso sikhathi.
ref: Kodwa naphezu kokuba etholakele, isizwe sama-Eskiro besilokhu sihlala lapho ngaleso sikhathi.

src: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
mt: Nakuba izwe ngalinye lalingeyama-Scandinavia, kwakunokwehluka okuningi phakathi kwabantu, amakhosi, amasiko nomlando waseDenmark, eSweden, eNorway nase-Iceland.
ref: Nakuba izwe ngalinye beliyi-‘Scandinavian’, bekunokungefani okuningi phakathi kwabantu, amakhosi, amasiko, kanye nomlando wase-Denmark, e-Sweden, e-Norway kanye nase-Iceland.

src: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
mt: Uma uke wabuka ifilimu ethi National Treasure, ungase ucabange ukuthi imephu yengcebo yayibhalwe ngemuva kweSitatimende Sokuzimela.
ref: Uma wake wayibuka imovie i-National Treasure, ungafunga ukuthi ibalazwe lomcebo lalibhalwe ngemuva kweSimemezelo Sokuzimela.

src: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
mt: Nokho, lokho akulona iqiniso. Nakuba kunento ebhaliwe ngemuva kwalo mbhalo, awuyona imephu yengcebo.
ref: Noma kunjalo, lokho akulona iqiniso. Noma kunokuthile okubhalwe ngemuva kwencwadi, akuyona imephu eyigugu.

src: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
mt: Kubhalwe ngemuva kwesimemezelo senkululeko amagama athi "Isimemezelo sokuqala senkululeko sango-4 Julayi 1776". Umbhalo ubonakala phansi kwedokhumende, uphahla luye phezulu.
ref: Okubhalwe ngemuva eNcazelweni Yokuzimela bekungamazwi “ENcazelo Yokuqala Yokuzimela yangomhlaka-4 kuNtulikazi 1776”. Umbhalo ovela ekugcineni kwencwadi, obheke phansi.

src: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
mt: Nakuba kungekho owaziyo ngokuqinisekile ukuthi ubani owabhala incwadi, kuyaziwa ukuthi ekuqaleni kwayo, incwadi enkulu yamapharamitha (esilinganisa u-293⁄4 ngamasentimitha angu-241⁄2 ) yayigubungelwe ukuze igcinwe.
ref: Yize kungekho owaziyo ngokuqinisekile ukuthi ngubani oyibhalile, kuyaziwa ukuthi ekuqaleni kokuphila kwayo, idokhumenti enkulu yesikhumba (ilinganisa ama-intshi angu-29¾ ngamayintshi angu-24½) yayigoqwe ukuze igcinwe.

src: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
mt: Ngakho-ke, kungenzeka ukuthi inothi yengezwe nje njengelebula.
ref: Ngakho-ke, cishe umcabango wafakwa njengophawu kalula.

src: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
mt: Ukwehla kwe-D-Day kanye nezimpi ezilandelayo kwakukhulule enyakatho yeFrance, kodwa iningizimu yayisengakhululekile.
ref: Ukufika kwe-D-Day nezimpi ezilandelayo kwakukhulule inyakatho yeFrance, kodwa eningizimu kwakungakakhululeki.

src: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
mt: Yayibuswa amaFulentshi "eVichy". Laba kwakungabantu baseFrance ababenze ukuthula namaJalimane ngo-1940 futhi basebenza nabahlaseli esikhundleni sokulwa nabo.
ref: Yayibuswa amaFulentshi ase-“Vinchy”. Laba bekungabantu baseFulansi ababenze ukuthula neJalimane ngo-1940 futhi besebenzisana nabaphangi esikhundleni sokuthi balwe nabo.

src: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
mt: Ngo-15 Agasti 1940, ama-Allies ahlasela eningizimu yeFrance, lokhu kuhlaselwa kwabizwa ngokuthi "i-Operation Dragoon".
ref: Ngezi-15 kuNcwaba 1940, Izivunani zahlasela iningizimu France, futhi ukuhlasela kwabizwa “Umsebenzi Dragoon”.

src: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
mt: Emasontweni amabili nje amabutho aseMelika namaFrench ahlanzekile ayekhulule iningizimu yeFrance futhi ayebheke eJalimane.
ref: Ngamasonto amabili nje amasosha ase-Melika kanye nawase-French Ekhululekile akhiphe iningizimu France ezingxoxweni zokuhweba futhi asephendukela eJalimane

src: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
mt: Inhlalakahle yamasiko ahlukile abelwa yiqembu elikhulu labantu abahlala futhi basebenza ngokubambisana, umphakathi.
ref: Umphakathi wesintu isiko elilodwa elihlanganyelwa iqembu elikhulu labantu abahla futhi basebenze ndawonye, umphakathi.

src: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
mt: Igama elithi isizinda livela egameni lesiLatini civilis, okusho ukuthi isakhamuzi, elihlobene nelithi civis, okusho ukuthi isakhamuzi, nelithi civitas, okusho ukuthi idolobha noma idolobha-zwe, futhi lokho futhi ngandlela thile kuchaza ubukhulu bomphakathi.
ref: Igama elithi civilization lisuka egameni lesiLatin elithi civilis, okusho impucuko, elihlobene nelesiLatin elithi civis, elisho isakhamuzi, kanye nelithi civitas, elisho idolobha noma isifundazwe, futhi lokho ngenye indlela kubuye kuchaze ubukhulu bomphakathi.

src: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
mt: Amazwe amadolobha angumanduleli wezizwe. Isiko lemiphakathi lisho ukudluliswa kolwazi phakathi kwezizukulwane eziningana, ukulandelela kwamasiko okuhlala njalo nokusabalalisa okulungile.
ref: Izifundazwe zandulela izizwe. Isiko lomphakathi lisho ukudlulisela ulwaze ezizukulwaneni eziningana, umkhondo ongokwesiko ohlala ukhona kanye nokusakazwa okuhle kokwaziswa.

src: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
mt: Amasiko amancane ngokuvamile anyamalala ngaphandle kokushiya ubufakazi obufanele bomlando futhi ahluleke ukubonwa njengamasiko afanele.
ref: Amasiko amancane ngokuvamile ayanyamalala ngaphandle kokushiya ubufakazi obungokomlando futhi ayahluleka ukuqashelwa njengemiphakathi yangempela.

src: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
mt: Phakathi neMpi Yenkululeko, lezi zifundazwe eziyishumi nantathu zaqala zakha uhulumeni ophakathi obuthakathaka - kanti iCongress iyona kuphela ingxenye yawo - ngaphansi kweZimiso ze-Confederation.
ref: Phakathi neMpi Yezinguqugo, izifunda eziyishumi nantathu zaqala zakha uhulumeni obuthakathaka—uKhongolose kuyisici sawo sodwa—ngaphansi kwe-Articles of Confederation.

src: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
mt: I-Congress yayingenalo igunya lokubeka intela, futhi, njengoba yayingenalo igunya eliphezulu noma lezomthetho kuzwelonke, yayithembele kuzithunywa zombuso, ngokuvamile ezazingasebenzisani, ukuze zisetshenzise zonke izenzo zayo.
ref: Ukhongolose wabe engenawo amandla okubeka intela, futhi, ngenxa yokuthi bokungekho sigungu sezwe noma noma isigungu sokwahlulela, uncike ezikhulwini zombuso, ezazingabambisani izikhathi ezingi, ukuphoqelela yonke imithetho yawo.

src: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
mt: Futhi yayingenalo igunya lokugqekeza imithetho yentela kanye nezintela phakathi kwezifundazwe.
ref: Yayingenalo futhi igunya lokweqa imithetho yentela nokuthelisa ngempahla phakathi kwezifunda.

src: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
mt: Imigomo yayidinga imvume evumelanayo evela kuzo zonke izifundazwe ngaphambi kokuba zilungiswe futhi izifundazwe zazithatha uhulumeni wasekhaya kalula kangangokuthi abamele bazo babevame ukungabi khona.
ref: Imithetho beyidinga ukuba zonke izifunda zivume ngaphambi kokuba ilungiswe futhi izifunda zithathe uhulumeni omkhulu njengongabalulekile kakhulu kangangokuba abameleli bazo babehlala bangekho.

src: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
mt: Ibhola lezinyawo lesizwe lase-Italy, kanye neqembu lesizwe lebhola lezinyawo laseJalimane yiqembu lesibili eliphumelela kakhulu emhlabeni futhi lalingumpetha weNdebe Yomhlaba yeFIFA ngo-2006.
ref: Ibhola lezinyawo lezwe laseNtaliyane, kanye neqembu lebhola lezinyawo lezwe laseJalimane iqembu lesibili eliphumelele kakhulu emhlabeni futhi bekuyizingqwele zeNdebe yoMhlaba yeFIFA ngo-2006.

src: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
mt: Imidlalo ethandwayo ihlanganisa ibhola lezinyawo, i-basketball, i-volleyball, i-water-polo, i-fencing, i-rugby, ibhayisikili, i-ice hockey, i-roller hockey kanye nemjaho wezimoto i-F1.
ref: Imidlalo ethandwayo ihlanganisa ibhola lezinyawo, i-basketball, i-volleyball, ibhola lasemanzini, umngcweko, iragbhi, ukugibela amabhayisikili, ihoki yaseqhweni, ihoki evamile kanye nomncintiswano wezimoto zeF1.

src: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
mt: Imidlalo yasebusika ithandwa kakhulu ezifundeni zaseNyakatho, lapho ama-Italy ancintisana khona emidlalweni yamazwe ngamazwe nemicimbi yama-Olympic.
ref: Imidlalo yasebusika ithandwa kakhulu ezindaweni eziseNyakatho, lapho amaNtaliyane encintisana khona emidlalweni yamazwe onke kanye nasemidlalweni yama-Olimpiki.

src: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
mt: AmaJapane aneziqhingi ezingaba ngu-7,000 (esikhulu kunazo zonke yiHonshu), okwenza iJapane ibe yisiqhingi esikhulu kunazo zonke emhlabeni!
ref: IJapani ineziqhingi ezicishe zibe ngu-7000 (esikhulu kunazo zonke iHonshu), okwenza iJapani isiqhingi sesi-7 esikhulu kunazo zonke emhlabeni!

src: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
mt: Ngenxa yeqoqo/iqoqo leziqhingi iJapane enalo, iJapane ivame ukubizwa, ngokuma komhlaba, ngokuthi "isiqhingi"
ref: Ngenxa yenqwaba/iqembu leziqhingi iJapani enazo, iJapani ivame ukubizwa ngokuthi, ngenxa yendawo ekuyo, njenge-"archipelago"

src: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
mt: Ukuqala kweTaiwan kuqale ngekhulu le-15 lapho amatilosi aseYurophu adlula khona adlula igama lesiqhingi ngokuthi i-Ilha Formosa, noma isiqhingi esihle.
ref: Ukusungulwa kweTaiwan kuqala kudala ngekhulu lama-15 leminyaka lapho amatilosi aseYurophu edlula ebhala igama lesiqhingi ngokuthi i-Ilha formosa, noma isiqhingi esihle.

src: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
mt: Ngo-1624, iDutch East India Company yasungula isisekelo eningizimu-ntshonalanga yeTaiwan, yaqala ukuguqulwa kwemikhuba yokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu kwabomdabu futhi yaqasha izisebenzi zaseChina ukuthi zisebenze emasimini ayo omchamo noshukela.
ref: Ngo-1624, i-Dutch East India Company yamisa isikhungo eningizimu ntshonalanga Taiwan, iqalisa ukushintshwa kokukhiqizwa kokusanhlamvu komdabu futhi iqasha izisebenzi zaseShayina ukuba zisebenze emasimini welayisi noshukela.

src: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
mt: Ngo-1683, amabutho omndeni wakwa-Qing (1644-1912) athatha indawo esogwini olusentshonalanga nasenyakatho yeTaiwan futhi amemezela iTaiwan njengesifundazwe soMbuso wakwa-Qing ngo-1885.
ref: Ngo-1683, amabutho obukhosi buka-Qing (1644-1912) athatha izindawo ezingasogwini ezisentshonalanga nasenyakatho ne-Taiwan futhi amisa i-Taiwan njengesifundazwe sombuso ka-Qing ngo-1885.

src: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
mt: Ngo-1895, ngemva kokunqotshwa eMpini Yokuqala YaseChina-Japan (1894-1895), uhulumeni wase-Qing wasayina iTreaty of Shimonoseki, lapho anikezela khona ubukhosi baseTaiwan eJapane, elalilawula lesi siqhingi kwaze kwaba ngu-1945.
ref: Ngo-1895, ngemva kokuhlulwa eMpini Yokuqala yamaJapani yase—ino (1894-1895), uhulumeni wase-Qing usayina Isivumelwano se-Simonoseki, ngaso edlulisela iTaiwan eJapani, ebusa isiqhingi kuze kube ngu-1945.

src: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
mt: IMachu Picchu iqukethe izakhiwo ezintathu eziyinhloko, okuyi-Intihuatana, iThempeli LeLanga, neGumbi Lamafasitela Amathathu.
ref: IMachu Picchu yenziwa izakhiwo ezintathu eziyinhloko, okungukuthi i-Intihuatana, i-Temple of the Sun, kanye ne-Room of the Three Windows.

src: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
mt: Izakhiwo eziningi ezisemaphethelweni alo mklamo zenziwe kabusha ukuze zinikeze izivakashi umbono ongcono wokuthi zazikubonakala kanjani ekuqaleni.
ref: Izakhiwo eziningi onqenqemeni lwendawo yokuhlala zakhiwe kabusha ukuzi zinikeze izivakashi umqondo ongcono wendlela ezazibukeka ngayo ekuqaleni.

src: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
mt: Ngo-1976, amaphesenti angamashumi amathathu e-Machu Picchu ayesebuyiselwe futhi ukubuyiselwa kuyaqhubeka kuze kube namuhla.
ref: Ngo-1976, amaphesenti angamashumi amathathu weMachu Picchu ayebuyiselwe esimweni sasekuqaleni futhi ukubuyiselwa kusaqhubeka kuze kube namuhla.

src: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
mt: Isibonelo, ifomethi ejwayelekile kakhulu yezithombe ezithwebuli izithombe emhlabeni yi-35mm, okwakubukhulu befilimu obuyinhloko ekupheleni kwenkathi yefilimu ye-analog.
ref: Ngokwesibonelo, indlela evamile kakhulu yohlobo lwesithombe emhlabeni ingu-35mm, ewubukhulu obufanayo nobefilimu ekupheleni kwesiqephu senkathi yamafilimu.

src: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
mt: Isakhiqizwa nanamuhla, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi isilinganiso sayo se-aspect siye sazuza ngefomethi yesithombe sekhamera yedijithali.
ref: Isenziwa nanamuhla, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi ubudlelwane bayo bobude nobukhulu buthathwe izimo zokuthungatha isithombe zekhamera yedijithali.

src: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
mt: Ifomethi engu-35mm empeleni, ngokudideka, ingu-36mm ububanzi ngo-24mm ukuphakama.
ref: Ifomethi ka-35mm empeleni, ngodidayo ngokunye, ingu-36mm ububanzi kuphindwe ngo-24mm ubude.

src: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
mt: Ngakho-ke, isilinganiso sezinto salolu hlobo (ukuhlukaniswa ngamashumi amabili ukuze kutholakale isilinganiso esilula kunazo zonke sezinombolo eziphelele) kuthiwa ngu-3: 2.
ref: Isilinganiso sobubanzi ebudeni salefomethi (ukudivayida ngeshumi nambili ukuze uthole isilinganiso senombolo ephelele elula) ngakho-ke kuthiwa singu-3:2.

src: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
mt: Amafomethi amaningi ajwayelekile (umndeni wamafomethi e-APS, isibonelo) alingana noma asondela eduze nalesi silinganiso se-aspect.
ref: Amafomethi amaningi avamile (iqoqo lamafomethi le-APS, ngokwesibonelo) ayalingana noma acishe alingane nalesi silinganiso sobubanzi ebudeni.

src: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
mt: Umthetho wezintathu osetshenziswa kabi futhi ngokuvamile ohlekwa usulu uyisiqondiso esilula esidala amandla ngenkathi kugcinwa isilinganiso sohlelo esithombeni.
ref: Lomthetho wezingxenye ezintathu esetshenziswa kabi kakhulu nonganakwa ngokuvamile isiqondiso esilula sokwenza ubuhle ube ugcina izinga lokuhleleka esithombeni.

src: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
mt: Ichaza ukuthi indawo esebenzayo kakhulu yesimo esiyinhloko isendaweni yokuphambana kwemigqa ehlukanisa isithombe sibe yingxenye yesithathu ngokuqondile nangokuphambene (bheka isibonelo).
ref: Ithi indawo ephumelela kakhulu ngesihloko esikhulu ilapho imigqa ihlangana khona ukuze ihlukanise isithombe kathathu ngokuqondile nangokuvundlile (bheka isibonelo).

src: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
mt: Phakathi nalesi sikhathi somlando waseYurophu, iSonto LamaKatolika, elalicebile futhi linamandla, laqala ukuhlolwa.
ref: Phakathi nalenkathi yomlando waseYurophu, iSonto lamaKatolika, elalicebile futhi linamandla, lahlolisiswa.

src: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
mt: Sekuyiminyaka engaphezu kwenkulungwane inkolo yobuKristu ibopha amazwe aseYurophu ndawonye naphezu kokwehluka kwezilimi namasiko.
ref: Ngaphezu kweminyaka eyinkulungwane inkolo yobuKhristu yahlanganisa amazwe waseYurophu ndawonye ngaphezu kokuhluka kwezilimi namasiko.

src: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
mt: Amandla ayo agcwele yonke indawo athinta wonke umuntu kusukela enkosini kuya kumuntu ojwayelekile.
ref: Amandla waso akuyo yonke indawo athinta wonke umuntu kusukela enkosini kuya emuntwini ovamile.

src: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
mt: Esinye sezimiso zobuKristu eziyinhloko ukuthi ingcebo kufanele isetshenziselwe ukunciphisa ukuhlupheka nobuphofu nokuthi izimali zamasonto zikhona ngokukhethekile ngenxa yalesi sizathu.
ref: Enye yemigomo eyinhloko yobuKristu ukuthi ingcebo kufanele isetshenziselwe ukudambisa ukuhlupheka nobuphofu nokuthi imali yebandla ilapho ngenxa yaleso sizathu.

src: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
mt: Igunya eliyinhloko lesonto lase liphezu kweminyaka eyinkulungwane eRoma futhi lokhu kugxiliswa kwamandla nemali kwaholela abaningi ukuba babuze ukuthi le mfundiso yayihambisana yini.
ref: Abaphathi abakhulu besonto babeseRoma iminyaka engaphezu kwenkulungwane futhi lokhu kuqoqana kwamandla nemali kwaholela abaningi ekusoleni ukuthi lomgomo wemfundiso uyafinyelelwa yini.

src: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
mt: Ngokushesha ngemva kokuqubuka kwezingxabano, iBrithani yaqala ukuvinjezelwa kweJalimane.
ref: Ngokushesha ngemva kobutha, iBrithani yaqala ukuvimbezela iJalimane ngemikhumbi.

src: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
mt: Lendlela yaba nempumelelo, yanqamula izinsiza ezibalulekile zempi nezomphakathi, nakuba lokhu kuvinjelwa kwephula umthetho wamazwe omhlaba owamukelwayo ohlanganiswe izivumelwano zamazwe ngamazwe eziningana zamakhulu amabili eminyaka adlule.
ref: Isu libonakale lisebenza, ukususwa kwezinto ezidingwa ibutho lamasosha nabantu abavamile, nakuba lokhu kuvimbela kuphule imithetho yamazwe wonke elungiswe izivumelwano zamazwe amaningana wamakhulu amabili eminyaka adlule.

src: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
mt: IBrithani yayimayini emanzini omhlaba ukuze kuvinjelwe noma yimiphi imikhumbi ukungena ezingxenyeni eziphelele zolwandle, okudala ingozi ngisho nasemikhumbi engathathi hlangothi.
ref: I-Britain imba amanzi ezwekazi ukuze ivimbele imikhumbi ukuthi ingene kuyo yonke ingxenye yolwandle, okubangela izingozi ngisho nasemikhunjini evamile.

src: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
mt: Njengoba kwakunempendulo encane kulobu buchule, iJalimane yayilindele impendulo efanayo empini yayo yamanzi engavinjelwe.
ref: Njengoba bekunokusabela okulinganiselwe kulendlela, iJalimane beyilindele ukusabela okufanayo empini yayo engavinjelwe yemikhumbi yangaphansi kwamanzi.

src: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
mt: Ngawo-1920, isimo sengqondo esivamile sabantu abaningi kanye nezizwe kwakuwukuthula nokuzihlukanisa.
ref: Ngezikhathi zawo-1920, izimo zengqondo zezakhamuzi eziningi kanye nezizwe bezikholwa ukuzonda impi nokulwa kanye nokuzihlukanisa.

src: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
mt: Ngemva kokubona izinto ezesabekayo nezinkulu zempi phakathi neMpi Yezwe I, izizwe zazinesifiso sokugwema isimo esinjalo futhi esikhathini esizayo.
ref: Ngemva kokubona izenzo zonya nezishaqisayo zempi phakathi neMpi Yezwe I, izizwe zafisa ukugwema isimo esinjalo futhi esikhathini esizayo.

src: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
mt: Ngo-1884, uTesla wathuthela e-United States of America ukuze amukele umsebenzi e-Edison Company eNew York City.
ref: Ngo-1884 uTesla wathuthela eMelika ukwamukela umsebenzi neNkampani ka-Edison eDolobheni lase-New York.

src: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
mt: Wafika e-US ephethe amasenti angu-4 egameni lakhe, incwadi yezinkondlo, nencwadi yokuncoma evela kuCharles Batchelor (umphathi wakhe emsebenzini wakhe wangaphambilini) kuThomas Edison.
ref: Ufike eMelika enamasenti angu-4 egameni lakhe, incwadi yezinkondlo, kanye nencwadi yokutusa evela ku-Charles Batchelor (umphathi wakhe wasemsebenzini wakhe wangaphambili) iya kuThomas Edison.

src: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
mt: IChina yasendulo yayinenqubo eyingqayizivele yokubonisa izinkathi zezikhathi ezahlukene; isigaba ngasinye seChina noma umndeni ngamunye owawusemandleni kwakuwumndeni ohlukile.
ref: IShayina yamandulo yayinendlela ehlukile yokuveza izinkathi ezihlukile; isigaba ngasinye seShayina noma umndeni ngamunye owawubusa wawuwubukhosi obuhlukile.

src: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
mt: Futhi phakathi kwemibuso ngayinye kwakukhona inkathi engazinzile yezifundazwe ezahlukene.Eyaziwa kakhulu kulezi zikhathi kwakuyi-Tri Kingdom epoch eyayithatha iminyaka engama-60 phakathi kweHan ne-Jin Dynasty.
ref: Futhi phakathi kobukhosi ngabunye kwakuyiminyaka engazinzile yezifundazwe ezihlukene. Inkathi eyaziwa kakhulu kulezi kwakuyinkathi yemibuso emithathu eyenzeka iminyaka engama-60 phakathi koMbusokaHan noJin.

src: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
mt: Ngalezo zikhathi kwaba nempi enzima phakathi kwabaningi ababekwa isikhundla sobukhosi.
ref: Phakathi nalesi sikhathi kwakuba nezimpi ezinodlame phakathi kwababusi belwela ubukhosi.

src: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
mt: Imibuso emithathu yayiyingxenye yesikhathi esopha igazi kakhulu emlandweni waseChina yasendulo, izinkulungwane zabantu zafa zilwela ukuhlala esihlalweni esiphakeme kunazo zonke esigodlweni esikhulu eXian.
ref: IMibuso Emithathu kwakungenye yenkathi yegazi eliningi kunazo zonke emlandweni waseShayina yakuDala, izinkulungwane zabantu zafa zilwela ukuhlala esihlalweni esiphakeme kakhulu esigodlweni esihle e-Xi’an.

src: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
mt: Kunemiphumela eminingi yezenhlalo nezombusazwe njengokusetshenziswa kohlelo lwe-metric, ukushintsha kusuka ku-absolualism kuya ku-republicanism, ubuzwe kanye nenkolelo yokuthi izwe lingelabantu hhayi umbusi oyedwa.
ref: Kunemiphumela eminingi yezenhlalo neyezepolitiki efana nokusetshenziswa kohlelo lokulinganisa ngamamitha, ukusuka ekukholelweni ezimisweni eziphelele kuya ekusekeleni izimiso zoburiphabhuliki, ubuzwe kanye nenkolelo yokuthi izwe elabantu hhayi umbusi oyedwa.

src: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
mt: Futhi ngemva koMshoshaphansi imisebenzi yayivuleleke kubo bonke abafakizicelo besilisa okuvumela abafisa kakhulu futhi abaphumelelayo ukuba baphumelele.
ref: Futhi ngemva kweNguquko izikhundla zazivulekele bonke abesilisa abafake izicelo okwavumela ukuthi abafuna ukuvelela kakhulu nokubahambela kahle baphumelele.

src: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
mt: Kunjalo nangamasosha ngoba esikhundleni sokuthi amazinga amasosha asekelwe ekilasini manje asekelwe ku-cailaber.
ref: Lokhu kufana nalokhu okwenzeka kumabutho amasosha kunokuba babheke inhlanga yakho bona bakhetha ukubeka i-cailaber ukuze banike amasosha ama-ratings.

src: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
mt: I-French Revolution yaphinde yashukumisela abanye abantu abaningi abacindezelwe abasebenza abavela kwamanye amazwe ukuba baqale izinguquko zabo.
ref: INguquko kwaseFulansi kugqugquzele abanye abantu abasebenzayo abacindezelwe bakwamanye abazwe ukuthi baqale ukuvukela kwabo.

src: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
mt: UMuhammad wayenesithakazelo esikhulu ezindabeni ezingaphezu kwalokhu kuphila kwansuku zonke. Wayevame ukuya emhumeni owaziwa ngokuthi "Hira" eNtabeni "kaNoor" (ukukhanya) ukuze acabange.
ref: UMuhammad wayenesithakazelo esijulile ezindabeni zokuphila ezingaphathelene nezinto zalomhlaba. Wayevame ukuya emhumeni owaziwa ngokuthi “iHira” eNtabeni “yeNoor” (ukukhanya) ukuze ayozindla.

src: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
mt: umhume uqobo, osinda ezikhathini, unikeza isithombe esicacile kakhulu sokuthambekela kukaMuhammad ngokomoya.
ref: Umhume ngokwawo, obekhona kuze kube manje, unikeza isithombe esicacile sokuthambekela okungokomoya kukaMuhammad.

src: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
mt: Ephumula esiqongweni sentaba eyodwa enyakatho yeMecca, lo mgodi uhlukaniswe ngokuphelele nabanye abantu emhlabeni.
ref: Umhume ohlezi phezu kwenye yezintaba zasenyakatho yase-Mecca, ukude kakhulu nomhlaba wonke.

src: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
mt: Eqinisweni, akulula ukuyithola ngisho noma umuntu azi ukuthi ikhona. Uma isingaphakathi emhumeni, iyisehlukaniso esiphelele.
ref: Eqinisweni, akulula ukuyithola ngisho noma wazi ukuthi ikhona. Uma isingaphakathi emhumeni isuke isihlukaniswe ngokuphelele.

src: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
mt: Akukho okunye okungabonakala ngaphandle kwesibhakabhaka esicacile, esihle esiphezulu nezintaba eziningi ezizungezile.
ref: Akukho okubonakalayo phezulu ngaphandle kwesibhakabhaka esibalele, esihle kanye nezintaba eziningi ezizungezile. Kuncane kakhulu okwalelizwe okubonakalayo noma okuzwakalayo uma uphakathi emgedeni.

src: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
mt: I-Great Pyramid yaseGiza iyona kuphela yezimangaliso eziyisikhombisa ezisasele namuhla.
ref: I-Great Pyramid yase-Giza iyokuphela kwizimangaliso eziyisikhombisa esamile nanamuhla.

src: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
mt: Yakhiwa abaseGibhithe ngekhulu lesithathu ngaphambi kokuzalwa kukaJesu, iPiramidi Elikhulu lingelinye lezakhiwo eziningi ezinkulu zamapiramidi ezakhelwe ukuhlonipha uFaro oshonile.
ref: Yakhiwe ngabaseGibhithe ngekhulu lesithathu leminyaka BCE, I-Great Pyramide, ngelinye lezakhiwo zamaphiramidi ezakhelwe ukuhlonipha uFaro oshonile.

src: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
mt: I-Giza Plateau, noma "i-Giza Necropolis" e-Egypt Valley of the Dead iqukethe amapiramidi amaningana (apho ipiramidi elikhulu likhulu khona), amathuna amaningana amancane, amathempeli amaningana, ne-Sphinx enkulu.
ref: I-Giza Plateau, noma "i-Giza Necropolis" eSigodini sabaFile saseGibhithe linemibhoshongo emingxa-ntathu eminingana (leyo umbhoshongo omkhulu kuyiwo omkhulu kakhulu), amathuna amaningana amancane, amathempeli amaningana, kanye ne-Sphinx enkulu.

src: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
mt: Ipiramidi elikhulu lasungulwa ukuze kuhlonishwe uFaro Khufu, futhi amaphiramidi amancane amaningi, amathuna namathempeli kwakhiwa ukuze kuhlonishwe abafazi bamalungu omndeni kaKhufu.
ref: Umbhoshongo omkhulu ongunxa-ntathu wakhelwa ukuhlonipha uFaro uKhufu, futhi neminye imibhoshongo engunxa-ntathu emincanyana, amathuna, kanye namathempeli akhelwe ukuhlonipha inkosikazi kaKhufu kanye namalungu omndeni.

src: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
mt: Uphawu "oluvela phezulu" lubukeka njenge-V kanti "oluvela phansi" lufana nesitembu noma isikwele esingaphansi kwaso.
ref: Uphawu "lomnsalo ophezulu" olubukeka njengo-V kanti "uphawu lomnsalo ophansi" lubukeka njengesigaxa noma isikwele esishoda ngohlangothi lwaso olungaphansi.

src: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
mt: Ephezulu kusho ukuthi kufanele uqale esiqwini bese ushaya umcibisholo, bese phansi kusho ukuthi kufanele uqale kumgodi (lapho isandla sakho sibambe khona umcibisholo) bese udonsa umcibisholo.
ref: Phezulu kusho ukuthi kumelwe uqale ekugcineni bese uphusha umnsalo, kanti phansi kusho ukuthi kumelwe uqale exoxweni (okusho ukuthi lapho ubambe khona umnsalo) bese ugobisa umcibisholo.

src: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
mt: Umcibisholo ophezulu ngokuvamile ukhiqiza umsindo othambile, kuyilapho umcibisholo ophansi unamandla futhi unamandla kakhulu.
ref: Umnsalo ophezulu ujwayele ukwenza umsindo opholile, kanti umnsalo ophansi wenza umsindo onamandla noqinile kakhudlwana.

src: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
mt: Zizwe ukhululekile ukufaka amapendela akho, kodwa khumbula ukuthi amapende okuguqa anyatheliswe akhona ngesizathu somculo, ngakho ngokuvamile kufanele ahlonishwe.
ref: Zizwe ukhululekile ukubhala izimpawu zakho ngepensela, kepha khumbula izimpawu eziphrintiwe ezehlayo zikhona ngesizathu esingokomculo, ngakho-ke kufanele zihlonishwe.

src: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
mt: Inkosi eyayethukile uLouis XVI, iNdlovukazi uMarie Antoinette izingane zabo ezimbili ezincane (uMarie Therese oneminyaka engu-11 noLouis-Charles oneminyaka emine) nodadewabo wenkosi, uNkk Elizabeth, ngo-6 Okthoba 1789 baphoqeleka ukuba babuyele eParis bevela eVersailles yiqembu labesifazane bezimakethe.
ref: Inkosi uLouis XVI ethukile, iNdlovukazi uMarie Antoinette kanye nezingane zabo ezincane ezimbili (uMarie Therese oneminyaka engu-11 ubudala kanye noLouis-Charles eneminyaka emine ubudala) kanye nodadewabo weNkosi, iNkosazana u-Elizabeth, ngomhla ka-6 kuMfumfu 1789 baphoqelelwa ukubuyela eParis besuka eVersailles uquqaba lwabesifazane basemakethe.

src: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
mt: Ngenqola, babuyela eParis behaqwe isixuku sabantu abememeza futhi bedelela iNkosi neNdlovukazi.
ref: Besenkalishini, babuyela emuva ePherisi bezungezwe uquqaba lwabantu oluklabalasa kanye nokumemeza izinsongo ngokumelene neNkosi kanye neNdlovukazi.

src: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
mt: Isixuku sabantu saphoqelela iNkosi Nenkosikazi ukuba ivule amafasitela e-carriage yabo.
ref: Isixuku sabantu siphoqelele iNkosi kanye neNdlovukazi ukuba bavule kakhulu amafasitela esithuthi sabo.

src: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
mt: Ngesinye isikhathi ilungu leqembu labantu labamba ikhanda lomlindi wasebukhosini owabulawa eVersailles phambi kweNdlovukazi eyayithukile.
ref: Kunesikhathi lapho ilungu loquqaba lalifuna ukunqathuzisa ikhanda lonogada wasebukhosini obulawe eVersailles phambi kweNdlovukazi ethukile.

src: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
mt: Izindleko zempi zombuso wasemakhaya wase-U.S. ekutheni uthathe iPhilippines, zazikhokhwa ngabantu basePhilippines.
ref: Izindleko zempi zobukhosi baseMelika lapho inqoba iPhilippines zakhokhelwa abantu basePhilippines ngokwabo.

src: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
mt: Baphoqeleka ukuba bakhokhe intela embusweni wamakoloni wase-U.S. ukuze bakhokhe ingxenye enkulu yezindleko kanye nenzalo yamabhondi ayeshaywa egameni likahulumeni wasePhilippines ngokusebenzisa izindlu zamabhange aseWall Street.
ref: Baphoqelelwa ukukhokhela intela umbuso wobukoloni waseMelika ukukhokha ingxenye enkulu yezindleko futhi inzalo yamabhondi yabekwa egameni likahulumeni wasePhilippines ngezindlu zasebhange zeWall Street.

src: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
mt: Yiqiniso, izinzuzo ezinkulu ezivela ekuxhasweni kwabantu basePhilippines isikhathi eside zizoba izinzuzo eziyisisekelo zombuso wobukhosi wase-U.S.
ref: Kusobala, izinzuzo ezinkulu ezitholwe ngokuxhaphazwa okungapheli kwabantu baseFilipino benza izinzuzo eziyisisekelo zobukhosi baseMelika.

src: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
mt: Ukuze umuntu aqonde amaTempile kumelwe aqonde umongo owashukumisela ukwakhiwa komyalelo.
ref: Ukuze uqonde amaTemplar umuntu kufanele aqonde umcabango owadala le nhlangano.

src: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
mt: Isikhathi lapho kwenzeka khona lezi zenzakalo ngokuvamile kubhekiselwa kuso njengeNkathi Ephakathi Ephakeme isikhathi somlando waseYurophu ngekhulu le-11, le-12 nele-13 (AD 1000-1300).
ref: Inkathi lapho kube nesehlakalo khona ivame ukubhekiselwa ngokuthi Inkathi Ephakathi Ephezulu inkathi yomlando waseYurophu ngekhulu lama-11, lama-12, kanye nelama-13 leminyaka (AD 1000–1300).

src: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
mt: Iminyaka Ephakathi Ephakeme yayilandelwa yiNkathi Ephakathi Yokuqala futhi yalandelwa yiNkathi Ephakathi Ephakathi Emuva, eyadlula ngokwesivumelwano cishe ngo-1500.
ref: IHigh Middle Ages yandulelwa i-Early Middle Ages futhi yase ilandelwa iLate Middle Ages, ngokwenjwayelo iphela ngabo ends around 1500.

src: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
mt: Ukuzimisela kwezobuchwepheshe yigama elihlanganisa uhla olubanzi lwemibono ekusebenzeni, kusuka ekucindezeleni kwezobuchwepheshe noma ekufuneni kwezobuchwepheshe kuya emcabangweni oqinile wokuthi ikusasa lomuntu liqhutshwa yinengqondo ehlobene nemithetho yesayensi nokuvela kwayo kwezobuchwepheshe.
ref: Inkolelo yokumiselwa okungokwezobuchwepheshe igama elihlanganisa imibono eminingi esebenzayo, kusukela ekusebenziseni ezobuchwepheshe ezikhona noma ekutheni ezobuchwepheshe ziyadingeka kuya emuzweni oqinile wokuthi ukumiselwa kwesintu kuholwa umcabango ojulile ohlobene nemithetho yesayensi nokubonakala kwayo kwezobuchwepheshe.

src: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
mt: Izincazelo eziningi ze-determinism yezobuchwepheshe zihlanganyela imibono emibili ejwayelekile: ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe uqobo lulandela indlela engaphezu kakhulu kwethonya lezamasiko noma lezombusazwe, nokuthi ubuchwepheshe bubuye "benomphumela" emiphakathini engokwemvelo, kunokuba ibekwe ngaphansi kombandela wezenhlalo.
ref: Izincazelo eziningi zenkolelo yokumiselwa okungokwezobuchwepheshe buhlanganyela imibono emibili evamile: ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe ngokwakho kulandela indlela engaphezu kwethonya lesiko noma lepolotiki kakhulu, kanye nokuthi ezobuchwepheshe nazo "nemithelela" emiphakathini ezuzwayo ngokwemvelo, kunangezimo zenhlalo.

src: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
mt: Ngokwesibonelo, umuntu angase athi imoto ngokuyisisekelo iholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemigwaqo.
ref: Ngokwesibonelo, othile angathi imoto iholela ekwakhiweni kwemigwaqo.

src: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
mt: Nokho, inethiwekhi yomgwaqo kazwelonke ayisebenzi ngokwezomnotho ezimotweni ezimbalwa nje, ngakho-ke kusungulwe izindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza ukuze kwehliswe izindleko zokuthi umuntu abe nezimoto.
ref: Nokho, imigwaqo exhumanisa izwe lonke ayizuzisi ngokomnotho ezimotweni ezimbalwa nje kuphela, ngakho izindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza ziyenziwa ukunciphisa inani lokuba nemoto.

src: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
mt: Ukuba nezimoto eziningi kuholela futhi ekwandeni kwezingozi emigwaqweni, okuholela ekutheni kusungulwe izindlela ezintsha ekunakekelweni kwezempilo zokulungisa izidumbu ezilimele.
ref: Ukuba nezimoto kwabantu abaningi nakho kuholela ezigamekweni eziphakeme zezingozi emigwaqweni, okuholela ekusungulweni kwezindlela ezintsha kwezempilo zokulungisa imizimba elimele.

src: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
mt: Uthando lwalunezinto eziningi zamasiko, ezazikhishwe ababhali abanjengoGoethe, uFichte, noSchlegel.
ref: I-Romanticism  yabanomthelela omkhulu ezinkolelweni zokuziphatha zamasiko, okuthathelwa kubabhali abanjengoGoethe, uFichte, kanye noSchlegel.

src: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
mt: Emvelweni ye-Romanticism, indawo yakha abantu, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kwavela amasiko namasiko ahlobene naleyo ndawo, futhi lokhu, ngokuvumelanisa nendawo yomphakathi, kwakungcono kunemithetho ebekwe ngokuzithandela.
ref: Esizindeni seRomanticism, indawo ibumba abantu ngabanye, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi imikhuba nesiko ehlobene naleyo ndawo yavela, futhi lena, ivumelana nendawo yomphakathi, yayingcono kunemithetho emiswe ngokunganaki.

src: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
mt: Ngendlela efanayo neParis eyaziwa ngayo njengenhlokodolobha yemfashini yomhlaba wanamuhla, iConstantinople yayibhekwa njengenhlokodolobha yemfashini yeYurophu yobukhosi.
ref: Ngendlela iParis eyaziwa ngayo njengenhlokodolobha yezwe lamanje, iConstantinople yayibhekwa njengenhlokodolobha yezikhonzi zaseYurophu.

src: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
mt: Idumela layo lokuba yindawo yokunethezeka laqala cishe ngo-400 C.E. futhi laqhubeka kwaze kwaba cishe ngo-1100 C.E.
ref: Yaziwa ngokuba yindawo yalapho kwaqala khona izinto zikanokusho cishe ngo-400 A.D. futhi yahlala cishe kwaze kaba u-1100 A.D.

src: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
mt: Isimo salo sawohloka phakathi nekhulu leshumi nambili ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokuthi amaCrusaders ayebuyele ephethe izipho ezinjengezilulu nezinongo ezazinenani eliphakeme kunalokho okwakuhlinzekwa izimakethe zaseByzantine.
ref: Isimo sayo sawohloka phakathi nekhulu leminyaka leshumi nambili ngokuyinhloko ngenxa yokuthi Abalweli Benkolo babebuye bephethe izipho ezinjengosilika nezinongo ezaziyigugu kunalezo imakethe yaseByzantium eyayinazo.

src: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
mt: Kungalesi sikhathi lapho kudluliselwa khona isihloko se-Fashion Capital kusuka e-Constantinople kuya eParis.
ref: Kwakungalesi sikhathi lapho ukudluliselwa kwesiqu seNhlokodolobha yeMfashini kusuka eKhonstantinopheli kuya ePherisi kwenziwa.

src: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
mt: Isitayela seGothic safinyelela esiqophelweni phakathi kwekhulu le-10 - 11 nekhulu le-14.
ref: Isitayela se-Gothic safinyelela umvuthwandaba enkathini ephakathi kwekhulu le-10 - 11 nekhulu le-14.

src: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
mt: Ekuqaleni, izingubo zazinethonya elikhulu kwamasiko aseByzantine empumalanga.
ref: Ekuqaleni ukwembatha kwakuthonywe kakhulu isiko laseByzantium empumalanga.

src: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
mt: Nokho, ngenxa yezindlela zokuxhumana ezihamba kancane, izitayela entshonalanga zingase zishiye emuva ngeminyaka engu-25 kuya kwengama-30.
ref: Noma kunjalo, ngenxa yokungabi khona kwezindlela zokuxhumana, izitayela zasentshonalanga zingasalela emuva ngeminyaka ewu-25 ukuya kwengu-30.

src: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
mt: ngasekupheleni kweminyaka Ephakathi entshonalanga yeYurophu yaqala ukuthuthukisa isitayela sayo. Enye yezintuthuko ezinkulu zesikhathi ngenxa yempi yabaphristi abantu baqala ukusebenzisa izinkinobho ukufaka izingubo.
ref: Ngasekupheleni kweNkathi Ephakathi intshonalanga Yurophu yaqala ukuthuthukisa isitayela sayo. Enye yentuthuko enkulu kakhulu yaleso sikhathi ngenxa yabalweli benkolo abantu baqala ukusebenzisa izinkinobho ukubopha izimpahla zokugqoka.

src: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
mt: Ukuziphilisa kwezolimo kuwukukukhiqiza ukudla okwanele ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomlimi nomndeni wakhe.
ref: Ukulimela ukuziphilisa ukulima okwenzelwa ukukhiqiza ukudla okwanele ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomlimi kanye nomdeni wakhe kuphela.

src: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
mt: Ukulima okusizayo kuyindlela elula, ngokuvamile eyokwemvelo, esebenzisa imbewu esindisiwe yendawo ehlala kuyo ehlangene nokujikeleza kwezitshalo noma ezinye izindlela ezilula ngokwanele ukuze kwandiswe isivuno.
ref: Ukulimela ukuziphilisa indlela elula, ngovamile okususelwe ezintweni eziphilayo, kusetshenziswa imbewu egciniwe yasendaweni enezici ezingokwemvelo kuhlanganiswe nokushintshashintsha izilimo noma ezinye izindlela ezilula zokwenza umkhiqizo ube mningi.

src: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
mt: Ngokomlando, iningi lamalimi lalisebenza kwezolimo ukuze likwazi ukuphila futhi lokhu kusenzakala emazweni amaningi asathuthuka.
ref: Ngokomlando abalimi abaningi babelimela ukuziphilisa futhi kusenjalo emazweni amaningi athuthukayo.

src: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
mt: Amasiko angaphasi ahlanganisa abantu abanomqondo ofanayo abazizwa benganakwa yizindinganiso zomphakathi futhi abavumele ukuba bathuthukise umuzwa wobunikazi.
ref: Amaqembu ahlukile ahlanganisa abantu abazizwa benganakiwe yizimiso zomphakathi futhi abavumela ukwakha umuzwa wobuntu babo.

src: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
mt: Amasiko angaphansi angaba ahlukile ngenxa yobudala, ubuhlanga, isigaba, indawo, kanye/noma ubulili bamalungu.
ref: Amasiko angaba ahlukanisayo ngenxa yeminyaka, uhlanga, isizinda, indawo, kanye/noma ubulili bamalungu.

src: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
mt: Izimfanelo ezinquma isiko elingaphansi njengokuhlukile zingase zibe ngolimi, ubuhle, inkolo, ezombusazwe, ezocansi, ezendawo, noma inhlanganisela yezici.
ref: Izici eziveza iqembu elinyingxenye yesiko njengelihlukile kungaba ulimi, ubuhle, inkolo, ipolotiki, ubulili, indawo, noma inhlanganisela yezici.

src: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
mt: Amalungu amasiko amancane ngokuvamile abonisa ubulungu bawo ngokusebenzisa isitayela esiyingqayizivele nesingokomfanekiso, esihlanganisa imfashini, izindlela, kanye ne-argot.
ref: Amalungu weqembu eliyingxenye yesiko avamise ukubonakalisa ubulungu bawo ngokusebenzisa isitayela esihlukile nesimelela okuthile, esihlanganisa imfashini, ukuziphatha, kanye nendlela yokukhuluma.

src: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
mt: Enye yezindlela ezivame kakhulu ezisetshenziswayo ukubonisa ukubaluleka kokuzihlanganisa nabantu ngabanye ukusetshenziswa kwezigameko ezimbalwa ezingathandeki zezingane ezazingazihlanganisi nabantu abadala ngenkathi zikhula, ngenxa yokunganaki, inhlekelele, noma ukuhlukunyezwa ngamabomu.
ref: Enye yezindlela eziningi kwezivamile ezisentshenziswa ukuchaza ukubaluleka kokuhlalisana nabanye ukusondelana nabambalwa ezinganeni, okwathi ngokunganakwa, ngeshwa, noma ngokuhlukunyezwa ngamabomu, bangajwayelaniswa nabantu abadala ngesikhathi besakhula.

src: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
mt: Izingane ezinjalo zibizwa ngokuthi "izilwane zasendle". Ezinye izingane zasendle ziye zavalelwa abantu (imvamisa abazali bazo); kwezinye izimo lokhu kushiywa kwengane kwakubangelwa ukwenqatshwa ngabazali ukukhubazeka kwengqondo noma ngokomzimba kwengane.
ref: Izingane ezinjalo zibizwa ngokuthi “zinobulwane” noma ezasendle. Ezinye izingane ezinobulwane zigcinwe abanye abantu (ngokuvamile abazali bazo); kwezinye izimo lokhu kulahlwa kwezingane kwakungenxa yokungamukeli komzali ukukhubazeka okukhulu ngokwengqondo noma ngokomzimba kwengane.

src: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
mt: Izingane zasendle zingase zibe nokuhlukunyezwa noma ukuhlukunyezwa okukhulu kwezingane ngaphambi kokuba zishiywe noma zibaleke.
ref: Izingane ezinobulwane kungenzeka ukuthi zihlangabezane nokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane okubi noma ukucindezeleka ngaphambi kokulahlwa noma ukubaleka.

src: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
mt: Abanye kuthiwa bakhuliswa yizilwane; abanye kuthiwa bahlala endle bebodwa.
ref: Ezinye kuthiwa zikhuliswe izilwane; ezinye kuthiwa zihlale endle zizodwa.

src: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
mt: Lapho ingane yasendle ikhuliswa ngokuphelele yizilwane ezingezona ezomuntu, ikhombisa ukuziphatha (ngaphakathi kwemingcele engokomzimba) cishe ngokuphelele njengaleyo yesilwane esithile sokunakekela, njengokwesaba noma ukungabi nandaba nabantu.
ref: Lapho ikhuliswe ngokuphelele isilwane ekungesona umuntu, ingane enobulwane iveza ukuziphatha (ngokulinganiselwa okungokoqobo) cishe okufana ngokuphele nokwesilwane ebesiyinakekela, njengokusaba noma ukungabi nandaba nabantu.

src: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
mt: Nakuba ukufunda okusekelwe kuphrojekthi kufanele kwenze ukufunda kube lula futhi kujabulise, ukuhlela kuya phambili.
ref: Nakuba ukufunda okusekelwe kuyiphrojekthi kumelwe kwenze ukufunda kube lula futhi kuthakazelise kakhudlwana, izibhaxa zenza okwengeziwe.

src: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
mt: Ukubeka phansi akuyona indlela yokufunda kodwa kunalokho kuyisizo esinikeza usizo kubantu abafunda ulwazi olusha njengokusebenzisa uhlelo olusha lwekhompyutha noma ukuqala iphrojekthi entsha.
ref: I-scaffolding akuyona indlela yokufunda kodwa kunalokho insiza enikeza usizo kubantu ngabanye abafunda okusha njengokusebenzisa uhlelo olusha lwekhompyutha noma ukuqala iphrojekthi entsha.

src: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
mt: Ama-scaffold angaba ngokoqobo futhi angokoqobo, ngamanye amazwi, uthisha uyindlela yesicubungula kodwa kunjalo futhi ngo-paperclip man omncane ku-Microsoft Office.
ref: Ama-Scaffolds angaba wekhompyutha futhi abe ngokoqobo, ngamanye amagama, uthisha uwuhlobo lwe-scaffold kodwa kunjalo nangomuntu omncane wocingo lokuhlanganisa amaphepha kuyi-Microsoft Office.

src: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
mt: Ama-Virtual Scaffolds angaphakathi kwisoftware futhi ahloselwe ukubuza, ukuphoqa, nokuchaza izinqubo okungenzeka ukuthi zazinzima kakhulu kumfundi ukubhekana nazo yedwa.
ref: Izibhaxa zekhompyutha zifakwe phakathi kohlelo lokusebenza futhi zenzelwe ukubuza, ukushukumisa, kanye nokuchaza izinqubo okungenzeka ukuthi bekunzima ukuthi abafundi basebenze ngazo bebodwa.

src: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
mt: Izingane zibekwa endaweni yokunakekela izingane ngenxa yezizathu ezihlukahlukene ezihlanganisa ukunganakwa, ukuhlukunyezwa, ngisho nokuxhashazwa.
ref: Izingane zigcinwa emakhaya anakekela abantwana ngezizathu eziningi njengokukhishwa inyumbazane, ukuhlukunyezwa kanye nokuphamba.

src: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
mt: Akekho ingane okufanele ikhule endaweni engakhulisi, enganakekeli futhi engakufundisi, kodwa iyakhula.
ref: Kayikho ingane okufanele ikhule endaweni engalungile, engenalo uthando, engenankathalo kanye nemfundo, kodwa kuyenzeka.

src: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
mt: Sibona uhlelo lokunakekela izingane ezifuywayo njengendawo yokuphepha kulezi zingane.
ref: Sibona i-Foster Care System iyindawo yokuphepha yalezi zingane.

src: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
mt: Uhlelo lwethu lokunakekela abantu abahlala ekhaya kufanele lunikeze amakhaya aphephile, abanakekeli abanothando, imfundo eqinile nokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuthembekile.
ref: Inqubo yethu yokuthola abantwana abangenabazali kumelwe ihlinzeke ngamakhaya aphephile, abanakekeli abanothando, imfundo ezinzile, kanye nezokwelapha ezinokwethenjelwa.

src: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
mt: Ukunakekelwa kwabantwana kufanele kunikeze zonke izidingo ezazingekho ekhaya ababelithathile ngaphambilini.
ref: Ikhaya lezintandane kumelwe lihlinzeke ngezidingo ezazingatholakali ekhaya abathathwe kulo ngaphambili.

src: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
mt: I-Internet ihlanganisa izinto zokuxhumana kwabantu abaningi nezokuxhumana nabanye.
ref: I-Inthanethi ihlanganisa izici zokukhulumisana kweningi nokokusebenzelana nabanye.

src: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
mt: Izici ezihlukile ze-Inthanethi zenza kube nezilinganiso ezengeziwe maqondana nokusetshenziswa kanye nendlela yokwanelisa.
ref: Izici ezihlukile ze-Inthanethi zaholela ebubanzini obengeziwe uma kukhulunywa ngendlela yokusebenzisa nokwaneliseka.

src: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
mt: Ngokwesibonelo, "ukufunda" kanye "nokuzihlanganisa" kusikiselwa njengezizathu ezibalulekile zokusebenzisa i-Internet (James et al., 1995).
ref: Ngokwesibonelo, "ukufunda" kanye "nokuzihlanganisa nomphakathi" kusikiselwa njengezisusa ezibalulekile zokusebenzisa i-Inthanethi (James et al., 1995).

src: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
mt: "Ukubandakanyeka komuntu siqu" kanye "nobudlelwano obuqhubekayo" nakho kwaboniswa njengezici ezintsha zokukhuthaza ngu-Eighmey noMcCord (1998) lapho bephenya ukusabela kwezilaleli kumawebhusayithi.
ref: “Ukuzibandakanya komuntu siqu” kanye “nobudlelwano obuqhubekayo” kubuywe kwavezwa njengezici ezintsha zokugqugquzela ngu-Eighmey noMcCord (1998) lapho behlola indlela yokusabela yababukele amawebhusayithi.

src: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
mt: Ukusetshenziswa kokurekhodwa kwevidiyo kuye kwaholela ekutholeni izinto ezibalulekile ekuchazeni izinkulumo ezincane, ukunyakaza kobuso okuthatha imizuzwana embalwa.
ref: Ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lwevidiyo kuholele kukwazisa okubalulekile ekuchazweni kokuziveza okuncane kakhulu, ukunyakaza kobuso okuthatha imizuzwana.

src: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
mt: Ikakhulukazi, kuthiwa umuntu angakwazi ukuthola ukuthi umuntu uqamba amanga yini ngokuhumusha kahle izinkulumo ezincane.
ref: Ikakhulu, kuthiwa umuntu angabona ukuthi umuntu uqamba amanga ngokuchachisa izibonakaliso zobuso ezincane ngokunembile.

src: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
mt: U-Oliver Sacks, ephepheni lakhe elithi The President's Speech, waveza indlela abantu abangakwazi ngayo ukuqonda inkulumo ngenxa yokulimala kobuchopho nokho abakwazi ngayo ukuhlola ngobuqotho ngokunembile.
ref: U-Oliver Sack ephepheni lakhe lNkulumo kaMongameli, ubonise ukuthi abantu abangakwazi ukuqonda inkulumo ngenxa yokulimala engqondweni bayakwazi ukubona ubuqotho ngokunembile.

src: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
mt: Uphinde athi amakhono anjalo okuhumusha ukuziphatha komuntu angase abelwe izilwane njengenja yasendlini.
ref: Futhi usikisele nokuthi amakhono anjalo wokuchaza indlela yokuziphatha komuntu angahlanganyelwa nezilwane ezinjengezinja ezifuywayo.

src: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
mt: Ucwaningo lwekhulu lamashumi amabili luye lwabonisa ukuthi kunamaqoqo amabili okuhlukahluka kofuzo: kufihlwe futhi kukhulunywe.
ref: Ucwaningo lwangekhulu lamashumi amabili leminyaka libonise ukuthi kunezigaba ezimbili zokuhlukana kofuzo: okufihliwe nokuveziwe.

src: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
mt: Ukuguquka kwesimo kufaka ukuhlukahluka okusha kofuzo, futhi ukukhetha kuyisusa echibini lokuhlukahluka okuveziwe.
ref: Ukuguquka kwenza ukwahluka kwezakhi zofuzo okusha, futhi ukukhetha kuzisusa emehlukweni oveziwe.

src: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
mt: Ukuhlukaniswa nokuhlanganiswa kabusha kuhlanganisa ukuhlukahluka emuva naphambili phakathi kwamapuleti amabili ngesizukulwane ngasinye.
ref: Ukwehluka kokuhlukaniswa nokuhlanganiswa kwehla kwenyuke phakathi kwezigaba ezimbli ngesizukulwane ngasinye.

src: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
mt: E-savanna, kunzima ukuba imvana enohlelo lokugaya ukudla olufana nolomuntu yanelise izidingo zayo zama-amino-acid emithonjeni yezitshalo etholakalayo.
ref: Ngaphandle emahlathini, kunzima ngesilwane esinesimiso sokugaya ukudla esifana nesabantu ukwanelisa imfuneko yaso yama-amino-acid ngezitshalo ezikhona.

src: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
mt: Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwehluleka ukwenza lokho kunemiphumela emibi: ukukhula okucindezelekile, ukungondleki, futhi ekugcineni ukufa.
ref: Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhluleka ukwenza kanjalo kunemiphumela emibi kakhulu: ukungakhuli kahle, ukungondleki, futhi ekugcineni ukufa.

src: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
mt: Izinsiza zezitshalo ezifinyeleleka kalula ngabe ngamaprotheni atholakala emaqabungeni nasezinhlamvu, kodwa lokhu kunzima ukuba izilwane eziphilayo njengathi ziyahlanza ngaphandle uma ziphekwe.
ref: Imithombo yezitshalo etholakala kalula ngabe ngamaprotheni atholakala emaqabungeni nasezindimeni, kepha lezi zilukhuni kohlobo lokuqala njengathi ukugaya ngaphandle kokuthi luphekwe.

src: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
mt: Ngokuphambene, ukudla kwezilwane (izimbungulu, ama-termit, amaqanda) akuyona nje into evakala kalula, kodwa kunikeza amaprotheni amaningi aqukethe wonke ama-amino acid abalulekile.
ref: Ngokuphambene, ukudla kwezilwane (izintuthwane, umuhlwa, amaqanda) akugayeki kalula nje kuphela, kodwa kunikeza amaphrotheni asezingeni eliphezulu anama-amino acid adingekayo.

src: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
mt: Zonke izinto kucatshangwa ngazo, akumelwe kusimangaze uma okhokho bethu bexazulula "inkinga yabo yamaprotheni" ngendlela efanayo neyamantongomane ase-savanna namuhla.
ref: Lapho zonke izinto sezicatshangelwe, akumele simangale uma okhokho bethu bazixazululela bona “inkinga yamaphrotheni“ ngendlela ecishe ifane neyezimfene ethafeni namuhla.

src: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
mt: Ukuphazamiseka kokulala kuyinqubo yokuvuka ngenhloso ngesikhathi sokulala kwakho okujwayelekile bese ulala isikhashana kamuva (imizuzu eyi-10-60).
ref: Ukuphazamiseka kokulala inqubo yokuvuka ngenhloso phakathi nesikhathi sakho sokulala esivamile nokuzumeka futhi ngokushesha ngemva kwalokho (imizuzu engu-10–60).

src: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
mt: Lokhu kungenziwa kalula ngokusebenzisa iwashi lokuvusa elizolile ukuze likwenze ukwazi ngaphandle kokukuvusa ngokugcwele.
ref: Lokhu kungenziwa kalula ngokusebenzisa iwashi elikhalayo elikhalela phansi uma kulinganiswa ukuze likusangulukise ngaphandle kokukuphaphamisa ngokugcwele.

src: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
mt: Uma uzithola usetha kabusha iwashi ngesikhathi ulele, lingase libekwe ngakolunye uhlangothi lwegumbi, likuphoqe ukuba uphume embhedeni ukuze ulivale.
ref: Uma uzithola usetha kabusha iwashi ube ulele lapho uphethwe ubuthongo, lingabekwa kolunye uhlangothi lwekamelo, okukuphoqa ukuba uphume embhedeni ukuze ulicime.

src: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
mt: Ezinye izindlela ezisekelwe ku-biorhythm zihlanganisa ukuphuza uketshezi oluningi (ikakhulukazi amanzi noma itiye, i-diuretic eyaziwayo) ngaphambi kokulala, okuphoqelela umuntu ukuba avuke ukuze athole umchamo.
ref: Ezinye izindlela ezisekelwe emjikelezweni ongokwemvelo zihlanganisa ukuphuza uketshezi oluningi (ikakhulukazi amanzi noma itiye, umuthi ochamisayo owaziwayo) ngaphambi kokulala, okuphoqa umuntu ukuba avuke ayochama.

src: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
mt: Inani lokuthula komuntu angaphakathi lihlobene ngokuhlukile nenani lokucindezeleka emzimbeni nasemoyeni wakhe.
ref: Inani lokuthula kwangaphakathi umuntu akutholayo lihlangana ngokuhlukene nenani lokucindezeleka emzimbeni womuntu kanye nasemoyeni.

src: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
mt: Lapho ukucindezeleka kuncipha, amandla okuphila akhona ayashintsha. Umuntu ngamunye unamandla okuthola ukuthula nokwaneliseka okuphelele.
ref: Lapho ukucindezeleka kuphansi, kuyilapho amandla okuphila akhona eba mahle kakhulu. Wonke umuntu angakwazi ukuthola ukuthula okuphelele kanye nokwaneliseka.

src: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
mt: Wonke umuntu angakwazi ukufinyelela ekuqondeni. Into eyodwa emi endleleni yalo mgomo ukucindezeleka kwethu nokungabaza kwethu.
ref: Wonke umuntu angazuza ukukhanyiselwa. Okuwukuphela kwento ema endleleni yokufinyelela lo mgomo isimo sethusenqondo kanye nokuzenyeza.

src: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
mt: UbuBuddha baseTibetan busekelwe ezimfundisweni zikaBuddha, kodwa bandiswa indlela ye-mahayana yothando kanye namasu amaningi avela ku-Yoga yaseNdiya.
ref: I-Tibetan Buddhism isekelwe  ezimfundisweni zikaBhuda, kodwa zandiswa indlela yothando yobu-mahayana nayizinqubo eziningi ezisuka kuyiYoga yaseNdiya.

src: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
mt: Ngokuyinhloko ubuBuddha baseTibetan bulula kakhulu. BuneKundalini Yoga, ukuzindla nendlela yothando olubandakanya konke.
ref: Ngokuyisisekelo ubuBuddha baseTibet bulula kakhulu. Buhlanganisa iKundalini Yoga, ukuzindla kanye nendlela yothando olwamukela konke.

src: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
