mt: Nge-Kundalini Yoga amandla e-Kundalini (amandla okuboniswa) avuswa ngezimo ze-yoga, ukuzivocavoca kokuphefumula, ama-mantra kanye nokubonwa.
ref: Nge-Kundali Yoga amandla e-Kundali (amandla okukhanyisa) avuselelwa ngokuzivocavoca ngohlobo lwe-yoga, ukuzivocavoca kokuphefumula, amazwi aphindwaphindwayo kanye nokubona ngeso lengqondo.

src: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
mt: Isikhungo sokuzindla kwaseTibetan yi-Deity Yoga. Ngokubona onkulunkulu abahlukahlukene iziteshi zamandla zihlanzwa, ama-chakra asetshenziswa futhi kwenziwe ukwazi kokuqondiswa.
ref: Isikhungo sokuzindla kweTibet yi-Deity Yoga. Ngokubona ngeso lengqondo izithixo ezahlukahlukene imizila yamandla iba ehlanzekile, ama-chakra enziwa ukuthi asebenze futhi ukukhanya kokubakhona kuyakhiwa.

src: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
mt: IJalimane yayisitha esivamile eMpini Yomhlaba Yesibili, okwaholela ekusebenzisaneni phakathi kwe-USSR ne-USA.Nokuphela kwempi ukungqubuzana kohlelo, inqubo namasiko kwaholela emazweni ukuba awe.
ref: Ijalimane bekuyisitha esivamile eMpini Yezwe 2, okwaholela ekusebenzisaneni phakathi kwe-USSR kanye neMelika. Ngokuphela kwempi ukungqubuzana kwezimiso, izinqubo kanye namasiko kwaholela ekubeni amazwe axabane.

src: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
mt: Eminyakeni emibili ngemva kokuphela kwempi, abaholi baseMelika base sebeyizitha futhi kwaqala iMpi Yomshoshaphansi.
ref: Ngemva kweminyaka emibili yempi, ababeyimifela ndawonye empini manje sebeyizitha futhi sebeqalise Impi Ebandayo.

src: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
mt: Kwakuzohlala iminyaka engama-40 ezayo futhi kwakuzolwa ngokoqobo, ngamasosha agunyaziwe, ezinkundleni zempi ezisuka e-Afrika kuya e-Asia, e-Afghanistan, e-Cuba nakwezinye izindawo eziningi.
ref: Kwakufanele ihlale iminyaka engu-40 elandelayo futhi kulwe kuyo ngokoqobo, amabutho abambele, ezinkundleni zempi kusukela e-Afrika kuya e-Asia, e-Afghanistan, eCuba kanye nakwezinye izindawo eziningi.

src: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
mt: Ngo-September 17, 1939, ukuvikela kwase kuphuliwe, futhi okuwukuphela kwethemba kwakuwukubuyela emuva nokuhlela kabusha eduze kwebhuloho laseRomania.
ref: NgoMandulo 17, 1939, amabutho avikelayo wasePoland wayehlaselwe kakade, futhi ukuphela kwethemba kwakuwukuhlehla nokuhlela kabusha eceleni kwesihloko saseRomaniya.

src: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
mt: Nokho, lezi zinhlelo zenziwa zaphelelwa yisikhathi cishe ngobusuku obungaphambi kobunye, lapho amasosha angaphezu kuka-800 000 avela ku-Red Army of the Soviet Union angena futhi enza ama-front aseBelarusian nase-Ukraine ngemva kokuhlasela izifunda ezisempumalanga yePoland ngokwephulwa koMvumelwano Wokuthula waseRiga, iSoviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, nezinye izivumelwano zamazwe ngamazwe, zombili ezingasezingeni eliphezulu nezingasezingeni eliphezulu.
ref: Nokho, lezi zinhlelo zaphelelwa yisikhathi cishe ngobusuku obubodwa, lapho amasosha angaphezu kuka-800,000 asuka eSoviet's Union Red Army angena futhi akha amabutho waseBelarussia kanye ne-Ukraine ngemva kokuhlasela izindawo ezingasempumalanga zasePoland ephula Isivumelwano Sokuthula seRiga, i-Soveiet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, kanye nezinye izivumelwane zamazwe onke zokuthula, kokubili zezizwe ezinxa-mbili kanye neziningi.

src: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
mt: Ukusebenzisa imikhumbi ukuthutha izimpahla kuyindlela esebenza ngempumelelo kakhulu yokuthutha abantu nempahla eningi olwandle.
ref: Ukusebenzisa imikhumbi ukuthutha impahla yindlela ephumelela kakhulu yokuthutha abantu abaningi kanye nempahla ngaphesheya kwezilwandle.

src: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
mt: Umsebenzi wamabutho omkhumbi ngokwesiko kube ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwe lakho ligcina ikhono lokuhambisa abantu bakho nezimpahla zakho, ngesikhathi esifanayo, liphazamisa ikhono lesitha sakho lokuhambisa abantu nezimpahla zakhe.
ref: Umsebenzi wamatilosi ngokujwayelekile kwakungukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwe lakho ligcina ikhono lokuhambisa abantu bakho nempahla, kuyilapho ngesikhathi esifanayo, ephazamisa ikhono lesitha sakho lokuhambisa abantu baso nempahla.

src: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
mt: Esinye sezibonelo zakamuva eziphawuleka kakhulu zalokhu kwakuyimpi yeNyakatho ye-Atlantic yeMpi Yezwe II. AmaMelika ayezama ukuthutha abantu nezinto ngaphesheya kwe-Atlantic Ocean ukuze asize iBrithani.
ref: Esinye sezibonelo sakamuva esiphawuleka kakhulu salokhu bekuwumkhankaso waseNyakatho Atlantic weWWII. AmaMelika ayezama ukuyisa abantu nezimpahla ngaphesheya koLwandlekazi i-Atlanti ukusiza iBhrithani.

src: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
mt: Ngesikhathi esifanayo, imikhumbi yamasosha omkhumbi yaseJalimane, eyayisebenzisa ikakhulukazi ama-U-boat, yayizama ukumisa lolu hambo.
ref: Ngesikhathi esifanayo, ibutho lemikhumbi laseJalimane, lisebenzisa ama-U-boat ngokuyinhloko, belizama ukuvimbela lokhu kuhamba.

src: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
mt: Ukube ama-Allies ayehlulekile, cishe iJalimane ngabe yakwazi ukunqoba iBrithani njengoba yayinjalo namanye amazwe aseYurophu.
ref: Ukube ama-Allies ehlulekile, iJalimane cishe ibizokwazi ukunqoba iBhrithani njengoba lenze okufanayo ngeYurophu yonke.

src: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
mt: Kubonakala sengathi izimbuzi zaqala ukuhlaliswa eminyakeni engaba ngu-10,000 edlule ezintabeni zaseZagros e-Iran.
ref: Izimbuzi kubonakala sengathi zenziwa izilwane ezifuywayo okokuqala ngokwesilinganiso eminyakeni engu-10,000 endlule eziNtabeni zase-Zagros e-Iran.

src: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
mt: Amasiko namalungu ezizwe zasendulo aqala ukuzigcina ukuze kube lula ukuthola ubisi, izinwele, inyama, kanye nesikhumba.
ref: Amasiko nezizwana zasemandulo zaqala ukuzigcina njengendlela elula yokuthola ubisi, izinwele, inyama, kanye nesikhumba.

src: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
mt: Izimbuzi zasekhaya ngokuvamile zazigcinwa emihlambini eyayizulazula ezintabeni noma kwezinye izindawo zokudla, ngokuvamile eyayinakekelwa ngabelusi bezimbuzi ababengamafana noma intsha, njengabelusi abaziwa kakhulu.
ref: Izimbuzi ezifuywayo ngokuvamile zazigcinwa nomhlambi owawuhamba emagqumeni noma ezindaweni zamadlelo, ngokuphindaphindiwe zazeluswa abelusi ngokuvamile okwakuba izingane noma abasebasha, okungabelusi abafanayo nabaziwayo. Lezi zindlela sokwalusa sisasentshenziswa nanamuhla.

src: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
mt: Izindlela zezimoto zakhiwa eNgilandi ekuqaleni kwekhulu le-16.
ref: Imizila yezinqola yakhiwa eNgilandi kusukela ngeKhulu lama-16 leminyaka.

src: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
mt: Nakuba imigwaqo yezinqola yayizakhiwa amabhodi ahambisanayo enkuni, yayivumela amahhashi ukuba awahudule ukuze athole ijubane elikhulu futhi adonse imithwalo emikhulu kunemigwaqo eyinkimbinkimbi kancane yosuku.
ref: Nakuba imizila yezinqola beyenziwa izingodo ezugudlene, bezivumela amahhashi azidonsayo ukufinyelela izivinini ezinkulu nokudonsa umthwalo okhudlwana kunasemigwaqweni emibi kancane yangosuku.

src: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
mt: Ama-crossties angeniswa kusenesikhathi ukuze agcine imigwaqo isendaweni yayo. Nokho, kancane kancane kwaqashelwa ukuthi imigwaqo ingaba ngempumelelo kakhulu uma inesici sensimbi phezulu.
ref: Amapulangi kajantshi cishe enzelwa ukuhlanganisa ujantshi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, nokho, kwabonakala ukuthi ujantshi ungasebenza kangcono uma ungaba nommombo wensimbi ngaphezulu.

src: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
mt: Lokhu kwaba umkhuba ovamile, kodwa insimbi yabangela ukuwohloka okwengeziwe emabhayini enkuni.
ref: Lokhu kwaba inqubo evamile, kodwa insimbi yayihlikihla amasondo okhuni wezinqola.

src: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
mt: Ekugcineni, amasondo okhuni athathelwa indawo amasondo ensimbi. Ngo-1767, kwaqaliswa imigwaqo yokuqala enensimbi ephelele.
ref: Ekugcineni, amasondo okhuni athathelwa indawo amasondo ensimbi. Ngo-1767, ujantshi wokuqala wensimbi ophelele waqala ukusetshenziswa.

src: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
mt: Ukuhamba kokuqala okwaziwayo kwakuhamba, abantu baqala ukuhamba beqondile eminyakeni eyizigidi ezimbili edlule ngokuvela kweHomo Erectus (okusho umuntu oqonde kahle).
ref: Indlela yokuqala yokuthatha uhambo eyaziwayo ukuhamba ngezinyawo, abantu baqala ukuhamba beqondile eminyakeni eyizigidi ezimbili edlule ngokuvela kwe-Homo Erectus (okusho umuntu ome waqonda).

src: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
mt: Abanduleli babo, i-Australopithecus yayingahambi iqonde njengenjwayelo.
ref: Ababalandela esikhundleni, ama-Australopithecus bawangahambi ngendlela yokuma aqonde ngokujwayelekile.

src: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
mt: Ukuthi kukhona okhethekile okunezinyawo ezimbili kutholakala emathunjini e-Australopithecus kusukela eminyakeni eyizigidi ezingu-4.2-3.9 edlule, nakuba i-Sahelanthropus kungenzeka ukuthi yayihamba ngezinyawo ezimbili eminyakeni eyizigidi eziyisikhombisa edlule.
ref: Okuchwepheshe ngokuba nyawo-mbili kutholakala emathanjeni aguquke itshe we-Australopithecus kusukela eminyakeni eyizigidi ezingu-4.2-3.9 edlule, nakuba ama-Sahelanthropus kungenzeka ayehamba ngezinyawo ezimbili ngaphambili kakhulu eminyakeni eyizigidi eziyisikhombisa edlule.

src: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
mt: Singaqala ukuphila ngendlela enobungane emvelweni, singajoyina inhlangano yezemvelo, futhi singaba nezishoshovu ukuze sinciphise ukuhlupheka kwesikhathi esizayo ngezinga elithile.
ref: Singaqala ukuphila ngobungane kakhulu nemvelo, singajoyina inhlangano yezemvelo, futhi singaba ngisho izishoshovu ukuze sinciphise ukuhlupheka okuzayo ngezinga elithile.

src: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
mt: Lokhu kufana nokwelashwa okubonisa izimpawu ezimweni eziningi. Nokho, uma singafuni nje isixazululo sesikhashana, kufanele sithole impande yezinkinga, futhi kufanele siziqede.
ref: Kufana nekhambi nje lokwelapha izimpawu zokugula ezimweni eziningi. Nokho, uma singafuni isisombululo sesikhashana, kumele sithole umsuka wenkinga bese sinqanda wona.

src: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
mt: Kucacile ukuthi umhlaba ushintshe kakhulu ngenxa yentuthuko yesintu kwezesayensi nezobuchwepheshe, futhi izinkinga ziye zaba zimbi ngenxa yokwanda kwabantu nendlela yokuphila yabantu.
ref: Kusobala ngokwanele ukuthi umhlaba ushintshe kakhulu ngenxa yokuthuthuka kwabantu kwezesayensi nezobuchwepheshe, futhi izinkinga zibe zinkulu ngenxa yokugcwala kwabantu kanye nempilo yesintu nokuphila kwesintu okuwubukhazikhazi.

src: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
mt: Ngemva kokwamukelwa yiKhomishane ngoJulayi 4, umklamo obhalwe ngesandla osayinwe nguMongameli weKhomishane uJohn Hancock noNobhala uCharles Thomson wabe esethunyelwa ezindlini ezimbalwa kude esitolo sokushicilela sikaJohn Dunlap.
ref: Ngemva kokwamukelwa uKhongolose ngoNtulikazi 4, isiphakamiso esibhalwe ngesandla sasayinwa uMongameli kaKhongolose uJohn Hancock futhi noNobhala uCharles Thompson wathunyelwa esitolo esiseduzane sokuphrinta sikaJohn Dunlap.

src: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
mt: Ngobusuku phakathi kwamakhophi angu-150 no-200 akhiqizwa, manje aziwa ngokuthi "ama-broadsides e-Dunlap".
ref: Phakathi nobusuku kwenziwa amakhophi aphakathi kuka-150 no-200, manje aziwa ngokuthi “iDunlap broadsides”.

src: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
mt: Ukufundwa kokuqala komqulu emphakathini kwaba nguJohn Nixon egcekeni le-Independence Hall ngoJulayi 8.
ref: Ukufundwa kwedokhumenti kokuqala kwenziwa uJohn Nixon enkundleni ye-Independence Hall ngoNtulikazi 8.

src: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
mt: Enye yathunyelwa kuGeorge Washington ngoJulayi 6, futhi wafundelwa amasosha akhe eNew York ngoJulayi 9. Ikhophi yafika eLondon ngo-August 10.
ref: Eyodwa yathunyelwa kuGeorge Washington ngoNtulikazi 6, owenza ukuba ifundwelwe amabutho akhe eNew York ngoNtulikazi 9. Ikhophi yafika eLondon ngoNcwaba 10.

src: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
mt: Amapheshana angu-25 aseDunlap asaziwa ukuthi akhona angamakhophi amadala kakhulu alolu dokhumenti.
ref: Ububanzi be-Dunlap 25 okwaziwa ukuthi kukhona amakhophi wedokhumenti akhona amadala kunawo wonke. Ikhophi yasekuqaleni ebhalwe ngesandla ayisekho.

src: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
mt: Izazi eziningi zezinto zasendulo namuhla zikholelwa ukuthi iqembu elilodwa lama-dinosaur lasinda futhi liyaphila namuhla. Sizibiza ngokuthi izinyoni.
ref: Izazi eziningi zesayensi yemivubukulo namuhla zikholelwa ukuthi iqembu elilodwa lama-dinosaur laqhubeka liphila futhi lisaphila namuhla. Siwabiza ngezinyoni.

src: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
mt: Abantu abaningi abacabangi ngabo njengezinambuzane ngoba zinamaphiko futhi zingandiza.
ref: Abantu abaningi abazithathi njengama-dinosaur ngoba zinezimpaphe futhi ziyakwazi ukundiza.

src: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
mt: Kodwa kunezinto eziningi ezinyoni ezisafana nezidinoza.
ref: Kodwa kunezinto eziningi ngezinyoni ezisafana ne-dinosaur.

src: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
mt: Zinemilenze enamasikali namakhwalithi, zibeka amaqanda, futhi zihamba ngezinyawo zazo zangemuva njenge-T-Rex.
ref: Zinezinyawo ezinocwecwe nezinzipho, zibekela amaqanda, futhi zihamba ngezinyawo zazo ezimbili zasemuva njengeT-Rex.

src: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
mt: Cishe wonke amakhompyutha asetshenziswa namuhla asekelwe ekuphatheni ulwazi oluhlanganiswe ngezinombolo ezimbili.
ref: Cishe wonke amakhompyutha asetshenziswayo namuhla asekelwe ekusebenziseni ukwaziswa okufakwayo endaweni ngezinombolo ezibhangqiwe.

src: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
mt: Inombolo ye-binary ingaba nenani elilodwa kuphela lamagugu amabili, okungukuthi u-0 noma u-1, futhi lezi zinombolo zibizwa ngokuthi izinombolo ze-binary - noma ama-bits, ukuze kusetshenziswe ijiragi yekhompyutha.
ref: Inombolo enziwe ngeziqu ezimbili ingaba nenani elilodwa kuphela kulawa amabili, okungukuthi u-0 noma u-1, futhi kubhekiselwa kulezinombolo ngokuthi amadijithi aneziqu ezimbili - noma ama-bit, ukusebenzisa ijagoni yekhompyutha.

src: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.
mt: Ukuthi kunobuthi bangaphakathi kungase kungabonakali ngokushesha. Izimpawu, njengokuhlanza ngokuvamile ngokwanele ukuthi umuntu akakwazi ukuxilonga ngokushesha.
ref: Ubuthi bangaphakathi kungezeka bungabonakali ngokushesha. Izimpawu, njengokuhlanza zanele ngokuvamile kangangokuthi umhlahlo wokushesha angeke wenziwe.

src: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
mt: Isibonakaliso esihle kakhulu sokuthi kunobuthi bangaphakathi kungaba khona kwesitsha esivulekile semithi noma amakhemikhali anobuthi ekhaya.
ref: Isibonakaliso esihle kakhulu soshevu ovela ngaphakathi kungaba ukuba khona kwezitsha zemithi ezivulekile noma amakhemikhali wasendlini anobuthi.

src: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
mt: Hlola ilebula ukuze uthole imiyalo ethile yosizo lokuqala yalolo thuluzi.
ref: Bheka ilebula ukuze ubone iziqondiso soziso lokuqala zalowo shevu.

src: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
mt: Igama elithi bug lisetshenziswa yi-entomologists ngomqondo osemthethweni kuleli qembu lezinambuzane.
ref: Igama elithi isilwanyakazane lisetshenziswa izazi zezinambuzane ngendlela esemthethweni yaleli qembu lezi zinambuzane.

src: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
mt: Leli gama lisuselwa ekuqasheni kwasendulo nge-Bed-bugs, okuyizinambuzane ezijwayele kakhulu ukuhlasela abantu.
ref: Leli gama lidabuka ekujwayelaneni kwakudala neziMbungulu, okuyizilwanyana ezizifanelisela ngokuphila ngokudla emzimbeni wabantu.

src: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
mt: Kokubili izinambuzane ze-Assassin-bugs nezingu-Bed-bugs zinomzimba, ezijwayele ukuhlala endaweni yokuhlala noma endaweni yokuhlala yomninikhaya wazo.
ref: Zombili iZimbungulu eziphila ngezinye izinambuzane neZimbungulu ezivamile zihlala esidlekeni, zifanelekele ukuhlala esidlekeni noma ezindlini zabasingathi bazo.

src: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
mt: E-United States of America, kunamacala aziwayo e-Multiple Sclerosis (MS) angaba ngu-400 000, okushiya kuyisifo esihamba phambili sezinzwa kubantu abadala abasebancane naphakathi nendawo.
ref: EMelika yonke kunesilinganiso sabantu abawu-400,000 okubikwe ukuthi bane-Multiple Sclerosis(MS), okusishiya njengesifo esihamba phambili semizwa kubantu abadala abasebasha naphakathi.

src: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
mt: I-MS isifo esithinta uhlelo lwezinzwa oluphakathi, olwakhiwa ubuchopho, umongo womgogodla kanye nenzwa yokubona.
ref: I-MS isifo esithinta uhlelo lwezinzwa, olwenziwa ubuchopho, umfunkulu kanye nenzwa yokubona.

src: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
mt: Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi abesifazane banamathuba aphindwe kabili okuba ne-MS kunamadoda.
ref: Ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi abesifazane banamathuba akabili okuba neMS kunabesilisa.

src: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
mt: Umbhangqwana ungase unqume ukuthi akukubi ngokwenzuzo yawo, noma ngokwenzuzo yengane yawo, ukukhulisa ingane.
ref: Abantu ababili abathandanayo bangabona kungenakubasiza, noma kusize ingane yawo, ukukhulisa ingane.

src: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
mt: Laba bantu abashadile bangakhetha ukwenza uhlelo lokutholwa kwengane yabo.
ref: Le mibhangqwana ingakhetha ukwenza uhlelo lokuthi ingane yabo itholwe abanye.

src: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
mt: Lapho kumiselwa ingane, abazali abazalwa bayayeka amalungelo abo okuba ngabazali ukuze omunye umbhangqwana ube ngumzali wengane.
ref: Endabeni yokutholwa, abazali abazizalayo banqamula amalungelo abo okuba abazali ukuze omunye umbhangqwana ube umzali wengane.

src: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
mt: Inhloso enkulu yesayensi ukuthola indlela umhlaba osebenza ngayo ngokusebenzisa indlela yesayensi. Le ndlela empeleni iqondisa ucwaningo oluningi lwesayensi.
ref: Umngomo oyinhloko wesayensi ukuthola indlela izwe elisebenza ngayo uma lisebenzisa indlela yesayensi. Le ndlela eqinisweni iqondisa oluningi ucwaningo lwesayensi.

src: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
mt: Kodwa-ke, akuyona into eyodwa, ukuhlola, futhi ukuhlola kuwukuhlolwa okusetshenziselwa ukuqeda enye noma ngaphezulu zemibono engenzeka, ukubuza imibuzo, nokwenza imibono nakho kuqondisa ucwaningo lwesayensi.
ref: Akukodwa nokho, ukulinga, futhi isilingo isivivinyo esisetshenziselwa ukususa ukucabangela okuhle okukodwa noma okwengeziwe, ukubuza imibuzo, nokwenza ukuphawula kanye nokuqondisa ucwaningo olungokwesayensi.

src: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
mt: Izazi zemvelo kanye namafilosofi agxila emibhalweni yakudala futhi ikakhulukazi eBhayibhelini lesiLatini.
ref: Izazi zemvelo kanye nezefilosofi zigxile emibhalweni yamandulo futhi, ngokukhethekile, eBhayibhelini ngesiLatin.

src: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
mt: Imibono ka-Aristotle mayelana nazo zonke izindaba zesayensi, kuhlanganise nesayensi yengqondo, yamukelwa.
ref: Imibono ka-Aristotle yesayensi yamukelwa yonke, kuhlanganise nesayikholoji.

src: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
mt: Njengoba ulwazi lwesiGreki lwalusiya luncishiswa, iNtshonalanga yazithola inqunywe ezimpandeni zayo zefilosofi nesayensi yamaGreki.
ref: Njengoba ulwazi lwaseGrisi lwaluncipha, iNtshonalanga yazithola isuka ezimpandeni zayo zefilosofi nesayensi zobuGriki.

src: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
mt: Izindlela eziningi ezibhekelelwe kwe-physiology nokuziphatha ngokuvamile zincike kakhulu ebukhoneni bemijikelezo ye-endogenous kanye nokukhiqizwa kwayo ngamawashi ezinto eziphilayo.
ref: Iningi lokuphindaphinda kuyifiziyoloji nasekuziphatheni okubonwayo ngokuvamile kuxhomeke ngokuyinhloko ekubeni khona kwemijikelezo evela phakathi kanye nokwenziwa kwako ngamawashi emvelo.

src: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
mt: Izigqizo ezivamile, ezingeyona nje impendulo ezikhombeni zangaphandle ezivamile, ziye zabhalwa kubantu abaningi abaphilayo, kuhlanganise namagciwane, isikhunta, izitshalo nezilwane.
ref: Izigqi zezikhathi ezithile, okungekhona ukusabela nje kwezinkomba ezingaphandle, kubikiwe ezidalweni eziningi eziphilayo, kuhlanganise amabhakithiliya, isikhunta, izitshalo, kanye nezilwane.

src: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
mt: Amawashi ebhayoloji angama-oscillator azigcina azigcina azoqhubeka nenkathi yokuhamba ngebhayisikili ngokukhululeka ngisho nangaphandle kokungabikho kwezinkomba zangaphandle.
ref: Amawashi endalo azivuselela amandla azoqhubeka esebenza emjikelwezweni okhululekile ngisho noma enkathini ongeke ukwazi ukuyicabanga.

src: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
mt: Ukuhlolwa kukaHershey noChase kwakungesinye seziphakamiso ezihamba phambili zokuthi i-DNA kwakuyizinto zofuzo.
ref: Ukuhlolwa kuka-Hershey no-Chase bekungokunye kokusikisela okuhamba phampili kokuthi iDNA isakhi sofuzo.

src: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
mt: UHershey noChase basebenzisa ama-phage, noma amagciwane, ukuze bafake i-DNA yabo siqu ebhaktheriya.
ref: UHershey noChase basebenzisa ama-phages, noma amagciwane, ukuze bafake i-DNA yabo ku-bacterium.

src: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
mt: Benza ucwaningo olunguzibili olwaluphawula i-DNA ku-phage nge-phosphorus enomsakazo noma i-protein ye-phage ngensuthu enomsakazo.
ref: Benze ukuhlola ezimbili ngokwenza i-DNA nge-phage besebenzisa iphosphorus ye-radioactive noma amaprotheni e-phage nge-sulfur ye-radioactive.

src: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
mt: Ukuguquka komzimba kungaba nemiphumela ehlukahlukene ehlukahlukene kuye ngohlobo lokuguquka komzimba, ukubaluleka kwengxenye yomkhiqizo wezakhi zofuzo othintekile nokuthi amangqamuzana athintekile angamaselula omugqa wamagciwane yini.
ref: Ukuguquka kungaba namathonya ahlukile angafani kuye ngohlobo lokuguquka, ukubaluleka kocezu lwesakhi sofuzo oluthintekile kanye nokuthi amangqamuzana athintekile amangqamuzana esidoda neqanda yini.

src: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
mt: Ukuguquka kwamaselula omgudu kuphela okungadluliselwa ezinganeni, kuyilapho ukuguquka kwezinye izindawo kungabangela ukufa kwamangqamuzana noma umdlavuza.
ref: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo emagqamuzaneni wamagciwane kuphela okungadluliselwa ezinganeni, nakuba ukuguquka kwenye indawo kungabangela ukufa kwamangqamuzana noma umdlavuza.

src: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
mt: Ezokuvakasha ezisekelwe emvelweni ziheha abantu abanentshisekelo yokuvakashela izindawo zemvelo ngenhloso yokujabulela indawo, kuhlanganise nezilwane zasendle nezitshalo.
ref: Izindawo zokuvakasha ezingokwemvelo zikhanga abantu abathanda ukuvakashela izindawo ezingokwemvelo ngenhloso yokujabulela ukubuka indawo, kuhlanganise izitshalo nezilwane zasendle.

src: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
mt: Izibonelo zemisebenzi yendawo zihlanganisa ukuzingela, ukudoba, ukuthatha izithombe, ukubuka izinyoni, nokuvakashela amapaki kanye nokutadisha ulwazi mayelana nemvelo.
ref: Izibonelo zemisebenzi eyenziwa endaweni zihlanganisa ukuzingela, ukudoba, ukuthatha izithombe, ukubuka izinyoni, kanye nokuvakashela amapaki nokufunda ukwaziswa okumayelana nezinto eziphilayo.

src: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
mt: Isibonelo ukuvakashela, ukuthatha izithombe, nokufunda ngama-organgatuangs eBorneo.
ref: Isibonelo ukuvakasha, ukuthatha izithombe, kanye nokufunda ngama-orangatan eBorneo.

src: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
mt: Nsuku zonke ekuseni, abantu bashiya amadolobha amancane asemakhaya ngemoto baye emsebenzini futhi badlula abanye abantu abafika lapho beya khona emsebenzini endaweni abasanda kuyishiya.
ref: Njalo ekuseni, abantu bashiya amadolobha amancane wasemaphandleni ngezimoto ukuze baye ezindaweni zabo zokusebenzela futhi badlulwa abanye indawo yabo yokusebenzela elapho basanda kusuka khona.

src: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
mt: Kulokhu kuhamba kwezokuthutha okunamandla wonke umuntu ngandlela thile uxhumene, futhi usekela, uhlelo lokuthutha olusekelwe ezimotweni zangasese.
ref: Kuloluhlobo lwesithuthi olunamandla wonke umuntu ngandlelathile uxhumene, futhi usekela uhlelo lokuthutha olusekelwe ezimotweni ezincane.

src: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
mt: Isayensi manje ibonisa ukuthi le nkampani enkulu ekhokhelwayo ikhabhoni iye yasusa indawo yokuhlala kwezinto eziphilayo kwesinye sezwe layo elizinzile elisekele ukuguquka kwabantu eminyakeni eyizigidi ezimbili edlule.
ref: Isayensi manje ikhomba ukuthi lokhu kubakhona kwe-carbon kucekele phansi imvelo kusuka kwesinye sezimo sayo esizinzile kakhulu esisekele ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwabantu eminyakeni eyizigidi ezimbili edlule.

src: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
mt: Wonke umuntu ubamba iqhaza emphakathini futhi usebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhamba. Cishe wonke umuntu ukhononda ngezinhlelo zokuhamba.
ref: Wonke umuntu uyahlanganyela emphakathini futhi usebenzisa uhlelo lokuthutha. Cishe wonke umuntu uyakhalaza ngohlelo lokuthutha.

src: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
mt: Emazweni athuthukile akuvamile ukuzwa izinga elifanayo lokukhala mayelana nekhwalithi yamanzi noma amabhuloho awela phansi.
ref: Emazweni athuthukile uyethukela uzwa amazinga afanayo okukhalaza ngekhwalithi yamanzi noma amabhuloho awayo.

src: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
mt: Kungani izinhlelo zokuthutha zivelisa izikhalazo ezinjalo, kungani zwehluleka nsuku zonke? Ingabe onjiniyela bezokuthutha nje abangakwazi ukwenza okuthile? Noma ingabe kukhona okunye okubalulekile okwenzekayo?
ref: Kungani izinhlelo zokuthutha zibanga ukukhalaza okunjalo, kungani zihluleka zinsuku zonke? Ingabe onjiniyela bezinto zokuthutha abafaneleki? Noma kunokuthile okubaluleke kakhudlwana okwenzekayo yini?

src: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
mt: Ukuhamba komgwaqo kuwucwaningo lokuhamba kwabaqhubi ngabanye nezimoto phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili kanye nokusebenzisana kwabo komunye nomunye.
ref: Ukugeleza Kwethrafikhi kuwucwaningo lokuhamba komshayeli ngamunye nezimoto phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili kanye nokusebenzisana abakwenzayo komunye nomunye.

src: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
mt: Ngeshwa, ukufunda ukuhamba komgwaqo kunzima ngoba ukuziphatha komshayeli akukwazi ukubikezelwa ngokuqiniseka ngamaphesenti ayikhulu.
ref: Ngeshwa, ukufunda ukuhamba kwethrafikhi kunzima ngoba ukuziphatha komshayeli akukwazi ukubikezelwa ngokuqiniseka kwaphesenti ayikhulu.

src: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
mt: Ngenhlanhla, abashayeli bavame ukuziphatha ngaphakathi kohlaka oluhambisanayo; ngakho-ke, imigwaqo yomgwaqo ivame ukuba nokuvumelana okuthile futhi ingaboniswa cishe ngokwezibalo.
ref: Ngenhlanhla, abashayeli bathambekele ekuziphatheni ngendlela ecishe ifane; ngakho ukuminyana kwezimoto kuthambekele ekufaneni futhi cishe kungafanekiswa ngokuqiniseka kwephesenti.

src: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
mt: Ukuze kumelwe kangcono ukuhamba komgwaqo, kuye kwasungulwa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezici ezintathu eziyinhloko: (1) ukugeleza, (2) ukujiya, kanye (3) nesivinini.
ref: Ukufanisa kangcono ukuhamba kwezimoto, ubudlelwane bumisiwe phakathi kwezici ezintathu eziyinhloko: (1) ukuhamba, (2) ukuminyana, kanye (3) nesivinini.

src: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
mt: Lezi zinhlobo zisiza ekuhleleni, ekwakheni nasekusebenzeni kwezakhiwo zomgwaqo.
ref: Lobu budlelwane buyasiza ekuhleleni, ekuklameni, kanye nasekusebenziseni izakhiwo zasemgwaqweni.

src: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
mt: Izinambuzane zazingazilwane zokuqala ukudilika emoyeni. Ikhono lazo lokundiza lazisiza ukuba zikhungathelise izitha kalula futhi zithole ukudla nezithandani ngendlela esebenzayo.
ref: Izinambuzane kwakuyizilwane zokuqala zokundiza. Ikhono lazo lokundiza lazisiza zigweme izitha kalula ngokwengeziwe futhi zithole ukudla kanye nomana ngokuphumelelayo kakhudlwane.

src: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
mt: Izinambuzane eziningi zinenzuzo yokukwazi ukugoba amaphiko azo emuva emzimbeni.
ref: Izinambuzane eziningi zisizakala ngokukwazi ukugoqa amaphiko wazo emva komzimba wazo.

src: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
mt: Lokhu kubanikeza izindawo ezincane eziningi zokuzifihla ezilwaneni ezilwaneni.
ref: Lokhu kubanika indawo enkudlwana yezindawo ezincane zokucashela izilwane ezizingelayo.

src: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
mt: Namuhla, izinambuzane kuphela ezingakwazi ukugoba amaphiko azo yizimpukane zedrako nezimpukane ze-mayfly.
ref: Namuhla, ukuphela kwezinambuzane ezingakwazi ukugoqa amaphiko wazo izinzekamanzi nosathamanzi.

src: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
mt: Eminyakeni eyizinkulungwane edlule, indoda okuthiwa u-Aristarchus yathi uhlelo Lwelanga lwalujikeleza ilanga.
ref: Eminyakeni eyizinkulungwane eyedlule, indoda ebizwa ngo-Aristarchus yathi Isimiso sikaNozungezilanga sasizungeza iLanga.

src: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
mt: Abanye abantu babecabanga ukuthi wayeqinisile kodwa abantu abaningi babecabanga okuphambene; ukuthi iSolar System yayihamba emhlabeni, kuhlanganise neLanga (kanye nezinye izinkanyezi).
ref: Abanye abantu babecabanga ukuthi unembile kodwa abantu abaningi babekholelwa okuhlukile; ukuthi Isimo Samapulanethi Sokuzungeza Ilanga sasizungeza uMhlaba, kuhlanganise neLanga (kanye nezinye izinkanyezi).

src: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
mt: Lokhu kubonakala kunengqondo, ngoba uMhlaba awuzwi sengathi uyahamba, akunjalo?
ref: Lokhu kubonakala kunengqondo, ngenxa yokuthi uMhlaba awuzwakali sengathi uyanyakaza, akunjalo?

src: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
mt: UMfula i-Amazon ungumfula wesibili omude kunawo wonke futhi omkhulu kunawo wonke emhlabeni. Uthwala amanzi angaphezu kwezi-8 kunomfula wesibili ngobukhulu.
ref: UMfula i-Amazon ngumfula wesibili omude nomkhulu kunayo yonke eMhlabeni. Unamanzi aphindwe izikhathi ezingaphezu kuka-8 kunomfula wesibili omkhulu kunayo yonke.

src: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
mt: I-Amazon futhi ingumfula obanzi kunawo wonke emhlabeni, ngezinye izikhathi ububanzi bayo bungamakhilomitha ayisithupha.
ref: I-Amazon ibuye ibe umfula obanzi kunayo yonke eMhlabeni, kwezinye izikhathi amamayela ayisithupha ububanzi.

src: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
mt: Amaphesenti angu-20 amanzi aphuma emifuleni yomhlaba aya olwandle avela e-Amazon.
ref: Amaphesenti angu-20 agcwele amanzi ageleza esuka emifuleni yepulanethi aye ezilwandle asuka e-Amazon.

src: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
mt: Umfula omkhulu i-Amazon ungaba amakhilomitha angu-6,387 (3,980 miles). Uqoqa amanzi ezinkulungwaneni zemifula emincane.
ref: Umfula i-Amazon oyinhloko ungama-6,387 km (amamayela angu-3,980). Uqoqa amanzi kusuka emifudlaneni eyizinkulungwane.

src: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
mt: Nakuba ukwakhiwa kwamapiramidi ngetshe kwaqhubeka kwaze kwaba sekupheleni koMbuso Omdala, amapiramidi aseGiza awazange adlule ngobukhulu bawo nangobuchwepheshe bokwakhiwa kwawo.
ref: Nakuba ukwakha amaphiramidi ngamatshe kwaqhubeka kwaze kwaba sekupheleni koMbuso Omdala, amaphiramidi aseGaza awakaze adlulwe ngobukhulu kanye nangobuhle bobuchwepheshe ekwakhiweni kwawo.

src: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
mt: AmaGibhithe asendulo eMbusweni Omusha ayemangele ngezikhumbuzo ezazingaphambi kwawo, ezazineminyaka engaphezu kwenkulungwane ubudala ngaleso sikhathi.
ref: Umbuso Omusha eGibhithe lamandulo labamba ongezansi ngezikhumbuzo zabanduleli babo, ezazineminyaka engaphezu kwenkulungwane ubudala ngaleso sikhathi.

src: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
mt: Isizwe saseVatican City sinabantu abangaba ngu-800. Yizwe elincane kunawo wonke elizimele emhlabeni futhi izwe elinabantu abancane kunawo wonke.
ref: Abantu beDolobha lase-Vatican bacishe babe ngu-800. Izwe elizimele elincane kunalo wonke emhlabeni nezwe elinabantu abancane kunabo bonke.

src: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
mt: IVatican City isebenzisa isi-Italian emithethweni yayo yezomthetho nasezitatimendeni ezisemthethweni.
ref: Idolabha lase-Vatican lisebenzisa imithetho yaseNtaliyane kanye nezilimi ezisemthethweni.

src: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
mt: Isi-Italian futhi ulimi olujwayelekile olusetshenziswa yiningi lalabo abasebenza kuhulumeni kuyilapho isiLatini ngokuvamile sisetshenziswa emikhosini yenkolo.
ref: IsiNtaliyane sibuye sibe ulimi lwansuku zonke olusetshenziswa iningi lalabo abasebenza esifundeni kuyilapho isiLatin sivame ukusebenziswa emikhosini engokwenkolo.

src: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
mt: Zonke izakhamuzi zaseVatican City zingamaRoma Katolika.
ref: Zonke izakhamuzi zeDolobha laseVatican zingamaRoma Katolika.

src: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
mt: Abantu baye bazi ngezinto eziyisisekelo zamakhemikhali njengegolide, isiliva, nethusi kusukela endulo, njengoba zonke lezi zinto zingatholakala emvelweni ngendlela yazo futhi kulula ukuzimbiwa ngamathuluzi ayisisekelo.
ref: Abantu babazi ngezakhi zamakhemikhali eziyisisekelo njengegolide, isiliva, kanye nethusi kusukela endulo, njengoba lezi zingatholakala endalweni ngohlobo lwendabuko futhi kulula kakhulu uguzigubha ngamathuluzi wasendulo.

src: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
mt: U-Aristotle, isazi sefilosofi, washo ukuthi yonke into yakhiwe ingxube yezinto ezine noma ngaphezulu.
ref: U-Aristotle, isazi sefilosofi, wayenombono wokuthi zonke izinto zenziwe ingxube yento eyodwa noma ezengeziwe kwezine ezingumsuka wezinto zonke. Bezingumhlaba, amanzi, umoya, kanye nomlilo.

src: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
mt: Lokhu kwakufana kakhulu nezimo ezine zendaba (ngohlelo olufanayo): eziqinile, ezimiqemane, igesi, ne-plasma, nakuba naye ayethi ziguqukela ezintweni ezintsha ukuze zakheke lokho esikubonayo.
ref: Lokhu bekucishe kufane nezigaba ezine zezinto ezikhona (ngesigaba esifanayo): eziqinile, uketshezi, igesi, kanye ne-plasma, nakuba abuye aba nombono wokuthi zingashintsha zibe izinto ezintsha ezakha lokho esikubonayo.

src: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
mt: Ama-alloys ngokuyisisekelo ayingxube yensimbi emibili noma ngaphezulu. Ungakhohlwa ukuthi kunezakhi eziningi etafuleni lezikhathi.
ref: Ingxubaniso ngokuyisisekelo ingxube yezinsimbi ezimbili noma ngaphezulu. Ungakhohlwa ukuthi kunezakhi eziningi eshadini lezakhi zamakhemikhali.

src: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
mt: Izinto ezifana ne-calcium ne-potassium zibhekwa njengezinsimbi.
ref: Izakhi ezinjengekhalsiyamu nephothaziyamu zithathwa njengensimbi. Yebo, kunezinye izinsimbi njengesiliva negolide.

src: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.
mt: Ungase futhi ube nama-alloys ahlanganisa amanani amancane ezinto ezingezona ezensimbi njengekhabhoni.
ref: Ungaba futhi nezidungo ezixutshanisiwe ezihlanganisa amanani amancane ezinto ezingezona ezensimbi njenge-carbon.

src: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
mt: Konke okuyi-Universe kwenziwa ngezinto. Zonke izinto zenziwe izinhlayiya ezincane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-athomu.
ref: Yonke into Embulungeni yenziwe izakhi. Zonke izakhi zenziwe izinhlayiyana ezincane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-athomu.

src: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
mt: Ama-athomu amancane ngendlela emangalisayo kangangokuthi izigidigidi zawo zingalingana nesikhathi esiphetheni sale nkulumo.
ref: Ama-athomu mancane ngokumangalisayo kangangokuba ayizigidi eziyizigidi angalingana kungqi osekugcineni kwalomusho.

src: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
mt: Ngakho, ipensela laba umngane omuhle wabantu abaningi lapho liphuma.
ref: Kanjalo, umsizi waba umngane omuhle wabantu abaningi uma uphuma.

src: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
mt: Ngokudabukisayo, njengoba izindlela ezintsha zokubhala sezikhule, ipiyinti liye ladluliselwa esimweni esincane nokusetshenziswa.
ref: Ngokudabukisayo, njengoba izindlela zokubhala ezintsha zivelile, umsizi inikwe isimo nomsebenzi ophansana.

src: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
mt: Abantu manje babhala imilayezo ezikrinini zekhompyutha, bengalokothi basondelane nesikhali esicijile.
ref: Abantu manje babhala imilayezo ezikrinini zamakhompyutha, bangasadingi ukusondela emshinini wokucija amapensela.

src: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
mt: Umuntu angazibuza ukuthi ikhibhodi izoba yini lapho kuvela okuthile okusha.
ref: Umuntu angazibuza ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngekhibhodi lapho kufika okuthile okusha.

src: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
mt: Ibhomu lokuhlukana lisebenza ngomgomo wokuthi kuthatha amandla ukuhlanganisa inqwaba yamaphrothoni namantongomane amaningi.
ref: Ibhomu le-fission lisebenza ngohlelo lokuthi lithathe amandla liwahlanganise njenge-nucleus kanye namaprothoni amaningi namanyutroni.

src: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
mt: Kufana nokugqusha inqola esindayo egqumeni. Ukuhlukanisa inqwaba futhi kukhipha amandla athile.
ref: Kufana nokugingqela ikalishi elisindayo phezulu egqumeni. Ukuhlukanisa i-nucleus futhi bese kukhululwa amanye walawo mandla.

src: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
mt: Amanye ama-athomu anezinhlayiya ezingazinzile okusho ukuthi athambekele ekuqhekekeni ngokushaya kancane noma akukho.
ref: Amanye ama-athomu anobuphakathi obuxegayo okusho ukuthi avame ukuphuka lapho eqhikinyezwa kancane noma lapho engaqhikinyezwanga.

src: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
mt: Ubuso benyanga buqoshwe ngamatshe nothuli. Uhlaka lwangaphandle lwenyanga lubizwa ngokuthi i-crust.
ref: Ingaphakathi leNyanga kwenziwe ngamatshe kanye nothuli. Ingxenye engaphandle yeNyanga ibizwa ngokuthi uqweqwe.

src: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
mt: Umquba cishe unobukhulu obungamakhilomitha angama-70 ohlangothini oluseduze futhi unobukhulu obungamakhilomitha ayi-100 ohlangothini olungaphezulu.
ref: Ungqimba cishe lungugqinsi olungama-70 km ohlangothini oluseduze kanye nogqinsi olungama-100 km ohlangothini olukude.

src: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
mt: Incane ngaphansi kwama-mariyo futhi inzima ngaphansi kwezindawo ezisezingeni eliphezulu.
ref: Izacile ngaphansi kolwandle futhi lungugqinsi ngaphansi kwezinkangala.

src: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
mt: Kungase kube nama-mari amaningi ohlangothini oluseduze ngoba i-crust impofu. Kwakulula ukuthi i-lava iphakame phezulu.
ref: Kungenzeka kube nezindawo zasenyangeni eziningi ezimnyama ohlangothini ngoba ungqimba luzacile. Bekulula ngodaka olushisayo ukukhuphukela phezulu.

src: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
mt: Imibono yokuqukethwe igxile ekutholeni ukuthi yini eyenza abantu bathande noma bakhange kubo.
ref: Imicabango yezizathu zokushintsha kwabantu igxile ezintweni ezishukumisa abantu noma ezithinta izinhliziyo zabo.

src: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
mt: Lezi zimfundiso zikhombisa ukuthi abantu banezidingo ezithile kanye/noma izifiso eziye zahlanganiswa njengoba besakhula baba ngabantu abadala.
ref: Le mibono isikisela ukuthi abantu banezidingo ezithile kanye/noma izifiso eziye zavalelwa ngaphakathi njengoba zikhulela ekubeni zindala.

src: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
mt: Lezi zinkolelo-mbono zibuka ukuthi yini ngabantu abathile eyenza bafune izinto abazenzayo nokuthi yini izinto ezikuzungezile ezizobenza benze noma bangenzi izinto ezithile.
ref: Le mibono ihlola ukuthi yini eyenza abanye abantu bafune izinto abazifunayo nokuthi yiziphi izinto endaweni yabo ezizobenza benze noma bangenzi ezinye izinto.

src: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
mt: Imibono emibili ethandwayo yokuqukethwe yi-Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory kanye ne-Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
ref: Imicabango eshukumisayo emibili ethandwayo yiHierarchy of Needs Theory kaMaslow kanye neTwo Factor Theory kaHertzberg.

src: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
mt: Ngokuvamile, ukuziphatha okubili kungavela njengoba abaphathi beqala ukuhola ontanga yabo yakudala.Omunye ohlangothini lwe-spectrum uzama ukuhlala "omunye wabafana" (noma amantombazane).
ref: Ngokukhuluma nje, ukuziphatha okubili kungahlangana njengoba abaphathi beqala ukuhola amawembu ababesebenzisana nabo.. Omunye uzama ukuba “ingxenye yabafana” (noma amantombazane).

src: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
mt: Lolu hlobo lomphathi lukuthola kunzima ukwenza izinqumo ezingathandeki, ukwenza isinyathelo sokuyala, ukuhlola ukusebenza, ukunikeza umthwalo wemfanelo, nokwenza abantu baba necala.
ref: Lolu hlobo lwemenenja luba nobunzima uma kufunanele lwenze izinqumo ezingathandeki, ukuqondisa izigwegwe zabasebenzi, ukuhlolwa kokusebenza, ukwabiwa komsebenzi, nokwenza abantu baziphendulele ngokwemisebenzi yabo.

src: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
mt: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umuntu uba umuntu ongakwazi ukubonwa ocabanga ukuthi kumelwe ashintshe konke iqembu ebelikwenza futhi akwenze okwalo.
ref: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umuntu uyaguquka abe ngumuntu ongasabonakali ukuthi ungubani ozizwa sengathi kumelwe ashintshe konke obekwenziwa iqembu futhi akwenze okwakhe.

src: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
mt: Phela, ekugcineni umholi unesibopho sempumelelo nokwehluleka kweqembu.
ref: Ngemva kwakho konke, abaholi ibona abonomthwalo wangempela wemfanelo wokuphumelela nokuhluleka kweqembu.

src: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
mt: Le ndlela yokuziphatha ngokuvamile iholela ekutheni kube nokungezwani phakathi kwabaholi nabanye abasebuthweni.
ref: Le ndlela yokuziphatha ezikhathini eziningi libangela ukwahlukana phakathi kwabaholi nethimba lonke.

src: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
mt: Amaqembu e-virtual agcinwa emazingeni afanayo okugqwesa njengamaqembu avamile, kodwa kukhona ukuhluka okuncane.
ref: Amaqembu abukeka njengangokoqobo aphathwa ngezimiso ezifanayo zobuhle njengamaqembu angokwesiko, kepha kunomehluko ocashile.

src: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
mt: Amalungu eqembu elibonakalayo ngokuvamile asebenza njengendawo yokuxhumana leqembu lawo langokomzimba.
ref: Amalungu weqembu wekhompyutha avame ukusebenza njengendawo yokuxhumana yamalungu aseduze kakhulu eqembu elingokoqobo.

src: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
mt: Ngokuvamile banokuzimela okukhulu kunamalungu eqembu avamile njengoba amaqembu abo engahlangana ngokwama-zones wesikhathi ahlukahlukene okungase kungaqondwa abaphathi babo bendawo.
ref: Ngokuvamile banenkululeko yokuzimela kakhulu kunamalungu eqembu avamile njengoba amaqembu abo angahlangana ngokuya ngezikhathi zendawo ezihlukene okungenzeka kungaqondwa abaphathi basendaweni.

src: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
mt: Ukuba khona kweqembu langempela "elibonakalayo" (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) nakho kuyingxenye eyingqayizivele yeqembu elibonakalayo.
ref: Ukuba khona “kweqembu elingabonakali” langempela (uLarson noLaFasto, 1989, k109) kubuye kube yisici esikhethekile seqembu ekungelona elingokoqobo.

src: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
mt: "Ithimba elingabonakali" yiqembu labaphathi elibhekiswe yilowo nalowo malungu. Ithimba elingabonakali libekela ilungu ngalinye izindinganiso.
ref: Iqembu elingabonakali iqembu labaphathi lelo ilungu ngalinye elilandisa kubo. Iqembu elingabonakali libekela ilungu ngalinye izindinganiso.

src: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
mt: Kungani inhlangano ifuna ukuhamba ngenqubo edla isikhathi yokusungula inhlangano yokufunda? Inhloso eyodwa yokwenza imibono yokufunda yenhlangano isebenze ukuqamba izinto ezintsha.
ref: Kungani inhlangano ingafuna ukusebenza ngenqubo edla isikhathi yokumisa inhlangano efundisa amalungu ayo? Umgomo owodwa wokusebenzisa imibono yenhlangano efundisa amalungu ayo amacebo.

src: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
mt: Lapho yonke imithombo etholakalayo isetshenziswa ngempumelelo kuyo yonke iminyango yokusebenza yenhlangano, ubuciko nobuciko bungashintsha.
ref: Uma zonke izinsiza-kusebenza zisetshenziswa ngempumelelo eminyanweni esebenzayo yenhlangano, ukusungula nobuhlakani kungenzeka.

src: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
mt: Ngenxa yalokho, inqubo yenhlangano esebenza ndawonye ukunqoba isithiyo ingaholela enqubweni entsha entsha yokuthuthukisa ukuze isebenze isidingo sekhasimende.
ref: Ngenxa yalokho, inqubo yokuba inhlangano isebenze ndawonye ukuze inqobe isithiyo ingaholela enqubweni etsha yamacebo okunaka izidingo zekhasimende.

src: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
mt: Ngaphambi kokuba inhlangano ibe nobuciko, ubuholi kumelwe bubumbe isiko lokuqamba izinto ezintsha kanye nolwazi oluhlanganisiwe nokufunda kwenhlangano.
ref: Ngaphambi kokuba inhlangano ibe namacebo, abaholi kumelwe benze isiko lokusungula amacebo kanye nolwazi oluhlanganyelwayo nokufundisa amalungu enhlangano.

src: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.
mt: I-Angel (2006), ichaza indlela ye-Continum njengendlela esetshenziswayo ukusiza izinhlangano ukuthi zifinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu lokusebenza.
ref: U-Angel (2006), uchaza indlela yeContinuum njengendlela esetshenziselwa ukusiza izinhlangano zifinyelele ezingeni eliphakeme lokusebenza.

src: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.
mt: Idatha ye-neurobiological inikeza ubufakazi obubonakalayo bokusebenzisa indlela engokwengqondo ekuphenyeni ukuqonda. Ngakho-ke kunciphisa indawo yocwaningo futhi yenze kube nokunemba kakhulu.
ref: Idatha ye-Neurobiological inikeza ubufakazi obubonakalayo bendlela yethiyori ekuphenyweni kokuqaphela. Ngakho-ke, inciphisa umkhakha wocwaningo futhi iwenze unembe kakhudlwana.

src: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supports scientists in their research.
mt: Ukuhlobana phakathi kwe-pathology yobuchopho nokuziphatha kusekela ososayensi ocwaningweni lwabo.
ref: Ukuhlanganiswa ngokuqhathaniswa phakathi kwesayensi yezifo zobuchopho kanye nokuziphatha kusekela ososayensi ocwaningweni lwabo.

src: It has been known for a long time that different types of brain damage, traumas, lesions, and tumours affect behaviour and cause changes in some mental functions.
mt: Sekuyisikhathi eside kwaziwa ukuthi izinhlobo ezihlukahlukene zokulimala kobuchopho, ukulimala, ukulimala, kanye nezifo zomzimba kuthinta ukuziphatha futhi kubangele izinguquko kwezinye imisebenzi yengqondo.
ref: Kudala kwaziwa ukuthi izinhlobo ezihlukile zokulimala kobuchopho, ukuhlukumezeka, izilonda, kanye nokhwekhwe kuthinta ukuziphatha futhi kubangela ushintsho kokunye kokusebenza kwengqondo.

src: The rise of new technologies allows us to see and investigate brain structures and processes never seen before.
mt: Ukuvela kobuchwepheshe obusha kusivumela ukuba sibone futhi sihlole izakhiwo zobuchopho nezinqubo ezingakaze zibonwe ngaphambili.
ref: Ukuba khona kwezobuchwepheshe ezintsha kusivumela ukuba sibone futhi sihlole ukwakheka kwengqondo kanye nezinqubo ezingakaze zibonwe ngaphambili.

src: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.
mt: Lokhu kusinika ulwazi oluningi nezinto zokwakha amamodeli okuqhathanisa okusisiza ukuba siqonde izinqubo ezingqondweni zethu.
ref: Lokhu kusinika ukwaziswa okuningi nezinto zokwakha imishini yokulingisa esisiza siqonde indlela zokusebenza kwengqondo.

src: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.
mt: Nakuba i-AI inencazelo enamandla yenoveli yesayensi, i-AI yakha igatsha elibaluleke kakhulu lesayensi yamakhompyutha, ebhekana nokuziphatha, ukufunda nokuzivumelanisa nokuhlakanipha emshinini.
ref: Nakuba i-AI inomqondo oqinilile wezindaba eziqanjiwe zesayensi, i-AI yenza ingxenye ebalulekile kakhulu yesayensi yamakhompyutha, ebukana nokuziphatha, ukufunda kanye nokusebenza komshini kokuhlakanipha.

src: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.
mt: Ucwaningo ku-AI lubandakanya ukwenza imishini ukuze yenze imisebenzi edinga ukuziphatha okuhlakaniphile.
ref: Ucwaningo lwezamarobothi luhlanganisa ukwenza imishini yenze ngokuzenzakalekayo imisebenzi edinga ukucabanga komuntu.

src: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.
mt: Izibonelo zihlanganisa ukulawula, ukuhlela nokuhlela, ikhono lokuphendula ukuxilongwa kwamakhasimende nemibuzo, kanye nokuqashelwa kokubhala, izwi nobuso.
ref: Izibonelo zihlanganisa ukulawula, ukuhlela nokwenza isheduli, ikhono lokuphendula ukubhula nemibuzo yekhasimende, kanye nokuqaphela ngesandla, izwi nobuso.

src: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.
mt: Izinto ezinjalo sezibe iziyalo ezihlukene, ezigxile ekuhlinzekeni izixazululo zezinkinga zempilo yangempela.
ref: Izinto ezinjalo zibe izimiso ezihlukile, ezigxila ekunikezeni izisombululo zezinkinga ezingokoqobo zokuphila.

src: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.
mt: Uhlelo lwe-AI manje selusetshenziswa kakhulu emikhakheni yezomnotho, yezokwelapha, yobunjiniyela kanye neyesosha, njengoba sekwakhiwe ezinhlelweni eziningi zekhompyutha yasekhaya kanye nesoftware yemidlalo yevidiyo.
ref: Uhlelo lwe-AI manje ngokuvamile lusetshenziswa emkhakheni wezomnotho, ezokwelapha, ubunjiniyela kanye nempi, njengoba kwakhiwe ezinhlelweni zokusebenza zamakhompyutha wasekhaya amaningana nemidlalo yevidiyo.

src: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.
mt: Uhambo lwasensimini luyingxenye enkulu yanoma yiliphi ikilasi. Ngokuvamile uthisha angathanda ukuthatha abafundi bakhe ezindaweni lapho uhambo ngebhasi lungeyona into engenakwenzeka.
ref: Uhambo lwesikole seluyingxenye enkulu yekilasi. Kaningi uthisha angathanda ukuyisa abafundi bakhe ezindaweni lapho kungafikeki khona ngohambo lwebhasi.

src: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.
mt: Ubuchwepheshe bunikeza isisombululo ngohambo lwezemidlalo olwenziwe nge-virtual. Abafundi bangabheka izinto zasendlini yeminyuziyamu, bavakashele i-aquarium, noma bajabulele ubuciko obuhle ngenkathi behleli ekilasini labo.
ref: Ezobuchwepheshe zinikeza isisombululo ngohambo lwesikole olubukeka njengolwangempela. Abafunda bangabuka imivubukulo yasemnyuziyamu, bavakashele indawo yokugcina izinhlanzi, noma bajabulele ubuhle bobuciko belokhu behlezi nekilasi labo.

src: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.
mt: Ukwabelana ngohambo lwezemfundo ngokoqobo kuyindlela enhle futhi yokubonisa ulwazi ohambweni nokwabelana ngamava namakilasi esizayo.
ref: Ukuhlanganyela uhambo lwesikole cishe enye indlela enhle kakhulu yokucabangisisa ohambweni nokwabelana ngokwenzekile namakilasi wesikhathi esizayo.

src: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
mt: Ngokwesibonelo, unyaka ngamunye abafundi baseBennet School eNyakatho Carolina bakha iwebhusayithi mayelana nohambo lwabo oluya eDolobheni Elikhulu Lesifundazwe, unyaka ngamunye iwebhusayithi iyavuselelwa, kodwa izinguqulo ezindala zigcinwa kuyi-inthanethi ukuze zisebenze njengencwadi yesikhala.
ref: Ngokwesibonelo, unyaka nonyaka abafundi baseBennet School eNorth Carolina baklama iwebhusayithi mayelana nohambo lwabo oluya eNhloko-dolobha Yombuso, unyaka ngamunye amawebhusayithi akhiwa kabusha futhi, kodwa izinhlobo ezindala ziyagcinwa kuyi-inthanethi ukuthi isebenze njengencwadi yokugcina izinto.

src: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
mt: Amabhulogi angasiza futhi ekuthuthukiseni ukubhala kwabafundi. Nakuba abafundi ngokuvamile beqala ulwazi lwabo lwebhulogi ngokuhlelwa kwemibhalo nokushicilelwa, ukuba khona kwezilaleli ngokuvamile kuyashintsha lokho.
ref: Amabhulogi angasiza abafundi ngokubhala. Nakuba abafundi kaningi baqala umsebenzi wabo wokubhuloga ngendlela yokubhala nokupela yobudlabha, ukuba khona kwezilaleli kaningi kuyakushintsha lokho.

src: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
mt: Njengoba abafundi ngokuvamile beyizithameli ezibucayi kakhulu, umbhali webhulogi uqala ukuzama ukuthuthukisa ukubhala ukuze agweme ukugxekwa.
ref: Njengoba abafundi ngokuvamile bayizilaleli ezigxeka kakhulu, umbhali webhulogi uqala ukulwela ukuthuthukisa ukubhala ukuze akweme ukugxekwa.

src: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
mt: Ukubhuloga "kuphoqa abafundi ukuba bazi kangcono umhlaba obazungezile". Isidingo sokondla isithakazelo sezilaleli sikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bahlakaniphe futhi babe nentshisekelo (Toto, 2004).
ref: Futhi ukubhuloga "kuphoqa abafundi ukuba babenokuqonda kakhudlwana ngezwe elibazungezile." Isidingo sokondla isithakazelo sabantu abafundayo kushukumisa abafundi ukuba bahlakaniphe futhi bathakazelise (Toto, 2004).

src: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
mt: Ukubhuloga kuyithuluzi eliphefumulela ukusebenzisana, futhi likhuthaza abafundi ukuba bandise ukufunda ngaphezu kosuku lwesikole lwendabuko.
ref: Ukubhuloga ithuluzi elikhuthaza ukubambisana, futhi likhuthaza abafundi ukuba bangagcini ngokufunda osukwini lwesikole oluvamile.

src: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
mt: Ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwamabhulogi "kunganikeza abafundi amandla okuba ngabahlaziyi nabahlaziyi kakhulu; ngokuphendula ngenkuthalo ezintweni ze-Intanethi, abafundi bangakwazi ukuchaza izikhundla zabo kumongo wemibhalo yabanye kanye nokuveza imibono yabo siqu ezindabeni ezithile (Oravec, 2002).
ref: Indlela efanele yokusebenzisa amabhulogi “inganika abafundi amandla okuba abahlakahlayo nabahlolisisayo kakhudlwana; abafundi bangachaza izikhundla zabo ngomongo wemibhalo yabanye kanye nokusho imibono yabo ngezindaba ezithile (Oravec, 2002).

src: Ottawa is Canada's charming, bilingual capital and features an array of art galleries and museums that showcase Canada's past and present.
mt: I-Ottawa iyidolobha elikhulu laseCanada elinomusa, elinenkulumo ezimbili futhi linezinhlobonhlobo zama-gallery wezobuciko namamyuziyamu akhombisa okwedlule nokwesimanje kweCanada.
ref: I-Ottawa inhlokodolobha yaseKhanada enhle, enezilimi ezimbili futhi enezikhungo eziningi zobuciko namamnyuziyamu abonisa izinto zaseKhanada zesikhathi esidlule nezamanye.

src: Farther south is Niagara Falls and the north is home to the untapped natural beauty of the Muskoka and beyond.
mt: Eningizimu kunamaNiagara Falls kanti enyakatho kunobuhle bemvelo obungazange busetshenziswe baseMuskoka nangaphezulu.
ref: Eningizimu ekude kuneNiagara Falls kanti enyakatho iyikhaya lobuhle bemvelo obungasetshenzisiwe beMuskoka nangale kwayo.

src: All these things and more highlight Ontario as what is considered quintessentially Canadian by outsiders.
mt: Zonke lezi zinto nokunye kugqamisa i-Ontario njengento ethathwa njengama-Canadian angavamile ngabangaphandle.
ref: Zonke lezi zinto nokuningi kugcizelela i-Ontario njengebhekwa njengeyaseKhanada uqobo lwayo abantu bangaphandle.

src: Large areas further north are quite sparsely populated and some is nearly uninhabited wilderness.
mt: Izindawo ezinkulu enyakatho azinabantu abaningi futhi ezinye zingasendle.
ref: Izindawo eziningi kude le enyakatho zinabantu abambalwa futhi ezinye cishe zingugwadule olungahlali muntu.

src: For a comparison of population that surprises many: There are more African Americans living in the US than there are Canadian citizens.
mt: Ukuze kuqhathaniswe inani labantu okumangazayo abaningi: Kunabantu abaningi baseMelika base-Afrika abahlala e-US kunabantu baseCanada.
ref: Uma kuqhathaniswa isibalo sabantu esingamangalisa abaningi: Baningi abantu baseAfrika-Melika abahlala e-US kunezakhamuzi zaseCanada

src: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa.
mt: Iziqhingi zaseMpumalanga Afrika zise-Indian Ocean ogwini olusempumalanga ye-Afrika.
ref: Iziqhingi zaseMpumalanga Afrika zisoLwandlekazini lwaseNdiya ngasogwini olusempumalanga ye-Afrika.

src: Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife.
mt: IMadagascar iyona enkulu kunazo zonke, futhi iyizwekazi elizimele uma kuziwa ezilwaneni zasendle.
ref: IMadagascar yiyo enkulu kakhulu, futhi iyizwekazi ngokwayo uma kuziwa ezilwaneni zasendle.

src: Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts.
mt: Iziqhingi ezincane eziningi ziyizizwe ezizimele, noma ezihlobene neFrance, futhi ezaziwa ngokuthi izindawo zokungcebeleka zasogwini.
ref: Eziningi zeziqhingi ezincane izizwe ezizimele, noma zihlangene neFulansi, futhi zaziwa njendawo yokuvakashela engasolwandle kanokusho.

src: The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte.
mt: Ama-Arabhu nawo aletha ubuSulumane emazweni, futhi lokhu kwatholwa kakhulu e-Comoros naseMayotte.
ref: Ama-Arabhu nawo aletha ubuSulumane emazweni, futhi kwathatha indlela enkulu eComoros naseMayotte.

src: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
mt: Ithonya laseYurophu nokungena kwalo kwaqala ngekhulu le-15, lapho umhloli wasePortugal uVasco da Gama ethola indlela yaseKapa esuka eYurophu iye eNdiya.
ref: Ithonya laseYurophu kanye nobukoloni kwaqala ngekhulu leminyaka lama-15, njengoba inhloli yomPutukezi u-Vasco da Gama ithola Indlela yaseKapa kusuka eYurophu ukuya eNdiya.

src: In the north the region is bounded by the Sahel, and in the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.
mt: Enyakatho le ndawo ilinganiswa yi-Sahel, futhi eningizimu nasentshonalanga i-Atlantic Ocean.
ref: Endaweni esenyakatho ikhawuliswe yiSahel, futhi eningizimu kanye nasentshonalanga uLwandlekazi i-Atlantic.

src: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
mt: Abesifazane: Kunconywa ukuthi noma yibaphi abesifazane abahambi bathi bashadile, kungakhathaliseki isimo sabo sangempela somshado.
ref: Abesifazane: Kutuswa ukuthi noma ngabe yiziphi izivakashi zesifazane zithi zishadile, kungakhathalekile ukuthi zishadile yini noma azishadile.

src: It is helpful to also wear a ring (just not one that looks too expensive.
mt: Kuyasiza futhi ukugqoka indandatho (kodwa hhayi eyodwa ebukeka ibiza kakhulu.
ref: Kuyasiza nokufaka indandatho (kodwa hayi ebukeka ibiza.

src: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
mt: Abesifazane kufanele baqonde ukuthi ukungafani kwamasiko kungase kubangele lokho abacabanga ukuthi kuhlukunyezwa futhi akuvamile ukulandelwa, ukuboshwa, njll.
ref: Abesifazane kumelwe baqaphele ukuthi ukungafani kwamasiko kungaholela kulokho abangacabanga ukuthi ukuhlushwa futhi akukhona okungavamile ukulandelwa, ukubanjwa ngengalo, njll.

src: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
mt: Yiba qinile ekwenqabeni amadoda, futhi ungesabi ukumela indawo yakho (ukungafani kwamasiko noma cha, akwenzi kube kulungile!).
ref: Qina lapho wenqaba amadoda, futhi ungesabi ukuzimela (umehluko wamasiko noma cha, awenzi kube okulungile!).

src: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber fishermen in the 10th century BCE, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and the Merenids as a strategic port called Anfa.
mt: Idolobha lesimanje laseCasablanca lasungulwa abadobi abangamaBerber ngekhulu le-10 BCE, futhi lasetshenziswa amaFenike, amaRoma, namaMerenids njengechweba eliyisiqalo elibizwa ngokuthi i-Anfa.
ref: Idolobha lanamuhla laseCasablanca lasungulwa abadobi baseBerber ngekhulu lama-10 leminyaka BCE, futhi belisetshenziswa abantu baseFenike, eRoma, kanye namaMerenid njengetheku elisendaweni ekahle elibizwa nge-Anfa.

src: The Portuguese destroyed it and rebuilt it under the name Casa Branca, only to abandon it after an earthquake in 1755.
mt: AmaPutukezi ayibhubhisa futhi ayakha kabusha ngaphansi kwegama elithi Casa Branca, kodwa ayishiya ngemuva kokuzamazama komhlaba ngo-1755.
ref: AmaPutukezi alichitha futhi alakha kabusha ngaphansi kwegama leCAsa Branca, ukuze nje aliyeke dengwane ngemva kokuzamazama komhlaba ngo-1755.

src: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city as Daru l-Badya and it was given the name Casablanca by Spanish traders who established trading bases there.
mt: Umsulwa waseMorocco wakha kabusha idolobha ngokuthi iDaru l-Badya futhi wanikezwa igama elithi Casablanca ngabahwebi baseSpain abasungula iziteshi zokuhweba lapho.
ref: Inkosi yaseMorocco yakha kabusha leli dolobha njengeDaru l-Badya futhi lanikezwa igama lokuthi iCasablanca ngabathengisi baseSpeyini abamisa izindawo zokuhweba lapho.

src: Casablanca is one of the least interesting places to shop in all of Morocco.
mt: I-Casablanca ingenye yezindawo ezingathandeki kakhulu zokuthenga kulo lonke elaseMorocco.
ref: ICasablanca enye yezindawo ezingathakazelisi kakhulu yokuthenga kuyo eMorocco yonke.

src: Around the old Medina it's easy to find places selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather goods, hookahs, and a whole spectrum of geegaws, but it's all for the tourists.
mt: Emhlabeni weMedina endala kulula ukuthola izindawo ezithengisa izimpahla zendabuko zaseMorocco, njenge-tagines, izimbiza, izimpahla zesikhumba, ama-hookah, kanye nemikhiqizo eminingi ye-gegaws, kodwa konke kwenzelwa izivakashi.
ref: Eduze neMedina endala kulula ukuthola izindawo ezidayisa izinto ezingokwesiko zase-Morocco, njenge-tagines, izinto zobumba, izinto zesikhumba, amapayipi okubhema, kanye neminikilishwana eminingi yokuhlobisa, kodwa konke okwezivakashi.

src: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda.
mt: IGoma yidolobha lezivakashi e-Democratic Republic of Congo empumalanga eseduze neRwanda.
ref: IGoma yidolobha laseDemocratic Republic of Congo elise mpumalanga eduzane naseRwanda eliheha izivakashi.

src: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.
mt: Ngo-2002 iGoma yabhujiswa yi-lava evela entabeni yaseNyiragongo eyambela imigwaqo eminingi yedolobha, ikakhulukazi isikhungo sedolobha.
ref: Ngo-2002 iGoma yabhujiswa udaka olushisayo oluvela kuyintabamlilo iNyirogongo eyagqiba eminingi yemigwaqo yasedolobheni, ikakhulukazi maphakathi nedolobha.

src: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
mt: Nakuba iGoma iphephile, noma yikuphi ukuvakasha ngaphandle kweGoma kufanele kuhlolwe ukuze kuqondwe isimo sezingxabano eziqhubekayo esifundazweni saseNyakatho Kivu.
ref: Nakuba iGoma iphephile ngokwezinga elithile, noma ikuphi ukuvakasha ngaphandle kweGoma kumelwe kucwaningwe ukuze uzwisise isimo sokulwa okusesifundazweni saseNyakatho Kivu.

src: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.
mt: Idolobha liphinde libe yindawo yokukhuphukela entabeni iNyiragongo kanye nezinye zezintaba ze-Mountain Gorilla ezishibhile kakhulu e-Afrika.
ref: Idolobha libuye libe isiqu sokugibela intabamlilo iNyiragongo kanye nokunye kokulandelela amaGorila waseNtabeni okubiza kancane kunakho konke e-Afrika.

src: You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.
mt: Ungasebenzisa i-boda-boda (itekisi yesithuthuthu) ukuze ujikeleze iGoma. Intengo ejwayelekile (yendawo) cishe ama-franc angama-500 eCongo ngohambo olufushane.
ref: Uma usebenzisa i-boda-boda (itekisi lesithuthuthu) ukuhambahamba eGoma. Inani elivamile (lasendaweni) u-~500 wama-Franc wase-Congo uma ufuna uhambo olufishane.

src: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
mt: Kuhlanganiswe nokungafinyeleleki kwayo, "iTimbuktu" iye yasetshenziswa njengesifaniso sezwe elingajwayelekile, elikude.
ref: Kuhlanganiswe nokungafinyeleleki kuyo kalula, "iTimbuktu" seyisetshenziswa njengesingathekiso samazwe angajwayelekile, akude.

src: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.
mt: Namuhla, iTimbuktu idolobha elintulayo, nakuba idumela layo liyenza ibe indawo yokuheha izivakashi, futhi inesikhumulo sezindiza.
ref: Namuhla, iTimbuktu idolobha eliphundlekile, nakuba idumela lalo lilenza lithandwe izivakashi, futhi linesikhumulo sezindiza.

src: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.
mt: Ngo-1990, yengezwa ohlwini lwamagugu omhlaba asengozini, ngenxa yesongo lesihlabathi sasogwadule.
ref: Ngo-1990, yafakwa ohlwini lwezindawo zefa lomhlaba ezisengozini, ngenxa yosongo lwesihlabathi sasohlane.

src: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
mt: Kwakuyindawo eyodwa enkulu yokuma ngesikhathi se-PBS Special Wonders of the African World kaHenry Louis Gates.
ref: Kwakungenye yezindawo zokuma phakathi nohlelo lwePBs lukaHenry Louis Gates lweZimangaliso Zezwe lase-Afrika.

src: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.
mt: Idolobha lihluke kakhulu kwamanye amadolobha aleli zwe, ngoba linomqondo wama-Arabhu kunowama-Afrika.
ref: Idolobha lihlukile ngokuphelele kwamanye amadolobha ezwe, ngoba linomoya wase-Arabhiya kakhulu ukudlula owaseAfrika.

src: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
mt: IPark kaZwelonke yaseKruger (KNP) itholakala enyakatho-mpumalanga yeNingizimu Afrika futhi ihamba emngceleni weMozambique empumalanga, eZimbabwe enyakatho, futhi umngcele waseningizimu yiMfula iCrocodile.
ref: IKruger National Park (KNP) isenyakatho-mpumalanga yaseNingizimu Afrika futhi ihamba ngasemngceleni weMozambique empumalanga, iZimbabwe enyakatho, futhi umngcele ongaseningizimu iCrocodile River.

src: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
mt: Ipaki ihlanganisa amakhilomitha-skwele angu-19,500 futhi ihlukaniswe yaba izindawo eziphilayo ezingu-14, ngayinye isekela izilwane zasendle ezahlukene.
ref: Ubukhulu bepaki bungu-19,500 km² futhi lihlukaniswe laba yizindawo ezingokwemvelo ezingu-14, ngayinye inezidalwa zasendle ezihlukahlukene.

src: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
mt: Ingenye yezinto ezihehayo zaseNingizimu Afrika futhi ibhekwa njengophawu lwezindawo zokungcebeleka zikazwelonke zaseNingizimu Afrika (SANParks).
ref: Ingenye yezindawo ezivakashelwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika futhi ithathwa njengendawo eyaziwa kakhulu kumaPaki weZwe waseNingizimu Afrika (SANParks).

src: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
mt: Njengazo zonke izingadi zikazwelonke zaseNingizimu Afrika, kunemali yokulondolozwa kwansuku zonke nezindleko zokungena epaki.
ref: Njengawo wonke amaPaki Wezwe waseNingizimu Afrika, kunamanani okuhlanga ngaphakathi usuku ngalunye kanye namanani okungena wepaki.
