src: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
mt: Kungasiza futhi ukuthenga i-Wild Card, enikeza ukungena kunoma yiziphi izingadi zaseNingizimu Afrika noma kuzo zonke izingadi zikazwelonke zaseNingizimu Afrika.
ref: Kungase futhi kube usizo ukuthi umuntu athenge i-Wild Card, enikeza ithuba lokungena kumapaki aseNingizimu Afrika noma kuwo wonke amaSouth African National Parks

src: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
mt: Isiqhingi saseHong Kong sinikeza indawo yaseHong Kong igama laso futhi yindawo izivakashi eziningi eziyibona njengendawo eyinhloko.
ref: Isiqhingi saseHong Kong sinika indawo yaseHong Kong igama layo futhi yindawo leyo izivakashi eziningi eziyithatha njengendawo yokuvakashelwa eyinhloko.

src: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
mt: Umbukiso wezakhiwo ezenza umkhawulo wezulu waseHong Kong ufaniswe nesithombe sebha esikhazimulayo esibonakala ngokuba khona kwamanzi aseVictoria Harbour.
ref: Umbukiso wezakhiwo ezenza isibhakabhaka saseHong Kong ufaniswe neshadi elicwebezelayo elibonakala ngokuba khona kwamanzi aseVictoria Harbour.

src: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
mt: Ukuze uthole umbono omuhle kakhulu waseHong Kong, shiya lesi siqhingi uye ogwini lwaseKowloon olungaphesheya.
ref: Ukuze ube nemibono emihle kakhulu ye-Hong Kong, shiya lesi siqhingi uye echibini lamanzi lase-Kowloon eliqondene.

src: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
mt: Iningi lokuthuthukiswa kwemizi eHong Kong Island ligcwele kakhulu ezindaweni ezibuyiselwe ogwini olusenyakatho.
ref: Iningi kokuthuthuka  kwedolobha laseHong Kong Island kugcwele ezweni elisanda kubuyiswa ngasogwini olusenyakatho.

src: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
mt: Yindawo lapho amakoloni aseBrithani athatha khona njengamacala awo futhi ngakho-ke uma ufuna ubufakazi besikhathi esedlule sokukoloni kwendawo, lena yindawo enhle yokuqala.
ref: Le indawo abenzi bamakoloni baseBrithani abayithatha njengendawo yabo ngakho uma ufuna ukubona ubufakazi besikhathi esedlule sobukoloni salendawo, lena indawo efanele ongaqala kuyo.

src: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
mt: Ama-Sundarbans yibhande elikhulu kunawo wonke lama- mangrove asogwini emhlabeni, elandelana ngamakhilomitha angama-80 (50 mi) kuya endaweni engaphakathi kweBangladeshi ne-Indian kusukela ogwini.
ref: Ama-Sundarban awuchungechunge lomhlume wothungulu omkhulu kunawo wonke emhlabeni, ayindawo engama-80 km (50 mi) ukuya phakathi nezwe laseBangladesh nelaseNdiya kusuka ogwini.

src: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
mt: I-Sundarbans imenyezelwe njengeNdawo Yamagugu Omhlaba ye-UNESCO. Ingxenye yehlathi ngaphakathi kwendawo yaseNdiya ibizwa ngokuthi yi-Sundarbans National Park.
ref: I-Sundarbans ibhekwe njengeNdawo Yamagugu Omhlaba i-UNESCO. Ingxenye yehlathi elisensimini yabaseNdiya libizwa ngokuthi i-Ipaki Lesizwe i-Sundarbans

src: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
mt: Amahlathi awona nje amabhodlela omangozi kodwa ahlanganisa ezinye zezitshalo zokugcina zamahlathi amakhulu ayesanda kugubungela iGangetic Plain.
ref: Amahlathi awagcini nje ngokuba amaxhaphozi anemihlume — ahlanganisa ezinye zezindawo zokugcina ezisele zamahlathi anamandla ake ahlanganisa ithafa lase-Gangetic.

src: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
mt: Ama-Sundarbans ahlanganisa indawo engamakhilomitha-skwele angu-3 850 lapho cishe ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu yayo ihlanganiswe ezindaweni zamanzi/zommbila.
ref: Ama-Sundarbans enza indawo engama-3,850 km², leyo ingxenye yesithathu yayo yembozwe yizindawo ezingamanzi/ubhuku.

src: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
mt: Kusukela ngo-1966 i-Sundarbans ibilokhu iyindawo yokulondolozwa kwezilwane zasendle, futhi kulinganiselwa ukuthi manje kunezingwe zaseBengal ezingama-400 nezinkukhu eziphukile ezingaba ngu-30 000 endaweni.
ref: Kusukela ngo-1966 amaSundarbans abeyindawo yokuhlala izilwane zasendle, futhi kulinganiselwa ukuthi manje sekunamahlosi waseBukhosini wase-Bengal kanye nezinyamazane ezinamabala ezicishe zibe ngu-30,000 endaweni.

src: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
mt: Amabhasi ashiya esiteshini samabhasi esiphakathi kwezifunda (ngakolunye uhlangothi lomfula) usuku lonke, nakuba iningi, ikakhulukazi lawo aya empumalanga naseJakar/Bumthang lisuka phakathi kuka-06:30 no-7:30.
ref: Amabhasi asuka esiteshi samabhasi esiphakathi kwesifunda (ngaphesheya komfula) usuku lonke, nakuba amaningi, ikakhulukazi lawo aya ngasempumalanga naseJakar/Bumthang asuka phakathi kuka-06:30 no-07:30.

src: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
mt: Njengoba amabhasi phakathi kwezifunda ngokuvamile egcwele, kungcono ukuthenga ithikithi izinsuku ezimbalwa kusengaphambili.
ref: Njengoba amabhasi esifunda ngokuvamile egcwala, kuyatuseka ukuthi uthenge ithikithi ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ngaphambili.

src: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
mt: Izifunda eziningi zisetshenziswa amabhasi amancane aseJapan, anethezekile futhi aqinile.
ref: Izifunda eziningi zihlinzekwa i-Japanese Coaster Buses amancane, akhululekile futhi aqinile.

src: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
mt: Amatekisi abelwe ayindlela esheshayo nekhululekile yokuya ezindaweni eziseduze, njengeParo (Nu 150) nePunakha (Nu 200).
ref: Amatekisi ahlanganyelwayo ayindlela esheshayo nenethezekile yokuya ezindaweni eziseduze, njengase-Paro (Nu 150) kanye nase-Punakha (Nu 200).

src: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
mt: Ibhuloho loMfula i-Oyapock liyibhuloho elinamakhaneli. Ihlanganisa uMfula i-Oyapock ukuze ixhumanise amadolobha ase-Oiapoque eBrazil naseSaint-Georges de l'Oyapock e-French Guiana.
ref: I-Oyapock River Bridge ibhuloho eliphaswe ngamakhebula ensimbi. Liwelela uMfula i-Oyapock uhlanganisa amadolobha ase-Oiapque eBrazil kanye neSaint-Georges de I'Oyapock eFrench Guiana.

src: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
mt: Lezi zinqaba ezimbili zenyuka zibe ngamamitha angama-83, zide ngamamitha angama-378 futhi zinemigwaqo emibili enobubanzi obungamamitha angama-3.50.
ref: Imibhoshongo emibili iphakama ngamamitha angu-83, ingamamitha angu-378 ubude futhi inemigwaqo emibili engu-3.50 m ububanzi.

src: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
mt: Umngcele ophakeme ngaphansi kwebhuloho ungamamitha ayi-15. Ukwakhiwa kwaqedwa ngo-Agasti 2011, akuvulelwanga umgwaqo kuze kube nguMashi 2017.
ref: Isikhala sokuphakama esisalayo ngaphansi kwebhuloho singamamitha angu-15. Ukulakha kwaphela ngoNcwaba 2011, alivulwanga ukuze kuhambe izimoto kwaze kwaba uNdasa 2017.

src: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
mt: Leli bhuloho kulindeleke ukuba lisebenze ngokugcwele ngoSeptemba 2017, lapho izikhungo zokuhlola kwamasiko aseBrazil kulindeleke ukuba ziphele.
ref: Ibhuloho lihlelelwe ukusebenza ngokugcwele ngoMandulo 2017, lapho izindawo zaseBrazil zokuhlola abangenayo kulindelwe ukuthi ziphele.

src: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
mt: AmaGuaraní ayeyiqembu lomdabu elibaluleke kakhulu elalihlala endaweni manje eyiMpumalanga yeParaguay, elalihlala njengabazingeli abahlala ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwezindawo futhi elalizolima ukuze liqhubeke nokuphila.
ref: Ama-Guarani bekuyiqembu lomdabu eliphawulekayo elinefa kulokho manje okuthiwa iMpumalanga Paraguay, baphila ngokuba abazingeli futhi bathola ukudla ngokulima.

src: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
mt: Isifunda saseChaco sasiyikhaya lamanye amaqembu ezizwe zomdabu njengeGuaycurú nePayaguá, asinda ngokuzingela, ukuqoqa nokudoba.
ref: Indawo yaseChaco bekuyikhaya lamanye amaqembu wezizwana zemdabu njengamaGuaycurú kanye namaPayaguá, ababephila ngokuzingela, ukubutha kanye nokudoba.

src: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
mt: Ekhulwini le-16 iParaguay, eyayike yabizwa ngokuthi "isifundazwe esikhulu samaNdiya", yazalwa ngenxa yokuhlangana kwabahlwithayo baseSpain namaqembu omdabu.
ref: Ngekhulu lesi-16 leminyaka iParaguay, ngaphambili eyayibizwa ngokuthi "Isifundazwe Esikhulukazi sama-Indie", yaba khona ngenxa yokuhlangana kwabanqobi baseSpain namaqembu abantu bomdabu ngokuzalwa.

src: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
mt: Abantu baseSpain baqala inkathi yokoloni eyaqhubeka amakhulu amathathu eminyaka.
ref: AbaseSpain baqala isikhathi sobukoloni esathatha amakhulu amathathu eminyaka.

src: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
mt: Kusukela kwasungulwa i-Asunción ngo-1537, iParaguay ikwazile ukugcina okuningi ngokwemvelo kanye nobunikazi bayo bomdabu.
ref: Kusukela ekusungulweni kwe Asunción ngo-1537, i-Paraguay yakwazi ukugcina isimo sayo sendabuko esikhulu kanye nobukhona bayo.

src: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
mt: I-Argentina yaziwa ngokuba neqembu lamapolo nabadlali abahamba phambili emhlabeni.
ref: I-Argentina idume ngokuba nelinye lamaqembu kanye nabadlali be-polo abahamba phambili emhlabeni.

src: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
mt: Umqhudelwano omkhulu kunayo yonke wonyaka wenzeka ngoDisemba ezinkundleni ze-polo eLas Cañitas.
ref: Umncintiswano omkhulu kunayo yonke wonyaka wenzeka ngoZibandlela ezinkundleni ze-polo eLas Cañitas.

src: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
mt: Imincintiswano nemidlalo emincane nayo ingatholakala lapha ngezinye izikhathi zonyaka.
ref: Imincintiswano emincane kanye nemidlalo ingabuye ibonwe lapha ngezinye izikhathi zonyaka.

src: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
mt: Ukuze uthole izindaba mayelana nemincintiswano nokuthi ungathenga kuphi amathikithi emidlalo ye-polo, hlola i- Asociación Argentina de Polo.
ref: Ukuze uthole izindaba zemincintiswano kanye nendawo yokuthenga amathikithi wemidlalo yepholo, hlola i-Asociacion Argentina de Polo.

src: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
mt: Imali esemthethweni yaseFalklands yi-Falkland pound (FKP) enenani elimiswe elilingana nelelo le-British pound (GBP).
ref: Imali esemthethweni yase-Falkland iwupondo waseFalkland (FKP) inani layo libekwe endaweni efanayo nopondo waseBrithani (GBP).

src: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
mt: Imali ingashintshaniswa ebhange elilodwa kulezi ziqhingi elitholakala eStanley ngaphesheya kwesitolo se-FIC West.
ref: Imali ingashintshwa ebhange okuwukuphela kwalo esiqhingini esiseStanley ngaphesheya kwesitolo saseFIC Ntshonalanga.

src: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
mt: I-British pound ngokuvamile izokwamukelwa noma kuphi eziqhingini futhi ngaphakathi kwamakhadi esikweletu ase-Stanley namadola ase-United States nawo ngokuvamile ayamukeleka.
ref: Amaphawundi wase-Britain ngokuvamile azokwamukelwa noma yikuphi eziqhingini futhi nangaphakathi amakhadi wesikweletu e-Stanley kanye namadola ase-United States nawo ajwayele ukwamukelwa.

src: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
mt: Ezithunzini ezikude kungenzeka ukuthi amakhadi esikweletu ngeke amukelwe, nakuba kungathathwa imali yaseBrithani neyase-United States; hlola nabanikazi kusengaphambili ukuze uthole ukuthi iyiphi indlela yokukhokha eyamukelekayo.
ref: Eziqhingini eziqhelile amakhadi wokuthenga ngesikweletu cishe ngeke amukelwe, nakuba imali yaseBrithani naseMelika ingathathwa; hlola nabanikazi kusengaphambili ukuthola ukuthi iyiphi indlela yokukhokha eyamukelwayo.

src: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
mt: Cishe akunakwenzeka ukushintshanisa imali yaseFalklands ngaphandle kweziqhingi, ngakho-ke ukushintshanisa imali ngaphambi kokushiya lezi ziqhingi.
ref: Cishe akwenzeki ukushintshelana imali yaseFalklands ngaphandlwe kweziqhingi, ngakho-ke shintshelana imali ngaphambi kokuhamba eziqhingini.

src: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
mt: Njengoba iMontevideo iseNingizimu ye-Equator, kulapho kuhlobo lapho kubanda khona eNyakatho yeHemisphere futhi okuphambene nalokho.
ref: Njengoba i-Montevideo iseningizimu yeNkabazwe, kuba ihlobo lapho ngesikhathi Ingxenye eseNyakatho kusebusika kuyaphambana.

src: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
mt: IMontevideo isezindaweni ezishisayo; ezinyangeni zasehlobo, amazinga okushisa angaphezulu kuka-30°C ajwayelekile.
ref: IMontevideo isendaweni yetropiki; ngezinyanga zasehlobo, amazinga okushisa angaphezu kuka +30°C avamile.

src: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
mt: Ubusika bungababanda ngokukhohlisayo: amazinga okushisa awavamile ukwehla ngaphansi kweqhwa, kodwa umoya nomswakama kuhlangana ukuze kube nokufudumala kunalokho okushiwo yi-thermometer.
ref: Ubusika bungaba nzima kakhulu: amazing okushisa angase adlulele ngale kweqhwa, kodwa umoya kanye nomswakama sekuhlangene kwenza kubande ngaphezu kwalokho isikali sokushisa esikushoyo.

src: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
mt: Azikho izinkathi ezithile "zemvula" ne "zomile": inani lemvula lihlala lifana unyaka wonke.
ref: Azikho izikhathi eziqondile “zemvula” noma “zobusika”: izinga lemvula lihlala linjalo cishe unyaka wonke.

src: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
mt: Nakuba izilwane eziningi zasendle zivame ukubona abantu, izilwane zasendle zisahlala zasendle futhi akufanele zondliwe noma ziphazamiswe.
ref: Nakuba izilwane eziningi epaki zijwayele ukubona abantu, izilwane zasendle noma kunjalo aziphucukile futhi akumelwe zondliwe noma ziphazanyiswe.

src: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
mt: Ngokweziphathimandla zepaki, hlala okungenani amamitha angu-100 ukusuka kumabhere nezimpisi namamitha angu-25 ukusuka kuzo zonke ezinye izilwane zasendle!
ref: Ngokweziphathimandla zepaki, hlala okungenani amayadi/amamitha angu-100 kude namabhere kanye nezimpisi ezifana namanketshane futhi amayadi/amamitha angu-25 kuzo zonke ezinye izilwane zasendle!

src: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
mt: Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zibonakala zingenamuntu, izilwane ezinjengamabhayisikili, i-elks, i-alce, amabhere, cishe zonke izilwane ezinkulu zingakwazi ukuhlasela.
ref: Kungakhathelekile ukuthi zibukeka zithobile kangakanani, izinyathi, ama-elk, ama-moose, amabhere, futhi cishe nazo zonke izilwane ezinkulu zingahlasela.

src: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
mt: Minyaka yonke, izinkulungwane zezivakashi zilimala ngenxa yokungagcini ibanga elifanele. Lezi zilwane zikhulu, zasendle, futhi zingaba yingozi, ngakho zinikeze indawo yazo.
ref: Unyaka ngamunye, izivakashi eziningi ziyalimala ngenxa yokuthi azigcinanga ibanga elifanele. Lezi zilwane zinkulu, ezasendle, futhi zingaba ingozi, ngakho zinike isikhala sazo.

src: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
mt: Ngaphezu kwalokho, qaphela ukuthi iphunga liyakhanga amabhere nezinye izilwane zasendle, ngakho gwema ukuthwala noma ukupheka ukudla okunamakha futhi ugcine ikamu lihlanzekile.
ref: Ngaphezu kwalokho, phawula ukuthi iphunga libiza amabhere kanye nezinye izilwane zasendle, ngakho gwema ukuphatha noma ukupheka ukudla okunephunga futhi ugcine ikamu lihlanzekile.

src: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
mt: I-Apia iyinhloko-dolobha yaseSamoa. Idolobha lisesiqhingini sase-Upolu futhi linabantu abangaphansi kuka-40,000.
ref: I-Apia inhlokodolobha yaseSamoa. Idolobha lisesiqhingini sase-Upolu futhi linabantu abangaphansi nje kuka-40,000.

src: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
mt: I-Apia yasungulwa ngawo-1850 futhi ibilokhu iyidolobha elikhulu laseSamoa kusukela ngo-1959.
ref: I-Apia yasungulwa ngabo-1850 futhi yaba yinhlokodolobha ngokomthetho yaseSamowa kusukela ngo-1959.

src: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
mt: Itheku laliyindawo yokushayisana kwezempi okudumile ngo-1889 lapho imikhumbi eyisikhombisa evela eJalimane, e-US naseBrithani yenqaba ukushiya itheku.
ref: Itheku laliyindawo lapho kwaqubuka khona impi yasolwandle edume kabi ngo-1889 lapho imikhumbi eyisikhombisa evela eJalimane, e-US, naseBrithani yenqaba ukusuka echwebeni.

src: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
mt: Zonke imikhumbi yanyamalala, ngaphandle komkhumbi owodwa waseBrithani. Kwafa cishe abantu baseMelika nabaseJalimane abangu-200.
ref: Yonke imikhumbi yacwila, ngaphandle komkhumbi owodwa wase-Britain. Cishe abantu abangu-200 baseMelika naseJalimane balahlekelwa yizimpilo zabo.

src: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
mt: Ngesikhathi sokulwela inkululeko ehlelwe yinhlangano yamaMau, umhlangano onokuthula edolobheni waholela ekubulaweni kwenduna ephezulu uTupa Tamasese Lealofi III.
ref: Phakathi nomzabalazo wokuzimela ohlelwe yinhlangano kaMau, umhlangano wokuthula edolobheni waholela ekubulaweni kwenkosi yezwe uTupua Tamasese lealofi III.

src: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
mt: Kunamabhishi amaningi, ngenxa yokuthi i-Auckland isendaweni yamachweba amabili.
ref: Kunezingu eziningi, ngenxa yokuthi i-Auckland ingapha nangapha kwamatheku amabili. Ezithandwa kakhulu zisezindaweni ezintathu.

src: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
mt: Amabhishi aseNorth Shore (esifundeni saseNorth Harbour) asohlanzeni lwePacific Ocean futhi asukela kuLong Bay enyakatho aye eDevonport eningizimu.
ref: Amabhisi wasoGwini oluseNyakatho (esifundeni seTheku eliseNyakatho) asoLwandlekazini lwePhasifiki futhi asuka e-Long Bay ngasenyakatho kuya e-Devonport eningizimu.

src: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
mt: Cishe wonke amabhishi anesihlabathi anokubhukuda okuphephile, futhi amaningi anomthunzi onikezwa izihlahla ze-pohutukawa.
ref: Kucishe kube izingu ezinesihlabathi eziyindawo ephephile yokubhukuda, kanti kugcwele nemithunzi eyenziwa izihlahla ze-pohutukawa.

src: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
mt: Amabhishi e-Tamaki Drive aseWitemata Harbour, emaphandleni ase-Mission Bay naseSt Heliers e-Central Auckland.
ref: Amabhishi ase-Tamaki Drive ase-Harbour yase-Waitemata, edolobheni labadla izambane likapondo e-Mission Bay naseSt Heliers e–Auckland eMaphakathi.

src: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
mt: Lezi ngezinye izikhathi ziyizindlu zamabhishi emindeni egcwele abantu, futhi kunezitolo eziningi ezigudla ugu. Ukubhukuda kuphephile.
ref: Lawa amabhishi wemindeni aba nabantu abaningi ngezinye izikhathi anezitolo ezihlukahlukene ezigcwele ogwini. Ukubhukuda kuphephile.

src: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
mt: Ibhiya lendawo eyinhloko 'iNombolo Yokuqala', akuyona ibhiya eliyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa liyamnandi futhi liqabula.
ref: Ubhiya oyinhloko wasekhaya ‘Uhamba Phambili’, awuwona ubhiya oyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa umnandi futhi uyaqabula. Omunye ubhiya wasekhaya ubizwa ngokuthi “i-Manta”.

src: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
mt: Kunamawayini amaningi aseFrance okumele aphuzwe, kodwa amawayini aseNew Zealand nawase-Australia angase ahambe kangcono.
ref: Kunamawayini amaningi waseFulansi okuphuzwa, kodwa amawayini waseNyuzilandi kanye nase-Australia angahamba kangcono.

src: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
mt: Amanzi ompompi wendawo aphephile ukuphuza, kodwa amanzi agcwele ebhodleleni kulula ukuwathola uma wesaba.
ref: Amanzi asempompini yomphakathi aphephe ngokuphelele ukuthi aphuzwe, kodwa amanzi athengwayo atholakala kalula uma unokwesaba.

src: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
mt: Kubantu base-Australia, umbono wekhofi 'eliyinsundu' awubalulekile. Umnyama omfishane 'uyispresso', i-cappuccino iza iqongqwe iqukethe ukhilimu (hhayi i-foam), futhi itiye linikezwa ngaphandle kobisi.
ref: Kubantu base-Australia, umcabango wekhofi 'elinobisi oluthunqiswe ngomusi' awujwayelekile. Inkomishi encane 'yi-espresso', i-cappuccino iza igcwele ukhilimu ophezulu (hhayi ugwebu), futhi itiye liphuzwa ngaphandle kobisi.

src: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
mt: Ishokoledi esishisayo sihlangabezana nezindinganiso zaseBelgium.
ref: Isiphuzo sikashokoledi esishisayo sisemazingeni waseBelgium. Iziphuzo ezenziwe ngezithelo ziyabiza kodwa zikahle kakhulu.

src: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
mt: Uhambo oluningi oluya emgqeni wamanzi lwenziwa unyaka wonke, futhi ukulimala ngenxa yalezi zimbangela emgqeni wamanzi akuvamile.
ref: Uhambo oluningi lokuya emkhombeni wekholali (reef) lwenziwa unyaka wonke, futhi izingozi ngenxa yanoma iziphi yalezi zimbangela zasemkhombeni azivamile.

src: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
mt: Noma kunjalo, lalela iseluleko esivela kubaphathi, ulalele zonke izimpawu, futhi unake kakhulu izixwayiso zokuphepha.
ref: Noma kunjalo, thatha iseluleko seziphathimandla, ulandele zonke izinkomba futhi unakisise izixwayiso sokuphepha.

src: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
mt: Ama-jellyfish ebhokisi atholakala eduze kwamahlathi asogwini naseduze nemifula esuka ngo-Okthoba kuya ku-April enyakatho ka-1770.
ref: Ama-jellyfish asabhokisi abakhona eduze namabhishi naseduze nezizalo zemifula kusukela ngoMfumfu kuya kuMbasa enyakatho ye-1770. Angatholakala ngezinye izikhathi ngaphandle kwalezi zikhathi.

src: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
mt: Oshaka bakhona, kodwa abavamile ukuhlasela abantu. Oshaka abaningi besaba abantu futhi bazomuka.
ref: Oshaka abekho, nokho abavamisile ukuhlasela abantu. Oshaka abaningi besaba abantu futhi bazobhukuda babaleke.

src: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
mt: Izingwenya zamanzi anosawoti azihlali olwandle, indawo yazo zokuhlala eyinhloko isezindaweni zomfula enyakatho neRockhampton.
ref: Izingwenya zamanzi anosawoti azihlali ngokukhululeka olwandle, indawo yazo yokuhlala eyinhloko kusezizalweni zomfula enyakatho kusuka e-Rockhampton.

src: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
mt: Ukubhuka kusengaphambili kunikeza umhambi ukuthula kwengqondo ngokuthi uzoba nendawo yokulala uma esefikile lapho eya khona.
ref: Ukubhukha kusenesikhathi kunikeza isihambi ukuthula kwengqondo kokuthi sizoba nendawo yokulala kuyo lapho sifika endaweni esiya kuyo.

src: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
mt: Ama-ejenti ezokuvakasha ngokuvamile anamalungiselelo emahhotela athile, nakuba kungase kutholakale ukuthi ungenza ezinye izinhlobo zokuhlala, njengamasimu okwakha amakamu, nge-ejenti yezokuvakasha.
ref: Izinkampani ezihlela uhambo kaningi ziba nezaphulelo namahhotela athile, nakuba ungakwazi ukubhukha ezinye izinhlobo zokuhlala, njengendawo yamakamu, ngenkampani ehlela uhambo.

src: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
mt: Ama-ejenti ezokuvakasha ngokuvamile anikeza amaphakheji ahlanganisa isidlo sasekuseni, amalungiselelo ezokuthutha aya/kusuka esikhumulweni sezindiza noma ngisho namaphakheji endiza kanye nehhotela ahlanganisiwe.
ref: Izinkampani ezihlela uhambo zinikeza inhlanganisela yezinto ezihlanganisa ibhulakufesi, amalungiselelo wezinto zokuthutha zokuya/zokusuka esikhumulweni sezindiza noma isethi ehlangene yendiza kanye nehhotela.

src: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
mt: Bangakwazi futhi ukukubekela incwadi uma udinga isikhathi sokucabanga ngesipho noma ukuthenga eminye imibhalo lapho uya khona (isib. i-visa).
ref: Bayakwazi ukukugcinela indawo uma wena usadinga isikhathi sokucabanga noma usafisa ukulungisa izinto ezithinta uhambo lwakho (isb., i-visa).

src: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
mt: Noma yikuphi ukuguqulwa noma izicelo kufanele zifakwe nge-ejenti yezokuvakasha kuqala hhayi ngqo ehhotela.
ref: Noma iziphi izinguquko noma izicelo nokho kumelwe zidluliselwe enkampanini ehlela uhambo kuqala futhi hhayi nehhotela ngokuqondile.

src: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
mt: Kweminye imikhosi, iningi labantu abahambele imikhosi yomculo linquma ukwakha ikamu endaweni, futhi iningi labantu abahambeleyo liyibona iyingxenye ebalulekile yokuhlangenwe nakho.
ref: Kweminye imikhosi, iningi lababakhona emkhosini womculo linquma ukukanisa kuleyo ndawo, futhi ababakhona abaningi bakubona kuyingxenye edingekayo yokuhlanganyela.

src: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
mt: Uma ufuna ukusondela esenzweni kuzodingeka ufike kusenesikhathi ukuze uthole indawo yokumisa eduze nomculo.
ref: Uma ufuna ukubona okwenzekayo useduze kuzomelwe ufike masinya ukuze uthole indawo yokukamisa eduze nomculo.

src: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
mt: Khumbula ukuthi nakuba umculo osezinkundleni ezinkulu kungenzeka ukuthi uphelile, kungase kube nezingxenye zomkhosi ezizoqhubeka zidlala umculo kuze kube sebusuku.
ref: Khumbula ukuthi nakuba umculo osesiteji esiyinhloko ungaphela, kungaba nezingxenye zomkhosi ezizoqhubeka zidlala umculo kuze kube sebusuku kakhulu.

src: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
mt: Eminye imikhosi inezindawo ezikhethekile zokukhempa zemindeni enezingane ezincane.
ref: Eminye imikhosi inezindawo zokukanisa ezikhethekile zemindeni enezingane ezincane.

src: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
mt: Uma uwela iNyakatho yeBaltic ebusika, hlola indawo yendlu, njengoba ukuhamba eqhweni kubangela umsindo omubi kakhulu kulabo abathinteke kakhulu.
ref: Uma unqamula iNyakatho Baltic ebusika, bheka ukuthi ikuphi indawo yokusandlwana okwakhiwe ngezingodo, njengoba ukuhamba eqhweni kubangela ukungaphatheki kahle emakhaleni kulaba abathinteke kakhulu.

src: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
mt: Ukuhamba nge-cruise eSaint Petersburg kuhlanganisa isikhathi edolobheni. Abagibeli be-cruise bakhululiwe ezidingweni ze-visa (hlola imibandela).
ref: Uhambo lomkhumbi lwaseSaint Petersburg luhlanganisa idolobha. Kulindelwe ukuthi abahamba ngomkhumbi bahlangabezane nezimfuneko ze-visa (hlola imigomo)

src: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
mt: Amakhasino ngokuvamile enza imizamo eminingi ukuze akhuphele isikhathi nemali esetshenziswa izivakashi. Amafasitela namawashi ngokuvamile awabi khona, futhi ukuphuma kungaba nzima ukuthola.
ref: Amahhlo okugembula ngokujwayelekile enza imizamo yokuba izivakashi zichithe isikhathi nemali eningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Amafasitela namakilogo ngokuvamile awekho, futhi kungaba nzima ukuthola izindawo zokuphuma.

src: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
mt: Ngokuvamile zinikeza ukudla okukhethekile, isiphuzo nokuzijabulisa, ukuze zigcine izivakashi zinemizwa enhle, futhi zizigcine endaweni.
ref: Ngokuvamile banokudla okukhethekile, iziphuzo kanye nokuzijabulisa, ukuze bagcine izivakashi zithokozile, futhi bazigcine ziphakathi kwawo.

src: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
mt: Ezinye izindawo zinikeza iziphuzo ezidakayo endlini. Nokho, ukudakwa kuphazamisa ukwahlulela, futhi bonke abagembuli abahle bayazi ukubaluleka kokuhlala benengqondo.
ref: Ezinye izindawo zihlinzeka ngotshwala ezindlini. Nokho, ukudakwa kudunga ingqondo, bonke abantu abagembulayo abahle bayakwazi ukubaluleka kokuhlala usangulukile.

src: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
mt: Noma ubani ozoshayela ezindaweni eziphakeme noma ngaphezu kwamaphasela ezintaba kufanele acabange ngamathuba eqhwa, iqhwa, noma ukushisa okubandayo.
ref: Noma ubani ozoshayela ezindaweni eziphakeme noma ngaphezu kwezintuba zezintaba kumelwe alindele ukuba khona kwesithwathwa, iqhwa, noma amakhaza ashubisa umkantsha.

src: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
mt: Emigwaqweni enesithwathwa nesithwasahlobo, ukungqubuzana kuphansi futhi awukwazi ukushayela sengathi usemgwaqweni onesihlahla samabhomu.
ref: Emigwaqweni eneqhwa kanye nomkhithiko, ukuhamba kuyabambezeleka futhi angeke ukwazi ukushayela njengalapho uhamba otiyeleni.

src: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
mt: Ngesikhathi seqhuma, iqhwa elanele lokukufaka engxenyeni ingase iwe ngesikhathi esifushane kakhulu.
ref: Uma kunomoya ohambisana neqhwa, kungawa iqhwa elanele elingakwenza ubhajwe ngesikhashana nje.

src: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
mt: Ukubonakala kungase futhi kunqunyelwe ukuwa noma ukuqhuma kweqhwa noma ukuqina noma iqhwa emafasiteleni emoto.
ref: Ukubonakala kungavinjelwa ukuwa noma ukufuthwa kweqhwa noma noma ngomswakama noma iqhwa efasiteleni lemoto.

src: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
mt: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izimo zeqhwa neqhwa azivamile emazweni amaningi, futhi imoto iqhubeka cishe unyaka wonke.
ref: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izimo zeqhwa noma zesithwathwa zivamile emazweni amaningi, futhi izimoto zihamba ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka cishe unyaka wonke.

src: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
mt: Ama-safaris mhlawumbe ayindawo enkulu kunazo zonke ezokuvakasha e-Afrika futhi ayisiqalo sevakashi eziningi.
ref: Amasafari mhlawumbe yinto enkulu kunazo zonke edonsa izivakashi e-Afrika futhi yinto ethandwa yizivakashi eziningi.

src: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
mt: Igama elithi safari elisetshenziswa kakhulu libhekisela ekuhambeni komhlaba ukubuka izilwane zasendle zase-Afrika ezimangalisayo, ikakhulukazi eSavana.
ref: Igama elithi safari ngokuvamile lisetshenziselwa ukubhekisela ohambweni lokunqamula izwe ukuze ubone izilwane zasendle ezihlaba umxhwele zase-Afrika, ikakhulukazi emathafeni.

src: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
mt: Ezinye izilwane, njengezindlovu nezinyoka, zivame ukusondela eduze nezimoto futhi imishini ejwayelekile izovumela ukubuka kahle.
ref: Ezinye izilwane, njengezindlovu kanye nezindlulamithi, zithanda ukusondela ezimotweni futhi izinto zokubuka ezisezingeni elikahle zizokuvumela ukuthi uzibuke kahle.

src: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
mt: Izingonyama, ama-cheetah nama-leopard ngezinye izikhathi ayaba namahloni futhi uzowabona kangcono ngama- binocular.
ref: Amabhubesi, izingulule kanye nezingwe ziyexwaya futhi uzozibona kangcono ngezingilazi zokubuka kude.

src: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
mt: I-safari ehamba ngezinyawo (ebizwa nangokuthi "i-shush walk", "hiking safari", noma "ukuya ngezinyawo") iqukethe ukuhamba ngezinyawo, kungaba amahora ambalwa noma izinsuku eziningana.
ref: Uhambo lokunqamula izwe lwezinyawo (ebizwa nangokuthi "i-bush walk", "hiking safari", noma "footing") luhlanganisa uhambo olude lwezinyawo, kungaba amahora ambalwa noma izinsuku eziningana.

src: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
mt: Ama-Paralympics azoba khona kusukela ngo-Agasti 24 kuya ku-September 5, 2021. Eminye imicimbi izobanjelwa kwezinye izindawo kulo lonke elaseJapane.
ref: Ama-Paralympic azokwenzeka kusukela ngomhla ka-24 kuNcwaba kuya ku-5 kuMandulo 2021. Ezinye izehlakalo zizobanjelwa kwezinye izindawo eJapani yonke.

src: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
mt: ITokyo iyoba idolobha elilodwa lase-Asia eliye labamba ama-Olympic asehlobo amabili, njengoba lalibamba imidlalo ngo-1964.
ref: ITokyo kuzoba ilona kuphela idolobha lase-Asia eliphathe imidlalo yama-Olimpiki wasehlobo emibili, eliyiphathe ngo-1964.

src: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
mt: Uma ubhalise izindiza zakho nendawo yokuhlala ngo-2020 ngaphambi kokuba kumenyezelwe ukubambezeleka, kungenzeka ube nesimo esiyinselele.
ref: Uma ubhukhe indiza kanye nendawo yokulala ngo-2020 ngaphambi kokuthi kumenyezelwe ukuhlehliswa, ungase ube sesimweni esinzima.

src: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
mt: Izinqubomgomo zokukhansela ziyahlukahluka, kodwa kusukela ngasekupheleni kukaMashi izinqubomgomo eziningi zokukhansela ezisekelwe ku-coronavirus azifiki kuJulayi 2020, lapho ama-Olympic ayehleliwe.
ref: Izinkambiso zokukhansela ziyahluka, kodwa kusukela ngasekupheleni kukaNdasa izinkampiso eziningi zokukhansela ngenxa ye-coronavirus azifiki kuNtulikazi 2020, ngenkathi okwakuhlelwe ngayo ama-Olimpiki.

src: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
mt: Kulindeleke ukuthi amathikithi amaningi emcimbi azobiza phakathi kuka-¥2,500 no-¥130,000, amathikithi avamile abiza cishe u-¥7,000.
ref: Kulindeleke ukuthi amathikithi amaningi womcimbi azobiza phakathi kuka-¥2,500 no-¥130,000, futhi amathikithi avamile abiza u-¥7,000.

src: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
mt: Ukufaka izingubo ezimanzi kungasiza ukuba zomile. Amahhotela amaningi anebhodi lensimbi ne-iron elibolekwayo, ngisho noma lingekho egumbini.
ref: Uku-ayina izingubo ezimanzi kungazisiza zome. Amahhotela amaningi ane-ayini nebhodi yoku-ayina etholakalayo ngokubolekwa, noma ngabe eyodwa ingekho egumbini.

src: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
mt: Uma insimbi ingatholakali, noma uma ungathandi ukugqoka amasokisi anensimbi, ungazama ukusebenzisa isomisi sezinwele, uma sitholakala.
ref: Uma i-ayina ingekho, noma uma ungagqoki amasokisi abizayo a-ayiniwe, ungazama ukusebenzisa umshini wokomisa izinwele, uma ukhona.

src: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
mt: Qaphela ukuthi awuvumeli indwangu ukuba ishise kakhulu (okungase kubangele ukuncipha, noma ezimweni ezimbi kakhulu, ukushisa).
ref: Qaphela ukuba ungavumeli indwangu ukuba ishise kakhulu (okungayenza ukuthi ishwaqe, noma ezimweni ezidlulele, ihamuke).

src: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
mt: Kunezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuhlanza amanzi, ezinye zisebenza kangcono ngokumelene nezinsongo ezithile.
ref: Kunezindlela eziningi zokuhlanza amanzi, ezinye ezisebenza kakhulu ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile eziwusongo.

src: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
mt: Kwezinye izindawo amanzi abilayo angafanele umzuzu owodwa, kwezinye kudingeka imizuzu eminingana.
ref: Kwezinye izindawo ukubilisa amanzi umzuzu kwanele, kwezinye kudingeka imizuzu eminingana.

src: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
mt: Izihlungi ziyahlukahluka ekusebenzeni kwazo, futhi uma unenkinga, kufanele ucabangele ukuthenga amanzi akho ebhodleleni elivaliwe enkampanini enedumela elihle.
ref: Izihlungi ziyahluka ngempumelelo, uma ungaba nokukhathazeka, kumelwe ucabangele ukuthenga amanzi wakho ebhodleni elivaliwe enkampanini ethenjwayo.

src: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
mt: Abahambi bangase babhekane nezilwane ezibulalayo abangazazi ezindaweni zabo.
ref: Izihambi zingahlangabezana nezifo zezilwane ezingazijwaleyanga ezindaweni zangakuzo.

src: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
mt: Izinambuzane zingonakalisa ukudla, zibangele ukucasuka, noma ezimweni ezimbi kakhulu zibangele ukusabela okungokwemvelo, zisakaze ubuthi, noma zidlulisele izifo.
ref: Izilokazane zingakonakalisa ukudla, zicasule, noma okubi nakakhulu zenze kusigulise, zisakaze ubuthi, noma zisakaze izifo.

src: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
mt: Izifo ezithathelwanayo ngokwazo, noma izilwane eziyingozi ezingalimaza noma zibulale abantu ngamandla, ngokuvamile azifaneleki njengezinambuzane.
ref: Izifo ezithelelwanayo ngokwazo, noma izilwane eziyingozi ezingalimaza noma zibulale umuntu ngamandla, azivamile ukufaneleka njengezilwane ezifuywayo.

src: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
mt: Ukuthenga ngaphandle kwemithwalo yentela kuyithuba lokuthenga izimpahla ezingahlawuliswa intela kanye ne-excise ezindaweni ezithile.
ref: Ukuthenga izimpahla ezingakhokhiswa intela kuyithuba lokuthenga izimpahla ezikhishwe izintela kanye nentela yezimpahla ezindaweni ezithile.

src: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
mt: Abahambi abaya emazweni anentela enzima ngezinye izikhathi bangonga imali eningi, ikakhulukazi emikhiqizweni efana neziphuzo ezidakayo nogwayi.
ref: Izihambi eziya emazweni akhokhisa intela ephezulu kwesinye isikhathi zingonga imali eningi, ikakhulukazi emikhiqizweni efana neziphuzo ezidakayo nogwayi.

src: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
mt: Umzila phakathi kwePunt Marion neFairmont uveza izimo eziyinselele kakhulu zokushayela emgwaqeni omkhulu waseBuffalo-Pittsburgh, odlula kaningi endaweni esezindaweni ezihlukanisiwe.
ref: Indawo ephakathi kwe-Point Marion ne-Fairmont yenza izimo zokushayela ezinzima kakhulu eMgwaqweni omkhulu wase-Buffalo-Pittsburgh, odlula njalo ezindaweni ezingenabantu zasemahlathini.

src: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
mt: Uma ungejwayele ukushayela emigwaqweni yasemakhaya, hlala uqaphile: kunamazinga aphezulu, imigwaqo emincane, nemigudu ebukhali.
ref: Uma ungajwayele ukushayela emigwaqweni yasemaphandleni, hlala uphapheme: izindawo eziyimiqansa kakhulu, izindlela eziwungcingo, kanye namajika amabi agcwele.

src: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
mt: Imikhawulo yesivinini esishiwo iphansi kakhulu kunezingxenye zangaphambilini nezingemuva - ngokuvamile 35-40 mph (56-64 km / h) - futhi ukulalela okuqinile kuyo kubaluleke kakhulu kunalokho.
ref: Ukulinganiselwa kwesivinini okusemabhodini kuphansi ngokuphawulekayo kunasezingxenyeni zangaphambili nezilandelayo — ngokuvamile u-35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — futhi ukukunakisisa kubalulekile nakakhulu kunokungakunakisisi.

src: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
mt: Nokho, okuhlaba umxhwele ukuthi insizakalo yocingo lweselula iqinile kakhulu lapha kunakwezinye izindawo eziningi zomzila, isibonelo iPennsylvania Wilds.
ref: Ngokumangazayo, nokho, insiza yefoni ephathekayo inamandla kakhulu lapha kunezindlela eziningi eziningi zomzila, isb. ePennsylvania Wilds.

src: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
mt: Izinkomo zaseJalimane zinhle kakhulu, futhi eBavaria, zinothe kakhulu futhi zihlukahlukene, zifana nalezo zomakhelwane wazo oseningizimu, i-Austria.
ref: Ukudla kwaseJalimane okubhakwayo kuhle empeleni, futhi eBavaria, kunothile futhi kuhlukile, kuyafana nalokho kwasendaweni engumakhelwane engaseningizimu, i-Austria.

src: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
mt: Ama-apples apheka abe ama-cake unyaka wonke, futhi ama-cherry nama-plum abonakala ngesikhathi sasehlobo.
ref: Ukudla okubhakwayo kwezithelo kuvamile, okunama-apula aphekwayo afakwa ezintweni ezibhakwayo unyaka wonke, kanye nama-cherry namapulamu evela ngehlobo.

src: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
mt: Izitsha eziningi zokupheka zaseJalimane nazo zinamandongomane, ama-hazelnut namanye ama-nut. Amakhekhe athandwayo ngokuvamile ahambisana kahle kakhulu nekhofi eqinile.
ref: Okuningi kokudla kwaseJalimane okubhakiwe kubuye kube nama-almondi, izindlubu zomhezela, kanye nezinye izindlubu zemithi. Amakhekhe athandwayo avame ukuhambisana kahle kakhulu nenkomishi yekhofi enamandla.

src: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
mt: Uma ufuna ukudla okuncane kodwa okunomsoco, zama lokho okubizwa ngokuthi iBerliner, i-Pfannkuchen noma i-Krapfen kuye ngendawo.
ref: Uma ufuna uphayi omncane kodwa onothile, zama lokho okubizwa kuye ngendawo ngokuthi iBerliner, iPfannkuchen noma iKrapfen.

src: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
mt: I-curry yindawo esekelwe emithini nezinongo, kanye nenyama noma imifino.
ref: Ukhari yisidlo esisuselwa kumakhambi nezinongo, kuhlanganiswe ndawonye mhlawumbe nenyama noma imifino.

src: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
mt: I-curry ingaba "omile" noma "omanzi" kuye ngokuthi ingakanani uketshezi.
ref: Ukhari ungaba “manzi” noma “wome” kuya ngesikali samanzi.

src: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
mt: Ezindaweni zasenyakatho yeNdiya nasePakistan, ijogathi livame ukusetshenziswa kuma-curry; eningizimu yeNdiya nakwezinye izindawo ezisogwini lwezwekazi, ubisi lukakhokho livame ukusetshenziswa.
ref: Izindawo ezimaphakathi nezwe zaseNyakatho yeNdiya nePakistan, iyogathi ivamise ukusetshenziswa ezitshuliwni; eNingizimu neNdiya kanye nasezindaweni ezinye ezisogwini zezwekazi, ubisi lukakhukhunathi luvamise ukusetshenziswa.

src: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
mt: Njengoba kunezindawo eziyisiqhingi ezingu-17,000 ongakhetha kuzo, ukudla kwase-Indonesia kuyinkulumo evamile ehlanganisa ukudla okuhlukahlukene kwesifunda okutholakala ezweni lonke.
ref: Ngeziqhingi ezingu-17,000 ongakhetha kuzo, ukudla kwase-Indonesia igama elihlanganisa izinhlobo eziningi zokudlwa kwendawo okutholakala ezweni lonke.

src: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
mt: Kodwa, uma kusetshenziswa ngaphandle kweminye imfanelo, leli gama livame ukusho ukudla okuvela ezingxenyeni eziphakathi nezisempumalanga zesiqhingi esikhulu iJava.
ref: Kodwa, uma lisetshenziswa ngaphandle kwenye incazelo, igama livame ukusho ukudla ekuqaleni okusuka ezingxenyeni ezimaphakathi kanye nezisempumalanga yesiqhingi esiyinhloko iJava.

src: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
mt: Manje isutholakala kabanzi kulo lonke iziqhingi, ukudla kwaseJava kunhlobonhlobo yezitsha ezilula, ukunambitheka okuyinhloko okuthandwa abantu baseJava okuyi- peanuts, ama-chilli, ushukela (ikakhulukazi ushukela kakhukhunathi waseJava) nezinongo ezihlukahlukene ezinuka kamnandi.
ref: Manje okutholakala kabanzi eqoqweni leziqhingi lonke, ukudla kwaseJava kuhlanganisa izinhlobonhlobo zokudla okunongwe kalula, lapho isinongo esivelele kubantu baseJava kungamantongomane, upelepele, ushukela (ikakhulukazi ushukela waseJava kakhukhunathi) kanye nezinye izinongo ezinamakha.

src: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
mt: Ama-stirrups ayimikhono yomgibeli ehlezi ohlangothini ngalunye lwesilo.
ref: Izitibili izinto zokusekela izinyawo zomgibeli ezilenga ezingxenyeni zonke zesihlalo sehhashi.

src: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
mt: Zinikeza ukuzinza okukhulu kumgibeli kodwa zingaba nezinkinga zokuphepha ngenxa yamandla ezinyawo zomgibeli ukuba ziminyene kuzo.
ref: Zinikeza ukuzinza emgibelini kodwa zingaba nezinkinga zokuphepha ngenxa yamathuba okuba izinyawo zomgibeli zibhajwe kuzo.

src: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
mt: Uma umgibeli ephonswa ehashini kodwa unyawo olungaphansi kwesitayela, angase adudwe uma ihhashi ebaleka. Ukuze kuncishiswe le ngozi, kungathathwa izinyathelo eziningi zokuphepha.
ref: Uma umgibeli ewiswa yihashi kodwa unyawo lwakhe lubambeke esitibilini, angahuduleka uma ihhashi libaleka. Ukunciphisa lengozi, izinyathelo ezimbalwa zokuphepha zingathathwa.

src: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
mt: Okokuqala, abagibeli abaningi bagqoka izicathulo zokugibela ezinesithende kanye nesondo elibushelelezi, eliwumshoshaphansi impela.
ref: Okokuqala, abagibeli abaningi bagqoka amabhuzi okugibela anesithende kanye nesoli ebushelelezi, elincane kakhulu.

src: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
mt: Okulandelayo, amanye amasela, ikakhulukazi amasela esiNgisi, anezibopho zokuzivikela ezivumela isikhumba esiphundu ukuba siwele phansi uma sidonswa emuva ngumgibeli owayo.
ref: Okulandelayo, ezinye izihlalo zehhashi, ngokukhethekile izihlalo zamaNgisi, zinezinsimbi zokuphepha ezivumela isikhumba sesitibili ukuba siwe esihlalweni lapho isihlalo sidonswelwa emuva umgibeli owayo.

src: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
mt: I-Cochamó Valley - Indawo ehamba phambili yokukhuphuka eChile, eyaziwa ngokuthi i-Yosemite yaseNingizimu Melika, enamagceke amakhulu e-granite namatshe ahlukahlukene.
ref: I-Cochamo Valley – indawo eyinhloko abaqhwali abafuna ukufika kuyo e-Chile, yaziwa nangokuthi i-Yosemite yaseNingizimu Melika, enezinhlobo ezihlukahlukene zezindonga ezinkulu ezakhiwe nge-granite kanye nemisele.

src: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
mt: Izingqungquthela zihlanganisa imibono ethakazelisayo evela eziqhingini. Abagibeli abavela kuzo zonke izingxenye zomhlaba baqhubeka nokusungula izindlela ezintsha phakathi kwamandla awo angenamkhawulo ezindonga.
ref: Iziqongo zihlanganisa izindawo zokubona izindawo ezinhle kakhulu ezihlokweni. Abagibeli abavela kuzo zonke izingxenye zomhlaba bayaqhubeka ngokuthola imizila emisha phakathi kwezindawo ezingapheli ezingaba izindonga.

src: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
mt: Imidlalo ye-snow-hill, ehlanganisa ukugibela ama-ski nokugibela ama-snowboard, imidlalo ethandwayo ehlanganisa ukugibela phansi endaweni embozwe yiqhwa ngama-ski noma i-snowboard ehlezi ezinyaweni zakho.
ref: Imidlalo yeqhwa ekwehleni, ehlanganisa ukushushuluza eqhweni ne-snowboarding, imidlalo edumile ehlanganisa ukuslayida phansi endaweni embozwe yiqhwa ngama-skis noma ibhodi leqhwa elinamathiselwe ezinyaweni zakho.

src: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
mt: Ukugibela ama-ski kungumsebenzi omkhulu wokuhamba nabantu abaningi abanentshisekelo, ngezinye izikhathi abaziwa ngokuthi "ama-ski bums", abahlela amaholide aphelele okugibela ama-ski endaweni ethile.
ref: Ukushushuluza eqhweni umsebenzi omkhulu wokuhamba onabashisekeli abaningi, kwezinye izikhathi abaziwa ngokuthi ama-"ski bums," abahlela ukuvakasha konke ukuze bashushuluze eqhweni endaweni ethile.

src: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
mt: Umqondo wokushushuluza ungowasendulo kakhulu - imidwebo yamagwadule ebonisa abashushuluzi isukela ku-5000 BC!
ref: Umcabango wokushushuluza eqhweni owakudala kakhulu — imidwebo yasemihumeni eveza abashushuluzi baseqhweni ihlehlela emuva ku-5000 BC!

src: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
mt: Ukugibela phansi njengendlela yokugibela kuqala okungenani ngekhulu le-17, futhi ngo-1861 iqembu lokuqala lokuzijabulisa lokugibela ku-ski lavulwa abantu baseNorway e-Australia.
ref: Ukushushuluza eqhweni wehla entabeni njengomhlalo kuhlehlela emuva okungenani ekhulwini lama-17 leminyaka, futhi ngo-1861 iqembu lokushushuluza eqhweni kokuzilibazisa lavulwa abantu baseNorway e-Australia.

src: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
mt: Ukuhamba ngesikhi: Lo msebenzi ubizwa nangokuthi ukugibela emuva, ukugibela iski noma ukuhamba ngesikhi.
ref: Ukushushuluza eqhweni ngesikhwama: Lokhu kubuye kubizwe ngokuthi ukushushuluza eqhweni emaphandleni, ukubona indawo ngokushushulaza eqhweni kanye nokushushuluza eqhweni kokuqwala izintaba.

src: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
mt: Kuhlobene kodwa ngokuvamile akubandakanyi ukuhamba nge-ski yesitayela se-alpine noma ukugibela izintaba, lokhu kokugcina okwenziwa endaweni enqamukile futhi okudinga ama-ski namabhuti aqinile kakhulu.
ref: Kuhlobene kodwa akuhlanganisi isitayela se-alpine sokuvakasha noma ukuqwala izintaba, okwenziwe abanye kamuva ezindaweni ezingamawa futhi ezidinga izinduku zokuhamba eqhweni eziqinile kakhudlwana kanye namabhuthi.

src: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
mt: Cabanga ngomzila wokushushuluza njengendlela efanayo yokuhamba ngezinyawo.
ref: Cabanga ngendlela yokushushuluza eqhweni njengendlela efanayo yokuqwala izintaba.

src: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
mt: Ezimweni ezinhle uzokwazi ukuhamba amabanga amakhulu kunokuhamba ngezinyawo kodwa kuncane kakhulu ukuthi uzothola isivinini sokushushuluza izwe ngaphandle kwesikhwama esindayo emigwaqweni elungisiwe.
ref: Ezimweni ezinhle uzokwazi ukuhamba cishe ibanga elide kunokuhamba ngezinyawo – kodwa ngokwethukela okukhulu kuphela ungathola isivinini sokushushuluza eqhweni ezindaweni ezingajwayelekile ngaphandle kwesikhwama esisindayo emizileni elungisiwe.

src: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
mt: IYurophu izwekazi elincane kodwa elinabantu abaningi abazimele. Ezimweni ezivamile, ukuhamba emazweni amaningi kuzodingeka kudlule izicelo zama-visa kanye nokuhlolwa kwamaphasiphothi kaningi.
ref: IYurophu izwekali elincane ngokwesilinganiso kodwa elinamazwe amaningi azimele. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezivamile, ukuthatha uhambo emazweni amaningana kungasho ukubhalisela i-visa kanye nokudlula lapho kuhlolwa khona amaphasiphoti kaningana.

src: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
mt: Nokho, i-Schengen zone isebenza njengelinye izwe kulokhu.
ref: Indawo yaseSchengen, nokho, isebenza ngandlelathile njengezwe elilodwa kulokhu.

src: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
mt: Uma nje uhlala kule ndawo, ngokuvamile ungangena emingceleni ngaphandle kokuphinda udlule ezindaweni zokuhlola amapasipoti.
ref: Uma nje uhlala kulendawo, ngokuvamile ungeqa imingcele ngaphandle kokuba kuhlolwe iphasiphothi yakho futhi.

src: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
mt: Ngokufanayo, ngokuba ne-visa ye-Schengen, awudingi ukufaka isicelo se-visa kuwo wonke amazwe angamalungu e-Schengen ngokwehlukana, ngaleyo ndlela wonge isikhathi, imali kanye namaphepha.
ref: Ngokufanayo, ngokuba ne-visa ye-Schengen, awudingi ukubhalisela i-visa yezwe ngalinye ngokuhlukile kulawo angamalungu e-Shengen, okonga isikhathi, imali kanye nomsebenzi wokugcwalisa amafomu.

src: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
mt: Ayikho incazelo evamile yokuthi izinto ezenziwe zenziwe yini njengezinto zakudala. Ezinye izinhlangano zentela zichaza izimpahla ezindala eminyakeni engaphezu kwengu-100 njengezinto zakudala.
ref: Ayikho neze incazelo ekhona yokuthi lemikhiqizo eyenziwe kwabe kungeyakudala. Izinhlangano zentela zichaza izinto esezidlulelwe yiminyaka engu-100 njengama gugu.

src: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
mt: Incazelo inokwehlukahluka kwendawo, lapho umkhawulo weminyaka yobudala ungaba mfushane ezindaweni ezifana neNyakatho Melika kunaseYurophu.
ref: Incazelo inokwehluka kwendawo, lapho isilinganiso sobudala singaba sifishane ezindaweni ezinjengaseNyakatho Melika kunaseYurophu.

src: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
mt: Imikhiqizo yezandla ingase ichazwe njengezinto zakudala, nakuba ineminyaka emincane kunezimpahla ezifanayo ezikhiqizwa ngobuningi.
ref: Imikhiqizo yezandla ingahle ichazwe njengezinto zakudala, nakuba imincane kunempahla efanaya ekhiqizwa ngobuningi.

src: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
mt: Ukufuya izinkabi kuyindlela ebalulekile yokuphila phakathi kwabantu baseSami futhi isiko elizungeze lo msebenzi libalulekile futhi kwabaningi abaneminye imisebenzi.
ref: Ukufuya ama-reindeer indlela ebalulekile yokuziphilisa phakathi kwamaSámi futhi isiko elizungeze lomsebenzi libalulekile futhi nakwabanye abaneminye imisebenzi.

src: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
mt: Ngisho nangokwesiko, noma kunjalo, akubona bonke abantu baseSami ababesebenza ekufuyeni izinkawu ezinkulu, kodwa babephila ngokudoba, ukuzingela nokunye okufana nalokhu, benenkawu ikakhulukazi njengezilwane ezihamba ngezinyawo.
ref: Ngisho nangokwesiko, nokho, akuwona wonke amaSámi ayehlanganyele ngokugcwele ekufuyeni izinyamazane, kodwa ayephila ngokudoba, ukuzingela nokufanayo, besebenzisa izinyamazane njengezilwane eziboshelwayo.

src: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
mt: Namuhla abantu abaningi baseSami basebenza emisebenzi yesimanje. Ezokuvakasha ziyimali ebalulekile eSápmi, endaweni yamaSami.
ref: Namuhla abaningi abantu bama-Sámi abasebenza kwezohwebo zesimanje. Ezokuvakasha ngumholo obalulekile e-Sápmi, endaweni yama-Sámi.

src: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
mt: Nakuba lisetshenziswa kabanzi, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abangewona amaRoma, igama elithi "i-Gypsy" ngokuvamile libhekwa njengelinyazisayo ngenxa yokuhlangana kwalo nemibono emibi kanye nemibono engaqondile yabantu abangamaRoma.
ref: Nakuba lisetshenziswa kabanzi, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abangewona amaRomany, igama elithi "Gypsy" kaningi lithathwa njengelokwedelela ngenxa yokuhlanganiswa kwalo nezinto ezimbi eziyiphutha ezishiwo abanye kanye nemibono enganembile ngabantu bamaRomany.

src: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
mt: Uma izwe ozolivakashela lingaphansi kweseluleko sokuhamba, umshwalense wakho wezempilo wokuhamba noma umshwalense wakho wokukhansela uhambo ungathinteka.
ref: Uma izwe ozolivakashela lithola izixwayiso zokuphepha ezingokomthetho, umshwalense wakho wohambo wempilo noma umshwalense wakho wokukhansela uhambo ungathinteka.

src: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
mt: Ungase futhi uthande ukubheka izeluleko zikahulumeni ngaphandle kwakho, kodwa izeluleko zabo zenzelwe izakhamuzi zabo.
ref: Ungafisa nokuhlola izeluleko zohulumeni ngaphandle kowakho, kodwa izeluleko ziklanyelwe izakhamuzi zawo.

src: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
mt: Isibonelo esisodwa, izakhamizi zaseMelika eMiddle East zingase zibhekane nezimo ezihlukile kuneYurophu noma ama-Arabhu.
ref: Ngengesibonelo esisodwa, izakhamuzi zaseMelika eMpumalanga Ephakathi zingabhekana nezimo ezihlukile kunalezo zaseYurophu noma e-Arabiya.

src: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
mt: Izeluleko ziwumbiko nje omfushane wesimo sezombusazwe ezweni elilodwa.
ref: Izeluleko zimane ziyisifinyezo esifishane sesimo sezepolotiki ezweni elilodwa.

src: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
mt: Imibono enikeziwe ngokuvamile ayisiyongqondo, iqondene nabo bonke futhi ilula ngokweqile uma iqhathaniswa nemininingwane eningiliziwe etholakala kwenye indawo.
ref: Imibono eveziwe ngokuvamile eyokudlulisa amahlo, evamile kanye nelula kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nokwaziswa okuningiliziwe okutholakala kwezinye izindawo.

src: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
mt: Isimo sezulu esibi yigama elivamile kunoma yisiphi isimo sezulu esiyingozi esingenakubangela umonakalo, ukuphazamiseka okukhulu komphakathi, noma ukulahlekelwa ukuphila kwabantu.
ref: Isimo sezulu esibi kumane kuyigama elilula elisho isimo sezulu esiyingozi esinamandla okudala umonakalo, ukuphazamiseka kwangempela kwenhlalakahle, noma ukufa kwabantu.

src: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
mt: Isimo sezulu esibi singenzeka noma kuphi emhlabeni, futhi kunezinhlobo ezahlukahlukene zaso, ezingathembela endaweni, endaweni, nezimo zomoya.
ref: Isimo sezulu esibi kakhulu singenzeka noma kuphi emhlabeni, futhi kunezinhlobo ezihlukile zaso, ezingaxhomeka ekumeni kwezwe, esimweni sendawo, kanye nezimo emkhathini.

src: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
mt: Imimoya enamandla, iqhwa, imvula eyengeziwe, nemililo yamahlathi kuyizinhlobo nemiphumela yesimo sezulu esibi, njengoba kunjalo ngesivunguvungu, iziphepho, ukuchitheka kwamanzi, neziphepho.
ref: Imimoya ephakeme, isangqotho, isimo sezulu esidlulele, kanye nemililo yasendle ziwuhlobo nomphumela wesimo sezulu esibi kakhulu, kanjalo neziphepho, izivunguvungu, izishomo zamanzi amuncwa yisivunguvungu, kanye nezihlwithi.

src: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
mt: Izimo zezulu ezibucayi zesifunda nezesizini zihlanganisa iziphepho zeqhwa, iziphepho zeqhwa, iziphepho zeqhwa, neziphepho zothuli.
ref: Izimo zezulu ezimbi zasendaweni nezenkathi ethile zihlanganisa iziphepho ezinkulu zeqhwa, izivunguvungu zeqhwa, isichotho, kanye nezivunguvungu ezinothuli.

src: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
mt: Abahambi belulekwa kakhulu ukuba bazi noma iyiphi ingozi yesimo sezulu esibi esithinta indawo yabo njengoba singathinta noma yiziphi izinhlelo zohambo.
ref: Izihambi ziyalulekwa ngokuqinile ukuthi ziqaphele noma iyiphi ingozi yesimo sezulu esibi kakhulu esithinta indawo yazo njengoba singathinta noma yiziphi izinhlelo zohambo.

src: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
mt: Noma ubani ohlela ukuvakashela izwe elingase libhekwe njengendawo yempi kufanele athole ukuqeqeshwa kochwepheshe.
ref: Noma ubani ohlela ukuvakashela izwe elizobhekwa njengesizinda sempi kumelwe athole ukuqeqeshwa okukhethekile.

src: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
mt: Ukusesha ku-Inthanethi 'isifundo semvelo enobutha' cishe kuzonikeza ikheli lenkampani yendawo.
ref: Usesho kuyi-inthanethi 'kwezifundo zemvelo enobuth'" cishe luzonikeza ikheli lenkampani yasendaweni.

src: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
mt: Ngokuvamile inkambo izohlanganisa zonke izindaba ezixoxwa lapha ngokuningiliziwe okukhulu, ngokuvamile ngolwazi olusebenzayo.
ref: Isifundo ngokuvamile sizohlanganisa zonke izindaba okuxoxwe ngazo lapha ngokujulile, ngokuvamile ngendlela yokukusebenzisa engokoqobo.

src: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
mt: Ngokuvamile inkambo izoba izinsuku ezingu-2-5 futhi izobandakanya ukudlala indima, usizo lokuqala oluningi futhi ngezinye izikhathi ukuqeqeshwa kwezikhali.
ref: Inkambo izohamba ngokujwayelekile kusukela ezinsukwini ezingu-2-5 futhi izobandakanya imidlalo yokulingisa, insiza yezimo eziphuthumayo eningi futhi kwesinye isikhathi ukuqeqeshwa ekusebenziseni izikhali ..

src: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
mt: Izincwadi nomagazini ababhekisela ekusindeni ezindaweni zasendle zivamile, kodwa izincwadi eziphathelene nezindawo zempi zimbalwa.
ref: Izincwadi nomagazini abakhuluma ngokuphila endle zivamile, kodwa izincwadi ezikhuluma ngezindawo zezimpi zimbalwa.

src: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
mt: Abahambi abahlelela ukuhlinzwa ngokuguqulwa kocansi phesheya kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi baphethe imibhalo efanele yohambo lokubuya.
ref: Izihambi ezihamba ngemikhumbi ezihlele ukushintsha ubulili bazo ngokuhlinzwa phesheya kwezilwandle kumelwe ziqinisekise ukuthi ziphethe amaphepha afanele ohambo lokubuya.

src: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
mt: Ukuzimisela kohulumeni ukukhishwa kwamaphasiphothi anobulili obungachaziwe (X) noma amadokhumende abuyekeziwe ukuze ahambisane negama kanye nobulili obufunwayo kuyahluka.
ref: Ukuvuma kohulumeni ukuthi anikeze abantu amaphasiphothi angavezi ubulili (X) noma amaphepha abuyekeziwe ukuthi afane negama elithandwayo kanye nokuhluka kobulili.

src: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
mt: Ukuzimisela kohulumeni bangaphandle ukuhlonipha le mibhalo kuyahlukahluka kakhulu.
ref: Ukuzimisela kohulumeni bangaphandle ukuhlonipha lamaphepha kungokuguquguqukayo.

src: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
mt: Ukuseshwa ezindaweni zokuhlola ezokuphepha nakho sekuyisikhathi esinzima kakhulu ngemva kukaSeptemba 11, 2001.
ref: Ukusesha ezindaweni zokuhlola sekube okuxhantelayo kakhulu enkathini yangemva kuka-2001, NgoMandulo 11.

src: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
mt: Abantu abaguqukile bobulili ngaphambi kokuhlinzwa akufanele balindele ukudlula kuma-scanner benobumfihlo babo nesithunzi sabo singalinyaziwe.
ref: Abantu abazohlinzwa ukuze bashintshe ubulili babo akufanele balindele ukuthi bazodlula kumasikena ngobumfihlo babo nangesithunzi sabo sisaqinile.

src: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
mt: Imikhumbi ye-ripp iyindlela yokubuya kwamagagasi aphuma ogwini, ngokuvamile endaweni enesihlabathi noma efanayo.
ref: Imisinga yokuqhuma kungukugeleza okubuyayo okuvela emagagasini aqhamuka olwandle, ngokuvamile emadwaleni noma kokuthi akufane.

src: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
mt: Ngenxa yokwakheka komhlaba ngaphansi kwamanzi ukugeleza okubuyayo kugxile ezigabeni ezimbalwa ezijulile, futhi kungakhishwa ugesi osheshayo oya emanzini ajulile lapho.
ref: Ngenxa yethopholoji yangaphansi kwamanzi ukugeleza okubuyayo kugxile ezingxenyeni ezimbalwa ezijulile, futhi umsinga osheshayo emanzini ajulile ungakheka lapho.

src: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
mt: Ukufa okuningi kwenzeka ngenxa yokukhathala okuzama ukubhukuda emuva maqondana nomfudlana, okungenzeka kungenzeki.
ref: Ukufa okuningi kwenzeka ngenxa yokukhathala kokuzama ukubhukuda uya emuva ngokuphambene nomsinga, okungaba yinto engenakwenzeka.

src: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
mt: Uma usuphume emfudlaneni, ukubhukuda emuva akulula kunokujwayelekile.
ref: Ngokushesha ngemva kokuba uphuma emsingeni wamanzi, ukubhukudela emuva akusabi nzima ngokuvamile.

src: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
mt: Zama ukuqondisa endaweni lapho ungeke uphinde ubanjwe khona noma, kuye ngamakhono akho nokuthi ngabe uphawulwe yini, ungase ufune ukulinda ukuze usindiswe.
ref: Zama ukuqonda lapho ungabambekile khona futhi noma, kuye ngamakhono akho nokuthi uphawuliwe yini, ungathanda ukulinda ukutakulwa.

src: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
mt: Ukushaqeka kokungena kabusha kuza ngokushesha kunokushaqeka kwamasiko (kunesigaba esincane sezinyanga zobulili), kuthathe isikhathi eside, futhi kungaba nzima kakhulu.
ref: Ukuthuka ngoba usekhaya kuza kuqala kunalokho kuthuka okwenzeka uma uvakashele endaweni ongayazi (kunesigaba esincane se-honeymoon), kuthathe isikhathi, futhi kungaya ngokuya kwande.

src: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
mt: Abahambi ababenesikhathi esilula sokujwayela isiko elisha ngezinye izikhathi kuba nzima kakhulu ukujwayela isiko labo lendabuko.
ref: Izihambi ezikuthole kulula ukujwayela isiko elisha kwesinye isikhathi zikuthola kunzima ukujwayela isiko lazo lendabuko futhi.

src: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
mt: Lapho ubuyela ekhaya ngemva kokuhlala phesheya, uye wajwayela isiko elisha futhi walahlekelwa ezinye zezimiso zakho zamasiko asekhaya.
ref: Lapho ubuyela ekhaya usuka phesheya, kuzodingeka ujwayele isiko elisha neminye yemikhuba yakho oyilahlile kusukela ezweni lakini.

src: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
mt: Lapho uqala ukuya phesheya, abantu cishe babekezela futhi beqondana, bazi ukuthi abahambi ezweni elisha kudingeka bazivumelanise.
ref: Lapho uya phesheya okokuqala, abantu kungenzeka ukuthi babebekezela futhi beqonda, bazi ukuthi izivakashi uma zifika ezweni elisha zidinga ukujwayela.

src: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
mt: Abantu bangase bangalindele ukuthi ukubekezela nokuqonda kuyadingeka futhi kubavakashi ababuyela ekhaya.
ref: Abantu kungezeka bangalindeli ukuthi ukulinda kanye nokuqonda nakho kubalulekile ezivakashini ezibuyela ekhaya.

src: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
mt: Umbukiso wezwi nokukhanya kwe-pyramid ungenye yezinto ezithakazelisa kakhulu kule ndawo ezinganeni.
ref: Umbukiso onxa-ntathu womsindo nokukhanya ungenye yezinto ezithakazelisayo endaweni yezingane.

src: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
mt: Ungabona amaphiramidi ebumnyameni futhi ungawabona ethule ngaphambi kokuba kuqale umbukiso.
ref: Ungabona imibhoshongo enxa-ntathu ebumnyameni futhi ungawabona lapho kuthulile ngaphambi kokuqala kombukiso.

src: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
mt: Ngokuvamile uhlala lapha umsindo wabavakashi nabathengisi. Indaba yomsindo nokukhanya ifana nencwadi yezindaba.
ref: Ngokuvamile njalo lapha umsindo izivakashi kanye nabathengisi. Indaba yomsindo nokukhanya ifana nencwadi yezindaba.

src: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
mt: I-Sphinx isethwe njengesimo sangemuva nomxoxi wezindaba ezinde.
ref: ISphinx isethwe njengesigcawu nomlandisi wendaba ende.

src: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
mt: Izithombe ziboniswa emapiramidini futhi amapiramidi ahlukahlukene akhanyisiwe.
ref: Izigcawu zikhonjiswa kumaphiramidi kanti amaphiramidi ahlukahlukene akhanyisiwe.

src: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
mt: Iziqhingi zaseSouth Shetland, ezatholakala ngo-1819, zibizwa izizwe eziningana futhi zinamasisekelo amaningi, ezineshumi nesithupha ezisebenzayo ngo-2020.
ref: Iziqhingi zaseSouth Shetland, ezitholwe ngo-1819, zinezizwe eziningi ezithi ziwela kuzo futhi zinezikhungo eziningi, eziyishumi nesishiyagalolunye ezisebenzayo ngo-2020.

src: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
mt: Iziqhingi zisezingeni elingamakhilomitha angu-120 enyakatho yeNhlonhlo. Esikhulu kunazo zonke yiKing George Island enendawo yokuhlala yaseVilla Las Estrellas.
ref: I-archipelago isendaweni eqhele ngamakhilomitha angu-120 enyakatho yeNhlonhlo. Enkulu kuwo i-King George enendawo e-Villa Las Estrellas.

src: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
mt: Ezinye zihlanganisa iLivingston Island, neDeception lapho i-caldera egcwala amanzi yentaba-mlilo esasebenza inikeza khona itheku lemvelo elimangalisayo.
ref: Okunye kuhlanganisa isiqhingi seLivingston, kanye neDeception lapho imbobo enkulu egcwele udaka lwentabamlilo esaphuquka umlilo yenza itheku elimangalisayo elingokwemvelo.

src: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
mt: I-Ellsworth Land iyisifunda esiseningizimu yeNhlonhlo, esilinganiswe uLwandle lwaseBellingshausen.
ref: IZwe lase-Ellsworth liyindawo eseningizimu neNhlonhlo, likhawuliswe uLwandle iBellingshausen.

src: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
mt: Izintaba zePeninsula lapha zihlanganiswa endaweni enesiqongo, bese ziphinde zivela ukuze zakhe uchungechunge lwamakhilomitha angu-360 lwezintaba zase-Ellsworth, oluhlukaniswe yi-Minnesota Glacier.
ref: Izintaba zeNhlonhlo lapha zihlangana ethafeni, bese ziphinde ziqhamuke ukuze zenze uchungechunge lwe-360 km lwezintaba zase-Ellsworth, ezihlukaniswe kabili yi-Minnesota Glacier.

src: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
mt: Ingxenye esenyakatho noma i-Sentinel Range inezintaba eziphakeme kakhulu e-Antarctica, i-Vinson Massif, ephakeme ngamamitha angu-4892 i-Mount Vinson.
ref: Ingxenye engasenyakatho noma iSentinel Range inezintaba eziphakeme kunazo zonke zase-Antarctica, iVinson Massif, ephakeme yaba ngu-4892 m Mount Vinson.

src: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
mt: Ezindaweni ezikude, ngaphandle kokufakwa komakhalekhukhwini, kungenzeka ukuthi ucingo lwesathelayithi luyindlela yakho kuphela.
ref: Ezindaweni ezikude, ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi yefoni esebenzayo, ucingo lwesathelayithi lungaba yiyo kuphela into ongayisebenzisa.

src: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
mt: Ucingo lwe-satellite ngokuvamile aluyona into ezongena esikhundleni se-mobile, njengoba kufanele ube ngaphandle unombono ocacile we-satellite ukuze wenze ucingo.
ref: Ucingo lwesathelayithi ngokuvamile ayithatheli ifoni ephathwayo indawo, njengoba kudingeka ube ngaphandle uqondene nesiphuphutheki ukuze ushaye ucingo.

src: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
