mt: Le nkonzo ivame ukusetshenziswa yizimpahla, kufaka phakathi izikebhe zokuzijabulisa, kanye nokuhanjiswa kwabantu abanezidingo zedatha nezwi elikude.
ref: Isevisi isetshenziswa kaningi yimikhumbi, kubandakanya umsebenzi wobungcweti, kanye nohambo olunezidingo zedatha nezwi elikude.

src: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
mt: Umhlinzeki wakho wocingo lwasendaweni kufanele akwazi ukunikeza ulwazi olwengeziwe mayelana nokuxhuma kulesi sikhungo.
ref: Inkampani yezingcingo yangakini kumelwe ikwazi ukukunikeza imininingwane engeziwe mayelana nokuxhuma kulolu hlelo.

src: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
mt: Inketho ethandwa kakhulu kulabo abahlela unyaka we-gap-year ukuhamba nokufunda.
ref: Indlela ethandwayo ekhulayo yalabo abahlela ukuthatha unyaka wokuphumula ekufundeni ukuthatha uhambo nokufunda.

src: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
mt: Lokhu kuthandwa kakhulu yilabo abaphuma esikoleni, kubavumela ukuba bathathe unyaka ngaphambi kokuba baqale eyunivesithi, ngaphandle kokuphazamisana nemfundo yabo.
ref: Lokhu kuthandwa kakhulu abaqeda isikole, okubavumela ukuthi bathathe unyaka ngaphambi kwenyuvesi, ngaphandle kokuyekethisa imfundo yabo.

src: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
mt: Ezimweni eziningi, ukubhalisa izifundo zonyaka we-gap-year phesheya kwezilwandle empeleni kungathuthukisa amathuba akho okuya emfundweni ephakeme ezweni lakini.
ref: Ezimweni eziningi, ukubhalisa esifundweni sonyaka wokuphumula ngemva kwesikole kwelinye izwe empeleni kuthuthukisa amathuba akho okuya emfundweni ephakeme emuva ezweni lakini.

src: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
mt: Ngokuvamile kuzoba nemali yokufunda ukuze ubhalise kulezi zinhlelo zemfundo.
ref: Ngokujwayelekile kuzoba nemali yokukhokhela izifundo yokubhalisa kulezi zinhelo zemfundo.

src: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
mt: IFinland iyindawo enkulu yokushushumbisa ngesikebhe. "Izwe lamachibi ayinkulungwane" linezinkulungwane zeziqhingi, emachibi naseziqhingini ezisogwini.
ref: IFinland indawo ekahle yokuhamba ngesikebhe. "iLake of a thousand lakes" ineziqhingi eziyizinkulungwane futhi, emachibini kanye nasemaqoqweni eziqhingi ezingasogwini.

src: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
mt: Ezithunzini namachibi awudingi ngempela isikebhe.
ref: Edlanzaneni leziqhingi nasemachibini awudingi isikebhe.

src: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
mt: Nakuba iziqhingi ezisogwini namachibi amakhulu ngempela mancane ngokwanele ukuba angahlala kuyo noma yiliphi i-yacht, izikebhe ezincane noma ngisho ne-kayak zinikeza okuhlangenwe nakho okuhlukile.
ref: Yize iziqhingi ezingasogwini kanye namachibi amakhulu kunawo wonke emakhulu ngokwanele ukuthwala noma imuphi umkhumbi kanokusho, izikebhe ezincane noma ngisho ne-kayak inikeza okwenzekayo okuhlukile.

src: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
mt: Ukuhamba ngesikebhe kuyindlela yokuzilibazisa kazwelonke eFinland, lapho isikebhe sifinyelela khona abantu abayisikhombisa noma abayisishiyagalombili.
ref: Ukuhamba ngezikebhe indlela yokuzilibazisa yezwe eFinland, ngesikebhe kubantu abayisikhombisa noma abayisishiyagalombili.

src: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
mt: Lokhu kufaniswa neNorway, iSweden neNew Zealand, kodwa ngenye indlela okuyingqayizivele (isib. eNetherlands isibalo singu-1 kuya kwamashumi amane).
ref: Lokhu kufana ne-Norway, i-Sweden kanye neNyuzilandi, kodwa ngaphandle kwalokho kuhlukile ngempela (isib. eNetherlands isibalo okukodwa kuya kwezingamashumi amane).

src: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
mt: Iningi le-Baltic Cruises ehlukile lihlala isikhathi eside eSt. Petersburg, eRussia.
ref: Iningi lweMikhumbi yokuVakasha yase-Baltic ehlukile ihlanganisa ukuhlala isikhathi eside e-St. Petersburg, e-Russia.

src: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
mt: Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungavakashela idolobha elinomlando izinsuku ezimbalwa ngokugcwele ngenkathi ubuya futhi ulale emkhunjini ebusuku.
ref: Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungavakashela idolobha elingokomlando izinsuku ezimbalwa ezigcwele ube ubuyela futhi ulala emkhumbini ebusuku.

src: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
mt: Uma uya ogwini usebenzisa kuphela uhambo ngomkhumbi ngeke udinge i-visa ehlukile (kusukela ngo-2009).
ref: Uma uya ogwini kuphela usebenzisa uhambo lomkhumbi olufishane angeke udinge i-visa ehlukile (kusukela ngo-2009).

src: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
mt: Ezinye izinkambo ze-cruise zine-Berlin, eJalimane ezincwadini. Njengoba ubona kumephu engenhla kweBerlin ayikho indawo eseduze nolwandle futhi ukuvakashela idolobha akuhlanganisiwe entengweni ye-cruise.
ref: Eminye imikhumbi yokuvakasha iveza i-Berlin, eseJalimane ezincwajaneni zayo. Njengoba ubona ebalazweni ngenhla i-Berlin ikude kakhulu nolwandle futhi ukuvakashela idolobha akuhlanganisiwe enanini lomkhumbi wokuvakasha.

src: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
mt: Ukuhamba ngendiza kungaba yinto esabekayo kubantu babo bonke ubudala kanye nemvelaphi, ikakhulukazi uma bengakaze bahambe indiza ngaphambili noma beye babhekana nesenzakalo esibuhlungu.
ref: Ukuhamba ngendiza kungaba isenzakalo esithusayo kubantu beminyaka yonke nezizinda zonke, ikakhulukazi uma bengakahambi ngendiza ngaphambili noma uma behlangabezane nesenzakalo esishaqisayo.

src: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
mt: Akukhona into okumele ube namahloni ngayo: akuhlukile ekusabeni nokungayithandiyo abanye abantu abaningi.
ref: Akuyona into yokuba namahloni ngayo: ayihlukile ekwesabeni komuntu siqu nokungathandwa kwezinye izinto abantu abaningi abanakho

src: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
mt: Kwabanye, ukuqonda okuthile ngendlela izindiza ezisebenza ngayo nokuthi kwenzekani ngesikhathi endizeni kungasiza ekunciphiseni ukwesaba okusekelwe kokungaziwa noma ekutheni awukwazi ukulawula.
ref: Kwabanye, ukuzwisisa okuthile kokuthi indiza isebenza kanjani nokuthi kwenzekani phakathi nokundiza kungabasiza ukuthi banqobe ukwesaba okusekelwe ezintweni ezingaziwa noma ukungaphathi izintambo.

src: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
mt: Izinkampani zezithuthi zikhokhelwa kahle ngokuletha izinto ngokushesha. Ngokuvamile, isikhathi sibaluleke kakhulu ngemibhalo yebhizinisi, izimpahla noma izingxenye ezisele ukuze kulungiswe ngokushesha.
ref: Izinkampani ezithutha impahla zikhokhelwa kahle ngokuthumela impahla ngokushehsa. Ngokuvamile, isikhathi sibalulekile ngamaphepha ebhizinisi, impahla ethengwayo ukuze idayiswe noma enye impahla edingekayo ukuze kwenziwe ukulungisa okusheshayo.

src: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
mt: Kwezinye izindlela, izinkampani ezinkulu zinezindiza zazo, kodwa kwezinye izindlela nezinkampani ezincane kwakunenkinga.
ref: Kwezinye izindlela, izinkampani ezinkudlwana zinezindiza zazo, kodwa kwezinye izindlela nezinkampani ezincane bekunezinkinga.

src: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
mt: Uma bathumela izinto ngomkhumbi, kwezinye izindlela kungase kuthathe izinsuku ukudiliza nokulayisha kanye nokuthumela izimpahla.
ref: Uma bebathumele zonke izinto ngebhanoyi, kwezinye izindlela bekuzothatha izinsuku ukwehlisa imithwalo nokudlula kwabahlola amaphepha.

src: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
mt: Indlela kuphela yokuyiyisa ngokushesha kwakuwukuthumela njengempahla ebhalisiwe. Imithetho yezindiza ayiyi kuvumela ukuba ithumele impahla ngaphandle komgibeli, okulapho ungena khona.
ref: Indlela elula yokuyingenisa ngokushesha ukuthi uyithumele njengomthwalo ohloliwe. Imithetho yezinkampani zezindiza angeke ibavumele ukuthumela umthwalo ngaphandle komgibeli, okuyilapho ungena khona.

src: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
mt: Indlela esobala yokundiza esigabeni sokuqala noma sebhizinisi ukuphaza imali eningi ukuze uthole ilungelo (noma, okungcono nakakhulu, yenza inkampani yakho ikwenzele lona).
ref: Indlela esobala yokugibela egumbini lendiza elibizayo noma labebhizinisi ukukhipha imali eningi yalelo lungelo (noma, okugcono, wenze inkampani yakho ikwenzele lokho).

src: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
mt: Kodwa-ke, lokhu akubizi: njengemithetho elukhuni, ungalindela ukukhokha imali efinyelela kokune kunemali evamile yebhizinisi, futhi izikhathi eziyishumi nanye yeklasi lokuqala!
ref: Noma kunjalo, lokhu akufiki kalula: njengomthetho obekiwe, ungalindela ukukhokha izikhathi eziphindwe kane kunenani elivamile lomnotho webhizinisi, kanye nezikhathi eziyishumi nanye ezingeni lokuqala!

src: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
mt: Ngokuvamile, akukho njongo ngisho nokufuna izaphulelo zezihlalo zebhizinisi noma zeklasi lokuqala ezindizeni eziqondile ezivela ku-A kuya ku-B.
ref: Ngokuvamile, akusizi ngisho nokufuna izaphulelo ezihlalweni zabebhizinisi noma ezinethezekile ohabweni lwendiza oluqondile olusuka ku-A luye ku-B.

src: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
mt: Izindiza zamazwe azi kahle ukuthi kunamaqembu athile abagibeli abazimisele ukukhokha imali ephezulu ngenzuzo yokufinyelela endaweni esheshayo nekhululekile, futhi bakhokhe ngokufanele.
ref: Izinkampani zezindiza zazi kahle ukuthi kuneqembu elithile eliyisisekelo labagibeli bezindiza abazimisele ukukhokha ama-dollar aphezulu ukuze bathole ilungelo lofika endaweni ethile ngokushesha futhi ngokunethezeka, futhi babakhokhisa ngokufanele.

src: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
mt: Inhlokodolobha yaseMoldova yiChişinău. Ulimi lwendawo luyiRomanian, kodwa isiRashiya sisetshenziswa kakhulu.
ref: Inhlokodolobha yaseMoldova yiChișinău. Ulimi lwendawo isiRomaniya, kodwa isiRashiya sisetshenziswa kabanzi.

src: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
mt: IMoldova iyirephabliki enezinhlanga eziningi eye yahlupheka ngenxa yokungqubuzana ngokobuhlanga.
ref: I-Moldova iriphabhuliki yezinhlanga eziningi ehlushwe imibango yobuhlanga.

src: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
mt: Ngo-1994, le ngxabano yaholela ekwakhiweni kweRiphabhuliki yeTransnistria ezimenyezelwe empumalanga yeMoldova, enohulumeni wayo nemali yayo kodwa engaziwa yiliphi izwe elingamalungu e-UN.
ref: Ngo-1994, lombango waholela ekumenyezelweni kweRiphabhuliki yokuzimisa yaseTransnistria empumalanga Moldova, enohulumeni wayo nohlobo lwemali kodwa engaqashelwa yinoma yiliphi izwe eliyilungu le-UN.

src: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
mt: Izixhumanisi zezomnotho ziye zabuyiselwa phakathi kwalezi zingxenye ezimbili zaseMoldova naphezu kokwehluleka kwezingxoxo zezombusazwe.
ref: Izixhumanisi zezomnotho zenziwe kabusha phakathi kwalezi zingxenye ezimbili zaseMoldova yize behlulekile ezinxoxweni zepolitiki.

src: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
mt: Inkolo enkulu eMoldova ubuKristu obu-Orthodox.
ref: Inkolo enkulu eMoldova ngamaKristu angama-Orthodox.

src: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
mt: I-Izmir yidolobha lesithathu ngobukhulu eTurkey elinabantu abangaba yizigidi ezingu-3.7, itheku lesibili ngobukhulu ngemva kwe-Istanbul, kanye nendawo enhle kakhulu yezokuthutha.
ref: I-İzmir iyidolobha lesithathu ngobukhulu e-Turkey elinabantu abangaba izigidi ezingu-3.7, isikhungo esikhulu sesibili ngemva kwe-Istanbul, okuyindawo enezokuthutha ezikahle.

src: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
mt: Idolobha laseSmirna elalikade lilidolobha lasendulo, manje seliyisikhungo sezentengiselwano esimanje, esithuthukile nesimatasa, esiseduzane nogwaja omkhulu futhi sizungezwe yizintaba.
ref: Kuqala okwakuyidolobha laseSmirna, manje kuyisikhungo sokuhweba sesimanje, esithuthukile, kanye nesiphithizelayo, esisethekwini elikhulu futhi nesizungezwe izintaba.

src: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
mt: Izindlela ezibanzi, izakhiwo ezibhalwe ngengilazi nezindawo zokuthenga zesimanje zinophahla olwalunethayela elibomvu, imakethe yekhulu le-18, namasonto amadala, nakuba idolobha linomoya waseYurophu yaseMedithera kunaseTurkey yendabuko.
ref: Umgwaqo obanzi okakwe izihlahla, izakhiwe ezinezingilazi ezinkulu kanye nendawo nezikhungo zezitolo zinophahla olungokwesiko olubomvu, imakethe yangekhulu lama-18 leminyaka, kanye namathempeli namasonto, nakuba idolobha linomoya omningi weYurophu yaseMedithera kunaseTheki engokwesiko.

src: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
mt: Idolobhana laseHaldarsvík linombono wesigodi esiseduze sase-Eysturoy futhi linesonto elingavamile elinamagoli ayisishiyagalombili.
ref: Umuzi waseHaldarsvík unezindlela zokubona isiqhingi esiseduze sase-Eysturoy futhi unesonto elingavamile elinezinhlangothi eziyisishiyagalombili.

src: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
mt: Esangweni, kunemifanekiso ethungathiwe yamamarufa ethinta inhliziyo yamajuba ngaphezu kwamathuna athile.
ref: Egcekeni lesonto, kunemifanekiso yemabula ethakazelisayo yamajuba phezu kwamathuna amanye.

src: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
mt: Kuwufanele isigamu sehora ukuhambahamba kulowo muzi othakazelisayo.
ref: Kuyifanele ingxenye yehora ukuhambahamba emzaneni othakazelisayo.

src: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
mt: Enyakatho futhi ekufinyeleleni kalula idolobha elithandekayo nelikhangayo laseSintra futhi elaziwa ngabangaphandle ngemva kokuba lichaze kahle ubuhle balo obalotshwa nguLord Byron.
ref: Ngasenyakatho futhi efinyeleleka kalula idolobha elinezabathandanayo nelithakazelisayo laseSintra elenziwa laduma ebantwini bakwamanye amazwe ngemva komlando walo okuhle wobukhazikhazi balo obhalwe iNkosi uByron.

src: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
mt: Ibhasi i-Scotturb 403 ihamba njalo iya eSintra, imisa eCabo da Roca.
ref: Ibhasi le-Scotturb 403 liya eSintra njalo, ime e-Cabo da Roca.

src: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
mt: Futhi enyakatho vakashela iNdlu Engcwele enkulu yeNkosikazi Yethu yaseFatima (Shrine), indawo yokubonakala kukaMariya edumile emhlabeni wonke.
ref: Futhi ngasenyakatho vakashela Indawo Engcwele enkulu yeNkosazane Yethu uFatima (indawo yokukhulekela), indawo yemifanekiso kaMariya edumile emhlabeni jikelele.

src: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
mt: Sicela ukhumbule ukuthi ngokuyisisekelo uvakashela indawo yamathuna omphakathi, kanye nendawo enencazelo engenakulinganiswa engxenyeni ebalulekile yabantu bomhlaba.
ref: Siza ukhumbule ukuthi empeleni uvakashela ithuna okungcwatshwe kulo abantu abaningi, kanye nendawo ebaluleke kakhulu kubantu abaningi basemhlabeni.

src: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
mt: Kusenabantu abaningi abesilisa nabesifazane abaphilayo abasinda esikhathini sabo lapha, futhi abaningi ababenabathandekayo ababulawa noma abasebenza khona, amaJuda kanye nabangewona amaJuda.
ref: Kusenabesilisa kanye nabesifazane abaningi abaphilayo abahlala lapha, kanye nabaningi abanabathandekayo babo ababulewe noma abasebenze baze bafela lapha, amaJuda kanye nokungebona amaJuda ngokufanayo.

src: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
mt: Sicela uphathe isayithi ngesithunzi, isithunzi nenhlonipho elifanele. Ungenzi amahlaya nge-Holocaust noma ngamaNazi.
ref: Siza uphathe le ngosi ngaso sonke isithunzi, isizotha kanye nenhlonipho eyifanele. Ungenzi amahlaya ngokuQothulwa kwesizwe noma amaNazi.

src: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
mt: Ungonakalisi indawo ngokubeka uphawu noma ngokukhasa imidwebo ezakhiweni.
ref: Musa ukungcolisa isiza ngokuphawula noma ukwenza imifanekiso esodongeni ezakhiweni.

src: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
mt: Izilimi ezisemthethweni zaseBarcelona ziyiCatalan neSpanishi. Cishe ingxenye ithanda ukukhuluma isiCatalan, iningi liyasiqonda, futhi cishe wonke umuntu uyazi iSpanishi.
ref: Izilimi ezisemthethweni zaseBarcelona isiCatalan neSpanishi. Cishe ingxenye ithanda ukukhuluma isiCatalan, iningi liyasizwisisa, futhi cishe wonke umuntu uyasazi iSpanishi.

src: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
mt: Kodwa-ke, izimpawu eziningi zibhalwe ngesiCatalan kuphela ngoba umthetho usimisile njengolimi lokuqala olusemthethweni.
ref: Nokho, izimpawu eziningi ziboniswe kuphela ngesi-Catalan ngoba simiswe ngokomthetho njengolimi lokuqala olungokomthetho.

src: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
mt: Nokho, isiSpanishi sisetshenziswa kakhulu ezokuthutha zomphakathi nakwezinye izindawo.
ref: Nokho, iSpanishi sibuye sisetshenziswe kabanzi ezithuthini zomphakathi kanye nakwezinye izindawo.

src: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
mt: Izimemezelo ezijwayelekile eMetro zenziwa ngesiCatalan kuphela, kodwa ukuphazamiseka okungahleliwe kumenyezelwa uhlelo oluzenzakalelayo ngezilimi eziningi kuhlanganise neSpanishi, isiNgisi, isiFulentshi, isi-Arabhu nesiJapane.
ref: Izaziso ezivamile eDolobheni Elikhulu zenziwa ngesi-Catalan kuphela, kodwa iziphazamiso ezingahleliwe zimenyezelwa ngohlelo lomshini ngezilimi eziningi ukuhlanganisa isi-Speyini, isiNgisi, isiFulentshi, isi-Arabhiya kanye nesiJapani.

src: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
mt: Abantu baseParis banedumela lokuzicabangela bona, ukungaziphathi kahle nokuziqhenya.
ref: Abantu basePherisi banedumela lokuqhosha, ukuba luhlaza kanye nokuzidla.

src: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
mt: Nakuba lokhu kuvame ukuba yisimo esingaqondile, indlela engcono kakhulu yokuzivumelanisa eParis kusalokhu ukuba ube nokuziphatha kwakho okuhle kakhulu, uziphathe njengomuntu "okhuliswe kahle". Kuzokwenza kube lula kakhulu ukuhamba.
ref: Nakuba lokhu kaningi kuyinto eshiwo abanye enganembile, indlela enhle yokuphila eParis kusase ukuziphatha kahle, uziphathe njengomuntu o-"bien élevé" (okhuliswe kahle). Kuzokwenza ukuphila kube lula kakhulu.

src: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
mt: Izindawo zangaphandle ezingalindelekile zaseParis zizoshintsha ngokushesha uma ubonisa ubuhle obuyisisekelo.
ref: Ingaphandle eliluhlaza labantu baseParis lizonyamalala ngokushesha uma uveza imikhuba emihle eyisisekelo.

src: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
mt: Ipaki kazwelonke yamachibi asePlitvice inezihlahla eziningi, ikakhulukazi izihlahla ze-beach, i-spruce, ne-fir, futhi inezinhlobo eziningi zezitshalo zase-Alpine neMedithera.
ref: Ipaki lezwe lePlitvice Lakes ligcwele izihlahla kakhulu, ngokuyinhloko line-beech, i-spruce, kanye nezihlahla ze-fir, futhi inenhlanganisela yezimila zase-Alps kanye naseMedithera.

src: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
mt: Inemiphakathi yezitshalo ehlukahlukene kakhulu, ngenxa yobubanzi bayo bezimo zezulu ezincane, inhlabathi ehlukene namazinga aphakeme ahlukahlukene.
ref: Inezinhlobo eziningi eziphawulekayo zemiphakathi yezitshalo, ngenxa yokwahluka kwesimo sezilu sayo esikahle, umhlabathi ongafani kanye namazinga okuphakama ahlukile.

src: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
mt: Le ndawo iphinde ibe nekhaya lezinhlobo eziningi zezilwane nezinyoni.
ref: Lendawo ibuye ibe yikhaya lezinhlobo ezingi zezilwane kanye nezinyoni.

src: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
mt: Izilwane ezingavamile ezifana ne-European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, cat yasendle kanye ne-capercaillie zingatholakala lapho, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi ezivamile
ref: Izilwane eziyivelakancane ezinjengebhere elinsundu laseYurophu, impisi efana nenketshane, ukhozi, isikhova, indabushe, ikati lasendle kanye ne-capercaillie zingatholakala lapho, kanye nezinye izinhlobo ezivamile.

src: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
mt: Lapho bevakashela izindlu zamasonto, abesifazane kudingeka bagqoke iziketi ezihlanganisa amadolo futhi bavale namahlombe abo.
ref: Lapho bevakashela amamonasteli, abesifazane kudingeka bagqoke iziketi ezemboza amadolo futhi bamboze namahlombe wabo.

src: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
mt: Izindlu eziningi zendlu yesigodlo zinikeza izimpahla zokugqoka zabesifazane abafika bengalungiselelwanga, kodwa uma uletha eyakho, ikakhulukazi eyodwa enemibala egqamile, uzothola ukumomotheka kommonki noma umlaleli emnyango.
ref: Amamonasteli amaningi anezembozo zabesifazane abeza bangalungile, kodwa uma uza nesakho, ikakhulukazi esinemibala ekhanyayo, ungamomothekelwa indela lowesilisa noma elesifazane esangeweni.

src: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
mt: Ngokufanayo, amadoda kudingeka agqoke amabhulukwe ahlanganisa amadolo.
ref: Ngokufanayo, abesilisa kumelwe bagqoke amabhulukwe azombhoza amadolo abo.

src: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
mt: Nalena ingabolekwa esitokisini esingeneni kodwa leyo mpahla ayihlanzwa ngemva komsebenzisi ngamunye ngakho-ke kungase kungabi lula ukugqoka lezi zingubo. Usayizi owodwa ufanelana namadoda!
ref: Lokhu futhi kungabolekwa ezimpahleni ezisendaweni yokungena kodwa leyo mpahla ayihlanzwa ngemva komsebenzisi ngamunye ngakho kungenzeka ungazizwa ukhululekile ukugqoka lesi siketi. Usayizi owodwa olingana amadoda onke!

src: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
mt: Ukudla kwaseMoldorca, njengakwamanye amazwe afanayo aseMedithera, kusekelwe esibukweni, emifino nenyama (ikakhulukazi ingulube), futhi kusetshenziswa uwoyela womnqumo kuyo yonke indawo.
ref: I-Majorcan cuisine, njengaleyo yezindawo ezifanayo eMedithera, isekelwe esinkwa, imifino kanye nenyama(ingulube ikakhulukazi), futhi isebenzisa amafutha omnqumo kuyo yonke indawo.

src: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
mt: Isidlo sakusihlwa esilula esidumile, ikakhulukazi ehlobo, yi- Pa amb Oli: Isinkwa namafutha omnqumo, utamatisi, nanoma yiziphi izinongo ezitholakalayo njengoshizi, i-tunafish, njll.
ref: Idina elilula elithandwayo, ikhakhulukazi phakathi nehlobo, yiPa amb Oli: Isinkwa namafutha omnqumo, utamatisi, kanye nanoma yiziphi izinongo ezikhona njengoshizi, inhlanzi ye-tuna, njalo njalo.

src: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
mt: Zonke izisimilo, eduze kwegama elithi Sie kuwe, zihlala ziqala ngezinhlamvu ezinkulu, ngisho nasenkabeni yomusho.
ref: Wonke amabizo, kanye negama elithi Sie kuwe, ahlala aqala ngosonhlamvukazi, ngisho noma ephakathi komusho.

src: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
mt: Le yindlela ebalulekile yokuhlukanisa phakathi kwezenzo ezithile nezinto.
ref: Lena indlela enhle yokuhlukanisa phakathi kwezenzo ezinye kanye nezinto.

src: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
mt: Kungase futhi kwenziwe lula ukufunda, nakuba ukubhala kuyinkimbinkimbi kancane ngenxa yesidingo sokuthola ukuthi isenzo noma isimilo sisetshenziswa ngendlela enesici.
ref: Ngokobufakazi obukhona kwenza ukufunda kube lula, nakuba ukubhala ngandlelathile kwenziwa inkimbinkimbi ngenxa yesidingo sokuthola ukuthi isenzo noma isiphawulo sisetshenziswa ngohlobo oluphathelene nosobizo.

src: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
mt: Ukubiza kulula ngesi-Italian njengoba amagama amaningi akhulunywa ngendlela efanayo
ref: Ukuphimisela cishe kulula ngesiNtaliyane njengoba amagama amaningi aphinyiselwa ngedlela efanayo nabhalwe ngayo

src: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
mt: Izinhlamvu eziyinhloko okumele uziqaphele yilezi c no-g, njengoba ukuphinyiselwa kwazo kuyehluka kuye ngokuthi yiliphi ijwabu elandelayo.
ref: Izinhlamvu eziyinhloko okumelwe uziqaphele u-c no-g, njengoba ukuziphimisela kuhluka ngokusekelwe kunkamisa olandelayo.

src: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
mt: Futhi, qiniseka ukuthi ukhuluma r no rr ngendlela ehlukile: caro kusho othandekayo, kuyilapho carro kusho inqola.
ref: Qiniseka ukuthi ubiza uhlamvu u-r kanye nezinhlamvu u-rr ngokuhlukile: u-caro usho ukuthi othandekayo, kuyilapho u-carro esho inqola.

src: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
mt: IsiPersian sinohlelo lolimi olulula futhi ngokuvamile olujwayelekile.
ref: IsiPheresiya sinohlelo lolimi olulula futhi oluvamile kakhulu.

src: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
mt: Ngakho-ke, ukufunda lo mbhalo wokuqala wolimi kuzokusiza ufunde okuningi ngolimi lwesiPheresiya futhi uqonde imisho kangcono.
ref: Ngakho-ke, ukufunda lencwadi yokusiza ukufunda uhlelo lolimi kungakusiza ufunde okuningi ngohlelo lolimi lwesiPheresiya futhi uqonde imisho kangcono.

src: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
mt: Akungabazeki ukuthi uma wazi ulimi lwesiRomance, kuzoba lula kuwe ukufunda isiPutukezi.
ref: Akungabazeki ukuthi, uma wazi ulimi loThando, kuyoba lula ngawe ukufunda isiPutukezi.

src: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
mt: Nokho, abantu abayazi kancane iSpanishi bangase baphethe ngokuthi isiPutukezi siseduze ngokwanele ukuba singadingeki sifundwe ngokwehlukana.
ref: Nokho, abantu abasazi kancane iSpanishi bangase baphethe ngokushesha ngokuthi isiPutukezi siseduze kakhulu kangangokuthi akudingeki ukusifunda ngokuhlukile.

src: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
mt: Izindawo zokuqapha ngaphambi kwesikhathi samanje ngokuvamile aziphelelwe yisikhathi namuhla, futhi zisaqhubeka njengezindlu zeminyuziyamu, noma izindawo zemfundo.
ref: Izinto zangaphambi kwenkathi yamanje ngokuvamile azisasetshenziswa namuhla, futhi zihlala kumamyuziyamu, noma izindawo zokufundisa.

src: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
mt: Njengoba ukungcola kokukhanya ngesikhathi sabo sokuphakama kwakungeyona inkinga enjengalezi namuhla, ngokuvamile kutholakala emadolobheni noma emakhaya, kulula ukufinyelela kuwo kunalawo akhiwe ezikhathini zanamuhla.
ref: Njengoba ukuphazamisa kokukhanya ngesikhathi sokudlondlobala kwazo kwakungeyona inkinga okuyiyona namuhla, ngokuvamile zitholakala emadolobheni noma ezikoleni, zitholakala kalula kunalezo ezakhiwe ngezikhathi zanamuhla.

src: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
mt: Izinhloli-mlilo eziningi zesimanje ziyizindawo ezinkulu ezindaweni ezikude ezinezimo zomoya ezilungele.
ref: Izindawo eziningo ezaziwayo zesibonakude ziyizindawo ezingaziwa ezindaweni ezinesimo esithandekayo.

src: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
mt: Ukubuka izimbali ze-cherry, okubizwa ngokuthi i-hanami, sekuyingxenye yamasiko aseJapane kusukela ngekhulu lesi-8.
ref: Ukubuka ama-cherry eqhakaza, okwaziwa ngokuthi i-hanami, kube ingxenye yesiko laseJapani kusukela ngekhulu lama-8 leminyaka.

src: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
mt: Umqondo wavela eChina lapho izimbali ze-plum kwakuyimbali ekhethwayo.
ref: Umcabango uvela eShayina lapho izimbali zepulamu kwakuyimbali ethandwayo.

src: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
mt: EJapane, imikhosi yokuqala ye-cherry flower yayibanjelwe umbusi kuphela yena namanye amalungu esigaba sobukhosi esizungeze iNdlu Yobukhosi.
ref: EJapani, imicimbi yokuqala yokuqhakaza kwama-cherry yabungazwa umbusi eyibungazela yena kuphela kanye namanye amalungu ohlobo lobukhosi lwasezweni Esigodlweni saseBukhosini.

src: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
mt: Izitshalo zibukeka kahle kakhulu lapho zisesimweni semvelo, ngakho zimelane nesilingo sokususa ngisho nesampula "lilodwa nje".
ref: Izitshalo zibukeka kahle kakhulu lapho zisendaweni yazo engokwemvelo, ngakho gwema isilingo sokususa nesifanekiso “esisodwa nje”.

src: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
mt: Uma uvakashela ingadi elungiselelwe ngokomthetho, ukuqoqa "amasampuli" nakho kuzokwenza ukuba uphonswe ngaphandle, ngaphandle kwengxoxo.
ref: Uma ukuvakashela ingadi ehlelwe ngokomthetho, ukuqoqa "izifanekiso" kuzobuye kukwenze ukhishwe, ngaphandle kwengxoxo.

src: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
mt: ISingapore ngokuvamile iyindawo ephephile kakhulu futhi kulula kakhulu ukuhamba kuyo, futhi ungathenga cishe noma yini ngemva kokufika.
ref: I-Singapore ngokuvamile iyindawo ephephile kakhulu ukuba kuyo kanye nokulula ukuhamba kuyo, futhi ungakwazi ukuthenga cishe noma yini ngemva kokufika.

src: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
mt: Kodwa njengoba usendaweni "ephakeme yezindawo ezishisayo" degrees ezimbalwa enyakatho ye-equator kuzodingeka ubhekane nokushisa (ngaso sonke isikhathi) nelanga elinamandla (lapho isibhakabhaka sicacile, kuncane kakhulu).
ref: Uma ubekwe “emazweni aphezulu anokushisa okukhulu” amadigiliyi ambalwa nje enyakatho nenkabazwe kuzodingeka ubhekane nokushisa (njalo) kanye nelanga elishisa kakhulu (lapho libalele, okungavamisanga ukwenzeka).

src: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
mt: Kukhona namabhasi ambalwa aya enyakatho eya eHebroni, indawo yendabuko yokungcwaba okhokho baseBhayibhelini u-Abrahama, u-Isaka, uJakobe, nabafazi babo.
ref: Kubuye kube namabhasi ambalwa aya enyakatho eHebroni, indawo engokwesiko yokungcwaba izinzalamizi zaseBhayibhelini u-Abrahamu, u-Isaka, u-Jakobe, kanye namakhosikazi wabo.

src: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
mt: Hlola ukuthi ibhasi ocabanga ukulithatha liya eHebroni hhayi nje kuphela endaweni yamaJuda eseduze yaseKiriyat Arba.
ref: Hlola ukuthi ibhasi ocabanga ukuligibela liya eHebroni yini futhi hhayi indawo yamaJuda eseduze yaseKiryat Arba.

src: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
mt: Imigwaqo yamanzi engaphakathi kungaba yindaba enhle yokwakha iholide.
ref: Imisele yamanzi emaphakathi nezwe kungaba umbono omuhle wokusekela iholide kuwo.

src: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
mt: Ngokwesibonelo, ukuvakashela izinqaba eLoire Valley, e-Rhine valley noma ukuthatha uhambo oluya emadolobheni athakazelisayo e-Danube noma ukuhamba ngesikebhe eduze kwe-Erie Canal.
ref: Ngokwesibonelo ukuvakashela izigodlo eSigodini saseLoire, isigodi saseRhine noma ukuthatha uhambo ngomkhumbi oluya emadolobheni athakazelisayo kuyiDanube noma ukuhamba ngesikebhe kuyi-Erie Canal.

src: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
mt: Zihlukanisa futhi izindlela zemigwaqo ethandwayo yokuhamba ngezinyawo nokuhamba ngebhayisikili.
ref: Babuye basho nezindlela zemizila yokuqwala izintaba nokuhamba ngamabhisikili.

src: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
mt: UKhisimusi ungomunye wemikhosi ebaluleke kakhulu yobuKristu, futhi ugujwa njengosuku lokuzalwa lukaJesu.
ref: UKhisimusi elinye lamaholide abalulekile ebuKristwini, futhi ligujwa njengosuku lokuzalwa kukaJesu.

src: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
mt: Amasiko amaningi azungeze leli holide amukelwa futhi abangakholwa emazweni angamaKristu kanye nabangebona amaKristu emhlabeni wonke.
ref: Amasiko amaningi ahlobene namaholide amukelwe abantu abangewona amakholwa emazweni obuKristu nabangewona amaKristu emhlabeni jikelele.

src: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
mt: Kukhona isiko lokudlulisa ubusuku be-Easter ngivukile endaweni ethile evelele ukubona ukuphuma kwelanga.
ref: Kukhona isiko lokuhlala ungalali kuze kuhlwe ngobusuku bePhasika endaweni ethile ukuze ubone ukuphuma kwelanga.

src: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
mt: Kunokuchazwa kwezenkolo zobuKristu kwalomkhuba, kodwa kungase kube yisiko langaphambi kobuKristu leNtwasahlobo nokuzala.
ref: Ngokuqinisekile kunezincazelo ezingokwenkolo yobuKrestu zaleli siko, kodwa kungenzeka kube isiko langaphambi kobuKrestu laseNtwasahlobo nesiko Lokuzala..

src: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
mt: Amasonto anendabuko avame ukwenza i-Easter Vigil ngoMgqibelo ebusuku phakathi nempelasonto ye-Easter, futhi amabandla avame ukuqala ukugubha ukuvuka kukaKristu phakathi kwamabili.
ref: Amaningi amasonto akudala asazibamba Izinkonzo zePhasika njalo ngoMgqibelo ebusuku ngesikhathi sempelasonto yePhasika, nebandla nalo libungaze ngokuhlanganyela ezinzulwini zobusuku kubungazwa ukuvuka kukaKrestu.

src: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
mt: Zonke izilwane ezafika kulezi ziqhingi ekuqaleni zafika lapha ngokubhukuda, ukundiza noma ukudilika.
ref: Izilwane ezafika eziqhingini ekuqaleni zafika lapha ngokubhukuda, ngokundiza noma ngokuntanta.

src: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
mt: Ngenxa yendawo ende ukusuka ezwenikazi izilwane ezincelisayo azikwazi ukwenza lolu hambo okwenza umnyama omkhulu ube yisilwane sokuqala sokudla e-Galapagos.
ref: Ngenxa yebanga elide kusuka ezwekazini izilwane ezincelisayo bezingakwazi ukuthatha uhambo okwenza ukuba izimfudu ezinkulu kakhulu zibe yizilwane eziklabayo eziyinhloko kumaGalapagos.

src: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
mt: Kusukela kufika umuntu e-Galapagos, kuye kwethulwa izilwane eziningi ezincelisayo kuhlanganise nezimbuzi, amahhashi, izinkomo, amagundane, amakati nezinja.
ref: Kusukela ekufikeni komuntu eGalapagos, izilwane ezincelisayo eziningi zalethwa kuhlanganise nezimbuzi, amahhashi, izinkomo, amagundane, amakati kanye nezinja.

src: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
mt: Uma uvakashela izindawo zase-Arctic noma e-Antarctic ebusika uzobona ubusuku be-polar, okusho ukuthi ilanga aliphumi ngaphezu kwezulu.
ref: Uma uvakashela izindawo zase-Arctic noma e-Aantarctic ebusika ungabona ubusuku obuthatha amahora angaphezu kuka-24, okusho ukuthi ilanga alisi ngaphezu komkhathizwe.

src: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
mt: Lokhu kunikeza ithuba elihle lokubona i-Aurora borealis, njengoba isibhakabhaka sizoba mnyama cishe ubusuku nemini.
ref: Lokhu kunikeza ithuba elihle lokubona i-Aurora borealis, njengoba isibhakabhaka sizoba mnyama kakhulu noma ngaphansi phakathi newashi.

src: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
mt: Njengoba izindawo zinabantu abambalwa, futhi ngenxa yalokho ukungcola kokukhanya ngokuvamile akuyona inkinga, uzokwazi futhi ukujabulela izinkanyezi.
ref: Njengoba izindawo zingahlali abantu abaningi, nokuphazamisa kokukhanya kungavamanga ukuba inkinga, uzokwazi futhi ukujabulela izinkanyezi.

src: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
mt: Isiko lomsebenzi laseJapane linobuhlelo futhi linomthetho kunalokho abantu baseNtshonalanga abajwayele.
ref: Isiko lokusebenza laseJapani lilandelana kakhulu futhi lihlelekile kunalokho labo abahlala emazweni aseNtshonalanga okungenzeka ukuthi bakujwayele.

src: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
mt: Izingubo ziyingubo ejwayelekile yebhizinisi, futhi osebenza nabo babizana ngamagama abo omndeni noma ngeziqu zomsebenzi.
ref: Amasudi ayindlela yokugqoka evamile ebhizinisini, futhi abasebenza ndawonye babizana ngezibongo zabo noma ngohlobo lomsebenzi.

src: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
mt: Ukuvumelana emsebenzini kubalulekile, kugcizelelwa umzamo weqembu kunokugcwala impumelelo yomuntu ngamunye.
ref: Ukusebenza ngokubambisana endaweni yokusebenzela kubalulekile, ukugcizelela ukusebenza njengeqembu kunokutusa umuntu ofeze okuthile.

src: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
mt: Izisebenzi ngokuvamile kumelwe zithole imvume yabaphathi bazo kunoma yiziphi izinqumo ezenzayo, futhi kulindeleke ukuba zithobele iziqondiso zabaphathi bazo ngaphandle kokubuza.
ref: Abasebenzi kumele kaningi bathole imvume yabaphathi babo nganoma yiziphi izinqumo ebazenzayo, futhi kulindeleke ukuthi balalele imiyalo yabaphathi babo ngale kokuthini.
